name: Extern
tags: Education; Marketplace; eLearning; Recruiting; Remote Work
one_liner: Professional Experience Anytime, Anywhere.
long_description:
At Extern, we’re solving the experience gap.  Extern created the remote Externship, a skill-building work experience that is easier for students to access, and easier for companies to run, than an internship.  Our mission is to help anyone discover and launch their career through professional experiences available anywhere at any time.  Since 2020, we’ve created and powered Externships for over 50,000 students on behalf of companies from Fortune 500s to startups.  

After spending $100K on average for a 4-year degree, graduates find that almost 40% of entry level jobs on Linkedin required 3+ years of work experience. Internships are how many college students get this kind of experience, but the demand for good internships outstrips the supply. Internship programs are difficult to scale, they favor students who already have social capital, and they’re time-consuming for employers to run.

Externships are short, online, project-based work experiences that employers can offer to hundreds of students using less resource and employee time than it would take to support an intern.  Extern makes the complex process of running an Externship completely turnkey with software and industry experts which in turn makes professional experience more accessible to more students.

By making work experience more accessible, Extern is driving the rapid mobility and upskilling needed for a new economy.  We envision a world where anyone can access work experience as a form of education – no matter their background, experience, or socio-economic status.  Come join our movement to reshape work, education, and credentialing for future generations with the Externship.

Extern was born out of a pivot from Paragon One (W17) which initially focused on providing students with a career center-as-a-service platform, connecting them with industry professionals to receive career coaching and guidance.  Backed by Y Combinator, Foundation Capital, Launch Fund, University Ventures, and Learn Capital.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote

name: FAZZ

long_description:
FAZZ is the leading all-in-one finance platform for businesses in Indonesia and Singapore. We are a b2b neobank with payment acceptance capabilities. The company is the market leader among underbanked segments such as warungs / startups and is building a super-app to serve mid-market and enterprise clients. Core features are: 

* Accept payments (e-wallet, bank transfer, credit card)
* Business Cash Account (earn 4% interest)
* Transfer / Pay (payment API's, corporate card, invoice processing via software)
* Lending (instant settlement, invoice financing)
* Value-add SaaS (inventory management, expense management)

FAZZ processes more than $6 bn of annualized GTV for companies of all sizes (from warungs to fortune 500s) and has achieved $25 mm of annualized Revenue. 

The company has raised over $74 mm USD from top tier global investors such as Tiger Global, DST, Y Combinator, B Capital Group, and Insignia Ventures. The founders are ex Amazon, Grab, Quora, and Traveloka.
regions: Indonesia; Southeast Asia; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Faire
one_liner: The global online platform empowering independent retail.
long_description:
Faire is an innovative online marketplace that uses machine learning to match local retailers with the brands and products that uniquely fit their stores. We are using the power of technology to connect brands and independent retailers from all over the world, building a thriving community of hundreds of thousands of retailers, which has resulted in over 7 million new connections to date. Faire was founded on the belief that the future of retail is local.

Our mission is to empower brands and retailers to strengthen the unique character of local communities. Our data-driven approach unburdens retailers from decades-old obstacles by helping find the right products for their shop. Plus, our straight-forward financial terms level the playing field by eliminating inventory risk and providing access to capital—key offerings previously only available to big box chains. For brands, our platform provides powerful sales, marketing, and analytics tools that simplify their business and allow them to focus on what they love: making great products.

outcome_analysis: Faire built a wholesale marketplace for independent retail and rose to a 12.59 billion post-money valuation in May 2022. It cut 20 percent of staff in November 2023 and roughly 250 more later, then employees sold shares at 5.2 billion in November 2025. Fortune reported in November 2026 that it is eyeing an IPO, and acquisition talks with Shopify were rumored but unconfirmed.

The platform provides a cheaper and more efficient solution than buying outright or hiring from rental shops. At the same time, it allows others to monetise their rarely-used possessions.

The company's mission is to enable people to share and monetize their unused possessions, increasing the efficiency of both the consumer and the planet’s resources.

The acquisition fits a mid sized marketplace exit rather than a venture scale outcome, helped by insurance, design and a loyal user base.

Feather is redefining furniture rental for city living and helping people feel at home no matter where they live or how long they plan on staying. By giving people smarter options, Feather is able to keep more furniture in homes and out of landfills.

Monthly furniture payments can go toward ownership or you can simply return the furniture you no longer need. Those items endure our extensive refurbishment process before they are sent to live in their next home. Our reverse logistics platform allows our customers to swap and add new furniture at any time, helping limit furniture waste.

It survived the pandemic with a pivot to remote workers and businesses but sold in November 2023 to Vesta alongside Fernish for an undisclosed price, and its consumer rental service was later discontinued. The inventory heavy model and the post 2021 funding drop most plausibly explain the soft exit, though sources do not state the cause.

long_description:
Flock Safety provides the first public safety operating system that empowers private communities and law enforcement to work together to eliminate crime. We are committed to protecting human privacy and mitigating bias in policing with the development of best-in-class technology rooted in ethical design, which unites civilians and public servants in pursuit of a safer, more equitable society. 

Our Safety-as-a-Service approach includes affordable devices powered by LTE and solar that can be installed anywhere.  Our technology detects and captures objective details, decodes evidence in real-time and delivers investigative leads into the hands of those who matter. 

While safety is a serious business, we are a supportive team that is optimizing the remote experience to create strong and fun relationships even when we are physically apart. Our flock of hard-working employees thrive in a positive and inclusive environment, where a bias towards action is rewarded. Flock Safety is headquartered in Atlanta and operates nationwide. We have raised $150M in our Series E led by Tiger Global at a $3.5B valuation.

The main risk is regulatory and reputational backlash, with dozens of localities canceling or pausing contracts over immigration data sharing, lawsuits and a Senate inquiry.

 * Following up with sales prospects
 * Maintaining relationships
 * Task delegation (put FollowUpThen in the bcc field)
 * Just-in-time reminders to get a task done (pay bills, etc)

In today's workplace we are bombarded with realtime demands on our attention. FollowUpThen answers this trend by making work more asynchronous, allowing you to place information in the future,  giving you freedom and peace of mind in the present and allowing you actually get something done. Easy to learn. Hard to outgrow.

name: Goodcover
one_liner: Digital Co-op Renters Insurance = half the price, better coverage.
long_description:
Goodcover provides its Members with Good Renters Insurance for 50% less than legacy companies and an Annual Dividend of the money left over after claims obligations are met.

Goodcover is a Managing General Agent (MGA) that administers personal insurance on behalf of our Membership, a bit like how USAA does it.

Member's premiums are pooled and used to pay claims.  We take a fixed fee, and the remainder is returned in our Annual Member Dividend.

We work with multi-billion dollar capital partners to ensure regulations are followed, adequate claims capital is always available, and we have emergency capacity for catastrophes.

Technology allows us to eliminate waste, saving roughly 25% of the cost.  We are 100% digital, but not bots - we invest in tech that enables our experts to help Members.

As an Invitation Only Membership served by an MGA, **we can give Members Free Insurance** when they invite others, turning our "Marketing Budget" into savings for Members.  This eliminates Lizards and Sales Agents, saving the other 25%.
We do not use the standard industry models, instead using a multiperil model to more granularly price risk.  This means that for a few of you we are more expensive... but everyone else pays much less than they would otherwise pay.

Our granular, multiperil model allows us to offer a superior policy over the standard market including:
    - coverage for if your place is flooded by a neighbor
    - Replacement Cost Coverage (meaning new stuff for your old)
    - All Risk coverage for high value items you tell us about - including computers (almost no one does that amazingly)
    - added coverage for mold removal

Our MGA business model allows us to be capital efficient, "renting" capacity as we need it.

All this adds up to our government approved pricing being 40-60% cheaper on average than that of our competitors.

name: Headstart

We provide leading organisations with a solution designed to help them transition away from experience/qualification based screening and towards a more inclusive and effective process which considers personality, behaviours, strengths and motivations. In doing so, Headstart helps companies hire people truly aligned to their values, culture and exact job requirements in a seamless, engaging way.

The Headstart process is simple and effective: companies save time and money by finding candidates who meet their exact job requirements at an earlier stage, and job seekers connect directly with businesses through an engaging, reusable 15 minute application form. outcome_analysis: Headstart grew to enterprise clients such as Accenture, Vodafone and Expedia according to the acquirer's release, then sold in August 2022 for a reported 14 million dollars in stock to a small OTC listed holding company. That price and buyer suggest a modest outcome rather than a venture scale exit. Founders stayed on as board members after the deal. Funding history is unclear from reliable sources.

name: Helix Nanotechnologies

long_description:
Technology finds information and delivers physical products to us almost instantly. mRNA does the same for biology. At HelixNano, we see a world where treatments are cheap, progress is decentralized, and you can modify biology at the push of a button.

By focusing on mRNA improvements from first principles, we’re getting there faster than we thought. Experiments that used to take months or years can be done in weeks and cost thousands instead of millions. The rate limiting step for our progress is now scientific curiosity.

Rigid hierarchies and top-down decisions will miss the magic. Some of our most powerful technologies started out as side projects of junior team members. At HelixNano, every individual scientist can have a massive impact on the company's direction. And the more diverse our team, the faster we’ll find the really cool ideas.

We've started rolling out some of our new tech — moving a COVID-19 vaccine candidate for the immunocompromised towards the clinic, and testing an intervention with massive environmental impact. But we’re scientists at heart, and team focus is solidly on the horizon.

name: Oncobox
one_liner: Finding the right cancer drug for each patient.
long_description:
Oncobox believes that many late-stage cancer patients are dying prematurely because doctors lack a data-driven tool to help them decide which drugs currently on the market would most effectively fight individual patients’ specific cancers. That’s where Oncobox comes in. Oncobox is low-cost personalized genetic profiling to help doctors decide which drug to use. In a recent study conducted by leading cancer researchers in Europe and Asia on 900 patients with various late-stage cancers, Oncobox increased the effectiveness of targeted therapies from 25% to 64%.

How does Oncobox work? Over 150 targeted cancer drugs are currently on the market. But deciding which of these drugs to give to late-stage cancer patients is not a simple task. Cancer doctors are in a race against the clock. They don’t always know which medication will be most effective for their patients. Because these drugs are expensive and typically have significant side effects, they can’t just try them all. Because of these barriers, targeted cancer therapies are effective only 25% of the time, and 70% of patients with late-stage cancers die due to the toxic side effects of ineffective drugs.

Oncobox Dx analyses tumor DNA, RNA, and molecular pathways using algorithms to distinguish which molecular targets are the most crucial for individual cases. Doctors receive a clinically actionable report that shows them which drugs are likely to be most effective on the patient.

We actively seek partners from pharma, hospitals/clinicians, payers, and genomic centers. Feel free to contact us at hello@oncobox.com. 

Our team and the scientific advisory board consisting of leading scientists and researchers from UCLA, Stanford, Johns Hopkins University, Boston University, Tufts University, and Rutgers University.

name: Peer5
one_liner: P2P delivery network that enables high quality video streaming
long_description:
Peer5's P2P CDN improves content delivery for live and on demand video streams. As video streaming continues to become more mainstream and the streams themselves become HD and 4K, traditional CDNs struggle to deliver high quality viewing experiences. Many publishers try to keep up with peak demand by paying for more servers, many of which are almost never used and struggle with video playback. Not only is this expensive, but it's also inefficient, which is why at Peer5, we've created a P2P CDN to boost your video streaming capabilities. 

Our CDN works with your servers to ensure that as your viewership increases, your network gets stronger by offloading bandwidth to our peer network. On average, this has been shown to increase server capacity by 20x, offload 70% of bandwidth, increase viewing time by 30% and decrease instances of rebuffering by 40%.

Our video streaming CDN uses emerging technologies, including HTML5 and WebRTC. They require no installation by end users and offer easy integration for content providers. We support many different streaming protocols, players and media servers.

product_category: Peer to peer video delivery network, eCDN

outcome_analysis: Peer5 sold a WebRTC peer to peer video CDN, raised a 2.5 million dollar seed after YC in 2017 and about 3.5 million dollars in total according to VentureBeat, and found a niche as an enterprise eCDN. name: Lucy Goods, Inc
one_liner: Lucy’s mission is to reduce tobacco-related harm to zero. We provide…
long_description:
If it isn’t bad enough that smokers don’t realize the scientific facts about nicotine, most non-tobacco nicotine products are poorly designed and unappealing to use. The leading gum is sold like a pharmaceutical drug, with flavoring and packaging to match. Vapes provide a cumbersome, over-the-top experience — with use as tightly restricted as cigarette smoking itself, but more juvenile, conspicuous, and highly addictive. People want, and deserve, a better way.

Therefore, we want to deliver nicotine users a superior experience, and at the same time give them a way to transition out of feeling dependent. In a better society, people wouldn’t carry around the sensation that they’re stuck with an involuntary habit. Our mission isn’t to encourage nicotine use among people who haven’t started. Unlike certain vapes or other products, ours isn’t the sort coveted by underage users on social media. Our mission is to alleviate the harm related to tobacco — first and foremost, by switching people away from the most harmful products.

So, at Lucy, we take an evidence based view of nicotine. Nicotine’s pleasurable properties make it an inevitable part of modern society. Therefore, minimizing harm in all nicotine products is key, in addition to giving people products and strategies for cessation. We feel that, as 1,300 people are dying of tobacco related illnesses every day in the US, the most important and immediate step toward a better society is giving nicotine consumers products they enjoy using that will cause less harm.

Our first product is designed to appeal to smokers and encourage them to switch. And, looking ahead, we hope to secure approval in the future as a clinically proven smoking cessation aid, while continuing to participate in the FDA’s public hearings around how NRTs are best regulated. Our goals are simple: because harm reduction is a better strategy around nicotine delivery than abstinence or prohibition, we want to help improve public health — and reduce its costs — through a superior pure nicotine product.

outcome_analysis: Lucy is still operating and expanded from gum into lozenges and pouches, with a $10M Series A led by RRE in February 2020 and a company claim of more than 100,000 customers. The founders came from Soylent and had direct consumer-packaged-goods experience, which fits the DTC model. With this technology, we can take any patient derived cell, whether it be blood, skin or fat and reprogram (convert) them into medically relevant cell types. Our first objective is to cure hair loss by using our reprogramming technology to make new hair (patent pending).  This is different from everything currently available on the market because the hair loss industry is focused on maintaining the hair that you already have, but no one is trying to produce NEW hair, de novo.  After hair, we envision using our cellular reprogramming technique to make any cell, any tissue or any organ on demand to replace what is lost as we age.

name: Accept.inc (formerly BoardRE)
one_liner: BoardRE is a new type of mortgage company that upgrades any offer…
long_description:
In a transaction powered by Board, sellers and agents are doing business with Board -- not the buyer.  We act as an intermediary buyer of a home, using our cash to buy homes for the 80% of homebuyers who need and qualify for a mortgage. By removing the lender from real estate transactions,  sellers and agents to close in as little as 2-3 days and buyers can lock-in their homes of choice at the best possible price before closing on their mortgage. 

With Board, buyers can "Buy Now. Mortgage Later" so everyone can have a cash deal.  

We differentiate ourselves from others in the "iBuyer" market by allowing anyone to have an all cash deal as opposed to buying, fixing and flipping properties for ourselves (e.g. Opendoor, OfferPad...etc). Board works directly with national lenders to evaluate the creditworthiness of buyers upfront and will use a short term credit facility to facilitate the purchasing of homes.

outcome_analysis: BoardRE launched in Colorado in 2019 after a 7M USD first round, renamed itself Accept.inc in October 2020, and raised about 90M USD of debt and equity in June 2021 as housing boomed. name: Arpeggio Bio
one_liner: Arpeggio Bio develops drugs targeting transcription factors using AI…
long_description: Arpeggio Bio is a pioneering pharmaceutical company that develops drugs targeting transcription factors using AI and high-throughput RNA-sequencing. With $20M in venture funding, we've targeted "undruggable" proteins like NRF2, TEAD, and GPX4 where our lead program is rapidly progressing towards a DC for the treatment of IO-resistant melanoma. With partnerships with J&J and FORMA, we've validated our platform in rare disease and inflammation with a significant Phase I success.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada

business_model: Biotech drug discovery with collaboration revenue and venture funded pipeline

The cause is a failing lead drug program, a technical biology risk rather than a market problem.

name: Ashby
one_liner: All-in-one recruiting platform that empowers hiring excellence in…
long_description:
At Ashby, we're improving the productivity of working professionals with intelligent and powerful software. We put a lot of effort into designing products that are approachable to beginners but mastered & extended by power users. In many ways, spreadsheets set the bar here.

Our first products provide talent teams with clever automation, powerful analytics tools, and customizable workflows packaged in great UX. We have many paying customers who love us and use us every day like Opendoor, Airtable, Duolingo, and Notion. Notion's Head of Talent said Ashby is "probably the tool we are in the most and rely on the most, as a recruiting team."

Our culture is motivated by Abhik's (my co-founder and Head of Engineering) and my belief that a small talented team, given the right environment, can build a great product and service fast (and work regular hours!). We hire exceptional, kind, thoughtful people and provide an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work.

We are well funded and backed by great investors, including Y Combinator, Elad Gil, and Lachy Groom. We'll share more once we meet!
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Talent and recruiting teams at startups, mid-market and enterprise companies that pay for an applicant tracking system and recruiting analytics
problem: Existing ATS products were fragmented and weak on analytics, scheduling and sourcing. Teams stitched several tools together.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for recruiting teams
product_category: Applicant tracking system and recruiting platform
market_need_then: The founders interviewed over 100 talent leaders and recruiting operations leaders before building (Ashby story page) and say analytics and reporting were a large gap in existing tools.
outcome_analysis: Ashby grew from a YC all in one recruiting tool into a growth stage ATS with more than 4,400 customers by 2026 per its own keynote. It raised a Series B in 2022, a 30 million dollar Series C in June 2024 and a 50 million dollar round in July 2025, with total funding of about 70 million dollars after Series C. Analytics led positioning, fast customer growth in tech companies and repeat investors drove the result. It is a strong outcome so far with no exit.

name: Asher Bio
one_liner: We build better immunotherapies
long_description:
Asher Bio is a biotechnology company developing precisely targeted immunotherapies for cancer and other diseases. Our cis-targeting platform aims to enable selective activation of specific immune cell types, addressing the inherent limitations of otherwise pleiotropic immunotherapies that act on multiple cell types. Our approach has the potential to precisely direct different immune mediators against a range of target immune cell-types and create best-in-class immunotherapies in cancer, autoimmune and infectious diseases. 

Asher Bio is backed by Third Rock Ventures and is located in South San Francisco.
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; San Carlos, CA, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Pharma and oncology patients treated through Asher's own clinical programs; commercially, biopharma partners and eventual payers for cancer and chronic infection immunotherapies
problem: Cytokines such as IL-2 activate many immune cell types at once, which causes toxicity and limits efficacy. Asher builds cis-targeted cytokines that act only on chosen cells such as CD8 T cells.
business_model: Venture-funded clinical-stage biotech; pipeline development with clinical collaboration and supply agreements, no product revenue
product_category: Biotech, cis-targeted immunotherapy (engineered IL-2 fusion proteins)
market_need_then: IL-2 was a validated but toxic cytokine; Sanofi paid about $2.5B for Synthorx in December 2019 and Merck later agreed to buy Pandion, which signals strong demand for better-targeted IL-2.
outcome_analysis: Asher left YC in 2019 with a three-person team and raised a $55M Series A led by Third Rock in March 2021, a $108M Series B five months later and a $55M Series C in April 2024 with AstraZeneca and BMS joining. It is still active with a Phase 1b program and big-pharma combination deals announced in January 2025. Its success rests on a differentiated IL-2 platform in a market validated by Sanofi's Synthorx purchase, plus an experienced CEO hired in 2020. Clinical risk remains and no pivotal data are public.

Whether the pivot is a durable success is not yet clear.

name: Atomic Alchemy
tags: Hard Tech; Small Modular Reactors; Medical Devices
one_liner: We produce cancer-curing materials used in nuclear medicine.
long_description:
Atomic Alchemy is building a bank of reactors to produce the nuclear material that goes into nuclear medicine. Radiopharmaceuticals are vitally important in biological tracers, diagnostic imaging, and cancer treatments.

Currently, the world's supply of Molybdenum-99, the cornerstone of 80% of all nuclear medicine procedures, is sourced from just six government-run, scientific research reactors abroad. Five of these reactors are 45-65 years old and are quickly coming to the end of their operational life. This has cultivated a fragile and lengthy supply chain, at odds with the nature of radioactive material.

This issue and its implications do not just effect molybdenum, but any other reactor-based isotope. Many promising cancer therapies are stuck in clinical trials, unable to secure enough material in a timely manner. Research doesn’t even happen because of the difficulty of sourcing any new isotopes.

It doesn't have to be this way. Atomic Alchemy is working to solve this by building the world's first scalable radioisotope production facility. This facility will contain the world’s first privately-owned nuclear reactors dedicated to radioisotope production.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Nuclear medicine, industrial, research and defense buyers of radioisotopes
problem: Most Mo-99 comes from a few aging government reactors abroad. Atomic Alchemy aimed to build private reactors dedicated to isotope production in the US.
business_model: Radioisotope production and sales
product_category: Nuclear, medical radioisotopes
market_need_then: YC page notes Mo-99 supply depends on a few aging government reactors abroad. Physics Today in 2019 describes several competitors racing to supply it.
outcome_analysis: Atomic Alchemy, founded by a former Advanced Test Reactor engineer, sought to build private isotope reactors. It stayed small in disclosed funding and was acquired by Oklo for a reported 25M in stock after a November 2024 letter of intent, becoming a subsidiary. The sale looks like a strategic fit for Oklo's isotope plans rather than a scaled standalone business.

name: AudioFocus
one_liner: Hearing aids that work in noisy places, like restaurants, using ML.
long_description:
If we've learned anything in the last few years it's that spending time with our friends and family is essential to our well-being and happiness. Unfortunately, loud and noisy places like weddings and family gatherings hinder human connection, especially for the hearing impaired. In fact, the biggest unmet need in the entire hearing healthcare industry is hearing in noisy places. AudioFocus helps patients hear in these environments by only enhancing voices nearby the patients and ignoring ones farther away. We do this using acoustics informed machine learning and custom microphone array design.

Our goal is to increase the adoption rate of 37M US adults with hearing loss, only 8M use hearing aids today.

Founded by Auditory Neuroscientist & AI expert and a Hearing Aid hardware design expert.

market_need_then: YC copy cites 37M US adults with hearing loss of whom 8M use hearing aids, and noisy places as the top complaint; consistent with industry surveys of hearing aid dissatisfaction, but not independently verified here.
outcome_analysis: AudioFocus entered YC in Summer 2019 with an ambitious ML and microphone array hearing aid for noisy rooms. It remains independent with about 10 staff. Funding appears modest relative to retail analytics rivals, so traction rests on enterprise rollouts and capital efficiency rather than large rounds.

name: AuroraQ
one_liner: Building the first practical, integrated quantum computer.
long_description: At AuroraQ, we are building the world’s first truly practical quantum computing system.  This system integrates together different quantum components, each performing different functions with the data, including processing, communication, and memory.  Integration of different specialized components that efficiently work together to complete the calculation is precisely how classical computers work.  No other quantum hardware company has yet tackled the integration challenge.  AuroraQ will be the Dell of quantum computing, sourcing components from our partners to build a better quantum computer.

product_category: quantum computing hardware integration
market_need_then: Heavy public and corporate investment in quantum computing around 2019, but no evidence found of paying demand for an integrator.
outcome_analysis: AuroraQ was a Winter 2019 YC company in Waterloo that aimed to build the first practical integrated quantum computer from partner components. name: Avo
one_liner: Fixing data quality in product analytics.
long_description:
Avo fixes data quality in product analytics. Avo helps teams like Ikea, Wolt, Fender, Sixt and Condé Nast to plan, implement and monitor analytics, so they don't fly blind and fail to build great user experiences

Start your step-by-step path to settle your analytics debt:

Step 1: Better tracking plan management.
Avo is a better alternative to the "tracking plan spreadsheet", keeping your data quality high and your schema sync'd with all downstream tools. Import your tracking plan for an instant audit, then design more scalable data for every feature release, even before you're an expert.

Step 2: Better data validation.
Avo is ongoing observability of actual tracking compared with tracking plan. One-time install the Avo Inspector SDK to see what's wrong with your tracking today so you can start making it better.

Step 3: Better analytics release workflow.
Avo is the self-serve analytics governance, changing how PMs, devs and data scientists collaborate to plan, implement and verify their product analytics. What used to take Patreon 1-4 days for every feature release, now takes 30-60 minutes.

business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for analytics governance
product_category: Developer tools, product analytics data governance
market_need_then: Customers such as Patreon spent one to four days per feature release on analytics implementation, which Avo cut to 30 to 60 minutes per its YC listing.
outcome_analysis: Avo, the first Icelandic company in YC, raised a $3M seed led by GGV in September 2020 and launched Inspector. It has since built enterprise case studies (Delivery Hero, Sixt, Fender) and shipped product updates through 2025. No later rounds, acquisition or shutdown were found, so it appears a steady independent company with modest disclosed funding.

one_liner: A zero inventory, zero returns factory-to-consumer apparel company
long_description:
Getting clothes tailor-made is very common in India, especially for women. Saree blouses have to be tailor-made always due to their fitted nature & the non-stretchiness of typical Indian fabrics. 

The tailoring market however, hasn't evolved at all. It is highly fragmented with a low NPS. The end user experience demands a significant amount of the customer's time, involving visits to a physical shop & avoidable back & forth. This is increasingly unviable for busy urban Indian women. We make it super easy by letting women place an order online, get fitted at the comfort of their homes, help them with styling their fabric & deliver the made-to-measure clothes directly to their doorstep.

name: Caribou
one_liner: The autonomous tax firm
long_description:
Going global is now the norm. But the moment you set up an entity in another country, you inherit a tax and legal mess that compounds with every hire and every invoice. 

For example, one jurisdiction has to be profitable, cash has to move between entities compliantly, and every cross-border decision has to be audit-ready, which today means a different law firm in each country, a tax advisor on top of that, and you coordinating the chaos.

The real expertise is locked up inside the Big Four. The world's largest companies pay millions a year for access. Everyone else gets selective coverage and hefty legal bills to half-solve the problem.

Caribou is the first autonomous tax firm. No lengthy workshops, no months of back-and-fort; connect your finance and HR systems and we graph your business — every entity, process, and employee — into a model we call the Atlas. 

From there we check transfer pricing, surface legal risks you didn't know you had, maximise your R&D credits, and monitor for accidental taxes as your shape changes.

And we don't just hand you a report. We speak to your accountants, draft the legal agreements, and implement the fix ourselves. We've turned an 
eight-week engagement into three hours.

Why work with three firms when one does the job?

We're already working with fast-growing companies like Butternut Box, OpenFX, Encord, Vertice, Omnea, and Hadrian - we've saved them hundreds of thousands on legal fees and surprise tax bills.
regions: Portugal; Europe

problem: Cross-border groups inherit a tax and legal burden that today needs a different law firm and advisor in each country, with Big Four work that is slow and unpredictably billed.
business_model: Subscription software with transfer pricing experts and accountants built in
product_category: Tax and transfer pricing software with services
market_need_then: The 2019 TechCrunch article describes startups and mid-size companies juggling several bank accounts, with about 70 customers in the US, Canada and UK generating around 50 million dollars in transactions.
outcome_analysis: Rebank was accepted into YC W19 after an earlier rejection and raised a 2.8 million dollar seed in December 2019 led by ADV. The banking layer idea does not appear to have scaled, and the YC page says the company pivoted to Caribou in 2024 with a focus on transfer pricing for micro-multinationals. It is still active with about 10 people, so the outcome is still open and the reasons for the pivot are not public.

one_liner: EncepHeal develops medications to treat substance abuse, starting…
long_description:
EncepHeal is developing medications to treat substance abuse. Our first product is a small molecule therapeutic for stimulants like cocaine and methamphetamine, of which there are no FDA approved treatments.

Our small molecule technology are atypical inhibitors of the dopamine transporter. Cocaine itself is an inhibitor of the same transporter. Directly reducing craving or positive reinforcement is a successful treatment strategy for addiction. Methadone or buprenorphine (Suboxone) are key examples of this for opioid use disorder. However, these types of medications can be addictive themselves. This has been a major hurdle for medication development for cocaine addiction and has led to many leaders in the addiction space to abandon the dopamine transporter as a target. At EncepHeal, we believe that the dopamine transporter should not be abandoned and instead focusing on fixing the abuse liability problem. Therefore with our partners at the National Institutes of Health, we have shown that these new, allosteric modulators at the dopamine transporter do not display addictive tendencies in animal models. They are also effective at curbing cocaine addiction. 

Our management team has two co-founders, Omeed Rahimi and Aaron Lazarus, as well as an experienced addiction pharmacologist as their research officer. The team has an advisory board with entrepreneurial and addiction drug development experience as well as expert partners at the National Institute on Drug Abuse, a subset of the NIH, and Wake Forest.

Our team has had success in raising non-dilutive funding and has expertise with SBIR/STTR grants. We are looking for help in better connecting with the biotech/pharmaceutical industry.

name: GEn1E Lifesciences
one_liner: AI platform accelerating therapies for rare & inflammatory diseases.
long_description:
GEn1E Lifesciences is a Clinical-stage, multi-target company with a unique AI platform. We develop novel, next-generation, immunomodulatory therapies for rare & inflammatory diseases with no effective treatments. Our team is supercharging the drug development cycle by applying AI to multiple-mechanism-of-action protein targets and their natural platform capabilities—creating novel therapeutics at an unprecedented pace. Our AI platform has enabled us to develop a purpose-built therapy for ARDS to reduce its $20 billion cost on society (just in the USA). 
 
GEn1E has built a rich pipeline of 21+ novel and selective immunomodulators and has plans to accelerate 2 additional devastating diseases (beyond their lead indication) to IND in the next 12 months. Our AI platform enables tremendous pace and capital efficiency as demonstrated by our progress in ~2 years with seed capital—a stark contrast to the typical spend of $100M+ and 7+ years exhibited in the pharmaceuticals / biotech industry.
 
With ~90% of rare diseases having no therapeutic treatment at all, GEn1E is taking a giant swing that will hopefully bring life-saving therapies to the lives of patients in need.
 
The team at GEn1E has decades of experience in drug development and machine learning. We graduated from YCombinator and Stanford-StartX in late 2019. We are based in Palo Alto, CA.

product_category: AI enabled biotech, immunomodulator therapeutics
market_need_then: ARDS has no approved drug therapy and the company cites a 20 billion dollar annual cost in the US; the company says about 90 percent of rare diseases have no treatment.
outcome_analysis: GEn1E took a university licensed p38 program into a Phase 2 ARDS trial that began in April 2023 and lists an expected primary completion in late 2026, funded by what the company calls seed capital. It earned FDA orphan designations for a Duchenne indication and announced a strategic partnership with Rubicon Research. Funding amounts are only available from aggregators, and no exit or shutdown was found. Success will depend on the Phase 2 result.

This platform is a dual use technology for both commercial and military customers.

//

**SPACE PEOPLE**
Geosite is a cloud-based platform creating a comprehensive repository of geospatial data, such as satellite imagery, through the aggregation of public and commercially available data, providing market-wide ability to rapidly search, select, purchase, assemble, and manage data sets. This will not only create the most comprehensive and exhaustive marketplace for geospatial data and analytics, but also build the underlying data infrastructure for the geospatial industry. problem: Few fashionable women's options existed in college-licensed apparel; students were cutting up team T-shirts.
business_model: Direct and wholesale e-commerce apparel under league and university licenses
product_category: Licensed sports/collegiate apparel
market_need_then: Founders observed students modifying men's cut team apparel; licensors initially resisted, so they started with school colors.
outcome_analysis: Hype and Vice is active with 55 staff and over 350 licenses including NBA and MLS, after a reported 1.5 million dollar seed around the Summer 2019 batch. Success rests on founders who saw an underserved women's segment and on licensing relationships and campus bookstore distribution, though revenue and later funding are not public.

name: Hypnos
one_liner: AI-powered sleep coach learns and optimizes your sleep
long_description: Hypnos is an AI powered digital sleep journal that helps you discover how your habits impact your sleep. It does this by taking in your mood, daily activities, and pairing them with data from your sleep tracker. Delivering insights on how to improve your sleep and habits.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote

name: In The Room
one_liner: Connect with people around you—IRL
long_description: In The Room helps people get more out of the events they already attend. Connect it to your Eventbrite event and attendees can see who else is coming, pick out the people they want to meet, and keep the conversation going once the event is over. There’s nothing to download: everything works over email, text, and the web, with premium features in the app for people who want more. Organizers get a more engaged room, and sponsors get in front of an audience that showed up on purpose.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Event organizers and sponsors who want more engaged rooms, plus attendees who want to meet people at events they already attend
problem: Attendees at events rarely know who else is in the room or how to follow up with the people they want to meet. Organizers want engagement and sponsors want an audience that showed up on purpose.
business_model: Freemium consumer networking with premium app features, plus organizer and sponsor offerings tied to events (Eventbrite integration)
product_category: Event networking and attendee matching
market_need_then: Event organizers and sponsors valued engaged attendees and networking was a feature sold by dedicated vendors by 2017, but this research found no direct evidence of demand for the In The Room product itself.
outcome_analysis: The company is listed as active with one person and little public trace. No funding, press coverage or exit was found beyond a January 2025 item saying an In The Room software product would power a large marketing conference, which may or may not be the same company. With no traction data, the story is a solo founder building a small event networking tool in a space where funded rivals already existed.

name: InEvent
one_liner: In-Person, Hybrid and Virtual Event Management Software
long_description:
InEvent is an all in one platform that allows you to use multiple solutions (website, registration, mobile app, hospitality, check-in, badge printing, budgeting, etc) altogether, without having to upload data 3-4x times on different pages.

Everything is available on the cloud, 24x7, for you and your attendees. Most of our competitors have modules that don't talk with each other, we solved this by creating a solid foundation that all of our solutions are built upon.

We have already successfully improved more than 12,400 events, boosting more than 2,390,000 registrations so far. We have integrations with Salesforce, Marketo, Oracle, Microsoft and other vendors to create a simple, easy-to-use marketing ecosystem for all our customers.

Discover the InEvent Virtual Lobby, the top event marketing solution in the world today: https://inevent.com/en/virtual-online-streaming-events-room-events-innovative.php
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Corporate marketing teams, agencies and associations running in-person, hybrid and virtual events
problem: Event teams stitch together separate tools for websites, registration, apps, check-in and badges and re-enter data across them. InEvent says its competitors have modules that do not talk to each other.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscriptions plus white-label and services for event agencies
product_category: Event management platform
founder_names: Pedro Góes; Mauricio Giordano; Vinicius Neris
market_need_then: Event organizers used fragmented tools in 2019, and the 2020 shift to virtual and hybrid events greatly increased demand for event platforms. InEvent's own site claims 12,400 events improved at the time of the YC listing.
outcome_analysis: InEvent is active with about 150 people and an enterprise customer list. Its only verified round is a 2021 seed of $2M led by Storm Ventures, announced as virtual and hybrid events boomed. The 2020 pandemic shift in events was a tailwind. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff was found, but funding history beyond the seed is unconfirmed.

name: Inito
tags: Fertility Tech; Health Tech; Digital Health; Women's Health
one_liner: Enabling better self care with at-home hormone tracking.
regions: India; South Asia; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Women trying to conceive who buy a consumer at-home hormone monitor and test strips
problem: Ovulation tests give a yes or no on LH only. Inito measures estrogen, LH, PdG and FSH on one strip read by a smartphone-linked device to personalize fertile windows.
business_model: Consumer hardware starter kit ($149 with 15 strips) plus recurring test strip sales
product_category: At-home fertility hormone monitoring
market_need_then: Women trying to conceive already bought LH ovulation tests and fertility monitors in 2019, and Clearblue's monitor was an established but costly product. Inito targeted that existing spend with multi-hormone readings.
outcome_analysis: Inito is active with about 100 people and has raised a Series A in 2023 and a $29M Series B in December 2025, reaching about $45M total equity per press. It earlier raised about $9M from YC, physicians and family offices. Its multi-hormone strip differentiated it from single-hormone tests, and US launch followed.

name: Insight
one_liner: The first extensible browser for iOS
long_description: The first extensible browser for iOS
regions: Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Consumer iPhone users who want ad blocking, privacy and customizable browsing; planned a paid pro tier.
problem: iOS browsers lacked the extension ecosystem desktop browsers have, so users could not block ads, spot fake reviews or customize search.
business_model: Free consumer app with a planned paid pro version
product_category: Consumer mobile browser with extensions
market_need_then: Mobile traffic was large and iOS users could not use browser extensions; the company cited bad ads, SEO spam and misinformation (HackerNoon, 2021).
outcome_analysis: Insight went through YC in Winter 2019, reportedly with a different search idea, then launched an extensible iOS browser in February 2021 alongside a $1.5M seed. It depended on Apple's browser engine rules and had no clear moat. The YC page lists it as acquired, but no acquirer or deal was found, and a browser directory says the app was discontinued in 2023. The factors are low-confidence inferences, and the real cause is not public.

name: Instapath Inc.
one_liner: We built the world's first automated digital pathology lab.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Hospital pathology labs and research institutions that need fast digital images of fresh tissue
problem: Conventional pathology cuts, fixes and stains tissue, which takes time and consumes the sample. Frozen section takes about twenty minutes, destroys part of the sample and needs a pathologist on site.
business_model: Medical device sales of an imaging system for fresh tissue, with grant funding in early years
product_category: Digital pathology imaging device
founder_names: Mei Wang; Quincy Brown; David Tulman
market_need_then: Pathology is a slow bottleneck in cancer surgery and diagnosis, and NSF funded the project in 2018 on that need. Direct demand evidence from customers was not found.
outcome_analysis: Instapath is active and small, funded mainly by NSF grants and registered a Class I device in 2024 according to a directory citing a March 2025 Tulane interview. No equity round was found and database totals range from about $1.7M to $6M. The company is still in early commercialization, so it is neither a success nor a failure yet.

name: Intact Therapeutics
one_liner: Smart gels for local drug delivery to the gut
long_description: Intatct is developing an advanced materials platform to improve the way drugs are delivered and absorbed in the digestive tract. Our vision is to improve the treatment of a wide range of gastrointestinal disorders that are currently underserved.
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; Los Altos, CA, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Patients with gastrointestinal disease such as ulcerative colitis, reached through pharma partners and clinicians
problem: Systemic drugs for gut disorders cause side effects and reach the diseased gut poorly. Intact develops thermosensitive gels and micelle formulations for local delivery in the digestive tract.
business_model: Biopharma platform: develop and license or partner local drug delivery products
product_category: Local drug delivery for GI disease
market_need_then: Ulcerative colitis and other GI disorders have large patient populations and side effects from systemic drugs. A 2015 Stanford study showed a thermosensitive gel improved colitis in mice, and a small Phase 1 study followed.
outcome_analysis: Intact is active and small. It has run a Phase 1 study of a thermal gel for ulcerative colitis and now describes itself as clinical-stage. Funding found is small and grant based, and a stated goal of a $20M Series A is undated and unconfirmed. It is a long-cycle biotech that has not yet reached the milestone for a large round.

name: Intelline
tags: Alternative Battery Tech; Hardware; Alternative Fuels; Climate
one_liner: Intelline makes the world's most efficient fuel agnostic engines for…
long_description:
Intelline makes fuel agnostic engines for practical, clean, and low-cost industrial power. Our first customers are in data center energy infrastructure and oil & gas production. Our engine generate electricity with even the most difficult fuels like flare gas, while reducing fuel OPEX by 40%.

There are 1,000,000 new heavy duty engines produced per year, and at an average $50k per heavy duty engine this is a $50B market opportunity.

Our generator can efficiently run emerging fuel types that traditional diesel engines can't use (flare gas, syngas, ammonia, hydrogen), and can switch between fossil fuels and any other liquid/gaseous fuel while running. Full size running prototype successfully tested April 2025.
regions: Canada; America / Canada
target_customer: Operators of data center backup and prime power and oil and gas sites that burn flare gas and other hard fuels
problem: Heavy duty engines waste fuel and cannot run flexibly on difficult fuels such as flare gas, syngas, ammonia or hydrogen.
business_model: Energy-as-a-Service with fixed energy pricing and managed generators, plus gensets of 50kW to 2MW
product_category: Fuel-agnostic opposed-piston engines and generators
market_need_then: Industrial power users wanted lower fuel cost and flexibility for flare gas and future fuels. Direct demand evidence from 2019 was not found.
outcome_analysis: Intelline is active with three people and reports a full-size prototype tested in April 2025. Public funding is tiny, about $0.13M seed from YC per one database, so progress has been capital light. It is still pre-commercial, with generator rollout planned from 2028, so the outcome is unresolved.

name: InterPrime
one_liner: Safe & Secure Cash Management for Businesses
long_description:
Manage your money like a Fortune 500 company, whether you are about to IPO or still working in a garage. Dealing with financial institutions is painful. Yet it’s critical to keep your corporate cash safe & earning a reasonable rate of return. InterPrime helps you do that.

InterPrime helps you
1. Keep your cash safe
2. Earn a reasonable rate of return on your money
3. Assure your investors that you will responsibly steward their capital

More details at www.interprime.co
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; Menlo Park, CA, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Startups and companies holding large cash balances that want safe, higher-yield treasury management.
problem: Companies keep idle cash in low-interest bank accounts and dealing with financial institutions is painful; InterPrime promised safe custody, reasonable returns and investor-friendly stewardship.
business_model: Fee-based automated treasury management, SEC-registered investment adviser with custody at Interactive Brokers and Charles Schwab
product_category: Business treasury and cash management
market_need_then: The company's pitch stressed that treasuries for startups and private companies earned little on idle cash and that investors wanted responsible stewardship; no quantified demand evidence found.
outcome_analysis: InterPrime was a three-person YC Winter 2019 company offering automated corporate treasury with advisory registration and brokerage custody. No funding amounts were found beyond a site list of investors, and Rho absorbed it into Rho Prime Treasury, with terms undisclosed. Dates differ by source, from March 2021 to February 2022. With so little public data, whether it was a soft landing or a good outcome is unknown, so the factor is a tentative reading.

name: Intersect Labs
one_liner: Collaborative data noteboook for business teams
long_description: Bring your data from various sources, process it, send it to a destination of your choice (and repeat all of that in a few clicks every day/week/month)
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Business analysts and teams without data science skills who need predictions and data workflows
problem: Business teams need machine learning and recurring data workflows but lack engineers; Intersect automated model selection and later offered data apps and notebooks.
business_model: SaaS subscription for business teams
product_category: No-code machine learning and data notebook
market_need_then: Business teams wanted ML without engineers in 2019, but the launch coverage gives no customer or revenue data.
outcome_analysis: Intersect Labs began in 2018 as a no-code machine learning platform, went through YC S19 with a team of four, and by 2021 had pivoted to data apps and notebooks. YC lists it as acquired, but no acquirer, date, price or round could be found, so the story of the exit is not public. With undifferentiated tooling against cloud AutoML and fast-growing notebook rivals, it plausibly ended in a small acquisition rather than a venture outcome, but that is not documented.

name: JetPack Aviation
one_liner: Flying motorcycles
long_description: Our focus is on developing the smallest, fastest heavy lift optionally piloted VTOL aircraft. Our aircraft can be operated in urban environments with no risk of rotor strikes - we don't use rotor systems! Ship anything from downtown LA to downtown San Diego in 20 mins!
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Early on wealthy buyers of jetpacks and a flying motorcycle; later national defense, cargo, firefighting and disaster relief customers
problem: Personal vertical flight without rotors, so that a small, fast vehicle could operate in urban areas and carry cargo.
business_model: Aircraft and jetpack sales with pre-orders, later government and defense development
product_category: Personal VTOL aircraft and jetpacks
market_need_then: Demand was speculative and tied to novelty buyers and niche government uses. The Speeder was open for pre-order at $380,000 in March 2019 per press.
outcome_analysis: JetPack Aviation, now Mayman Aerospace, built flying prototypes and raised a $2M seed in November 2019 and $3M from the UAE Strategic Development Fund in February 2023. By April 2024 it pivoted toward military drones and planned to discontinue the jetpack, with a crewed version not expected before 2028. It remains active but capital is small for certification-heavy aircraft.

name: Juno College of Technology
one_liner: Juno is the university of the future.
regions: Canada; America / Canada
target_customer: Career changers and adult learners in Canada paying for coding bootcamps and continuing education
problem: Traditional higher education was slow and costly for people wanting tech careers; Juno offered intensive bootcamps and a pay-what-you-can income share model.
business_model: Tuition for bootcamps and courses, later income share agreements; later shift to training solopreneurs
product_category: Coding bootcamp and career college
market_need_then: Demand for coding bootcamps in Toronto was high in the mid 2010s, with five of Canada's seven main bootcamps there, and HackerYou was admitted to YC on the strength of a new tuition model.
outcome_analysis: HackerYou became Juno College in 2019 and was in YC Summer 2019 with a pay-what-you-can ISA model. In May 2023 it stopped admitting new students to its web development bootcamp and continuing education programs because job placements fell sharply. Course Report now marks the school closed, though the directory lists it Active and it planned a shift to solopreneur training.

name: JuziBot
one_liner: Intercom for WeChat, help companies to acquire,  engage, retain…
long_description:
JuziBot is a startup that provides smart marketing and sales services for customers on WeChat platform, the company helps SMBs build secure and stable key opinion customer (KOC) channels, as well as helps corporate clients with customer acquisition and sales conversion. JuziBot currently serves customers in education, insurance, healthcare, and a few other industries, some of the clients include Meituan Dianping, Digital China, Zuoyebang, etc., and 80% of these existing customers have been acquired through word of mouth. JuziBot's products have been known to improve the sales experience for one million sales professionals on a daily basis. 

The company is invested by a number of leading VCs including PreAngel, Plug and Play, Y Combinator, TSVC, and Alpha Startups. JuziBot received the CCFA Retail Technology Rising Enterprise Award in 2018. In 2018 and 2019, respectively, the company won the 1st place in both of the task-based human-machine dialogue response naturalness, and the chat-type human-machine dialogue assessment in the SMP Chinese Human-Machine Dialogue Technology Evaluation held by the Chinese Information Processing Society of China (CIPSC).
regions: China; East Asia; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Kalshi
one_liner: 1st federally regulated exchange where people can trade on events
long_description:
Kalshi (www.kalshi.com) is the first federally regulated exchange where you can trade on the outcome of events.  We built Kalshi because we believe that people should be able to capitalize on what they know and have opinions on. We make this possible by expanding what people can trade on and allowing them trade in the domain of everyday knowledge. 

Kalshi is developing a new asset class, “event contracts,” and a financial exchange for trading on the outcome of events: we are federally regulated by the CFTC as the first-ever legal futures exchange in the U.S. for trading on a broad category of events.
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; New York, NY, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Keeper
one_liner: AI tax filing for complex returns
long_description:
Keeper is AI tax filing for complex returns. We serve individuals and small businesses in the US. Today, over 50% of tax returns still get filed by accountants - that’s 75M returns a year. Unfortunately, great accountants are really hard to find, and the data shows most of them are retiring in the next 5-10 years. 

Keeper is the modern alternative. We use AI to automate most of the prep work, which frees up in-house human tax experts to focus on guidance and reviewing final results. The net outcome is that we’re able to deliver higher quality / more accurate returns at 50% of the cost of traditional accountants.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Kern Systems
one_liner: Using DNA to store data.
long_description:
DNA has emerged as a compelling data storage medium due to its density, longevity, and eternal relevance compared to current memory technologies. However, the high price of synthesizing DNA remains a major bottleneck for adoption of this promising storage solution. We are pioneering new approaches to synthesizing DNA for data storage with enzymes and custom digital codecs. We are building an interdisciplinary team to build the world's most scalable information infrastructure in DNA. 

We seek technical experts in enzyme engineering, chemistry, hardware engineering, and information theory. We also seek business development to identify emerging markets for early use cases of our technology.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada

name: Keynua
one_liner: E-signatures with identity verification for Latin America
long_description: Keynua is an E-sign platform that uses short video signatures which serve both to approve specific documents and provide the visual identity of the signatory, which is then confirmed using official records and social network profiles. All transactions are "notarized" on the Blockchain. Keynua stores encrypted versions of the identities of all signatories so that users may reuse them with other companies affiliated to the Keynua platform.

Our systems need 10x less construction materials compared to a conventional wind turbine and our systems cost half as much.

We believe that exploration and community make people whole. Kopa exists to inspire people to get out of their comfort zones, to form lasting relationships, and to live more fulfilled lives.

Kopa enables people to browse rentals, find roommates, and book and pay for spaces all online.

name: Kovi
one_liner: Making car ownership more inclusive, flexible and simple.
regions: Brazil; Latin America; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Brazilian and Mexican ride-hailing and delivery app drivers who want to rent or lease-to-own a car without a credit check.
problem: Only about 20 percent of Brazilians own a car and traditional rental companies serve only 20 to 30 percent of roughly 1 million app drivers, leaving many without access to a vehicle.
business_model: Car rental and subscription for app drivers, asset-light fleet sourced from automakers and rental firms, with a purchase option
product_category: Mobility and vehicle rental fintech
market_need_then: Few Brazilians owned cars, the number of app drivers was large and expected to double within five years per the CEO, and many drivers were underserved by traditional rental firms.
outcome_analysis: Kovi was founded in August 2018 by two ex-99 executives, raised a $10.5M seed in May 2019, a $30M Series A in November 2019 and a $104M Series B in August 2021 with Valor and Prosus, and grew to 12,000 cars by then. Capital-heavy rental and growth of Moove's global fleet led to an all-share sale to Moove in January 2025 at an undisclosed price. Later conflicting valuation estimates are unverified.

name: Kraftful
one_liner: Copilot for product teams
long_description: Helping product builders to listen to users at scale so they can make something people want.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Smart home hardware brands at founding; later product teams at software companies
problem: Smart home device makers had to build and maintain their own iOS and Android apps, which is costly and slow. Later the pain became listening to user feedback at scale.
business_model: B2B SaaS (app component platform at founding, later AI feedback analysis subscription)
product_category: Smart home app platform, later product feedback analysis
market_need_then: Smart home brands wanted branded apps without building them from scratch, per the Jan 2020 TechCrunch report of several unnamed large smart lighting, plug and thermostat customers.
outcome_analysis: Kraftful started as app infrastructure for smart home brands, raised a small $1M seed in January 2020 and $2M in February 2022, then reoriented toward AI feedback analysis for product teams. Amplitude acquired the team on July 10, 2025 for an undisclosed price and shut the standalone product on August 11, 2025, so the outcome looks like a small capability acquisition rather than a large exit.

name: KubeSail
one_liner: The Self-Hosting Company
long_description:
KubeSail is the home hosting company.

We make it easy to take back your privacy, fix the internet, and de-google all at once: host apps at home!

Plug in a spare PC or buy our custom home-hosting hardware https://pibox.io, install apps like PhotoPrism, NocoDB, and Minecraft, and enjoy complete ownership of your data. We build everything you need to make hosting at home viable and fun.

For companies, we make it easy to deploy software on-demand for your customers (either in the cloud, or by physically shipping them pre-configured hardware) to your users. Companies like ChatWoot use KubeSail Platform to deploy instances of their software dynamically, the moment a user pays.
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; Pasadena, CA, USA; Remote
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote

name: LAIKA
one_liner: Online pets supplies for Latin America with over 4000 products & 20…
long_description:
The top of mind for pets, the “one-stop shop” market in LATAM. A pet ecosystem that combines On and offline platform where pet owners will find a solution for all their needs, including products & services. 
Currently, to meet the needs of their pets, people must go to different places and platforms. To find products, they go to one place; for services, they go to several others; and for healthcare, a few more. In Colombia, in average, a person must visit or consult more than seven places per year to meet the needs of their pets.

We built a digital platform where users don’t have to go anywhere else to meet said needs. With two main sections; products and services. In the products section, we have more than 4,000 references (among which you can find most of the brands of food, snacks, medicines, accessories and others). In the services section, we have more than 17 services, all the healthcare, beauty and entertainment services. All of the above delivered straight to your home and with the flexibility of choosing the date and time on and at which you wish to receive the order, including same-day deliveries for the main cities and accepting all payment methods, both online and cash on delivery.
regions: Colombia; Latin America; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Pet owners in Colombia, then Mexico and Chile
problem: Pet owners had to visit many places for products, vet and grooming services.
business_model: Pet e-commerce with product margin, membership and services
product_category: Pet products and services e-commerce platform
founder_names: Camilo Sanchez; Manuela Sanchez; Tulio Jimenez
market_need_then: Portafolio reported in 2019 that Laika addressed fragmented pet purchases, and related Portafolio coverage says six in ten Colombian households own a pet.
outcome_analysis: Laika grew from a Colombian pet store into a three country platform, reporting 5x growth, 300,000 active users and 500 employees by January 2022, funded by seed, Series A and a 48M SoftBank led Series B. Strong membership sales and strong local press drove momentum; later retrenchment from Mexico is mentioned in coverage but not detailed.

name: LEAH Labs
one_liner: Living therapies for pets first, and their people next
long_description: LEAH Labs is building living therapies for pets first, and their people next. We're first focused on CAR-T cell therapy for dogs with B cell lymphoma, the naturally occurring clinical analog of human non-Hodgkin's lymphoma. CAR-T cells are curative in humans, and our early results are showing the same - we're inducing remissions in pets with late stage lymphomas. Our virus-free gene editing platform allows us to engineer a dose of CAR-T cell therapy for ~$500, and brings the promise of a curative outcome. Given our safety and efficacy data to date, we believe this product could be used by general practice veterinarians, meaning we have thousands of customers all across the USA who typically treat with palliative care or refer cancer patients to specialty oncologists. Our CAR-T cell platform is regulated by the USDA, not the FDA, affording us a cost effective "full stack" to iterate and innovate on CAR-T cell therapy from a hypothesis through clinical validation.

name: Legacy
tags: Fertility Tech; Consumer Health Services; Digital Health; Healthcare; Health & Wellness
one_liner: Legacy helps you test, improve, and freeze your sperm
long_description:
**TL;DR:** 

Legacy (YC S19) is a startup focused on the fast-growing field of fertility and family planning. Founded at Harvard, the company has now raised $40M from leading investors like FirstMark Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, Section 32, Tribe Capital, and even celebrities like Justin Bieber, The Weeknd, and others. 

**What we're doing**

We aim to change the outdated view that fertility is a "women's issue" by creating an accessible, affordable product for men & people with sperm. This includes everything from a mail-in kit for sperm testing & sperm freezing, personalized sperm improvement products, tele-health, DNA fragmentation analysis, supplements, and more.

**Why are we the leader?** 

The company was founded at Harvard by a team of healthcare and fertility experts. We obsess about talent density and have out-executed our competitors over the past few years. Beyond our D2C channel, we've also unlocked:

1. Nationwide insurance coverage (10M+ lives)
2. Military contracts (Including the Navy SEALs and 15M+ veterans)
3. Employer offerings (Working with the top fertility benefit providers)

**Tell me about the team** 

We're a team of about 30, extremely diverse (majority female, majority immigrants, strong LGBQTIA+ representation, age range of 25-65), and very values driven. Our 5 values are customer centricity, reliability, kindness, openness, and winning. 

Learn more about our values here:
https://khaled-legacy.medium.com/legacys-values-and-why-they-matter-db116539d3da

Learn more about our workplace here:
https://khaled-legacy.medium.com/how-and-why-legacy-is-reinventing-workplace-benefits-9e5fda6cb863

Read about our mission to humanize the path to parenthood:
https://khaled-legacy.medium.com/how-and-why-legacy-is-reinventing-workplace-benefits-9e5fda6cb863

Learn more about sperm and why it matters here:
docsend.com/view/zkgk7ws
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Cambridge, MA, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Men (and their partners) who want to test, improve or freeze sperm without visiting a clinic, including cancer patients, TRT users and people in high-risk jobs
problem: Male fertility testing and sperm freezing required awkward, expensive clinic visits and there was no trusted, convenient option; the founder started after a friend facing cancer treatment found no trustworthy storage.
business_model: Direct-to-consumer mail-in testing kits plus annual storage subscriptions, plus B2B partnerships and insurance

long_description:
Lofty is a marketplace that let's anyone sell a house to investors online. Instead of the typical real estate transaction where one seller sells to one buyer, Lofty is much more flexible.

Sellers fractionalize their equity ownership in the property into smaller units, so that anyone can buy a portion for as little as $50, allowing access to one of the best asset classes for people who have previously been locked out. Sellers can also sell a portion of their equity (starting at just 10%) instead of the entire property or create customized HELOC structures.

Investors can browse a variety of individual real estate properties ranging from commercial strip malls, a HELOC in someone's house, Airbnbs, to a single-family rental properties, and directly purchase ownership in these properties in under 5 minutes. There is no lockup period. Users can constantly trade these ownerships with others on the marketplace.

Investors truly legally own the properties they invested in and co-manage it with other investors through an online governance program. Owners have so far voted on how to handle various repairs, delinquent tenants, the sale of the underlying property, and much more.

Lofty never custodies or handles user funds or assets. Through smart-contracts on the blockchain, all transactions are directly peer-to-peer.

If we succeed, we'll have built the NASDAQ for real estate and transformed how real estate is bought and sold in the USA.

one_liner: On demand fuel delivery service in India
long_description:
Why did we pick this idea to work on? 
India is a country with 200 mln vehicles (about the same number as USA) but one third the number of gas stations(60K) as compare to USA(160K), The consequence of odd number of fuel stations is long queues of vehicles at the gas stations to fill up, heavily congested Indian roads make it worse. Opening of 100K new fuel stations is practically & economically impossible in urban localities due to rocketing high land prices. And that's how the idea of mobile refueling was conceptualized by founders. Literally "bringing the gas stations to doorsteps". The problem of buying fuel is much more alarming in large volume consumer segments such as Vehicle fleet users like schools, cab rentals, freight logistics operators , tours and travels operators, hospitals, hotels, real estate etc who burn huge amount of dead mileage & loss of productivity while sending all fleet vehicles to gas stations to fill up. Additionally, India has a unique problem of Electricity blackouts. Current avg. is less than 18 hours of a day of electricity in Indian metro cities, which causes more than 20 mln household and commercial buildings running on backup generators which require Diesel. They cant bring the generators to gas stations either therefore they buy Diesel in jerry cans or barrels and transport unsafely. Our solution is solving the desperate & daily need of Indian consumers along with convenience.

Do we have domain expertise in this area? 
Founder is ex veteran of Shell with 9 years of global experience, has complete understanding Oil marketing business.

How do you know people need what you're making? 
We have over 5000 registred large volume customers who are waiting to be served. With our limited number of refueling vehicles ,we could serve max 1200 customers currently. We got all these customers without spending a penny in marketing and promotion. Zero sales efforts. Additionally, we have received over 400 franchisee requests across India where people want to offer mobile refueling service their town validating the demand.

business_model: Fuel delivery with margin per litre plus delivery fee
product_category: On-demand fuel delivery

market_need_then: Indian fleets, hospitals and generator users relied on stations or bulk suppliers; KrASIA called it Uber for fuel and the company claimed demand across several cities.
outcome_analysis: MyPetrolPump raised about USD 1.6M in 2019 and operated in Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Pune before FuelBuddy acquired it in an all cash and stock deal announced May 9, 2021. Poverty, disease, hunger, climate change, war, existential risks, and inequality: The world faces many great and terrifying problems. It is these large problems that our work at Our World in Data focuses on.

Our World in Data publishes an open-access publication where users can understand the state of the world today, where we are making progress and where we are falling behind. Through a non-invasive 10 min breath test, PNOĒ analyzes the human breath and prescribes a personalized nutrition, exercise, breathwork, and bio-optimization (i.e., red light therapy, hyperbaric chamber, IV therapy, etc.) program based on one’s biological limitations. 3,000+ health professionals trust PNOĒ because it personalizes the clients’ journey through their clinics, builds retention by quantifying progress, and enables the upsell of personalized nutrition and breathwork. All this without any effort, time commitment, or upfront cost. PNOĒ has been independently validated by Georgetown University, VA in Maryland, and Rutgers University and is trusted by leading institutions including Cenegenics, Dais Cove, MIT, UCLA, Pan Pacific, CLMBR, UCS, OURA, TONAL, Spartan Racing, and Paris Saint Germain.

Building a home requires human labor to: measure, cut, lift, drill, paint, and attach. This labor is used for a building’s: structure, vapor barriers, windows, insulation, siding, roofing, electrical, plumbing, fixtures, appliances, and cabinetry.
