long_description:
Recall.ai is the API to get recordings, transcripts, and metadata from meetings. We offer several form factors to capture this data: 
1. Meetings bots
2. A desktop recording SDK
3. A mobile recording SDK

We integrate with meeting platforms like Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and more, as well as in-person meetings.

outcome_analysis: Recall.ai started in the W20 batch with a transcription tool and relaunched in 2022 as a meeting bot API as generative AI created demand for meeting data. Revenue reportedly grew from zero to several million dollars in under two years, it raised a 10 million Series A in May 2024 and a 38 million Series B in September 2025. Dependence on Zoom and Microsoft access is the key risk.

name: Recurrency
one_liner: Automated ERP for distributors.
long_description:
Recurrency is reversing enterprise resource planning (ERP) stagnation by building the industry-standard ERP automation platform: blazingly fast and complete with powerful automation tools like intelligent sales recommendations, dynamic pricing, and demand forecasting. Despite distribution being a multi-trillion dollar industry, the legacy ERP systems that exist to help businesses manage their purchasing, inventory, sales, order processing, and accounting are decades behind. 

For the most part, ERP systems are painfully slow, difficult to use, and soul-crushingly manual. Using Recurrency can boost a distributor’s revenue and profit margins, while reducing waste and saving time. Most importantly, Recurrency is fully integrated with the customer’s legacy system, so deploying Recurrency in production can be done in as little as one day.

product_category: ERP automation and demand planning for distribution
market_need_then: Over 600,000 US distribution companies with about 7 trillion dollars in revenue run on lock in ERPs (Bessemer 2023).
outcome_analysis: Recurrency, founded by a third generation distributor, sells a layer on top of legacy ERPs rather than replacing them. It raised a 22 million Series A led by Bessemer in February 2023 and is still active. Funding after that is not confirmed, and labels of Series B in aggregators are unverified.

name: RoboTire
one_liner: Robotire is automating vehicle maintenance for today and future…
long_description:
In a fleet-centric world where everything is delivered to your doorstep, cost-per-mile and uptime are all that matter. Vehicles will be driving more miles and the decreased complexity of electric motors will fundamentally change the automotive service industry. ROBOTIRE will bring manufacturing-level automation to vehicle servicing. 

Tires are the perfect vertical to tackle first because they are future-proof (tires are going nowhere) and scale from luxury personal automobiles to freight-centric big-rigs. The current tire changing industry is entrenched with an aging workforce but maintains strong margins. We will build and deploy a robotic tire changing container that can change tires in 10 minutes. 

Our fully-integrated ROBOTIRE containers can be placed inside existing shops, Walmart parking lots or in the middle of a fleet service area hundreds of miles away from a major city. In the medium term, we will expand to brakes, oil, batteries, etc. becoming an uptime assembly line that keeps fleets on the road 24/7 at a fraction of the maintenance cost per mile we see today. In a fleet-centric world, cost-per-mile and uptime are all that matter. ROBOTIRE tackles both.

name: Spenny

Spenny is the Acorns for India. Every time a user make any digital transaction, we round off the amount to the nearest 10 INR and invest it for them into a diversified portfolio, automatically.

400M millennials in India don't invest because they don't have enough time, knowledge or access to large capital. With Spenny, they just connect the card and invest every time they spend.

We're growing 67% WoW since launch, with 3,000+ users and $15,000 in AUM. Indians put $500Bn into their bank accounts annually. We charge 1.75% of the AUM for investments. That's a direct ~$9Bn market in India alone.

Potentially every time a user makes a transaction, we make money. And in that sense, the timing for Spenny couldn't have been better: 1 Trillion+ transactions are expected in 2021 because of factors like Whatsapp launching its P2P payments in India for its 400M users. And the emergence of UPI means every Indian has a virtual bank account now. 

More interesting revenue models develop from the transaction data insights of our users. We analyse the rich data to A) up-sell more financial products like insurance etc., and B) create brand loyalty programs & partnerships.

We acquire customers at minimal CAC by bank partnerships. We leverage the banks' existing users, by integrating with their mobile app. In turn, we invest into their mutual funds.

Our long-term vision is to become a one-stop asset management solution for millennials.

one_liner: Turns spreadsheets into internal apps and customer portals
long_description:
We let you create applications for your team, your partners or your customers, powered by the data you're already using.

Connect in your spreadsheets, Airtable or database and we'll automatically create an app for you.
regions: United Kingdom; Europe; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: SMBs and business teams that keep data in spreadsheets, Airtable or databases and need portals and internal tools
problem: Teams need apps and customer portals on top of spreadsheet data without engineers.
business_model: No-code SaaS subscription per team
product_category: No-code internal apps and portals
market_need_then: About 250 customers in Aug 2020 rising to 500 and $1M ARR by Jan 2021 per TechCrunch, mostly SMBs.
outcome_analysis: Stacker simplified its product in 2019, reached about 500 customers and $1M ARR by January 2021 on a $1.7M seed, then raised a $20M Series A led by a16z in August 2021. It remains Active with a small team; no later round or exit is found, so this is a solid early success that stalled or went quiet after the 2021 round, with public data ending there.

name: StartPlaying.Games
one_liner: Building Communities Through Play
long_description: ✨ Hello! ✨ - StartPlaying.Games is the largest marketplace for finding game masters to host digital tabletop games like D&D. Today, more than 40 million people play D&D around the world and sales have grown by double-digit percentages for the last five consecutive years. But still finding people to host and play these games with is challenging. Most solutions involve digging through discord servers, reddit, and specialty forums. We built StartPlaying.Games to solve this problem.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Players who want a hosted tabletop RPG game and pay a game master per session; game masters who earn money hosting
problem: Finding a game master and a group for online D&D meant digging through Discord servers, Reddit and specialty forums.
business_model: marketplace take rate on paid game master sessions
product_category: tabletop RPG game master marketplace
market_need_then: Early pandemic demand for online tabletop play. The seed press release states that more than 40 million people play tabletop RPGs and that almost half of new StartPlaying users had never played before.
outcome_analysis: StartPlaying.Games rode pandemic era demand for online tabletop play and raised a 6.5 million dollar a16z led seed in May 2022 with over 100,000 games hosted and more than 1,000 professional game masters. No later round, exit or layoff was found, so the company reads as active and small, with market size and take rate on a niche hobby as the open question.

name: Statiq.
one_liner: India's Largest EV charging network
long_description: Statiq connects electric vehicle owners to EV chargers. EV owners can discover chargers near them, pre-book a slot and pay for the usage conveniently. Property owners can buy, share their chargers, manage them and earn by becoming charger hosts with Statiq. Our EV chargers can be found at shopping malls, workplaces, restaurants , hotels, residential spaces.
all_locations: Gurugram, HR, India; Bengaluru, KA, India
regions: India; South Asia; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Indian EV owners who pay per charging session, and property owners, fleets and partners who host or buy chargers
problem: India had too few public chargers to make EV ownership practical, and property owners lacked an easy way to host and monetise chargers.
business_model: per session charging fees split with property hosts, charger sales, charging station management software and advertising
product_category: EV charging network and charger hardware
market_need_then: TechCrunch in August 2020 described pollution in Delhi, rising two and three wheeler EV adoption among a growing middle class, and government incentive approvals for EVs and charging stations. The founders reported growing 20 percent week over week with more than 150 stations installed.
outcome_analysis: Statiq started in October 2019, launched in May 2020 and reported 20 percent weekly growth at YC. By 2025 trade press put the network at more than 8,000 chargers and described partnerships with HPCL and BMW Group India, and in February 2026 it raised about 18 million dollars of equity and debt led by Tenacity Ventures. No layoffs or exit were found. Capital intensity remains the main risk.

name: StayQrious
one_liner: StayQrious helps kids in India learn through online group classes,…
long_description: Imagine doing personalised workouts with a fitness coach, but for school subjects. Students log into their session that has been scheduled with their coach, they can see their learning workout for the day. Their workout typically consists of watching an interactive video, writing explanations, giving feedback to other students, making an explainer video etc. They get constant feedback and encouragement from the coach and progress only after they have understood the pre-requisites.
regions: India; South Asia; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Parents of children in grades 3 to 8 in India who pay fees for live online group learning
problem: Indian school children get little personal coaching or mastery-based progression in large classes or recorded video courses.
business_model: B2C tuition fees for cohort-based online classes, later a full remote school with annual fee
product_category: K-12 online group coaching and remote school
founder_names: Shankar Ram A; Aanand Srinivas; Avinash Anand
market_need_then: Indian online K-12 demand rose sharply in 2020 as schools closed for COVID-19. The company launched around March 2020. No dated demand figure was sourced.
outcome_analysis: StayQrious raised a roughly $2M seed in September 2020 during the COVID online learning surge and is still active, with a reported team of 29. The current site sells a remote school with a high annual fee rather than the original group classes. No later round, exit, or layoff was found, so the long term outcome is unclear and no success or failure factor is well supported.

name: StratumAI
one_liner: AI that tells mining companies where to mine to maximize profits
long_description: The mining industry drills narrow holes in the ground called drillholes to identify how much gold is in a ground at any spot. These holes are expensive so the industry uses statistical interpolation to predict what's in between these holes. Stratum replaces these traditional methods by utilizing deep learning to better predict both where to best drill and how much gold is in between these holes. This technology is not limited to gold and has been demonstrated to work on other metals, including base metals like copper. Based on Stratum's current pilots, our technology is projected to create ~10M in annual value for the average mine.
regions: Canada; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Mining companies (exploration and mine planning)
problem: Traditional statistical interpolation between drillholes limits where to drill and grade estimates; Stratum uses deep learning to predict grade and suggest targets.
business_model: Project-based and software services for mining companies (pilots with projected value; later alliance with Major Drilling)
product_category: AI for mine planning and exploration targeting
market_need_then: YC page claims pilots project about US$10M annual value for the average mine (company claim); mining AI demand otherwise not sourced for 2020.
outcome_analysis: StratumAI is still listed Active and shows commercial activity (a Kazakhstan gold project reported by Mining.com, a 2024 alliance with Major Drilling, 2023 conference papers), but funding is limited to a possible US$125-130K seed, and revenue and headcount are not public. Evidence shows a slow, services-style business rather than a clear venture outcome.

name: Streamdal
one_liner: Data Quality & Playback Platform
long_description: SaaS data platform for observing, repairing and replaying data in streaming systems.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Engineering and data platform teams running event driven and streaming data systems such as Kafka and RabbitMQ
problem: Teams could not easily see, repair or replay bad data flowing through streaming systems, and usually built custom in house tooling for it.
business_model: open source core with a SaaS platform for data observability and in flight data handling
product_category: Streaming data observability and data quality
market_need_then: TechCrunch in 2023 quoted the founder saying the main competitor was in house engineering teams building custom fixes, and that customers such as Recharge and ParkMobile paid. The open source tool Plumber reportedly had over 150,000 downloads.
outcome_analysis: Streamdal raised a 5.4 million dollar seed led by Work-Bench in 2022, announced in February 2023, and reported 7.2 million raised in total plus named paying customers. YC now lists it as Inactive, and an archived repository README says it was acquired by an unnamed buyer under NDA with the team moving on. No post-mortem or press report states the cause, so the cause is not public and failure factors are left empty.

name: Strive School
one_liner: Training the next generation of software engineers in Europe 🇪🇺
long_description: In exchange for a part of their future salary, select students can become professional-grade software engineers through a six-month online program. While the majority of universities in Europe are free to attend, STEM courses are often outdated and theoretical; Strive School works with those pursuing STEM fields to help them become job-ready software engineers.
regions: Germany; Europe; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: European STEM students who pay tuition as a share of future salary
problem: European university STEM courses are often outdated and theoretical, and students cannot afford private bootcamps upfront.
business_model: Income share agreement coding school, tuition deferred until employment
product_category: Online coding bootcamp with income share financing
market_need_then: Strive's pitch cites outdated European STEM teaching; no dated spend data was found.
outcome_analysis: Strive School was a five person Berlin team selling income share coding training to European students. In March 2022 it joined Epicode, which rebranded around the combined company and raised 10 million euros from Italian angels and family offices, and Strive's co-founder became Chairman. Sources disagree on whether it was a March 2022 merger or a July 2023 acquisition, and the price is unknown, so it is an unclear exit.

name: Supabase
tags: Developer Tools; Open Source; Big Data; Data Engineering; Databases
one_liner: Build in a weekend. Scale to millions.
long_description:
Supabase is the easiest way to get started with Postgres. 

Each project within Supabase is an isolated Postgres cluster, allowing customers to scale independently, while still providing the features that you need to build: instant database setup, auth, row level security, realtime data streams, auto-generating APIs, and a simple to use web interface.

We are 100% remote.
regions: Singapore; Southeast Asia; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Developers and startups building web and mobile apps, increasingly including AI coding tools that provision databases
problem: Developers wanted the speed of Firebase on top of open standard Postgres without proprietary lock in.
business_model: hosted usage and tier based Postgres platform with an open source core
product_category: Postgres backend as a service and developer platform
market_need_then: A retrospective on the May 2020 Hacker News post says the open source Firebase alternative post drew over 1,120 upvotes and became the second most popular Launch HN, indicating strong developer demand for a Postgres based option.
outcome_analysis: Supabase launched an open source Firebase alternative on Hacker News in May 2020, raised a 6 million dollar seed in December 2020, and then stacked Series A through E rounds, reaching a reported 5 billion dollar valuation in October 2025 with 4 million developers. AI coding tools using it as the default database added a tailwind. A further 150 million dollar round and Turso acquisition were reported in October 2026.

name: SuperTokens
tags: Developer Tools; SaaS; B2B; Open Source
one_liner: Open source alternative to Auth0 / AWS Cognito / Firebase Auth
long_description:
SuperTokens is building open source authentication (as an alternative to Auth0, Firebase and AWS Cognito). Add secure, hassle free authentication to your app in 1 day. We enable startups to launch quicker and focus on their core product offering

1. We're easier to implement as we take a modular approach - making it possible to pick only the features you need for your use case. This means you need not worry about complications associated with other features (eg: SSO and OAuth if you don’t need it) and this in turn makes it easier to implement and manage SuperTokens.
2. Developer's can own and manage their user's data. 
3. SuperTokens can be run on your premise for free and also has a generous hosted tier for those who dont want to manage it themselves.

SuperTokens is being used by hundreds of developers across the globe.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Developers and startups that need login and session management and want to self host or control user data
problem: Developers spent too much time on authentication and found hosted providers like Auth0 expensive and opaque about user data.
business_model: open source core with paid hosted tier and enterprise features
product_category: open source authentication and session management
market_need_then: The founders' December 2020 post says they were fed up with time spent on auth in earlier startups and had spoken to hundreds of developers; Auth0 and Cognito were the main alternatives.
outcome_analysis: SuperTokens built an open source authentication product against Auth0 and Cognito, graduated from YC in summer 2020 and raised additional venture money in December 2023 from Root Ventures, WestWave and Y Combinator. It stayed independent and acquired Rownd's authentication business line in March 2026. Funding amounts are unverified, so the scale of its traction is unclear beyond GitHub popularity.

name: Swif.ai
one_liner: Manage every device. Govern every AI agent.
long_description:
Swif.ai is the Unified Agent & Endpoint Management (UAEM)

Manage every device. Govern every AI agent.

One control plane for device management, AI-agent governance, continuous enforcement, and autonomous remediation.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: IT and security teams at companies that need device management with security and compliance enforcement beyond basic MDM
problem: Standard MDM tools manage devices but do not continuously enforce security and compliance, and often lack Linux support and visibility into shadow IT and AI tools.
business_model: B2B SaaS per device or per employee with a free tier for up to 5 employees
product_category: device management (MDM and UEM) with security and compliance
market_need_then: The pandemic pushed device fleets to remote work in 2020, and Kandji's October 2020 Series A coverage cites rising device management demand. The company's own pages stress SOC 2 and audit readiness as the compliance driver.
outcome_analysis: Swif.ai is listed as an active Summer 2020 YC company that has moved from device compliance toward unified agent and endpoint management with AI agent governance. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff was found, and no verified funding round could be confirmed, so traction and the quality of its position against Jamf, Kandji and Intune remain unknown.

name: Swipe Technologies
one_liner: Building modern payments, accounting and cashflow management tools…
long_description: Swipe is building modern modern payments, accounting and cashflow management tools for businesses. We own and operate Float, a global b2b payments platform and Accounteer - a cloud accounting and bookkeeping platform for businesses and freelancers.
all_locations: London, England, United Kingdom; Accra, Greater Accra Region, Ghana
regions: United Kingdom; Ghana; Europe; Africa; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: African small and medium businesses needing invoicing, credit against receivables, payments and cash flow tools
problem: African SMBs faced a liquidity gap and slow payment collection; Swipe started with invoicing and then moved to credit and cash advances as Float.
business_model: fees and interest on credit, cash advances and B2B payments, plus accounting software
product_category: B2B payments, credit and accounting for SMBs
market_need_then: TechCrunch in June 2021 framed a 300 billion dollar liquidity gap for African SMBs, and the company reported 10 million dollars of credit spending and cash advances in its first seven months live.
outcome_analysis: Swipe pivoted to Float in mid 2021 and raised a 17 million dollar equity and debt seed in January 2022, then bought Accounteer. In 2023 WeeTracker and TechCabal reported unanswered client withdrawals, alleged misappropriation and FX trading losses, with an estimated 6 million dollars stuck for some startup clients. A later list of failed African startups includes Float, but no formal shutdown date or cause statement was found.

name: Synapsica Healthcare
one_liner: AI-enabled automation of diagnostic radiology workflow and reporting.
regions: India; South Asia; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Synapticure
tags: Health Tech; Telehealth; Digital Health; Healthcare; Mental Health
one_liner: We deliver personalized medicine for neurodegenerative  patients
long_description:
Personalized virtual clinical care is finally here for neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's and related Dementias (Cognitive), Parkinson's and Huntington's (Movement), and ALS (Motor neuron).

We provide a novel approach to care in these diseases, centering a patient and caregiver around a coordinator who quarterbacks patients through our full Multi-Disciplinary Care Resources to local aid, PT/OT and home health support. When you leave our clinic, it's not with a handful of paper referrals, but with our coordinators helping you book and find the best physicians, DME, trials, and even cheapest prescriptions. We are devoted to helping patients, from guidance on care and insurance to providing the full spectrum of investigational and clinical testing to improve outcomes. 

Synapticure was built by leading patient and caregiver advocates alongside leading  clinicians, biotech executives and telemedicine executives to bring the neurodegenerative disease care and treatment experience into the 21st century, and is backed by the leading Venture funds and investors in the remote health and life sciences space.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Patients and caregivers living with ALS, Alzheimer's and related dementias, Parkinson's and Huntington's, paid through insurers, health systems and payers
problem: Neurodegenerative patients face scarce specialists and fragmented care; the company offers virtual specialist care with a coordinator.
business_model: virtual clinic billed to insurance and payer contracts, plus partnerships with health systems
product_category: virtual neurology care for neurodegenerative disease
founder_names: Peter Wallach; Brian Wallach; Martina de Majo
market_need_then: The company says patients leave clinics with paper referrals and no coordination. Brian Wallach's own ALS diagnosis in 2017 and his I AM ALS advocacy motivated the care model, per the company's story page.
outcome_analysis: Synapticure combined an ALS patient advocate founder with a virtual specialist clinic, raised a seed round from GV and a 25 million dollar Series A led by B Capital in November 2024 with CVS Health Ventures and CommonSpirit Health, and later launched an ataxia program in July 2026. It is active and growing with payer and health system partnerships, with no layoffs or exit found.

name: Syncro
one_liner: Intelligence layer for internal communications and culture
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote

name: TANGObuilder
one_liner: TANGObuilder automates structural engineers jobs.
long_description: Today the building design process is cumbersome and expensive. Architects submit their design to structural engineers for validation. Engineers need to design all structural elements such as walls, columns, and beams to ensure the structure will not collapse and complies with regulations.  The structural engineer needs four to six weeks to generate the initial solution. The engineer will submit his proposal to the architect and then engage in an extensive back and forth discussion until they agree on a satisfying solution. TANGObuilder generates the building structural design in real-time, cutting six weeks of the overall process, and reducing material usage by 30%.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote

name: TagMango
one_liner: Monetisation tool for the Indian creator economy
long_description: TagMango is building a SAAS tool to enable edutainment creators create monetisation channels by creating paid and scalable communities. Anyone who has a skill-set, talent and an engaged audience can build their community on TagMango and provide exclusive services, learnings and content.
regions: India; South Asia; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Indian edutainment creators, coaches and influencers who want to charge their audiences for communities, workshops and courses
problem: Creators with engaged audiences had no simple way to run paid communities and collect payments in India.
business_model: SaaS and platform commission, about 10 percent of creator earnings per a Republic profile
product_category: creator monetisation and paid community platform
market_need_then: In January 2021 the company reported about 3,500 transactions in its first three weeks of soft launch and more than 3,000 organic creators onboarded, indicating early creator demand in India.
outcome_analysis: TagMango raised about 750 thousand dollars of seed in December 2020 and then a pre-Series A from JAM Fund, Soma Capital and others, and the YC page and company site claim thousands of creators earning large sums on the platform and profitability. These figures are company claims. No exit, layoffs or later priced round was found, and the founders launched AI Fiesta in August 2025.

name: Taiv
tags: Marketplace; Computer Vision; B2B; Advertising; AI
one_liner: AI-powered tech that makes business TV smarter, engaging, and…
long_description:
Taiv puts business TVs on autopilot, automatically switching between cable, our own streaming channels, digital signage, and trivia.  Our proprietary AI model analyzes the live video feed and intelligently switches sources during commercial breaks, show changes, or based on the time of day, to show the best possible content & ads for any environment.

We offer this for free to venues and make money by selling ads, which we rev-share back with the venue, turning their TVs from a cost center to a profit center.
regions: Canada; America / Canada
target_customer: Bars, restaurants and retail venues (get the service free); brands and advertisers pay for in-venue TV ad slots
problem: Venue TVs are an unmanaged cost; commercial breaks on cable show irrelevant national ads. Taiv detects breaks and swaps in targeted ads and content, sharing ad revenue with the venue.
business_model: Ad-supported: free hardware box to venues, ad sales with revenue share back to venue
product_category: In-venue CTV/digital out-of-home advertising with AI video detection
founder_names: Noah Palansky; Jordan Davis; Avi Stoller
market_need_then: Venues wanted revenue from TVs and brands wanted bar audiences; no dated demand evidence found beyond the founders' story and early venue adoption (launched in the US south in 2021).
outcome_analysis: Taiv is active and growing: it launched in 2021, reported 1,000+ bars and restaurants plus 1,000+ retail locations in 14 US cities by mid-2025, and raised a US$6M seed, a Series A of US$7.75M equity plus US$2.75M debt, and a further US$13M round in 2026. The free-to-venue ad-share model solved venue supply cheaply, but revenue and profitability are not disclosed.

name: Tajir
one_liner: The one-stop shop for mom-and-pop stores in Pakistan to buy inventory.
long_description:
In Pakistan, stores struggle to buy inventory. Stores waste hours dealing with dozens of suppliers and wait passively for salesmen to visit their stores. Deliveries are often late, incorrect, or never arrive at all. Stores often learn prices at the point of delivery and cannot compare across different suppliers.

Tajir solves this by offering a one-stop shop for all inventory purchasing with low prices, huge selection, and the convenience of 24/7 ordering with next-day delivery.

Mom-and-pop stores are the arteries of Pakistan's economy. Through empowering them with world class logistics & information tools, Tajir aims to refactor and simplify Pakistan's retail economy.
regions: Pakistan; South Asia
target_customer: Mom-and-pop neighborhood stores (kirana) in Pakistan that buy inventory, and the brands and distributors that sell to them
problem: Small Pakistani stores waste hours dealing with dozens of suppliers, wait for salesmen to visit, get late or wrong deliveries and learn prices only at delivery.
business_model: B2B marketplace and distribution: Tajir buys from brands, sells to stores on margin and delivers next day; later adds software for brands and financial services
product_category: B2B retail inventory marketplace and distribution app
market_need_then: About 2 million neighborhood stores in Pakistan buying through fragmented, undigitized distribution; TechCrunch (June 2020) reported most sales are offline and no major e-commerce player existed.
outcome_analysis: Tajir was a Lahore B2B inventory marketplace for neighborhood stores, founded by two brothers whose father ran FMCG distribution. It raised a $1.8M seed in June 2020 after YC and a $17M Series A led by Kleiner Perkins in June 2021, among the largest Pakistani rounds that year. It remains listed as active with about 50 staff, but a Profit report grouped it with startups that quietly cut staff as capital tightened, and no later round was found.

name: Taktile
tags: Fintech; Machine Learning; Enterprise Software; AI
one_liner: Transform your decision-making with reliable AI agents in weeks, not…
long_description:
Taktile empowers financial institutions to quickly unlock AI-driven efficiencies across the customer lifecycle, reducing manual work while optimizing decisions and enabling seamless end-user experiences.

Built for highly regulated environments, our agentic decision platform combines the speed of AI automation with the oversight of human judgement—so you can safely approve customers, catch more fraud, and stay compliant.

We power AI transformation from offices in NYC, London, Berlin, and Iasi, and have raised $80M in capital from top investors including Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital and Y Combinator.

Join over 200 leading financial institutions who rely on Taktile to enable faster, more intelligent decisions from onboarding to credit, AML, compliance, and fraud.
regions: Germany; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Banks, fintechs, lenders and insurers that make credit, fraud, onboarding and underwriting decisions
problem: Financial institutions struggle to deploy machine learning in decisions because they lack expertise, IT resources to run ML services, and ways to build regulatory and organizational trust.
business_model: Enterprise SaaS decision platform, sold by contract to financial institutions
product_category: Decision automation and risk decisioning platform
market_need_then: Index Ventures (Aug 2021) cited that 89 percent of ML projects fail to reach production and that banks lacked ML expertise, IT resources for microservices and regulatory trust, creating demand for a managed decision platform.
outcome_analysis: Taktile sold a decision engine to regulated financial institutions, raising a $4.7M seed in 2021, $20M Series A in 2022, $54M Series B in 2025 and a $110M Series C in June 2026, with top tier investors. Success factors are an enterprise sales motion, integration lock in and an AI tailwind; it claims over 200 institutions including Allianz and Monzo. No exit or distress has been reported.

name: Talyn Air
one_liner: Long range, battery electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft.
long_description: Talyn is making long-range electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft for cargo.  We get fixed-wing performance with VTOL capability by making an electric fixed wing aircraft that is caught mid-air with a custom winged drone, enabling it to take-off and land vertically.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Cargo logistics operators and the US military for runway-free middle-mile delivery
problem: Long range cargo delivery needs fixed-wing efficiency but vertical takeoff and landing fits remote sites, and existing VTOL designs give up range.
business_model: Aircraft development funded by government contracts, with commercial cargo as the target
product_category: Electric cargo aircraft, eVTOL and drone systems
market_need_then: The US Air Force Agility Prime program funded eVTOL work, and the company's own site cites defense contracts as demand.
outcome_analysis: Talyn built a long range electric cargo aircraft caught in midair by a winged drone and funded much of it through US Air Force programs. It sold substantially all assets, eight patents and seven government contracts, to Ampaire in July 2023, with the founders staying as advisors. The price was not disclosed and the reason for the sale was not stated, so failure_factors reflects a likely but unconfirmed capital constraint of a hardware company, and the outcome looks like an asset sale.

name: Tappity
one_liner: World's largest library of interactive lessons for kids
long_description: Tappity is building the world’s largest library of interactive lessons for kids—starting with science! Find every science topic kids love in one place taught by the world's most entertaining instructors.
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; Palo Alto, CA, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Parents of children aged 4 to 10 who pay a monthly subscription; later homeschooling families
problem: Kids learn science from YouTube and passive video; parents want interactive, standards aligned science lessons delivered by engaging presenters.
business_model: Consumer subscription, about 9 dollars per month average, free to schools
product_category: Kids interactive science education app
founder_names: Chad Swenson; Tanner Swenson; Lawrence Tran
market_need_then: In December 2020 TechCrunch reported over 5,000 paying customers, more than 20,000 weekly active users and about 30 million lessons completed, and the company was profitable when it applied to YC; remote learning during Covid raised parent demand.
outcome_analysis: Tappity was a small, already profitable subscription app of interactive science lessons that raised a $1.3M seed in December 2020 with Mystery Science and Toca Boca founders among backers. It is listed as active with a small team and has extended into homeschool courses, but no later round, exit or growth data was found, so the outcome is a quiet small business rather than a proven venture scale result.

name: Tasker AI
one_liner: Your AI co-worker
long_description: Tasker is an AI assistant for everyday work and life to-dos. Tasker is able to perform complex tasks from a single prompt by using multiple tools.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Individuals and knowledge workers who want an AI assistant to do email, calendar and web tasks, free to use
problem: People juggle too many narrow tools for everyday work and life to-dos and want a single assistant that completes multi-step tasks from one prompt.
business_model: Free consumer and prosumer assistant; no pricing found
product_category: AI assistant and workflow automation
market_need_then: Scheduling and inbox chores were a known pain point, evidenced by x.ai and Clara Labs raising tens of millions for email assistants before 2020.
outcome_analysis: Tasker AI is an AI assistant that reschedules meetings through email, summarizes newsletters and automates web pages, listed by YC as active with about seven people. No funding, traction or exit data was found, and the fit between the 2020 batch and the current product is unclear, so no success or failure story can be sourced.

name: Teleo
one_liner: Supervised Autonomous Heavy Equipment
long_description: Teleo converts heavy equipment, like dozers, trucks, and loaders, into supervised autonomous robots. This enables a single operator to remotely operate multiple machines while sitting at a remote control center, unlocking productivity gains for the General Contractor.
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; Palo Alto, CA, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: General contractors, mining and construction firms with existing heavy equipment fleets
problem: Heavy equipment operators are scarce and machines sit idle, and buying new autonomous vehicles is costly, so retrofitting existing machines for supervised autonomy is attractive.
business_model: Retrofit hardware and software sold or leased through equipment dealers and direct to contractors
product_category: Supervised autonomy and teleoperation for heavy equipment
market_need_then: Construction labor shortages and the cost of new autonomous machines made retrofitting existing fleets appealing, though no dated spend data was found.
outcome_analysis: Teleo's founders came from Lyft Level 5 and Google, and it raised a 12 million dollar Series A in June 2022 led by UP.Partners plus a 16.2 million dollar extension in 2024, about 29.8 million dollars total per the Robot Report. It sold through John Deere dealers and contractors with a retrofit approach. Havoc acquired it in March 2026 alongside drone maker Mavrik with terms undisclosed, a defense autonomy consolidation rather than a clear venture return.

name: Tella
one_liner: The all-in-one screen recorder.
long_description: Send your team quick video messages, post eye-catching product demos to social, publish long-form content to YouTube and more. All with one app and one subscription.
regions: Netherlands; Europe; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Remote teams, creators and marketers who record screen and camera videos for messages, demos and YouTube; paid per user subscription
problem: Making polished screen and product videos takes several tools and editing skill; async video tools like Loom focus on quick messages rather than produced content.
business_model: SaaS subscription, individual and team plans
product_category: Screen recording and video editing
market_need_then: Covid drove remote work and video communication in 2020; Loom's 2020 rounds showed investor and customer demand for async video.

one_liner: Foundation models and autonomous chambers for plant biology
long_description:
UrbanKisaan is an AI-for-plant-biology company. We build foundation models and the physical infrastructure that trains them.

Shipping a single new seed variety takes about ten+ years. Two on germplasm, three on crosses and selection, three or four on field trials, one on regulatory. Inside that decade, prediction and experiment never properly meet. DNA is abundant, phenotype data is scarce and unpaired, and the cycle never trains itself.

We closed that loop.

Three foundation models cover the upstream science. 

Aadi is a 48-layer transformer trained from scratch on the public and proprietary corpus of plant genomes; it reads plant DNA and ranks variants before any wet-lab spend. 

Jeeva is the genotype-to-phenotype model that turns a seed and a target environment into yield, flowering, maturity, and height with confidence intervals plus per-locus attribution. 

Akash is the geospatial backbone - it maps every pixel of every field to crop class and growing condition.

Two pieces of physical infrastructure close the downstream half. 

GeneRush is a controlled-environment chamber engineered for speed: extended photoperiod, optimized temperature, integrated phenomics. Wheat reaches anthesis in 38 days. Breeding programs run 4–6 generations a year instead of 1–2. 

GrowRush takes that same chamber to commercial production scale, where every harvest is also a labelled phenotype training pair flowing back to Jeeva. The unit is paid for by what it grows; the science works because the unit is identical to the chamber the AI was trained on.

Every cycle produces proprietary genotype-to-phenotype data the next generation of models needs. The ten-year breeding cycle compresses toward three. We are already commercial

About Us
Volumetric is a recognized world leader in building living multicellular tissues, with a focus on replicating discrete functions of the human body for basic mechanistic biology, laboratory testing and screening, and drug development. Founded in 2018 by Bagrat Grigoryan and Jordan Miller as a spin-out from Rice University, the full potential of our work is to build whole human organ replacements for patients, made from their own cells.

Our Technology and Approach
We have invented a suite of breakthrough 3D bioprinting technologies, featured on the cover of Science, that can build human tissue with complex blood vessel networks. We are leveraging this technology in the short term to build patient-specific tissues for drug safety and efficacy testing. Patient cells are taken from a biopsy, added to our proprietary 3D printed tissues, and then drug compounds are injected through the blood vessel network to mimic actual drug delivery in humans. Our vision is that our technology will provide rigorous, reproducible, and predictive outcomes for patients, resulting in drastically improved outcomes for diseases like cancer. More broadly, we see the full potential of our mission as being able to produce functional tissue and organ replacements for diseased or damaged vital organs in the body such as the lung, liver, pancreas, kidney, and heart.

Its truly digital KYC-compliant onboarding allowed us to be the first opening first branchless accounts in the country. We target poorly served Startups and SMEs therefore focusing on the ~40B market opportunity that are profitable when served fully online.
regions: Mexico; Latin America; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Mexican startups and small and medium businesses needing credit lines, payments and spend management
problem: Mexican SMEs are underserved by banks. delt.ai offers online account opening, payment tools and revolving corporate credit with corporate cards.
business_model: Fintech lending and spend management with interchange and interest revenue
product_category: SME neobank and corporate credit
founder_names: Jose de la Luz Lopez; Alejandro Cedeno
market_need_then: The YC page cites a Mexican business payments market of about 450 billion and a roughly 40 billion opportunity among online served segments, company claims, with SMEs underserved by banks.
outcome_analysis: delt.ai grew an SME credit and payments product in Mexico, financed a 25 million dollar crypto native debt facility in February 2022, and sold to albo for 20 million in August 2023. The sale price is below the debt facility size, which shows the exit was not a large equity win, and its lender and rates are not public. Reported credit of over 90 million dollars granted and 130 thousand transactions are company claims in albo's release.

name: doola
one_liner: Business-in-a-Box™ for LLCs
long_description: doola is a “Business-in-a-Box” for creators. We take care of everything creators need to form an LLC, set up their bank account, accept payments, and manage ongoing compliance and tax filings. We realized how difficult it was to set up the full stack of software and accounts you need to get a business off the ground. This is the same problem faced by online businesses, who begin their business as a side hustle, and just want to focus on growing their business, not annoying administrative work. That’s why we built doola: to take care of it all. Today, people on every continent have launched companies with doola. (HQ: New York)
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; New York, NY, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Non-US and US online founders, creators and ecommerce sellers who need a US LLC or C-Corp, EIN, registered agent, bookkeeping and tax filings
problem: Forming a US company, opening a bank account and keeping up with compliance and taxes is slow and confusing, especially for founders without a US Social Security number.
business_model: Subscription bundle (plans from $297 per year plus state fees) with formation, compliance, bookkeeping and tax services, plus a formation API for businesses
product_category: Business formation and back-office compliance platform
market_need_then: The TechCrunch article describes demand from founders without a US Social Security number, and says hundreds of companies had formed LLCs with doola by November 2021.
outcome_analysis: doola pivoted from an earlier idea into LLC formation for global founders, raised a $3M seed in 2021, an $8M Series A and a strategic HubSpot Ventures round in January 2024, and states $13M raised in total. The CEO told TechCrunch the business was growing profitably on unit economics, and the company reports founders in 175 plus countries. Formation is easy to copy, so the later push into banking, bookkeeping and tax APIs is the path to a durable position. No shutdown or acquisition was found.

name: farmtheory
one_liner: India's first vegetable delivery service to restaurants with a hack
long_description: Farmtheory is a B2B agri-tech startup. We are bridging the gap between buyers and sellers of ugly produce by creating a farm-to-fork value chain. Ugly produce is freshly harvested fruitage that is cosmetically unappealing, hence left unsold at farms.
regions: India; South Asia
target_customer: Restaurants, cloud kitchens, caterers and food processors in Bengaluru that buy fruit and vegetables
problem: Roughly 30 percent of a farmer's harvest goes unsold because of cosmetic appearance, while commercial kitchens pay full price for produce they often cut or puree anyway.
business_model: B2B produce distribution: buys cosmetically imperfect produce directly from farms and resells to kitchens at a discount of 25 to 30 percent, margin on the spread
product_category: Agri-food B2B supply chain marketplace
market_need_then: The company says about 30 percent of harvest goes unsold for looks and that its produce costs kitchens 25 to 30 percent less. These are company statements from its website.
outcome_analysis: Farmtheory stayed active and in February 2024 reported 3,000 partner farmers and more than 1,500 kitchens served after a $1.45M seed from Merak Ventures, four years after its YC batch. Sources show no big venture rounds and no distress, so the story is a slow, capital light supply chain business rather than a breakout or a failure. Whether the imperfect produce wedge scales beyond a niche is not shown by the sources.

name: goDutch
one_liner: Group payments product which lets people pay together at any offline…
long_description:
goDutch is a new-age fintech app that powers group payments for millennials. We’re on a mission to reimagine group payments and enable people to enjoy with their friends without any worry of awkward reminders, delayed payments, and multiple transactions.

We've first-hand seen that group payments are very tedious - one person first pays on behalf of the entire group, then calculates and makes a note of who owes whom how much, and then individually reminds each person to pay back. At goDutch, we are passionately working towards re-imagining this multi-step process that extends over numerous days and multiple apps. Our focus is on being design-led and driving cutting-edge fintech innovation.

goDutch is founded by IIT Bombay grads with a total work experience of 10+ years in fintech and we are backed by global VC investors including Y Combinator.
regions: India; South Asia

name: inFeedo AI
tags: Generative AI; SaaS; HR Tech; Enterprise Software; AI
one_liner: AI to engage employees, predict attrition and automate HR/IT support
long_description:
In 2016, we set out on a mission to make 100 million employees heard and valued. Today we’re Asia’s leading employee experience platform that helps engage employees, predict attrition & answer FAQs with conversational AI that people love ❤️ 

From India’s Shark Tank to Tiger Global. We’re backed by Y Combinator, Bling Capital and founders of Gainsight, Freshworks, Zeta, Lenskart, innov8. As a Chief Listening Officer, our A.I. bot Amber helps people-first leaders find hidden gaps in their culture, managers and wellbeing in real time. Spanning across 60 countries, our customers include MNCs like Samsung, Xiaomi, Lenovo, conglomerates like TATA, Godrej, Bharti.

Come join our mission to help build cultures where people love to come to work. For career opportunities, please visit our careers page: jobs.infeedo.com
all_locations: Dubai, Dubai, United Arab Emirates; New York, NY, USA
regions: United Arab Emirates; United States of America; Middle East and North Africa; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote

regions: United States of America; America / Canada

name: onetool
one_liner: App-Store for SaaS: one invoice, one user management, one login.
long_description: Onetool provides businesses with their own app-store for business software. One login, one invoice, and centralized user management. Onetool offers everything from project management software and video conferencing to document signing.
regions: Germany; Europe; Remote; Fully Remote

name: twoplus fertility
one_liner: An effective home-use fertility treatment for natural conception
long_description:
We are making a new fertility treatment that infertile couples can order with a click of a
button to help them conceive at home. Our technology increases the likelihood of pregnancy by guiding significantly higher number of sperms towards the ovum using a proprietary combination of surface features and microenvironment optimization.

The fertility treatments available today, such as in-vitro fertilization (IVF) and intra-uterine
insemination (IUI), are psychologically and financially draining and come with considerable treatment-associated risks. Furthermore, over 25 million women of reproductive age in the US
have limited nearby access to fertility treatment.
regions: Singapore; Southeast Asia

name: webapp.io
one_liner: Build webapps faster with 10x better CI/CD + preview envs
long_description:
Webapp.io's custom hypervisor makes webapp CI/CD, E2E testing, and preview environments as simple as writing a Dockerfile.

If your team is building a webapp + using github/gitlab/bitbucket, please reach out!
regions: Canada; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Engineering teams building web apps on GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket that pay for CI/CD and preview environments
problem: CI runs and end-to-end tests are slow and preview environments are hard to set up. webapp.io used memory snapshots and a custom hypervisor to make full-stack environments start in seconds from a Dockerfile-like Layerfile.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for CI/CD and preview environments
product_category: Developer tools, CI/CD and preview environments
market_need_then: Slow CI and the cost of per-branch environments were common developer complaints. No dated 2020 source was opened that quantifies spend.
outcome_analysis: webapp.io joined Y Combinator in Summer 2020 with a fast snapshot based CI product. Its own homepage later said it joined Harness and linked to a post about shutting down, so the outcome reads as an acquisition that ended the standalone product. Price, date and Harness role were not found and the Harness claim comes only from the company site, so the soft landing label is a tentative reading.

name: yBANQ
one_liner: yBANQ is building a Bill.com for India to simplify collections and…
long_description: We are building a collections and reconciliation platform for MSME's in India. In India, reconciliation is largely manual and error prone due requiring manual matching of bank statements with Invoices. In my last role, I used to head product for PayU, India #1 Fintech firm. I would love to connect with other Fintech founders building solving similar problems and in the neobanking space
regions: India; South Asia
target_customer: Indian MSMEs that issue invoices and need to collect payments and reconcile them
problem: Reconciliation of bank statements against invoices is manual and error prone for Indian small businesses. yBANQ built collections, reconciliation and bookkeeping tooling, pitched as a Bill.com for India.
business_model: B2B SaaS and payments for collections and reconciliation
product_category: Fintech, B2B payments and receivables
founder_names: Abhishek Ayyagari; Ganesh Mallya; Ahamed Shah Wahidullah
market_need_then: YC description states reconciliation is largely manual and error prone for Indian MSMEs. No dated spend figure was opened.
outcome_analysis: yBANQ joined YC in Winter 2020 led by a former PayU product head and sold to Clear in July 2021 in a cash and equity deal, about a year and a half after founding. Terms were undisclosed and the stage of funding is unclear, so the exit reads as a strategic acquisition into an established tax and fintech platform rather than a venture scale outcome.

name: yearend
one_liner: Optimize your equity and taxes in real-time.
long_description: YearEnd helps startup employees optimize their equity and taxes, and can also file their tax returns. They simply connect their financial accounts and YearEnd will tell them how much tax they’ll owe and will make recommendations on how to make better decisions. At the end of the year, YearEnd can also file their tax return for them or they can collaborate with their existing tax accountant.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote

name: AI Tech Packs
one_liner: Build factory ready tech packs in minutes.
long_description: AI Tech Packs is software that generates factory-ready techpacks in minutes for apparel design teams who currently spend 3-4 hours on each one. Our customers are brands, licensing companies, and manufacturers producing 200+ techpacks a month. We make their designers 3x more productive without new hires.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Apparel brands, licensing companies and manufacturers producing 200 or more tech packs a month
problem: Designers spend 3 to 4 hours hand-building each factory-ready tech pack. The software generates one in minutes.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription plus a done-for-you agency service
product_category: Apparel design and production software
market_need_then: The company states manual tech packs take 3 to 4 hours each and its customers produce 200+ a month; a search summary cites $100 to $500 per style when outsourced, unverified. No dated 2021 demand source was found.
outcome_analysis: The company remains active as a tiny team with a product that now generates tech packs and flat sketches and claims 500+ fashion teams and 17K+ tech packs created. No funding, exit or distress was found in public sources, so the outcome is modest and low-visibility. Its descriptive name and narrow niche suit search-led acquisition, but the market is crowded with PLM tools and newer AI entrants.

name: AOA Dx
one_liner: Blood Test for Early Detection of Ovarian Cancer
long_description: AOA Dx is developing the next frontier in early-stage cancer detection for women through our pioneering work in glycolipids and proprietary biomarker technology.
all_locations: Denver, CO, USA; Cambridge, MA, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Clinicians and labs that would order a blood test for symptomatic women to detect ovarian and other gynecologic cancers early; ultimately payers and health systems
problem: No reliable biomarker detects early-stage ovarian cancer; existing diagnostic methods lack sensitivity or specificity per the YC page, so most cases are found late.
business_model: Diagnostics developer: lab-developed or FDA-cleared test sales per test, with a multi-omics discovery platform for other cancers
product_category: Cancer diagnostics / liquid biopsy
founder_names: Oriana Papin-Zoghbi; Alex Fisher; Anna Jeter
market_need_then: Ovarian cancer is typically detected late and no reliable early-stage biomarker existed per the 2022 funding announcement, a large unmet clinical need.
outcome_analysis: AOA Dx raised about $7M in September 2022 and about $17M in October 2023, ran a roughly 1,000-patient validation study and presented results at AACR 2026 while preparing an early access program. The founders had previous diagnostics exits, which helped fundraising credibility. The outcome is still pending regulatory and commercial milestones; the main risk is clinical and regulatory rather than market.

name: ARQ
one_liner: The global financial platform for affluent consumers in the Americas.
long_description:
ARQ opens the world’s strongest assets and markets to travelers, investors and professionals across the Americas—so they can spend, receive, send and grow their money wherever they are.

Formerly known as DolarApp.
regions: United Kingdom; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Affluent consumers, travelers, investors and professionals in Latin America who want dollar and euro balances, a card and investing
problem: People in Latin American countries with weak local currencies and limited access to dollar accounts need a way to hold, spend, receive and send dollars at real market rates.
business_model: Consumer and business fintech: FX spread, card interchange, transfer fees and earnings products
product_category: Neobank / stablecoin-based global account (formerly DolarApp)
founder_names: Fernando Terres; Zach Garman; Alvaro Correa
market_need_then: High demand for dollar access in Latin America due to currency instability; the seed announcement described beta users swapping pesos to USDC and a dollar card with cashback.
outcome_analysis: DolarApp raised a $5M seed from YC and Kaszek in September 2022, grew to a claimed 2 million users across Latin America, and raised $70M in March 2026 led by Sequoia and Founders Fund while rebranding to ARQ. Success rests on strong demand for dollar access, ex-Revolut founders, and stablecoin rails; the risks are regulatory dependence and rivals like Wise, Revolut and Bitso.

name: Abacum
one_liner: The AI-native FP&A platform that helps Finance teams drive business…
long_description:
Finance teams get instant access to all the operational and financial metrics in one place. 

With a single click, Finance teams surface insights, automate reporting, forecast revenue, plan headcount, and run multiple scenarios at scale.

Abacum perfectly balances entreprise-grade scalability with consumer-grade ease of use. Our powerful, intuitive multi-dimensional modeling engine and collaborative workflows make business partnering seamless.

With more than $100M raised, Abacum powers industry leaders such as CoreWeave, Strava, Replit, Abridge, BetterUp, Placer.ai, Kajabi, Aiven, Dish Networks, and hundreds more.

Finance teams rate Abacum as the best FP&A solution for mid-market companies, with a 4.8/5 rating on G2 - higher than any competitor.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Finance teams (CFOs, FP&A) at scale-ups and mid-market companies
problem: Finance teams plan and report in spreadsheets disconnected from operational data; Abacum pulls metrics from many systems into one collaborative planning, forecasting and reporting platform.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription
product_category: FP&A / business planning software
market_need_then: TechCrunch (April 2021) framed legacy planning tools as old and spreadsheet-bound; early customers Typeform, Cabify and Ebury, over 50 customers by Nov 2021 per Fortune.
outcome_analysis: Abacum launched in mid-2020, joined YC W21, raised a $7M seed (Apr 2021), a $25M Series A (Nov 2021) and a $60M Series B (Jun 2025). It is still independent. It grew in a crowded FP&A field by selling to scale-ups and mid-market finance teams, reportedly tripling revenue in the 12 months before the Series B with over half of revenue from the US. The long gap between rounds and the shift from Barcelona to New York headquarters are visible; the reasons are not given in sources.

name: Abatable
tags: Carbon Capture and Removal; B2B; Climate
one_liner: Carbon markets platform and solutions
long_description: Abatable is a carbon offsetting procurement platform which connects companies with carbon project developers of high quality carbon offsets. Abatable facilitates procurement decisions by offering third party quality assessments of projects and by standardizing multi-year purchase agreements and an automated RFP platform. The team has extensive experience advising institutional investors on nature-based carbon removal and impact investment portfolios and is backed by leading investors like YCombinator, BlueBear Capital and Global Founders Capital.
regions: United Kingdom; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Corporates, investors and insurers buying voluntary carbon credits and CORSIA units
problem: Buyers struggle to source, vet and contract quality carbon credits. Abatable runs procurement, due diligence and portfolio management.
business_model: Procurement and advisory services plus credit sourcing via the Ecosphere+ acquisition
product_category: Carbon markets procurement platform
market_need_then: Corporate net zero pledges and growing voluntary carbon market demand in 2021 created buyers who lacked procurement expertise; the founders came from carbon advisory, per the YC page.
outcome_analysis: Abatable stayed independent and raised a reported 13.5 million dollar round from Azora in April 2023 while buying supplier Ecosphere+, then positioned itself as an operating system for environmental markets. Founder background in carbon advisory and a corporate net zero tailwind helped, while the carbon credit sector has seen consolidation and layoffs at peers, so durability is still unproven.

name: Abbot
one_liner: Your Customer Success Co-Pilot
long_description: Abbot helps customer-facing teams work with their customers in Slack. Abbot watches activity to make sure that customers get replies quickly. Once Abbot joins a room, it summarizes conversations, tags relevant topics, and even suggests next steps. Abbot's Insights make it easy to see your team's responsiveness at a glance. Want to automate common tasks? Abbot's built-in Skills functionality (think: small bits of code we run for you) can be triggered by customer topics, on a schedule, in response to external webhooks, or directly from chat.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote

name: Abhi
one_liner: Abhi is Pakistan's 1st financial wellness platform focusing on…
long_description: An early wage access platform allowing salaried employees to draw down a percentage of their accrued salary before the next payroll cycle. Helping employees to avoid late payment fee on bills, access emergency cash and substitute expensive debt. We work on a B2B2C model allowing companies to extend the product as a benefits program to their employee base.
regions: Pakistan; South Asia; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Pakistani employers who offer earned wage access as a benefit, their salaried employees, and later small merchants needing financing
problem: Salaried workers in Pakistan have no cheap way to reach earned pay before payday and fall back on late fees or expensive debt; Abhi lets them draw a share of accrued salary.
business_model: B2B2C earned wage access with fees, plus payroll software, merchant financing and a licensed microfinance bank
product_category: Fintech / earned wage access and financial wellness
market_need_then: Salaried employees in Pakistan lacked formal short-term credit, and the company stated that late fees and costly debt were common; Dawn reported an MoU with about 20 companies at launch in June 2021.
outcome_analysis: Abhi raised a $2M seed in June 2021, a $17M Series A in April 2022 and a $15M debt facility in October 2024, and expanded into the UAE and Bangladesh with a licensed NBFC and microfinance bank. Strong employer demand for earned wage access and regulatory licenses drove growth; credit risk and local competitors such as Neem are the main watch points.

name: Abstra
one_liner: Automate finance operations with AI
long_description:
Abstra is a platform that allows finance teams to build, run, and automate their workflows using AI.

Instead of relying on spreadsheets, ERPs, and manual processes, teams can create programmable workflows for tasks like reporting, reconciliations, approvals, and integrations with systems like SAP.

We provide a developer-friendly environment where finance and technical teams can turn business processes into code, connect to their existing tools, and run everything in a controlled, auditable way.

Our goal is to become the operating system for finance operations, where workflows are not static or manual, but versioned, automated, and continuously improved.
regions: Brazil; Latin America; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Finance and operations teams, and the developers who support them, at mid-size and large companies in Brazil and abroad
problem: Critical finance and business processes run on spreadsheets, ERPs and manual approvals that are hard to audit and change. Abstra lets teams write them as versioned code with human review steps.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for a Python based workflow platform
product_category: Workflow automation and internal tools for finance operations
market_need_then: Companies were adopting no-code and low-code tools for internal apps in 2020 and 2021; Abstra signed 11 customers including Accenture, Stone and Descomplica by early 2022 per TechCrunch.
outcome_analysis: Abstra is still active with about 18 people. It raised a seed led by SoftBank Latin America in January 2022 on early traction of 11 customers including Accenture, then repositioned from a general Python workflow tool toward AI finance operations. No later rounds were found, so scale and valuation are unknown.

name: Adaptyv
one_liner: We're building fully automated labs for protein engineering
long_description: Proteins are the most advanced nanotechnology we know of. At Adaptyv, we’re building a fully automated protein foundry to allow you to synthesize and test any protein you design.
regions: Switzerland; Europe
target_customer: Protein design teams at biotech companies, pharma and universities that need fast wet lab validation of designed proteins
problem: Testing designed proteins in the lab is slow and expensive and limits how fast AI protein design can iterate. Adaptyv offers automated lab testing by API and web order.
business_model: Lab as a service, per protein assay fees (listed from 149 USD per protein) plus data products
product_category: Automated protein engineering lab and validation service
founder_names: Julian Englert; Daniel Nakhaee-Zadeh Gutierrez; Amir Shahein; Moustafa Houmani
market_need_then: Generative AI protein design was emerging in 2021 and made experimental validation the bottleneck; the 2023 launch article calls conventional testing slow, costly and failure prone.
outcome_analysis: Adaptyv is active and growing: a CHF 2.5 million pre-seed in February 2022, an 8 million dollar seed in 2025 and a 40 million dollar Series A in August 2026. It rode the rise of AI protein design, which created demand for fast wet lab data, and now sells to well known AI and pharma teams.

name: Adni
one_liner: The career network for healthcare workers
long_description:
Adni helps companies reach the right healthcare workers faster and cheaper. We combine a verified database of 2.4M licensed clinicians with an AI sourcing agent and AI-powered marketing services. Our career app, where 200,000+ nurses and allied health workers find jobs, talk to career coaches, and track credentials, keeps that network engaged and growing.

Our customers include Massachusetts General Hospital, Penn Medicine, ChristianaCare, Stepful, Medical Solutions, Medline, Jaanuu, and Proliability.

Founded by two nurses. Backed by YC, Flare Capital, Liquid 2, Fresco, Augment, Crista Galli, Adam Grant, and the founders of CareRev, Clipboard Health, and Papa.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Healthcare employers and staffing firms that pay to reach licensed nurses and allied health workers, plus the clinicians who use the free career app
problem: Hospitals and staffing companies struggle to reach and recruit licensed clinicians cheaply, and nurses lack a trusted community for jobs, credentials and advice.
business_model: B2B recruiting and marketing services sold to employers on top of a clinician network and consumer app
product_category: Healthcare worker career network and recruiting marketplace
market_need_then: Nurse staffing and burnout were acute topics in 2021 and the founders were nurses selling to nurses; specific spend data was not found.
outcome_analysis: Adni started as Lumify Care, a nurse light and marketplace, raised a 1.25 million dollar seed in May 2022, then renamed in 2023 and shifted toward employer recruiting with AI sourcing. It is active with a small team and no later rounds found; scale and financial results are not public.

name: Adravision
one_liner: Automation for dental clinics and insurance companies.
long_description:
We build automation solutions powered by AI to improve the efficiency of diagnostics, documentation, and patient education for dental clinics. Our technology is also used by dental insurance companies to process large volumes of claims by analyzing unstructured data like X-rays, narratives, and documents.

We're a dentist and clinic owner, a computer vision expert, and a bioscientist.

https://www.adra.ai/
regions: Singapore; Southeast Asia; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Dental clinics and dental insurers that review X-rays, charting and claims
problem: Dentists miss findings on radiographs and spend time on documentation, and insurers process large volumes of claims with unstructured X-rays and narratives.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to dental practices and payers, with partner and white label integrations
product_category: Dental AI imaging, documentation and claims automation
founder_names: Hamed Fesharaki; Yasaman Nemat; Liushifeng Chen
market_need_then: Dental imaging AI was beginning to reach clearance in 2021 and the founders were practicing dentists; pilots in a few clinics were reported in Aug 2021.
outcome_analysis: Adra stayed small, with about 8 people, after a 250,000 dollar raise in 2021. It reportedly won FDA 510(k) clearance for a periodontal product and now claims 512 dental teams, but better funded rivals like Overjet and Pearl raised far more. Later funding is unclear across aggregators.

name: Advantage Club
tags: SaaS; Human Resources; B2B; HR Tech
one_liner: Global platform for employee engagement with rewards&flexible benefits
long_description: Advantage Club is a global platform for employee engagement including rewards, flexible benefits, perks and communities. We are currently live with 1000+ companies across 100+ countries and have a ARR of ~$8m. Our revenue has grown ~4x in the last 1 year.
all_locations: Gurugram, HR, India; San Francisco, CA, USA; Bengaluru, KA, India; Chicago, IL, USA; Mumbai, MH, India; Manila, NCR, Philippines; Dubai, Dubai, United Arab Emirates; Singapore, Singapore
regions: India; United States of America; Philippines; United Arab Emirates; Singapore; South Asia; America / Canada; Southeast Asia; Middle East and North Africa; Remote; Partly Remote

problem: Companies need one platform to deliver rewards, recognition, flexible benefits and perks to employees across many countries.
business_model: B2B SaaS plus transaction margin on rewards, gifts and benefits sold through the platform
product_category: Employee engagement, rewards and benefits platform
market_need_then: Entrackr reported over 370 companies across 60 countries already using it in August 2021, including Concentrix, Teleperformance, Hexaware, EY and Target, which shows paying demand from distributed workforces.
outcome_analysis: Advantage Club is active with a large headcount and has grown revenue, with the CEO saying in December 2024 it was on track for 8 million dollars that year. It raised about 5 million dollars in 2021 and 4 million in December 2024, small totals relative to its team size, and rebranded around AI in 2024.

name: Aer
one_liner: Compound compliance: the central hub for meeting SEC obligations
long_description: Aer Compliance is Rippling for compliance, combining Code of Ethics, marketing, calendars, filings, workflows, and more in a single place.
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; New York, NY, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Investment advisers, funds and crypto firms that must run employee trading and code of ethics compliance
problem: Firms must monitor employee trades, pre-clear them and maintain a code of ethics. For digital assets no tool covered coin and wallet level monitoring, and the YC page later pitched a Rippling for compliance suite.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription compliance software
product_category: Regtech, employee trade compliance for digital assets
market_need_then: Crypto funds and market makers faced SEC code of ethics duties under Rule 204A-1 with no purpose built tooling, and institutional crypto activity grew in 2021.
outcome_analysis: Aer started as Argus, a crypto employee trade compliance tool in YC Summer 2021, raised a $2.8M seed in December 2022 and broadened to a general compliance suite with a team of 18. StarCompliance, an incumbent in the same category, acquired it in November 2024, which suggests the crypto wedge was valuable to incumbents but did not reach a venture scale independent outcome.

name: Aerotime
one_liner: Calendar that kills time fragmentation
long_description:
A modern calendar that helps people prioritize their work by goal setting, time blocking, and reducing fragmentation created by randomly placed meetings and distracting Slack messages.

Aerotime helps you create key goals for the week, helps break it down into tasks and meetings, and streamlines the calendar to support and align your team. This leads to people being effective and not busy.

name: Affogato AI
one_liner: Affogato AI — Your Agent for instant TikToks, Reels, and ads.
long_description: Affogato AI is your all-in-one AI Video Agent, designed to help businesses, eCommerce sellers, agencies, and creators produce professional short-form videos instantly. From TikTok ads and Instagram Reels to YouTube Shorts, UGC content, and branded campaigns, Affogato makes high-quality video creation simple, fast, and scalable. No editing skills required — just type an idea and get campaign-ready videos that look studio-made, in minutes.

target_customer: Ecommerce sellers, agencies, brands and creators who need short form video and image content without a production crew
problem: Producing consistent, studio quality social video and images is slow and costly. Affogato offers AI generated characters, images and video from a text prompt.
business_model: Consumer and team subscriptions for an AI creative suite, with a Teams plan of up to 25 seats
product_category: Generative AI image and video creation
market_need_then: At the Summer 2021 batch the company's original product is not documented in sources opened; the launch post for RenderNet is undated (over 2 years old at fetch time), so demand evidence from 2021 is unknown.
outcome_analysis: The company is active with 15 people and claims 2 million creators, having moved through several generative media products under the YC listing before settling on Affogato. Funding is not reliably public, so how much it raised and how efficient growth was cannot be judged from verified sources.

name: Agapé
one_liner: Feel close, even when apart. One meaningful conversation at a time.
long_description: Agapé is a relationship wellness app that helps you feel close to your friends, family, or partner, even when apart! We curate daily questions to spark meaningful conversations for over 2 million people around the world.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Couples and close pairs, including long distance relationships, who want to talk more meaningfully; consumers who pay a premium subscription
problem: Partners drift apart and avoid deep conversation. The app sends a daily research informed question and reveals each answer only after both respond.
business_model: Consumer freemium app with premium subscription and a points and giveaway mechanic
product_category: Relationship wellness consumer app
market_need_then: Spectrum News reports the app was released by February 2020 and went viral on TikTok about a year later with over 100,000 installs overnight, evidence of consumer demand in the pandemic era of long distance relationships.
outcome_analysis: Agapé is active with about 6 people and says over 2 million people have received its questions. It went viral on TikTok around 2021 and published a university co-authored pilot study in 2023. Funding is unclear in public sources, so the strength of its financial story cannot be judged.

name: AgendaPro
one_liner: Shopify for Beauty and Wellness businesses in Latam
