target_customer: B2B marketing and customer marketing teams that need case studies and references
problem: Finding happy customers and turning them into case studies is manual and slow.
business_model: B2B SaaS
product_category: AI customer advocacy and social proof generation
market_need_then: B2B teams rely on social proof in sales; the company cites call recordings, NPS and Salesforce as untapped sources, but no spend data found.
outcome_analysis: Laudable raised a seed of about 2.95M in October 2021 after YC and was acquired by Base.ai in February 2025 to add conversation insights and social proof generation. Total funding appears to be about 3M, so it exited on modest capital. Terms are undisclosed and no traction figures were found, so success or failure factors cannot be assigned.

name: Laudspeaker
one_liner: Open source mobile marketing platform. Alternative to appcues /…
long_description: Open source mobile marketing automation and customer onboarding platform. Alternative to braze customer io / iterable / pendo / appcues  . Segment and engage your users with complex scheduled push notification, sms and email campaigns. (acquired by PostHog)
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Product and growth teams at software companies who want a self-hostable customer messaging tool
problem: Braze, Customer.io and Iterable are expensive and closed; teams wanted an open source way to send event-triggered push, SMS and email campaigns.
business_model: Open source with a hosted cloud subscription and enterprise edition
product_category: Open source customer messaging and onboarding automation
market_need_then: Messaging platforms were costly and closed; open source adoption among developers (about 2,357 GitHub stars at last sync) showed interest in self-hosted alternatives.
outcome_analysis: Laudspeaker was a three person open source rival to Braze and Customer.io that raised only a roughly 500K USD YC note per CB Insights. It built developer interest and a PostHog integration, and the founder's YC bio says it was acquired by PostHog in May 2025. Terms and whether the product continues are not public, so this may have been a team landing rather than a venture outcome.

name: Launcher Labs
one_liner: Maker of consumer crypto apps: Launchcaster, Frameboard, Maindrop
long_description: Launcher Labs made consumer crypto apps, including Launchcaster (acq by Orange DAO), a leading community for launching and discovering crypto projects; Frameboard, a visual curation app and protocol; Launcher Actions, a smart contract mini-app platform; and Maindrop, a Venmo for NFTs.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote

name: Legion Health
tags: Consumer Health Services; Telehealth; Healthcare; Mental Health; AI
one_liner: Autonomous medical care
long_description: Legion Health is building autonomous medical care, starting with psychiatry. Our AI-native care-delivery platform currently automates 95% of the administrative work required for us to deliver direct patient care. We also became the first company ever to receive regulatory authorization to let AI prescribe psychiatric medications, allowing us to not only collapse health care’s admin costs but also its clinical labor costs—entirely shifting this industry’s economics from humans to tokens.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Initially telehealth and mental health companies buying clinician hours; now patients, who pay or use insurance, for psychiatric care
problem: Shortage of mental health professionals; psychiatric care is administratively heavy and expensive to deliver.
business_model: Direct-care psychiatry practice with AI-automated operations (marketplace for clinician hours at launch)
product_category: AI-native telepsychiatry
founder_names: Yash Patel; Arthur MacWaters; Daniel Wilson
market_need_then: At the 2021 launch the founders cited a shortage of 230,000+ US mental health professionals; initial network was 131 professionals matched manually (HN launch post as mirrored).
outcome_analysis: Legion Health started as a manual staffing marketplace for mental health in 2021, then pivoted by 2024 into running its own AI-enabled psychiatry practice and raised a $6.3M seed. In April 2026 Utah cleared its AI to renew certain psychiatric prescriptions, a regulatory first-mover edge. It is still Active with a small team, so the outcome is unresolved.

name: LemFi
one_liner: Fair, simple and accessible financial services
long_description: LemFi makes everyday financial services fair, simple and accessible for people overlooked by traditional banks, starting with those who live and work across borders
regions: United Kingdom; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Immigrants and diaspora (first African corridors from the UK and Canada) sending money home and needing everyday financial services
problem: Banks and remittance providers charged high fees and were slow for people living and working across borders. LemFi offers cheaper transfers and, later, accounts and credit.
business_model: Remittance FX margin and fees, expanding to accounts, cards and credit
product_category: Cross-border payments and remittance fintech
competitors_at_founding: Established remittance providers (Western Union, MoneyGram and digital players)
market_need_then: Technext reported in April 2021 that Africans paid about 30 percent above global rates to send money abroad. Quartz reported users were mostly Africans abroad.
outcome_analysis: LemFi started as Lemonade Finance, discovered that its users were diaspora members, and focused on remittances. It raised a small pre-seed in 2021, a 33 million Series A in 2023 and a 53 million Series B in January 2025 and then expanded into credit through an acquisition. No failure signals were found.

name: Lendflow
one_liner: Embedded lending infrastructure for software companies
long_description: We help companies embed lending services into their software so they can better serve their customers by helping them access capital, increase engagement in their product, improve retention and expand their revenue per user.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Vertical SaaS companies, payment firms and brands that want to offer loans inside their product, plus the lenders that fund them
problem: Software companies wanted to give customers access to capital but building lending, underwriting and lender integrations was hard. Lendflow provides an API and network of lenders.
business_model: Embedded lending infrastructure: platform fees and revenue share on loans routed to its lender network
product_category: Embedded lending infrastructure (fintech)
market_need_then: Vertical SaaS and embedded finance were growing in 2021 and Lendflow's launch customers such as Levelset (construction) cited wanting to expand reach through lending products.
outcome_analysis: Lendflow raised a 10.8 million dollar Series A in October 2021 and claims a 75 plus lender network and 1.5 billion dollars in offers in the 12 months to March 2025. It remains independent, with headcount reportedly around 89 in 2026 and no layoff reports found.

name: Level
one_liner: Fast and simple fintech financing
long_description: Level provides fast and simple financing to lending startups that gets them off the ground and grows with them as they scale. We do so by buying loans in small quantities at first and rewarding our customers with more access to capital based on performance. Co-founder & CEO, Vladimir Korshin, previously worked in the traditional venture debt system at Silicon Valley Bank, where he noticed that strong startups were frequently denied from non-dilutive financing because they were too small. Just 4 weeks after going live with our first customer, we purchased $1.3M in loans across 6 customers. The founding team brings 30+ years of startup experience: Vladimir previously worked as an operator at Facebook, Eventbrite, and Niantic; Asa Schachar was an engineer at Microsoft and managed teams of engineers at Optimizely; Molly Hogan led new and international product initiatives at Amazon for over 7 years. Level is backed by Liquid2, Y Combinator (S21), and others. https://www.trylevel.app/
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Early stage consumer and small business lending startups needing loan capital
problem: New lenders need a track record to raise debt but need capital to build one; warehouse facilities are costly and inflexible.
business_model: Loan purchase financing (buys loans from startup lenders, scaling capacity with performance)
product_category: Fintech lending capital
founder_names: Vladimir Korshin; Asa Schachar; Molly Hogan
market_need_then: The Hacker News launch post argued new lenders lack history to raise capital; Level reported buying 1.3M of loans from 6 customers four weeks after its first customer went live.
outcome_analysis: Level offered loan purchase financing to young lending startups and reported early volume four weeks after launch. In January 2023 Vouch acquired it with its engineering team in what coverage describes as an acqui-hire, terms undisclosed. Funding found is only small aggregator figures, so whether the business ran out of runway is not public.

name: Levo
one_liner: Treasury management platform for SMBs to optimize idle cash in Latam
long_description: Levo is a regulated treasury management platform for startups and SMBs to optimize idle cash with tailor-made investment, cash management and working capital strategies
regions: Mexico; Latin America; Remote; Fully Remote

name: Levro
one_liner: Multicurrency account & international payments for businesses
long_description:
Levro is a multicurrency account and global payments platform for businesses. We help US & international companies hold, convert, and pay 30+ currencies. Our exchange at rates are 40-90% lower than banks and FX services like Wise. We also offer free currency risk management, recipient onboarding, automated multicurrency reconciliation, and wire tracking.

If you have international customers, employee payroll, vendors, or bulk payouts to different countries please send us a note! founders@levro.com
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: US and international businesses with international customers, payroll, vendors or bulk payouts in many currencies
problem: Banks and FX providers charge high spreads and are slow for business cross-border payments. Levro offers a multicurrency account with low FX rates and currency risk tools.
business_model: FX spread and fees on conversions and payouts
product_category: Business multicurrency account and global payments
market_need_then: The company claims exchange rates 40 to 90 percent lower than banks and FX services such as Wise (company description, self-reported).
outcome_analysis: Levro is a small YC S21 fintech listed as active with about 12 people. No verified funding round or press coverage was found, so its traction and trajectory are not public; it competes with much larger and well-funded FX players.

name: LightTwist
tags: Augmented Reality; Computer Vision; Design Tools
one_liner: Realistic virtual video studio to record and stream from your browser
long_description: LightTwist let you record and stream your show in a realistic virtual studio, even if your guests and co-hosts are remote. All you need is a camera, a browser, and LightTwist.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Creators, podcasters and companies who record or stream shows with remote guests
problem: Remote shows look like a plain video call and a physical studio is expensive. LightTwist renders a realistic virtual studio from a browser.
business_model: SaaS subscription (about 30 dollars a month for a studio library and a 500 dollar a month custom studio plan per the founder on Product Hunt)
product_category: Browser based virtual video studio
market_need_then: The shift to remote video and creator shows in 2020 and 2021 increased demand for better looking remote production; the launch post contrasts LightTwist with a boring Zoom call and costly physical studio.
outcome_analysis: LightTwist is a two person YC W21 company led by an experienced computer vision founder. No verified outside round or exit was found, and it appears to remain a small product company shipping a browser studio, so traction and outcome are not public.

name: Lightly
one_liner: Help ML teams label the right data
long_description: When ML teams send their data to companies like Scale.ai for labeling, most can only afford to label 1% or less of their datasets.  But today they don’t have a good way to pick which 1% to label. We help them pick the best 1% of their data to label.  By labeling the most representative data, they significantly improve model accuracy at the same cost.
regions: Switzerland; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Machine learning and computer vision teams in autonomous driving, robotics and video analytics
problem: Teams can afford to label only a small share of their data and lack a good way to pick which part. Lightly uses self-supervised learning to select the most representative samples.
business_model: B2B software licenses and cloud platform, with open source library and services
product_category: ML data curation and active learning platform
market_need_then: ML teams labeled only about 1 percent of data by cost, and selection was largely manual (YC page, Lightly 2022 blog). Autonomous driving and robotics produced large unlabeled datasets.
outcome_analysis: Lightly spun out of ETH research, joined YC S21 and raised a 3 million dollar seed in May 2022 led by Wingman Ventures. It has expanded from data selection to a broader Physical AI data platform with open source and community traction, but no later priced round was verified and totals vary between databases.

name: Lion Pose
one_liner: Clinical skincare tested on diverse skin, now available in Sephora.
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; Los Angeles, CA, USA; Remote
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Consumers, especially people with deeper skin tones, with hyperpigmentation, acne, dryness and barrier problems who lack dermatologist access
problem: Skincare was mostly clinically tested on lighter skin and dermatology care is hard to reach. Lion Pose sells dermatologist developed formulas with third party clinical testing on diverse skin tones.
business_model: Direct to consumer e-commerce on Shopify plus Sephora retail
product_category: Clinical skincare (consumer beauty)
market_need_then: Brands were promoting inclusivity while diverse skin testing was rare (Topicals founder quoted by Refinery29). Sephora Accelerate in 2021 focused on BIPOC owned brands.
outcome_analysis: Lion Pose went through YC W21 and Sephora Accelerate, launched at Sephora in July 2023 with a 3 million dollar seed backed by Mindy Kaling and others, and remains a small independent brand selling online and at Sephora. No later round, shutdown or acquisition was found.

name: Litnerd
one_liner: Reading + Writing Club App for Kids
long_description:
Litnerd is a kids reading + writing club app that grew by 14x this past school year. Think of us as a modern-day Scholastic, with a heavy IP play. We create original IP with our community + partner brands -> turn them into books, media and learning curriculum, layered with an AI personalized tutor to help kids learn to read and write in a personalized and engaging way.

Our product format is a Social and Gamified - with a live weekly community meetup and monthly e-tournaments. 

- And it works! Litnerd 4x improved the pass rate of students on their annual state Reading (ELA) exam.
- STICKY: Kids spend 10-20 minutes on the Litnerd app OUTSIDE of classroom time.
- KID AUTHORS: Kids are the authors of the books and Litnerd AI helps illustrate + publish the book.
- Built on the Science of Reading
- Original IP: all books, media and courseware is original content created and published by Litnerd.
all_locations: Miami, FL, USA; New York, NY, USA; Remote
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Schools, parents and kids (reading and writing club app)
problem: Kids need engaging ways to read and write outside class; Litnerd offers a social, gamified club with original IP.
business_model: B2B2C subscription (schools and consumers); exact model not sourced
product_category: Edtech, kids reading and writing app
market_need_then: Pandemic-era learning loss and school demand for engaging reading programs is plausible but not sourced here; the company self-reports 14x growth in a school year and a 4x improvement in state reading exam pass rate (YC page, unverified).
outcome_analysis: Litnerd is Active as of the directory with a small team; searches found no shutdown, acquisition or layoff news and no verified funding figures, only company-reported traction (14x growth, 4x exam pass rate). No outcome conclusion can be drawn, and missing funding data should not be read as failure.

name: Liv Labs
tags: Hardware; Consumer Health Services; Women's Health; Consumer Products
one_liner: Pelvic floor fitness made easy
long_description:
Liv Labs (@livlabsfitness) is a US-based, Y Combinator-backed women's wellness innovator. Some 78 million American women live with pelvic floor weakness and 31M worry daily about leaking. Liv Labs now sells the patented Pippa® Resistance Spring to boost a healthy user's pelvic floor fitness during exercise, when it matters most.

Pippa inventor, Carly Price, reimagined the humble pillow for Casper and has 45 patents to her name. Company CEO, Melody Roberts, incubated digital service experiences now scaling globally at McDonald's and Panera. Pippa development was substantially funded by non-dilutive SBIR grants from NIH, NSF, and State of Illinois, based on stellar product effectiveness data and user feedback like, "With this, surgery is off the table."
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Women who want to strengthen the pelvic floor, sold direct to consumer, including active women who exercise
problem: Pelvic floor weakness and leaking during exercise affect many women, and existing options require months of private regimens or clinical visits. Liv Labs offers a worn internal resistance spring that trains the pelvic floor during normal movement.
business_model: Direct to consumer hardware sales of the Pippa resistance spring kits, funded largely by non-dilutive grants
product_category: Women's health consumer device (pelvic floor fitness)
market_need_then: The company cites 78 million US women with pelvic floor weakness and 31 million who worry daily about leaks. NIH, NSF and Illinois grants funded development, indicating federal interest in the problem.
outcome_analysis: Liv Labs stayed alive on mostly non-dilutive grants and a small team, reaching market with Pippa only around 2025 after years of development from the 2017 patent filing. It remains active in 2026 with direct sales and awards but no reported equity round or large traction figure, so the story is slow, capital efficient hardware development rather than venture scale growth.

name: LiveFlow
one_liner: The Unified AI-ERP & FP&A Platform
long_description:
LiveFlow is the unified AI-ERP & FP&A platform.

We're on a mission to transform the $200B+ accounting & finance industry by replacing the fragmented, legacy finance stack with one intelligent system — eliminating the manual operational work for accounting & finance teams.

Serving +6,000 businesses. 

HQ in New York, with team members around the globe.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Small and mid-size businesses, accountants and bookkeepers who run finances in QuickBooks and spreadsheets
problem: Finance teams exported QuickBooks data and pasted it into spreadsheets each month to build reports. LiveFlow keeps the numbers live in Google Sheets and Excel.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription
product_category: Finance reporting and FP&A software, later AI-ERP
founder_names: Lasse Kalkar; Anita Koimur; Evan O'Brien
market_need_then: Finance teams complained about monthly export and paste workflows; the founders said they felt this frustration in earlier companies. Millions of businesses ran QuickBooks, and the 2021 seed press framed the problem as manual financial data flows.
outcome_analysis: LiveFlow raised a 3.5M seed in December 2021 from Moonfire, YC, Seedcamp and WndrCo, grew to a claimed 6,000 plus businesses, and raised a 13.5M Series A led by Valar in September 2024. It expanded from spreadsheet sync into FP&A and in February 2026 an AI-native ERP. Still active with a team of 51, it shows steady PMF in a niche but no exit yet.

name: Lobby
one_liner: Local onboarding for the $200B health tourism industry
long_description:
Selling healthcare products online is hard. You need accurate health data to serve customers. Getting this data is extremely difficult. 

We are building a network of locations that companies can use to collect this health data and onboard their customers. 

Today our focus is the $270B health tourism industry. We help health tourism clinics onboard customers coming from the UK.  Our licensed guides help them collect dental scans and other important health data. 

They use this data to create personalised treatment plans.
regions: United Kingdom; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Locale
one_liner: Organic and gourmet high-protein meals, designed for longevity.
long_description:
We create organic high-protein meals with high standards, backed by leading longevity research.

Our standards:
- 40-60g protein per meal
- Nutrient-dense meat (grass-fed, pasture-raised, wild-caught)
- No seed oils (cooked in extra virgin olive oil)
- 8g+ fiber per meal
- Organic, pesticide-free produce
- No processed ingredients. No refined sugars
- Microplastic-free, reusable glass jars
- High in Anti-inflammatories, and Omega-3s

Since starting in 2020, we’ve delivered 100K+ orders and are backed by a16z, Y-Combinator, Goodwater, Decent Capital, and other top investors.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Health conscious consumers in the US who subscribe to weekly high-protein prepared meals (originally shoppers wanting local bakeries and restaurants delivered in one box)
problem: Small local food businesses were unprofitable on per-delivery apps and shoppers could not get them in one order. The company later pivoted to clean high-protein meals designed for longevity.
business_model: Consumer subscription meal delivery (originally marketplace with a flat 5 dollar delivery fee)
product_category: Prepared meal delivery, food marketplace
founder_names: Christopher Clark; Kaveh Nemati; Jonathan Friedland
market_need_then: TechCrunch reported that bakeries were not on DoorDash because delivery fees made small orders uneconomic, and Locale had more than 80 vendor customers in late 2021.
outcome_analysis: Locale started in 2020 as a weekly batched marketplace for local food, raised a 2 million seed in October 2021 and about 14 million in May 2022 with a16z. It later shifted to its own high-protein longevity meals and says it has delivered over 100K orders. It remains active, but the sources do not show revenue or why the pivot happened, so the success drivers are unclear.

name: Logica
one_liner: Visual, collaborative financial modeling software
long_description: Logica helps finance teams with forecasting & budgeting.  The software provides a drag and drop interface for building financial models that can be updated and shared in real time and connects with accounting and analysis tools for comparing plan vs actual.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Mid-market finance teams, SMBs, fractional CFOs and accounting firms moving beyond spreadsheets
problem: Financial models in spreadsheets are hard to share, scenario test and update. Logica offers visual, collaborative drag-and-drop financial modeling with plan versus actual.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with Basic, Business and Enterprise tiers
product_category: FP&A and financial modeling software
market_need_then: Spreadsheets dominated planning at SMBs and the company contrasts itself with rigid enterprise tools; no dated demand data found beyond the Finmark funding news in 2020.
outcome_analysis: Logica launched on Product Hunt in February 2021 as part of YC Winter 2021 and is still active with two listed team members and mid-market customers such as CQuence Health. No primary source confirms any round or exit, so the record shows a small steady product without evidence of venture scale traction.

name: LogisticsOS
tags: SaaS; Delivery; Logistics; API; Cloud Computing
one_liner: World's fastest and most optimal route optimization engine
long_description: LogisticsOS provides route optimization and fleet dispatching algorithms as services to let any last-mile company offer same-day and next-hour delivery. We are the creators of the route optimization engine that both FedEx and USPS are using on production today. We increase profit per delivery by 15% and optimize thousands of deliveries in seconds using 30X faster algorithms.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Last-mile delivery and fleet companies that need dispatch and route optimization as an API
problem: Last-mile operators need fast route and dispatch algorithms to offer same-day and next-hour delivery profitably.
business_model: Usage-based algorithm API (REST)
product_category: Route optimization and fleet dispatch API
market_need_then: Growth in same-day and last-mile delivery in 2020 and 2021; no direct spend evidence found.
outcome_analysis: LogisticsOS is an active small route optimization API company from YC Winter 2021. The founders claim FedEx and USPS use its engine in production, which is unverified. Funding is reported at about 130 thousand dollars by one database and no larger round is confirmed, so the story is a capital light technical team with unknown traction and no clear success or failure signal.

name: LootRush
one_liner: The global operating account you truly deserve.
long_description: The account designed to earn in one country, live in another, and access assets everywhere.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Gamers wanting to play blockchain games without buying expensive NFTs (original); later users who earn in one country and live in another via a global operating account
problem: Blockchain games such as Axie Infinity required costly NFTs to start. LootRush let players access NFTs in a few clicks. The current YC page describes a global operating account.
business_model: Platform taking a share of NFT rental and play revenue (original, inferred from the product description); current model not stated
product_category: Web3 gaming access platform, later cross-border account
market_need_then: Axie Infinity scholarships exploded in 2021 with YGG growing 8,500 percent year over year, showing demand for lowering NFT entry costs.
outcome_analysis: LootRush rode the 2021 play-to-earn boom and raised a 12 million round led by Paradigm in May 2022, just before the sector cooled. The current YC description is a cross-border account, which suggests the gaming model changed, but no source states the cause or date of the shift. The company is listed active with open engineering roles.

name: Lovd
one_liner: It's not used, it's Lovd.
long_description: Buy and sell previously Lovd goods. We'll pick up and deliver in 24 hours. Only in NYC.
all_locations: Los Angeles, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Luable
one_liner: Latin America's Deposits Marketplace for Banks
long_description:
Luable is an Bank Deposits Marketplace in Latin America where Banks can get faster and cheaper funding from Retail users compared to opening traditional branch offices or hiring more Sales Representatives.

Luable's Marketplace features all banks in one place so retail users can choose for their best needs, and enables upcoming banks to provide a full digital experience with no fixed costs. 

Since Launching in 2021, Luable has processed over USD $30M in deposits for many banks and its currently expanding its operations from Colombia to Mexico and the Caribbean.
regions: Colombia; Latin America; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Colombian retail savers (free to them) and banks that pay for each deposit customer
problem: Banks in Latin America needed cheaper funding than branches and sales reps, and savers could not easily compare CDT fixed-term deposit rates. Luable runs MejorCDT, a marketplace to compare and open CDTs digitally.
business_model: Marketplace where banks pay per client brought in
product_category: Deposits marketplace (fintech, Latin America)
market_need_then: Banks sought cheaper deposit funding than branches, and savers lacked a place to compare CDT rates; the site claims MejorCDT is the only simulator that checks bank rates periodically.
outcome_analysis: Luable's MejorCDT grew to more than 700,000 users and over 30 million dollars in deposits processed by the company's own count, crossed 1 million dollars in sales per Forbes Colombia in 2024, and relaunched its app in October 2026. The bank-pays model keeps it free for savers. It remains active with 40 staff and expansion plans to Mexico and the Caribbean.

name: Luminate
tags: Hard Tech; Consumer Health Services; Medical Devices
one_liner: We make cancer care at home possible.
regions: Ireland; Europe
target_customer: Cancer patients, oncologists, hospitals and insurers (home cancer infusion; chemotherapy side-effect devices)
problem: Chemotherapy causes hair loss and other side effects, and cancer drug infusions require hospital visits; Luminate builds devices to preserve hair and move infusions home.
business_model: Medical devices plus a home-infusion care program (reimbursed via oncologists and insurers)
product_category: Medical devices / home cancer care
founder_names: Aaron Hannon; Barbara Oliveira; Martin O'Halloran
market_need_then: TechCrunch (Aug 2021) described chemotherapy hair loss as costly and distressing, with animal tests showing about 80% retention and Irish government grants funding the work so far.
outcome_analysis: Luminate began as a chemotherapy hair-loss device developed at the University of Galway and joined YC in Summer 2021. It then raised a $15M Series A in September 2024 (plus $2.5M in December 2024) and a $21M expansion in January 2026, bringing total funding past $50M by the company's count, with 60-plus staff and a widened home-cancer-infusion program. It is a strong regulated-hardware story, but the devices are still in trials with launch targeted for 2027 and no exit.

name: Lunatic
one_liner: Operating System for server-side apps
long_description: At the core of the company there is Lunatic, a runtime for developing low latency, robust and distributed networking applications. It can be used for web applications, game servers, video and voice chat, or other apps requiring low latency runtimes. Lunatic borrows many proven ideas from Go and Erlang, but also uses WebAssembly to make it easier targetable from existing languages, allowing teams to leverage already existing code and libraries.
regions: Austria; Europe; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Backend developers and teams building low-latency distributed apps (game servers, chat, web backends)
problem: Building fault-tolerant, highly concurrent servers is hard in mainstream languages; Lunatic offers Erlang-style lightweight processes on WebAssembly so any language can use them.
business_model: Open source runtime with planned paid hosting or managed platform (no pricing found)
product_category: WebAssembly application runtime / developer infrastructure
market_need_then: Interest in WebAssembly beyond browsers was rising in 2020 and 2021 and Erlang-style concurrency had a loyal following, but a commercial buyer for a new runtime was unproven.
outcome_analysis: YC lists Lunatic as inactive, yet the website still loads with a 2023 footer and no shutdown notice or post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public. A two-person team faced established runtimes from well-funded platforms and had no verified funding beyond YC, but no source states why activity stopped, so failure factors are left empty.

name: Lygg
one_liner: Building New Anti-Aging Ingredients for Skincare
long_description: Up to 90% of skin aging is caused by UV light from the sun. Most of this is caused by UVA light and only two FDA-approved chemical ingredients protect against it, one of which is neither photostable nor GRASE. To address this, we have developed a patented, photostable, and safe ingredient that can dramatically increase current UVA protection.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Sunscreen and skincare formulators and brands that license anti-aging UVA protection ingredients
problem: Only two FDA-approved chemical ingredients protect against UVA, and one is neither photostable nor GRASE, while UV causes most skin aging. Lygg developed a patented photostable ingredient to boost UVA protection.
business_model: Ingredient development and licensing to skincare brands (not confirmed by the company site)
product_category: Cosmetic and sunscreen active ingredient
market_need_then: Hawaii banned two sunscreen ingredients (the YC page cites this) and the YC page notes up to 90 percent of skin aging comes from UV light; the page's claim that only two FDA approved chemical UVA filters exist reflects limited options.
outcome_analysis: Lygg is a one person YC Winter 2021 company building a UVA filter ingredient. Its website offers a single line and the sources give no verified funding, customers or milestones, so the outcome is unknown. Research-heavy regulatory timelines make slow progress plausible, but no source confirms the reason for the quiet record.

name: Mable
one_liner: First personalized migraine clinic using genetics and telehealth.
long_description:
Mable is a personalized migraine clinic using DNA to find and provide the right medication alongside continuous expert care

Using our approach, patients have an 80% higher treatment satisfaction rate, have one extra day per week to enjoy their life and get 55% pain reduction.
all_locations: London, England, United Kingdom; San Francisco, CA, USA; Remote
regions: United Kingdom; United States of America; Europe; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Migraine patients, with employers as a stated secondary payer in the seed announcement
problem: Migraine patients cycle through medications by trial and error. Mable used a cheek swab pharmacogenetic test plus telehealth to pick the drug and dose, with ongoing clinician follow up.
business_model: Direct to consumer telehealth clinic with genetic testing and prescriptions; employer benefit angle mentioned
product_category: Telehealth, pharmacogenomics, migraine care
market_need_then: The seed announcement cites migraines costing US employers about 13 billion dollars a year per the Initialized post; many patients lack effective personalized treatment.
outcome_analysis: Mable raised a 3.2 million dollar seed in July 2022 led by Initialized, then appears to have wound down: a directory reports the UK entity was dissolved in August 2023 while YC lists it as acquired with no named buyer. The cause is not public. Failure to raise a follow on round in the 2022 to 2023 funding downturn is a plausible but unconfirmed reading, so it is tagged with low certainty.

name: Mach9
tags: Machine Learning; Computer Vision; Design Tools; Infrastructure; AI
one_liner: AI CAD Software for Civil Engineering
long_description: Mach9 accelerates how teams model and understand the world with automated feature extraction technology. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, Mach9's flagship Digital Surveyor platform helps transportation agencies, utility companies, and engineering firms extract miles of road corridor projects in a fraction of traditional processing time. Built on decades of research from Carnegie Mellon University's Robotics Institute, Mach9 empowers the architecture, engineering, and construction industries to tackle large-scale infrastructure projects with unprecedented speed and accuracy. Leading survey and geospatial organizations, including Langan, Olsson, Woolpert, HDR, and major state DOTs trust Digital Surveyor to create engineering-grade maps for infrastructure design and operations.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Civil engineering, surveying and mapping firms and transportation agencies that process LiDAR scans (customers named include Langan, Olsson, Woolpert, HDR, Michael Baker, state DOTs)
problem: Turning raw LiDAR point clouds into engineering drawings is slow manual work. Mach9 started with mobile mapping hardware for inspection and now sells AI software that drafts features such as curbs and guardrails.
business_model: B2B software subscription (originally hardware plus software)
product_category: AI CAD and geospatial feature extraction for civil engineering
founder_names: Alexander Baikovitz; Haowen Shi; Zach Sussman; Michael Mong
market_need_then: Civil engineers relied on slow manual extraction from scans; the original goal in 2021 was better and cheaper visual inspection tools. Federal infrastructure spending and rising LiDAR use added demand.
outcome_analysis: Mach9 began in 2021 as a CMU spinout building mobile mapping hardware, then pivoted to software by March 2023 after finding hardware was not the bottleneck. It raised a 12 million seed in November 2024 and a 34 million Series A in October 2026 with nearly 100 beta customers and over 2,500 projects. The pivot to software on partners' hardware found a real workflow need.

name: Machine26
one_liner: Marketplace for construction machines
long_description: Machine26 is a marketplace that helps construction machine owners to sell their machines without any effort. Our inspection app collects all relevant data on the machine condition so that our customers can receive the best offer from international used dealers within a few days.
regions: Germany; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Owners of used construction machines (contractors and small construction companies) who want to resell them, and international used equipment dealers who bid on them
problem: Selling a used construction machine is slow and opaque for owners, who lack access to an international dealer network and a standard way to document machine condition.
business_model: Marketplace and remarketing service for used construction machines (inspection app plus dealer bidding; fee structure not stated in sources)
product_category: Used construction equipment marketplace and inspection software
founder_names: Steffen Schweiger; Christian Schweiger; Niklas Fritz
market_need_then: Used construction machines are traded through local dealers and auctions; the company's pitch is that small owners cannot reach international buyers easily. No dated demand statistics were found.
outcome_analysis: Machine26 remains active as a small Berlin team of about 12 per YC. No outcome event such as an acquisition or shutdown was found in a dedicated search. Public funding information is limited to database entries of roughly 125 thousand to 190 thousand dollars, so the company appears capital light, but this cannot be confirmed. It announced a partnership with Cemex Germany in 2023 according to search results, which suggests some commercial traction.

name: MadEats
one_liner: Online delivery-only restaurant group in the Philippines
long_description:
MadEats is an online delivery-only restaurant group in the Philippines, building affordable, high margin food brands by using our own ghost kitchens. 

Since we use ghost kitchens, we don’t have to spend for expensive dining areas and wait staff. We can spend more money on growing our food brands, better food, and making better delivery experiences.
regions: Philippines; Southeast Asia; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Consumers in Metro Manila ordering food delivery through apps and its own channels
problem: Restaurants carry heavy rent, dining space and wait staff costs. MadEats ran delivery-only food brands from its own ghost kitchens to spend more on food and delivery.
business_model: Own-brand ghost kitchen restaurant group selling through delivery apps and direct
product_category: Ghost kitchens, delivery-only restaurant brands
founder_names: Mikee Villareal; Andie Cruz; Keisha Lao
market_need_then: Pandemic lockdowns in 2020 and 2021 pushed Philippine diners to delivery, and e27 and Inquirer coverage discussed rising cloud kitchen interest.
outcome_analysis: MadEats raised a pre-seed in late 2020 led by Tinder co-founder Justin Mateen, joined YC in summer 2021, and closed a 1.7 million dollar seed in April 2022. YC lists it as acquired but no acquirer, date or price is public, and the storefront showed an opening soon banner. The cause or terms of the exit are not public, so no factors are assigned.

name: MagicBell
one_liner: The notification inbox for web/mobile applications.
long_description:
MagicBell is the notification inbox for web & mobile apps.

As consumers of many apps, we have personally experienced the growing volume of notifications - many of which add to our anxiety instead of helping us manage it. MagicBell is on a mission to end this chaos and help every app deliver a stellar notification experience.

We do this by offering a beautifully designed notification inbox that apps can embed in their products in minutes. We do all the heavy lifting related to real-time delivery & syncing, web & mobile push notifications, email notifications, and even notification preference management.

We sit at an interesting intersection of a dev tool & a productivity tool for end-users. We are helping every app make its users more productive!
regions: Spain; Europe; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Product and engineering teams at SaaS and mobile apps that want an embeddable notification inbox and multichannel delivery without building it themselves
problem: Building real time notification delivery, read state sync, channel routing and per user preferences takes a lot of engineering time, and email based notifications are inefficient.
business_model: Usage based developer API and SaaS with a free tier of 1,000 deliveries per month and paid monthly plans
product_category: Notification infrastructure and in-app inbox for developers
market_need_then: The founders met the problem at SupportBee, where notification systems consumed engineering time; TechCrunch reported that several early customers invested, including Pitch before its co-founder invested.
outcome_analysis: MagicBell raised a 1.9 million dollar seed from Cherry Ventures and angels in April 2021 right after Winter 2021, built on the founders' experience with notifications at SupportBee, and is still operating in 2026 with a free tier and over 1,000 customer companies claimed on its site. No Series A, acquisition or shutdown was found, and the notification category now has several funded rivals, so it appears to be a stable but modest company.

name: Mailmodo
one_liner: No-code email marketing platform to send forms & widgets within emails
long_description: Mailmodo is an email marketing software that helps marketers create app-like experiences in email by adding forms, shopping cart, calendar, NPS and more widgets within the email. Our interactive emails reduce the number of steps for users, thereby increasing email conversions. You can use it to collect feedback from your users, book meetings with prospects, recover abandon carts, generate leads, and more all within emails.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Marketers at startups and growth companies, largely in India, sending email campaigns
problem: Email conversion needs multiple clicks and page loads. Mailmodo lets marketers embed forms, carts, calendars and NPS widgets inside the email using AMP, without code.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for email marketing, tiered by contacts and sends
product_category: Email marketing, interactive AMP email
market_need_then: Google made AMP for Email public and early coverage said most ESPs did not support it, leaving a niche; Indian startups were adopting SaaS marketing tools.
outcome_analysis: Mailmodo rode the opening of AMP for Email, raising a 270 thousand dollar pre-seed in January 2021 and a 2 million dollar seed from Surge and YC in July 2021. YC lists it as acquired, but no buyer is named and the company site in 2026 shows no ownership change, so the status is unverified. It reached 70 staff per YC and customers such as Razorpay and bigbasket per its own site.

name: Makani Science
one_liner: Reinventing respiration monitoring
long_description:
Makani Science is a medical device company based in Irvine, California. We have created the world's first wireless patch that can accurately and continuously monitor breathing. The company is co-founded by Dr. Michelle Khine and Dr. Michael Chu, two experts in the wearable monitoring space from the University of California, Irvine. 

The Makani Science system will collect unique breathing waveforms from patients in everyday environments to create the first large database of respiratory patterns associated with different diseases. Data will be collected through systems sold to our initial beachhead market, where we will help improve monitoring safety in patients being sedated for medical procedures. Our long-term goal is to combine machine learning with this database to identify and predict respiratory complications for different patient populations. 

We have a highly experienced team and will be FDA cleared in our beachhead market within a year.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Hospitals, surgery centers and dental offices that sedate patients and need continuous respiration monitoring
problem: Patients under sedation can stop breathing unnoticed, and existing monitors such as pulse oximetry and capnography are indirect or poorly tolerated.
business_model: Medical device sales (wireless respiration patch plus monitoring system) to healthcare facilities; later respiratory data platform
product_category: Wearable respiratory monitoring medical device
competitors_at_founding: Respiratory Motion (ExSpiron); Masimo rainbow Acoustic Monitoring
market_need_then: Sedation safety monitoring is a known gap; the company cites a market for respiratory monitoring devices (pulse oximetry, capnography, spirometry) and a 2015 press release describes capnography and pulse oximetry as inadequate in studies.
outcome_analysis: Makani Science spun out of a UC Irvine lab, raised small early funding, and reached FDA 510(k) clearance for its respiration monitor in March 2025 after joining YC in Summer 2021, a slow timeline typical of medical devices. It remains active with an NIH grant for infant apnea work. Commercial traction is not yet public, so the story is a long regulatory path rather than a fast growth outcome.

name: Malga
one_liner: Malga is an API to accept payments with multiple payment providers
long_description: Malga gives digital businesses access to multiple payments services through a single integration, and the ability to change between them on a transaction to transaction basis without writing code.
regions: Brazil; Latin America; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Brazilian digital businesses, e-commerce and B2B platforms that process online payments through several providers
problem: Companies integrate one payment provider at a time and cannot easily switch, retry or route transactions between providers without engineering work.
business_model: B2B payments orchestration API (usage based fees, details not stated in sources)
product_category: Payment orchestration infrastructure
founder_names: Alex Vilhena; Thiago Garuti; Marcel Nicolay
market_need_then: Brazilian merchants used many local payment methods and providers; the company reported processing R$15 billion in 2025 and R$4 billion planned for 2024, indicating demand, but no dated 2020 demand evidence was found.
outcome_analysis: Malga, formerly Plug, grew from a 2020 Rio de Janeiro start into a payments orchestration company with 46 staff per YC, raised a small seed in 2021 and a 5.5 million dollar Series A in February 2025 led by TOTVS iDEXO and Costanoa. It reports R$15 billion processed in 2025 and plans to double it. It stays focused on Brazil, and there is no sign of an exit or distress.

name: Malloc Inc
one_liner: AI-driven mobile cybersecurity
long_description: Malloc monitors and prevents anyone from recoding or transmitting data from your mobile device without your knowledge. Malloc uses on-device AI to detect zero-click spyware and abnormal activity and blocks any suspicious communication in real time. We sell this to individuals, enterprises and governments that care about their privacy.
regions: Cyprus; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Privacy conscious individuals first, then enterprises and governments that need to detect spyware and unwanted data transmission on mobile devices
problem: Zero click spyware and apps can record or transmit data from a phone without the user knowing, and signature based scanners miss new spyware.
business_model: Consumer mobile security app (freemium) with planned enterprise and government offerings
product_category: Mobile cybersecurity and privacy
founder_names: Maria Terzi; Liza Charalambous; Artemis Kontou
competitors_at_founding: Apple and Google built in camera and microphone indicators; Malwarebytes
market_need_then: TechCrunch reported over 80,000 monthly active users for the Antistalker app within months of its 2021 launch, and stalkerware and spyware risk was widely discussed.
outcome_analysis: Malloc, a Cyprus based mobile spyware detection company, launched the Antistalker app and reached over 80,000 monthly users in 2021, then raised nearly 2 million dollars from YC and the Urban Innovation Fund. It later won research grants and a 2026 headline suggests interest in defence customers. No Series A, acquisition or shutdown was found, so it is a small active company still in an early stage.

name: Manara
one_liner: Connecting top Middle East talent to global tech jobs
long_description: Manara untaps the human potential in the Arab world and helps global tech companies access high-quality, diverse talent. We identify the top software engineers in the region and offer them a last-mile solution to land their dream jobs: interview preparation and referrals.
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; Berkeley, CA, USA; Remote
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Software engineers in the Middle East and North Africa (candidates) and global tech employers that hire them; later enterprises, governments and individuals buying upskilling programs
problem: Talented Arab engineers lack interview preparation and referrals to land global tech jobs, while global companies struggle to reach diverse talent in the region.
business_model: Cohort based training and recruiting; placement referrals to employers, later paid upskilling programs for enterprises and governments
product_category: Edtech and tech talent placement
market_need_then: Launch HN thread (January 2021) reports 67 percent of candidates referred to Google for internships passed the hiring committee, and the company stated high employer demand for diverse remote engineers.
outcome_analysis: Manara began as a pilot in 2018 and officially launched in November 2020, joined YC Winter 2021, and raised a 3 million dollar pre-seed in May 2022 led by Stripe. The founders' direct experience of the region gave strong founder market fit. Its site now describes a broader upskilling business with enterprise partners, and no layoffs, acquisition or later priced round were found.

name: MarcoPolo
one_liner: Alibaba for Latin America
long_description: Marketplace for US companies to source products from LatAm manufacturers
regions: Mexico; Latin America

name: Maroo
one_liner: CRM for creatives (acquired by Helium Ventures)
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Independent creatives and later wedding and event businesses such as photographers, planners, venues and caterers
problem: Small creative and event businesses juggle leads, quotes, contracts, invoices and contractor payments across separate tools. Maroo bundles CRM with payments.
business_model: SaaS plus payments; free plan with zero fee ACH and cards, revenue from payments and paid tiers
product_category: CRM and payments for creative and event businesses
founder_names: Alex Nikityuk; Andrei Riaskov; Anja Winikka
market_need_then: Not evidenced by a dated source in this research; the product later narrowed to wedding and event businesses.
outcome_analysis: Maroo started as a CRM for creatives out of YC Summer 2021, took a small pre-seed round and total funding reported near 3.8 to 3.96 million dollars, and narrowed toward wedding and event businesses with payments. It was acquired by Helium Ventures in April 2026 with terms undisclosed. The company claims over 13,000 to 15,000 businesses on the platform, which suggests a modest but real small business footprint.

name: MarqVision
tags: SaaS; Computer Vision; B2B; LegalTech; AI
one_liner: IP operating software for brands and content companies
long_description:
MarqVision’s mission is to protect and build a future shaped by original ideas, innovations, and creativity. As a leading online brand protection solution, we help global brands identify and remove counterfeits and combat piracy from over 1,500 platforms and thousands of rogue websites in over 118 countries. In a time when counterfeiting poses an increasingly serious challenge, we believe that democratizing legal expertise and access to the latest in generative AI technology is critical for continuing to support the inventors, developers, and artists of the world who work tirelessly to deliver safe, high-quality products.

MarqVision’s technology powers everything from detection, monitoring, and even enforcement to protect brands at scale. Founded in 2020 by Harvard Law graduates, MarqVision is proudly backed by Altos Ventures, DST Global Partners, Softbank, Atinum Investments and Y Combinator. Our commitment to innovation has also been recognized with a prestigious 2022 Innovation Award from LVMH Louis Vuitton Moët Hennessy (LVMH), and we are honored to be part of the LVMH accelerator program, La Maison des Startups, at the Station F incubator. As we bring forth the next evolution of brand protection, we invite businesses everywhere to join us in safeguarding the creativity that drives our world.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Global consumer brands and content companies that need to find and remove counterfeits, impersonators, gray market sellers and pirated content online
problem: Counterfeits and piracy spread across thousands of marketplaces and sites, and brands lack scalable tools and legal expertise to detect and enforce.
business_model: B2B AI managed service and SaaS for brand protection with attached legal enforcement (MarqLaw); self serve pricing from 99 dollars a month listed on the site
product_category: AI brand protection and IP enforcement software
market_need_then: The Block coverage of the 2022 round links the product to NFT and consumer counterfeit detection, and the company claims LVMH's 2022 Innovation Award; dated 2021 market size figures were not found.
outcome_analysis: MarqVision, founded in 2020, joined YC in Summer 2021 and grew into a roughly 200 to 260 person company serving about 350 brand partners, raising a Series A in 2022, an extension in 2024 and a 48 million dollar Series B in September 2025 from Peak XV, Salesforce Ventures and others. Its enterprise sales motion and legal services layer drive growth, and the company remains private with no distress found.

name: Matidor.com
one_liner: Project management on a live map
long_description:
Matidor.com is a project management software for projects where you need to see what's happening live on a map. Natural resources companies such as energy operators and consultants manage their environmental activities across thousands of locations. Instead of switching between spreadsheets, they need to visualize their projects on a map and zoom into each one of them for details such as site drawings, tasks, costs and communications.

https://matidor.com
regions: Canada; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Environmental services, energy, oil and gas and vegetation management firms and consultants that run projects across many field sites
problem: Teams manage thousands of site locations across spreadsheets, drawings, tasks, costs and communications, with no single live map view.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for map based project management and field operations
product_category: Geospatial project management and field operations software
market_need_then: Matidor's 2020 TechCrunch Startup Battlefield placing and early customers such as Arup (partnership announced in trade press) show demand for map based collaboration; the YC description cites energy operators managing environmental activities across thousands of locations.
outcome_analysis: Matidor, a Vancouver map based project management company, placed second at TechCrunch Disrupt Startup Battlefield in 2020, joined YC Summer 2021 and raised a seed of about 1.9 million dollars in January 2022. It has named customers such as GFL Environmental, Peyto and Arup and an Esri partnership, and remains small. No later priced round, acquisition or shutdown was found, so it looks like a modest, steady niche SaaS business.

name: Matrubials
tags: AI-powered Drug Discovery; Women's Health; Therapeutics
one_liner: Developing milk-inspired therapeutics for infectious diseases
long_description: Matrubials is an anti-infectives company, focused on human milk peptides as therapeutics to address antimicrobial resistance and modern diseases. Currently the global rise in severe bacterial infections and the drying pipeline of effective treatments are burdensome for healthcare and economics. Sculpted by evolution, milk, first food for the newborn, provides an exemplary solution to address the nutritive and protective challenges an infant is faced with. The anti-pathogenic molecules from milk can be developed into therapeutics geared towards all-age diseases. Our first indication is bacterial vaginosis, a bacterial dysbiosis related inflammation that results in recurrent infections, disruption of homeostasis and long-term clinical complications in women of reproductive age, including but not limited to preterm births, fertility issues and increased rates of STDs. Our next inflection point is the evaluation of rapidly acting and selective candidate peptides in pre-clinical host impact and early safety studies, which can aid clinical and portfolio development towards topical applications.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Pharmaceutical partners and women with recurrent bacterial vaginosis (future prescribers and payers of a topical therapeutic)
problem: Antimicrobial resistance and a thin antibiotic pipeline leave recurrent bacterial vaginosis poorly treated; broad antibiotics also harm beneficial bacteria.
business_model: Preclinical biotech developing milk-peptide therapeutics, funded by grants and equity, aiming at licensing or clinical development
product_category: Anti-infective peptide therapeutics
founder_names: Bruce German; Carlito Lebrilla; David Mills
market_need_then: The company site says bacterial vaginosis affects almost a third of women and rising resistance is a recognised problem; the NIH funded a Phase I grant in 2022 for the lead peptide.
outcome_analysis: Matrubials remains an active, tiny preclinical biotech spun out of UC Davis, run by three professors with prior startup experience. It won an NIH Phase I grant in 2022 and an aggregated article reported about 1.1 million dollars raised overall, with a seed round still open. No clinical data, large round or exit was found, so its outcome is still undetermined and it is early stage.

name: Mayan
one_liner: A growth automation platform for Amazon sellers
long_description: We help Amazon sellers grow their business with our data-driven automations. We are starting out with advertising and inventory. From there, we're moving to other avenues that help accelerate brand growth!
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Amazon FBA sellers and brands that spend on Amazon advertising
problem: Amazon sellers must manage advertising bids and inventory across many products by hand, which wastes ad spend and time.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscriptions plus managed ad optimization services
product_category: Amazon seller growth automation and ads optimization
market_need_then: Amazon third party selling and ad spend grew quickly in 2020 and 2021, and the company reports customers gaining ad sales, though those figures are self-reported.
outcome_analysis: Mayan raised a seed round after YC W21 and a 5M Series A led by Bright Pixel in March 2023, and still operates with a team of 14 on the YC page. It sells ad optimization to Amazon sellers in a crowded category with funded rivals. No exit or shutdown was found, so it looks like a steady but modest growth company; reported customer results are self-reported.

name: Measured
one_liner: Telemedicine platform for chronic conditions like obesity
long_description: Measured is a telemedicine platform helping people with chronic conditions get access to affordable care. We're growing rapidly and have thousands of customers across the US.
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; New York, NY, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: US consumers with obesity or chronic conditions paying for telehealth care and prescriptions
problem: Access to affordable, medically supervised weight management and chronic condition care is limited.
business_model: Direct to consumer telehealth subscription with prescriptions and coaching
product_category: Telemedicine for weight loss
market_need_then: Digital weight management companies raised about 740M dollars in 2021 rounds per trade coverage, showing strong investor and consumer demand.
outcome_analysis: Measured is still operating as a direct to consumer GLP-1 telehealth brand run by Better Health Labs in New York. No outside funding was found and aggregators conflict, so traction is uncertain. A March 2026 FDA warning letter on compounded GLP-1 marketing is a regulatory risk, but no shutdown or acquisition was found.

name: Mecho Autotech
one_liner: On-demand  auto maintenance & repairs
long_description:
It is cumbersome to maintain/repair vehicles in Africa. Vehicle owners currently have 2 options to choose from; very expensive and geographically limited branded mechanic garages (less than 1% of the supply pool) or unvetted roadside mechanics (about 99% of the supply pool). 

About 95% of vehicle owners cannot afford branded garages where quality and reliable service delivery can be guaranteed and thus rely on roadside mechanics. However, low quality and transparency are typical issues associated with roadside mechanics. 

We created a network of vetted mechanics, spare part vendors and an app that enables easy booking, payment and mechanic matching process. Via the mecho app, a customer or business can make a request for any automobile service (repairs or regular servicing) or part.
regions: United States of America; Nigeria; America / Canada; Africa
target_customer: Vehicle owners and fleets in Nigeria needing maintenance, and later workshops and spare part dealers
problem: Car owners in Nigeria rely on unvetted roadside mechanics and fragmented spare part supply.
business_model: Marketplace and service network taking a margin on repairs and parts
product_category: On demand auto repair and spare parts marketplace
market_need_then: Mecho states most owners rely on unvetted roadside mechanics; fleet clients such as Shuttlers and Moove were reported in secondary coverage.
outcome_analysis: Mecho raised a 2.15M seed in February 2022 and 2.4M in September 2023, and expanded into spare parts. A December 2024 repost of TechCabal reported restructuring after currency volatility and economic pressure, moving staff to contracts and cutting some of about 40 employees. It is still listed Active but is under strain from the Nigerian macro environment.

name: MedMe Health
tags: SaaS; B2B; Digital Health; Healthcare; Healthcare IT
one_liner: Software for pharmacies to move beyond dispensing
long_description:
MedMe Health builds software for pharmacists to deliver paid clinical services like prescribing/adapting medications, point-of-care testing, giving vaccinations, and monitoring chronic conditions.  

Our web-based platform helps both independent pharmacies and large chains schedule appointments online, conduct virtual care, automate documentation, and flag clinical opportunities. With MedMe, our customers have increased their efficiency of clinical service delivery by 10x and increased pharmacy revenue with the same staff.

For the first time, MedMe enables integrations to traditionally locally-stored pharmacy data. Our vision is to transform today’s dispensing locations to tomorrow’s health hubs.
regions: Canada; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Independent pharmacies and pharmacy chains offering paid clinical services
problem: Pharmacists want to offer prescribing, testing and vaccination services but lack software for scheduling, documentation and billing.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for pharmacies
product_category: Pharmacy clinical services software
founder_names: Purya Sarmadi; Nick Hui; Rui Su
market_need_then: Pharmacist scope of practice was expanding in Canada, and the company positioned pharmacies as health hubs; MaRS and Microsoft's M12 backed the thesis in 2022.

name: Medium Biosciences
one_liner: AI-designed Affinity Reagents
long_description: We turn advances in AI and protein design into experimentally validated molecular tools, partnering with research teams and diagnostic developers to deliver high-performance affinity reagents in weeks, not months.

name: MeetAnyway
one_liner: We help run engaging online conferences.
long_description: We help run engaging online conferences. Unlike Hopin or Zoom, we are super focused on connecting conference attendees with each other. Most attendees don’t actually go to watch the talks, they go for the networking. With us they can self-organize, meet and stay in touch. Usually it's incredibly hard for the organizer to build conferences which lead to key business opportunities for the attendees. We have good networking built-in.
regions: Germany; Europe; Remote; Fully Remote

name: Membo
one_liner: Groceries fresher than a farmer’s market, delivered to you (EU)
long_description: Membo is a next-day grocery delivery app for premium customers in Europe. Like PinDuoDuo Groceries in China, Membo is the fastest way to order your weekly groceries directly from local food producers. The convenience of supermarkets & 15-minute grocery apps comes at the expense of freshness: food that should be delivered fresh, gets bought in bulk and sits on warehouse shelves for days. To get the freshest produce, you need quick producer-to-end-customer delivery, not just quick warehouse-to-customer delivery. Membo lets you order food directly from hundreds of local food producers & organises delivery so you always get the freshest version of every product. Membo's CEO, Vahur Hansen, was an early engineer at TransferWise, and co-founder, Paula Kink, built her own healthtech startup. Launched in Dec 2020, we've grown 30% MoM for the past 8 months and have delivered over 4000 orders in Tallinn, Estonia.
regions: Estonia; Europe

name: Mendel
one_liner: Workflows to empower employees to spend while finance stay in control
regions: Mexico; Latin America; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Finance teams of mid size and large companies in Mexico and Latin America

Two repeat founders with earlier exits, a focus on large Latin American firms and local tax tooling drove steady growth. No acquisition or layoffs were found.

name: Mentorcam

long_description: Mentorcam is a marketplace for 1:1 business and career advice.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Mentum

one_liner: AI-Powered Assistant for Procurement and Strategic Sourcing
long_description: Mentum helps procurement and supply chain teams streamline strategic sourcing with AI, transforming unstructured data into actionable insights for faster decisions and cost savings. Backed by Google’s Gradient Ventures and Y Combinator, we serve industries like CPG, energy, automotive, and aerospace.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: At founding, fintechs and wealth managers needing an investment API; after the pivot, procurement and supply chain teams in CPG, energy, automotive and aerospace
problem: Fintechs wanted to offer investment products without building brokerage plumbing. Later, procurement teams struggled to turn unstructured sourcing data into decisions.

Terms were not disclosed, and the pivot reason and date are not public.

name: Mergent
one_liner: Incredibly reliable background task queues and cron jobs
long_description:
Mergent is a task scheduling API that makes it super easy for developers to schedule and manage background tasks like notifications, data processing, and third-party integrations.

We provide a simple well-documented API that any developer can instantly start using straight from our website.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Developers and startups needing background jobs, cron and delayed tasks without running queues
problem: Running reliable background task queues and cron jobs on serverless platforms is hard and distracting for small teams.
business_model: Usage-based API subscription
product_category: Task scheduling API and developer infrastructure
market_need_then: Serverless platforms lacked native queues and cron, which Quirrel's maintainer described as the reason it existed, indicating demand.
outcome_analysis: Mergent was a one person scheduling API that processed hundreds of billions of tasks per Resend and was acquired by Resend in April 2025 with the product sunset on July 28, 2025. No funding was found, so it was likely small. The team absorption plus product shutdown fits a soft landing rather than a venture outcome, though terms were not disclosed.

name: Meru.com
one_liner: The one-stop-shop for auto-parts in Mexico.
long_description: Meru is a platform that is optimizing the automotive aftermarket supply chain for mechanics in Latin America.
regions: Mexico; Latin America; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Independent auto mechanics and small repair shops in Mexico buying aftermarket parts
problem: Mechanics buy parts through many intermediaries with poor price transparency, uncertain availability and fraud risk. Meru sources directly from manufacturers and bundles purchasing, delivery and financing.
business_model: B2B marketplace take rate on parts sold, plus fintech partner financing
product_category: Auto parts B2B marketplace and supply chain
founder_names: Manuel Rodriguez Dao; Virgile Fiszman; Federico Moscato; Eduardo Mata; Daniel Ferreyra
market_need_then: Meru later said each purchase passes through four to five intermediaries and many transactions suffer fraud (company claim, 2026 trade press, unverified). Mexico's aftermarket was fragmented and mechanics had few digital purchasing options.
outcome_analysis: Meru launched its marketplace in August 2020 and, per TechCrunch, passed 10,000 registered users in about a year with revenue growing 40 to 50 percent monthly, which supported a $15M Series A in December 2021 co-led by Valor Capital and EMLES Ventures. No later round, layoffs or exit was found. YC still lists it as active with about 70 staff, but the meru.com domain now serves an unrelated product, so the current state of the auto parts business is not verified.

name: Meticulous
one_liner: Automated e2e screenshot testing without writing or maintaining tests
long_description:
Meticulous is a tool to automatically catch UI bugs in your web application with zero-effort. Install our JavaScript snippet onto production or staging and dev environments, which records user sessions by collecting clickstream and network data. When you post a pull request, Meticulous selects a subset of sessions which are relevant and simulates these against the frontend of your application. Meticulous takes screenshots at key points and detects any visual differences. It posts those diffs in a comment for you to inspect in a few seconds. 

This eliminates the setup and maintenance burden of UI testing.
regions: United Kingdom; Europe
target_customer: Engineering teams with web frontends that want regression coverage without writing tests
problem: End to end UI tests are costly to write and maintain and are often flaky. Meticulous records real sessions and replays them against pull requests to catch visual and behavior changes.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for engineering teams
product_category: Developer tools, automated frontend testing
market_need_then: Flaky, high maintenance end to end tests were a widely discussed pain; Twilio and Google built internal regression detection systems per the founder's seed post.
outcome_analysis: Meticulous went through YC in Summer 2021, raised a $4M seed in January 2024 and a $15M Series A in July 2026 led by Chemistry. The company says over 100 organizations use it, and the AI coding boom raised the need for automated verification. The long gap between YC and the announced seed suggests slow early funding, but no failure signals were found.

name: Mezli
tags: Food Service Robots & Machines; Ghost Kitchens; Robotics
one_liner: Autonomous restaurants that make great, affordable meals.
long_description:
At Mezli, we're building "auto-kitchens", fully autonomous shipping-container restaurants that serve great, affordable meals for takeout and delivery.

While at Stanford, the three of us got fed up with having to either cook every day or spend $10 or more for healthy options like Chipotle, Sweetgreen, etc. So, we decided to democratize access to healthy, convenient food by building Mezli.
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; San Mateo, CA, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada

name: Micro Meat

target_customer: Cultivated meat manufacturers that would license a scaffold and production technology

product_category: Cultivated meat enabling technology (scaffolds)

No shutdown announcement or post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public and failure factors are left empty.

name: Milk Video

long_description:
Milk Video is a video marketing platform that simplifies short-form video creation for marketers.
