We have created an effective, accessible, and affordable solution: Recover. We offer a proven approach using medication and counseling, that can improve outcomes for over 70% of patients. It reduces overdoses by 80%, death by 50%, and has years of research and application showing it works. 

Despite how effective this medication can be, most rehabs do not have medical professionals on staff. Not only does our program work better and bring medicine to addiction care, it also costs just 10% of traditional programs.

Nick founded Recover after seeing his family and friends struggle with addiction. He was raised by a drug addict, has an alcoholic brother, and lost an uncle to heroin. He saw how hard it is for people to get the treatment they need, and how ineffective existing options are. We are working to make sure that people like Nick’s family have access to best-in-class addiction treatment so they can get and stay well.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: State and local governments (counties) that refer patients and fund addiction treatment; Medi-Cal in-network patients
problem: Most addiction treatment is government funded but ineffective or lacks medical care; Recover offers medication plus counseling over telehealth at a claimed tenth of traditional program cost.
business_model: Government contracts and insurance reimbursement for telehealth addiction treatment (clinic entity Recover Medical Group P.C.)
product_category: Telehealth substance use disorder treatment
market_need_then: YC description cites over 20 million Americans with addiction and under 10 percent treated; governments fund most treatment, with high overdose death toll.
outcome_analysis: Recover sells government-funded telehealth addiction treatment and remains active. Third-party profiles report only a small seed and roughly 3.3 million of 2024 revenue with about 22 staff, with no large outside round found. It grew on county contracts rather than venture capital, so the story is steady, capital-light growth with a risk concentrated in government contracts.

name: Redbean
one_liner: Make games and stories with AI
all_locations: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam; Remote
regions: Vietnam; Southeast Asia; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Consumers aged 12 and up who create original characters and games; creators and storytellers
problem: People without coding skills want to make games and stories; Redbean lets them place AI characters in a shared pixel world.
business_model: Free consumer app and platform, monetization not stated
product_category: AI games and character worlds
market_need_then: AI Dungeon reached 1.5 million monthly users by February 2021, evidence of consumer interest in AI generated stories.
outcome_analysis: Redbean was a YC Summer 2021 company whose founder previously ran DanteHQ, and the product is now an AI character world for creators with launches on Product Hunt in 2025 and 2026. No funding, user numbers or exit are public. The company is active but its trajectory is unknown from the sources found.

name: Redcliffe Lifetech
tags: Consumer Health Services; Health Tech; Digital Health; Healthcare; Diagnostics
one_liner: Redcliffe Labs is India's Largest Omni-channel Diagnostics platform
long_description:
Redcliffe Labs (a unit of Redcliffe Lifetech Inc) provides diagnostics with a comprehensive portfolio approach both with routine and specialised test menus with advanced testing labs all over India. Its digital first approach with on-demand 1-hour home collection and same day report is disrupting the way diagnostics is delivered today and thus is the fastest growing in India. 

Redcliffe Labs is providing 3500+ tests across its wide network of labs and collection centres. The company has served about millions of Indians and is processing more than 250K+ test parameters daily. The test portfolio is very wide including routine pathology tests, advanced genetic screening, research-based DNA tests in reproductive health, cancer and wellness/fitness. The easy to interpret smart reports provide key health check-points, which can help in diagnosing and treating both chronic and acute diseases on time. Redcliffe Labs has pioneered Drone technology adoption in the diagnostic sector by opening up the first commercial corridor from Uttarkashi to Dehradun. The company currently has 30+ labs and 700+ authorised collection centres in more than 120 cities across India. 

Redcliffe's vision is to provide world-class diagnostic services to people across the Indian sub-continent in an affordable manner.
all_locations: Delhi, DL, India; Gurugram, HR, India; Noida, UP, India
regions: India; South Asia
target_customer: Indian consumers (home collection and labs), hospitals and other labs for outsourced testing
problem: Diagnostic testing in India is fragmented and slow; Redcliffe offers a wide test menu with home collection and same day reports.
business_model: Diagnostics services revenue per test, omnichannel labs, collection centres and home collection
product_category: Diagnostics and pathology labs, digital health
market_need_then: Large unmet diagnostic demand in India and Covid 19 shifted testing to home collection; the YC description claims millions served and 250K plus parameters daily.
outcome_analysis: Redcliffe built owned labs and home collection in India, joined YC in Winter 2021, then raised a 61 million Series B in May 2022 and a 42 million Series C in September 2024. It has grown through acquisitions and in April 2026 sold its fertility unit Crysta IVF to refocus on diagnostics. Growth is tied to a large market, the Covid era shift to home testing and capital for lab expansion.

name: Reframe
tags: Mental Health Tech; Consumer Health Services; Consumer
one_liner: App to help people quit or cut back on alcohol use
long_description: Reframe is the leading app to help people cut back on drinking. Reframe uses neuroscience & psychology to help people shift the way they think about drinking & help build great habits. We don't believe in stigma or restrictions. In the past 12 months, Reframe has had over 2M+ users and has helped more people cut back on alcohol use than any other org worldwide.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Consumers who want to cut back on or quit alcohol, paying for a premium subscription
problem: People who drink more than they want to find abstinence programs stigmatizing and have few evidence based, flexible tools for moderation.
business_model: Consumer subscription app with premium coaching, plus a non alcoholic drink product
product_category: Digital health app for alcohol reduction
market_need_then: Pandemic era drinking increases and the sober curious trend created demand; founders interviewed over 500 users and in mid 2021 moved from quitting to cutting back.
outcome_analysis: Reframe grew from a Georgia Tech program project into a consumer app with reported millions of downloads. It raised a 1.4M seed in March 2021 and a 12.5M Series A in late 2021 at a reported 100M valuation. Positioning on moderation without stigma and strong ratings drove growth, and it later added a non alcoholic drink. It remains active.

name: Rejoy Health
one_liner: AI workers that book, scribe, code, interpret, and answer clinicians
long_description:
Rejoy Health is the AI care team for clinics. AI workers for healthcare that run the day end to end, from the first call to the last note.

Every missed call is a patient you never see. Every hour after clinic is time you don’t get back. Phones go unanswered, the schedule has holes, and clinicians are still charting, coding, and looking things up while the next patient waits. Rejoy takes that work off the team’s plate.

The AI Receptionist answers around the clock, books and reschedules visits, and never puts a patient on hold, so the calendar stays full. In the room, the AI Scribe turns the conversation into structured notes, the AI Interpreter handles live language in English, Spanish, French, Chinese, Korean, and more, and RejoyGPT plus clinical decision support answer questions while the patient is still there. After the visit, the AI Coder suggests ICD-10 and CPT codes so billing goes out cleaner and faster. A medical search engine and study companion sit in the same suite for guidelines, journals, and exam prep.

Not another chatbot. One system for doctors, nurses, MAs, and the front desk. More accurate than ChatGPT. HIPAA-compliant. Trusted by 40,000+ clinicians at leading US hospitals and health systems.

You stay in charge. Rejoy does the work. Book more patients. See more patients. Chart less.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Clinics, clinicians and hospitals (AI receptionist, scribe, coder, interpreter, clinical decision support)
problem: Clinicians spend time on charting, coding, phone calls and searching for medical information; Rejoy offers AI workers and a medical search engine.
business_model: B2B software for clinics; earlier an AI medical search and patient education tool; pricing not found
product_category: Healthcare AI suite
market_need_then: Clinician burnout from documentation and information search is the pitch; the 2024 press release claims up to 14 hours a month saved per staff member (company claim).
outcome_analysis: Rejoy Health joined YC in Winter 2021 and has shifted to an AI care team for clinics. A September 2024 press release reported a 125 million valuation without the round size, and aggregators show 1.7 to 22 million raised, so capital raised is uncertain. The company is active and claims 40,000 clinicians, but traction and funding details are mostly self reported.

name: Remora
one_liner: Modular carbon capture
long_description:
We’re building modular carbon capture systems, turning exhaust into beverage-grade CO₂ sold to breweries and greenhouses. We deploy in regions facing severe CO₂ shortages, where prices are highest, allowing us to generate high margins without relying on tax credits or carbon credits.

We’ve raised over $115 million in funding from top investors including Lowercarbon Capital, Union Square Ventures, First Round Capital, Y Combinator, and Valor Equity Partners.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Trucking fleets and freight railroads whose exhaust is captured; captured CO2 is sold to industrial buyers such as concrete producers, beverage makers and greenhouses
problem: Heavy-duty diesel trucks and locomotives are hard to electrify, so their CO2 is emitted at scale. Remora captures it onboard and sells it, sharing revenue with the vehicle operator.
business_model: Hardware device on vehicles plus sale of captured, purified CO2, with revenue shared with fleet or railroad customers
product_category: Mobile carbon capture hardware
founder_names: Paul Gross; Christina Reynolds; Eric Harding
market_need_then: Heavy-duty trucking was a large and hard-to-electrify emissions source, and the launch post pitched battery and hydrogen trucks as impractical for long haul. A buyer base for CO2 existed in concrete and beverages, though no 2021 demand figures were found.
outcome_analysis: Remora launched in Winter 2021 with a research-based device for capturing truck exhaust CO2 and has stayed active, reaching about $117 million raised by April 2025 including a $60 million Series B led by Valor. Its success so far rests on a hard technical asset from the CTO's research and climate investor backing, while commercial scale is unproven in public sources and the 2025 shift to locomotives suggests the truck wedge widened rather than narrowed.

name: RendaloMaq
one_liner: Tech-powered equipment rentals in Latam.
long_description: RendaloMaq is the main tech-powered equipment rental company in Latin America. Leveraging our core tech ROS® (Rendalo Operating System), we simplify and accelerate equipment access for the construction and mining industries. Fleet management and equipment rentals under control. Our mission is to drive productivity through technological innovation while delivering reliable, world-class service.
regions: Chile; Latin America; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Construction and mining contractors in Chile, formerly also Brazil and Mexico, renting heavy equipment
problem: Renting construction machinery is slow and opaque; RendaloMaq offers online rental and fleet management with GPS and telemetry so equipment arrives in minutes rather than days.
business_model: Equipment rental marketplace that leases machines from suppliers and sub-leases to contractors, later moving toward an owned fleet
product_category: Construction equipment rental marketplace and fleet software
market_need_then: Chile's construction and mining sectors relied on fragmented rental yards; the company's later claims were 300+ clients and 50+ partner branches by August 2022. No pre-batch demand data found.
outcome_analysis: RendaloMaq grew quickly after YC, reaching about US$7.5M revenue in 2023 across three countries, then closed Brazil and Mexico and shrank to a 40 machine owned fleet under a new board led by its first angel. Public sources do not state the cause in detail, but the multi-country marketplace did not hold up and the company changed model, which fits a failure to scale the asset-light approach.

name: Replo
one_liner: Sell anything
long_description:
Agents that help you sell anything on the internet. Come build what the next million businesses launch on.

To date, we’ve raised over $8.2M from Figma, YCombinator, Vercel, General Catalyst, Infinity Ventures, MAGIC Fund, Base Case Capital.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: E-commerce brands on Shopify, mid-market and DTC, that want landing pages and storefront pages without developers
problem: Shopify merchants need many high-converting landing and product pages but depend on developers; Replo began as a page builder and now sells AI agents to build, test and launch stores.
business_model: SaaS subscription by tier ($39 to $499 per month for the page builder per a vendor doc, unverified)
product_category: Shopify landing page builder, later AI commerce agents
market_need_then: Shopify's merchant base was growing quickly and brands wanted faster landing pages; TechCrunch in 2023 noted other Shopify tool startups raising funding the year before. No 2021 demand figures found.
outcome_analysis: Replo has stayed active and raised a $4.2M seed in February 2023 after two Berkeley founders with Uber and PlanGrid experience built a Shopify page builder in the Summer 2021 batch. It now claims 100,000 plus businesses and has repositioned toward AI agents, while public funding data stops at the seed plus an unitemized total of about $8.2M, so later growth capital is unverified.

name: Repool
one_liner: Modernizing hedge fund back office software and services.
long_description: Repool makes it easy to launch and operate private funds, like Carta or Juniper for hedge funds. We build modern back office software and services to modernize and simplify launch, fund administration, and LP onboarding.
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; New York, NY, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Emerging hedge fund, digital asset fund and private fund managers launching and running funds
problem: Launching a private fund requires slow, costly legal formation, administration and LP onboarding; Repool bundles software and services into a fund in a box.
business_model: Fees for fund launch and fund administration services plus software
product_category: Fund launch and administration platform
market_need_then: Emerging managers faced slow, expensive launches; YC's pitch compared the gap to what Carta did for startups. No 2021 market data found in sources.
outcome_analysis: Repool is an active Summer 2021 company that raised a seed in mid 2022 from Canaan, Matrix and others, and added products such as the Warp digital subscription tool in August 2024 while hiring fund administration executives. It has not announced a later round in the sources found, so its path is steady but unproven at venture scale.

name: Reshape Biotech
one_liner: Robots that automate the everyday tasks of microbiologists.
long_description:
Reshape Biotech builds lab robots that automate the everyday tasks of microbiologists, from filling plates to analyzing images.
Other companies try to sell “one lab robot that does everything”.  But those robots become so complicated that they sit unused on the shelf.  We build one robot for each function, which makes them easy to use.
regions: Denmark; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Microbiology labs in food, agriculture, pharma and biotech that count and prepare bacterial plates
problem: Microbiologists spend hours on manual plate filling and colony counting; Reshape sells single-function robots and image analysis instead of one all-purpose lab robot.
business_model: Hardware sales plus software and consumables for lab automation
product_category: Lab automation robotics and computer vision
founder_names: Carl-Emil Grøn Fuglesang; Magnus Nyborg Madsen; Daniel Storgaard
market_need_then: Microbiology plate work was manual and repetitive, and the YC pitch said existing all-purpose lab robots sat unused. No quantified 2021 demand data found.
outcome_analysis: Reshape Biotech has grown from a 2021 Copenhagen YC company into a funded robotics firm with an $8.1M seed in February 2023 that was described as Denmark's largest, followed by a $20M Series A led by Astanor in April 2024. Its strength is single-function robots and image analysis aimed at a manual workflow, while its generic name collides with an unrelated listed company.

name: Resquared
one_liner: Marketing automation platform for selling to local businesses.
long_description:
Local businesses were the hardest B2B segment to reach, but account for over 60% firms in the U.S.
Our SaaS application has data on every local business that are easy to get in touch with using our specialized marketing automation tools and workflows. 
Resquared has been proven to save sales pro's over 3 hours per day and result in 53% stronger leads (case study on website).
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Sales teams selling to local businesses, such as commercial real estate, retail leasing, business brokers and insurance agencies
problem: Standard sales data tools rely on LinkedIn, which few local business owners use, so reps struggle to find and reach them; Resquared provides a local business database with outreach automation.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription
product_category: Sales prospecting and outreach for local businesses
market_need_then: Local businesses account for a large share of US firms yet were poorly covered by LinkedIn based prospecting tools, according to company copy; no dated 2021 evidence of spend was found.

name: Rethoric
one_liner: LinkedIn content consultancy and scheduling platform for busy founders
long_description:
Rethoric is a LinkedIn content consultancy service and scheduling platform used by companies like Checkr, ClickUp, Storylane, Checkly, and 100+ startups and enterprises. We run your entire content operation from strategy to publishing, so you stay visible and top of mind with your ICP without spending time on it.

Our platform replaces the usual agency workflow of Google Docs, review threads, and scheduling tools. You connect your LinkedIn and Slack, and everything shows up already written, scheduled, and ready to publish.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Busy startup founders and executives who want a consistent LinkedIn, X and newsletter presence
problem: Founders know public content builds authority but lack time to write it consistently and distrust generic AI written posts.
business_model: subscription content service with human writers and editors
product_category: Founder led content as a service and LinkedIn ghostwriting

outcome_analysis: Rethoric is an active small LinkedIn content service from YC W21 with a four person team, reporting 25k monthly recurring revenue and zero churn four months after launch. No funding, exit or later traction figures were found, and the field of ghostwriting agencies grew sharply later, so its long run trajectory is unknown.

name: Revery AI
tags: Generative AI; Social; E-commerce; Creator Economy; AI
one_liner: Tiktok for fashion - where designers show their work + build traction
long_description:
We are building the TikTok for fashion — a platform for creators to showcase their works, gain traction and build their brands. 

### Reverie is powered by two pieces of core technology:
- An AI-enhanced design tool for creators to turn their design ideas into e-commerce quality product images very efficiently.
- An AI-powered Virtual Dressing Room to create professional fashion photography directly from product images. Both fashion creators and other users can easily style outfits on different models.

With our core tech, we are building an active community of fashion creators (designers, stylists, influencers, bloggers, artists, casting directors, etc..) who produce original designs and engaging content around the published pieces. The social media platform will provide a streamlined path for fashion creators to experiment with their ideas and build traction. 

We want to eventually become the default choice for anyone who wants to launch their fashion label, and have the future Off-White, Balenciaga, Rick Oven, etc. originate from Reverie. Our team combines deep expertise in technology (AI Phds) and the fashion industry (Community builder). Our Virtual Dressing room is live with top retailers (such as Neiman Marcus) and has ~1M ARR. We are backed by YCombinator, TSVC, Cabra VC, and other amazing angels with retail experience and connections. Join us to reshape the fashion industry!
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Revolve Surgical
one_liner: Surgical robotics for every operating room
long_description: Revolve is building the world’s only surgical robot designed for every operating room. Its simple yet powerful design makes it the only robot that can service the 1M+ abdominal surgeries performed outside of hospitals in the US every year.
regions: Canada; America / Canada
target_customer: Ambulatory surgery centers and hospitals performing abdominal and laparoscopic surgery that cannot afford large surgical robots
problem: Existing surgical robots are expensive and bulky; Revolve built a table-mounted, non-teleoperated system with 5mm wristed instruments for any operating room.
business_model: Capital equipment sale with instruments and software
product_category: Surgical robotics hardware
founder_names: Peter Francis; Matthew Kang; Alex Gordon
market_need_then: The company said over a million abdominal surgeries a year in the US occur outside hospitals, per its YC description, and large robots were priced for hospitals.

Its path shows a capital efficient, regulation gated route; commercial launch awaits broader laparoscopic clearance and funding is not publicly itemized.

name: Rinse

regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Urban consumers in San Francisco seeking convenient preventive dental care

product_category: Consumer dental clinics

outcome_analysis: Rinse opened a studio on Union Street in San Francisco around its 2021 launch and remains active with a small team and the Marina area focus, but no priced round, expansion or exit appears in reliable sources. The thesis of a One Medical for dental faces capital intensive studio growth, and with funding unknown the record shows a quiet operating clinic rather than a clear success or failure.

name: Rinsed
one_liner: Software to run car washes moving to a monthly subscription model
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Car wash operators, from single sites to large chains, that sell monthly unlimited wash memberships
problem: Car washes moving to recurring memberships lacked software to sell, market and retain subscribers on top of their existing point of sale systems, so churn and missed upsells went unmanaged.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for car wash CRM, marketing automation and membership sales tools
product_category: Vertical SaaS, car wash CRM and membership management
founder_names: Austin Esecson; Nic Hippenmeyer; Sam Logan

It reported ARR growth above 400 percent in the year before its 2022 Series A, raised a Series B in 2023, and bought Ignite Wash in May 2024 to add a sales platform. It is active with a reported 3,000 plus locations as customers.

name: Rivia.AI
one_liner: Interactive Product Demos
long_description: Rivia.ai empowers marketing, sales, and demand generation teams to effortlessly generate and distribute interactive product demos within 10 minutes. Potential customers of SaaS brands can now personally engage with these self-guided product stories without direct sales interactions. With our user-friendly platform and intuitive dashboards, teams can effortlessly capture, customize, enhance, and share their demos without sound technical expertise. These interactive demos can seamlessly integrate into applications, websites, email campaigns, or ad campaigns.
regions: India; South Asia
target_customer: Marketing, sales and demand generation teams at SaaS companies
problem: Product videos do not let prospects try the product, and click through demos are text heavy so viewers drop off. Teams want interactive demos without engineering help.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for interactive demo and product engagement tools
product_category: Interactive product demo and product growth platform
market_need_then: Sales and marketing teams wanted self serve product tours as buyers avoided sales calls; competitor Walnut raised 15M in August 2021 for the same use case.
outcome_analysis: Rivia.AI started as interactive video demos and broadened into a product growth platform with tours, checklists and sales enrichment. It remains active with a very small team and no verified funding beyond the YC investment, in a crowded category where Walnut and others raised much larger rounds. There is no clear public evidence of strong traction or of failure.

name: RocketSDR

The only sales outreach platform you’ll ever need.

business_model: Founding business: D2C clear aligners made in-house with teledentistry (as Snazzy). Current business: B2B SaaS AI sales outreach platform.
product_category: D2C dental tech (clear aligners) at founding; sales development automation now

outcome_analysis: RocketSDR, YC W21, began as Snazzy, a direct-to-consumer clear aligner company that raised a $2.2M seed in December 2021 from YC, Form Capital, Goodwater and ANIM Fund and claimed doubling revenue and profit on every order. It now appears under the name RocketSDR as an AI sales outreach platform, so the aligner business seems to have been dropped; no source gives the date or the reason. A later $5M Series A reported once is unverified. Listed Active with about 30 people, so the outcome is unresolved.

name: Roin Technologies

product_category: Construction robotics, automated power trowel and shotcrete robot

name: Rulebricks
tags: Developer Tools; SaaS; B2B; Workflow Automation; Enterprise Software

long_description:
Many workflow builders and automation tools have support for adding logic to your processes, but get complicated quick– to the point where process owners are unable to edit them directly and require specialist services.

Rulebricks separates decision-making logic from your workflows, giving your team a clear visual, spreadsheet-like interface to manage the changing rules that drive your business, and use those rules as API endpoints, visual forms, and in automation tools like Zapier.
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; Los Altos, CA, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Enterprise teams and developers that automate business processes and need business users to manage decision rules
problem: Workflow and automation tools handle logic badly: rules get complicated, process owners cannot edit them and need specialist services. Rulebricks separates decision logic into a spreadsheet like interface exposed as APIs.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with a free tier, plus self hosted and on premises deployment options
product_category: No code business rules engine and decision management
market_need_then: The founder's YC application described five figure RPA platforms as the alternative and workflow tools whose logic steps get complicated, as stated on the YC page.
outcome_analysis: Rulebricks stayed a very small team with a decision management product aimed at enterprises and now cites Fortune 500 customers and SOC 2 Type II. No public funding, exit or shutdown was found, so the trajectory beyond the YC investment is not documented.

name: SFA Therapeutics

one_liner: Regulating the immune system to block cancer & autoimmune diseases
long_description: SFA Therapeutics is creating therapeutically-tailored oral drugs that regulate the immune system; with a focus on autoimmune diseases and cancers that originate from chronic inflammation. There are over 300 million patients who suffer from autoimmune diseases. Our treatment is designed to block the root cause of many of these chronic inflammatory diseases, with safe oral drugs. We have strong clinical data from a phase 1b clinical trial in psoriasis, and human data in pancreatic cancer, uveitis and NASH. we have a total of 9 drugs in our pipeline and 15 patents.

target_customer: Pharma and biotech licensees (the plan is to develop through phase 2 then license), and ultimately patients with psoriasis, autoimmune disease and inflammation driven cancers

business_model: Biotech drug development, license phase 3 ready assets to partners for fees, royalties and milestones
product_category: Biotech, oral small molecule immunology
founder_names: Ira Spector; Alla Arzumanyan; Mark Feitelson
competitors_at_founding: Bristol Myers Squibb deucravacitinib (later Sotyktu); Amgen Otezla (apremilast)
market_need_then: Psoriasis and other autoimmune diseases affect large patient populations and oral options were limited; the company cites over 300 million patients with autoimmune diseases.
outcome_analysis: SFA is a Temple University spinout that raised about 4 million seed in 2022 and a further bridge round, and reports positive phase 1b psoriasis data. It is still seeking a 25 million Series A to run phase 2, so progress is slow and capital constrained, but it has not failed. Its fate depends on phase 2 funding and results.

name: Safer Management
one_liner: Student Attendance tracking for Public Schools
long_description:
Safer Management sells attendance software to public school districts and colleges. Public schools receive federal funding based on their average daily attendance, and our software ensures they get the money they need.

We started Safer Mgmt. 12 months ago after I dropped off my twin boys and experienced inefficiencies with the sign-in process. We are now in 75 public schools and two colleges with annual reoccurring revenue of $621,000. We have 82% margins and are profitable. At scale, we will charge $15 per student per year. 

There are 70 million public school students in America which is a $1.4 billion dollar market opportunity.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Public school districts and colleges that receive funding based on average daily attendance
problem: Schools lose federal funding when attendance is recorded inefficiently, and sign in processes are slow; the software automates attendance tracking.
business_model: B2B SaaS, planned 15 dollars per student per year at scale
product_category: Education attendance software
market_need_then: The YC page says schools are paid by federal and state formulas tied to average daily attendance, giving a direct dollar reason to improve attendance tracking; the founder reported 75 schools and about 621,000 ARR in 2021.
outcome_analysis: Safer Management reported early traction in 2021 of 75 public schools, two colleges and about 621,000 ARR with 82 percent margins, all self reported on the YC page. No later funding, exit or reliable status update was found, and one directory lists the product as discontinued, so the outcome is unclear.

name: SalaryBook
one_liner: Mobile first solution for Payroll, employee & expense management
long_description:
SalaryBook is an payroll, employee attendance and Expense management app for 60 million Indian SMEs. SMBs see in our app a one stop solution for running their business. Starting from seamless on-boarding of employees to managing their payroll and attendance. Our app includes some cool features like selfie & location based attendance marking. SalaryBook also helps 400M Indian blue-collar employees to create their first ever credit & skills profile online.

business_model: Mobile SaaS subscription for payroll, attendance and expense management (pricing not verified)
product_category: SMB payroll, attendance and expense app

The failure factor reflects that inference and is not stated by any source.

name: SalaryBox

long_description:
Salarybox is a payroll app for small businesses in India. There are 63 Million small businesses in India and 90% still manage payroll manually. Today, business owners manage attendance on pen-paper; calculate salary on excel and pay employees in cash.

Using our App, the entire process can be performed with the click of a button. Our app reduces the time taken to process payroll from 5 days to 5 minutes. 

We use Payroll data to build a credit profile of 300 Million+ blue-collar workers and improve access to financial products.
regions: India; South Asia
target_customer: Small and medium businesses in India with blue-collar staff, paying for attendance and payroll software
problem: Most Indian small businesses track attendance on paper, calculate salaries in Excel and pay in cash, taking days per payroll run.
business_model: Mobile-first B2B SaaS for attendance, payroll and HR, later with credit profiles for workers
product_category: SMB payroll and workforce management app
market_need_then: YC description cites 63 million small businesses with 90 percent managing payroll manually; Inc42 (Nov 2021) projected a large Indian HR payroll software market.
outcome_analysis: SalaryBox raised a pre-seed in May 2021 and a $4M seed in November 2021 shortly after YC, with over 1 million employees on payroll by then. It stayed active with a team of 40 and enterprise logos on its site, but no Series A was found, so it is a steady grower rather than a breakout, in a market with funded rivals.

name: Satsuma
tags: Developer Tools; SaaS; Crypto / Web3; Data Engineering
one_liner: Reliable blockchain indexing & querying for web3 engineering teams.
long_description:
Satsuma is a developer tool for building applications on top of real-time blockchain data. Our product lets developers take decoded data from multiple chains, customize it for their use cases, and access it through API endpoints.

Blockchains serve as distributed databases for these products, holding their most important data. However, it’s difficult to access and query that data. We believe this friction is an enormous blocker for web3 developers and that better tooling will enable mass adoption for web3.

We’re a founding team of engineers, having built data infrastructure and product as early employees at Airtable, Heap, and Y Combinator.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Web3 engineering teams building applications that need fast, reliable access to indexed on-chain data
problem: Blockchains act as the database for web3 apps, but querying and indexing their data is slow and painful, which blocked developers from building responsive products.
business_model: Usage-based developer API for hosted blockchain indexing and subgraphs
product_category: Web3 developer tools, blockchain data indexing
market_need_then: Web3 application development was booming in 2021 and developers needed ways to query on-chain data. The founders cited indexing friction as a blocker, though dated third party demand evidence was not collected.
outcome_analysis: Satsuma, started by early employees of Airtable, Heap and Y Combinator, built a hosted subgraph indexer for web3 developers and raised a $5 million seed in April 2023 led by Initialized Capital and Archetype. Five months later Alchemy acquired it for undisclosed terms and rebranded it Alchemy Subgraphs, which Alchemy shut down in December 2025. The soft landing label is an inference from the short independent life and later product shutdown.

name: Scispot

Scispot is the best tech stack for biotech. It's the first-ever toolkit that lets you tailor it to your needs – no coding required. Think of it as a super combo of ELN + LIMS + Integrations + Analytics. You can set it up using a user-friendly interface (GUI) or by entering commands (CLI). It's about making your digital biotech dreams a reality. You can design your data infrastructure, automate your workflows and integrations and make your data ready for machine learning and artificial intelligence – all on one spot. Scispot even provides pre-made blueprints for major experiments, teamwork, and data management.

Request a demo to see Scispot in action here: https://calendly.com/scispot/30min

product_category: Lab informatics (ELN and LIMS)
market_need_then: Biotech startups needed affordable lab data tools as lab software was dominated by costly legacy LIMS; exact spend data from 2021 not found.
outcome_analysis: Scispot raised about $2M over five years, then an $8M Series A in mid 2026 led by Avenue Growth Partners, and serves over 125 labs. It grew slowly and capital efficiently in a niche dominated by Benchling and legacy LIMS vendors, with a biotech native founder and a product platform engineer.

name: Secoda

Our vision is to become the AI search engine for your company’s analytics, making data discovery as seamless as finding a website on Google. To do that, Secoda gets data AI-ready by unifying governance, cataloging, observability, and lineage into one trusted, easy-to-use platform—empowering every team to move faster, stay compliant, and make smarter decisions.

It reached about 45 staff and in December 2025 Atlassian acquired it, with undisclosed terms, to give Rovo a data catalog.

We're a fast-growing, remote-first YC startup with a lean team and healthy runway. [Segments.ai](http://segments.ai/) is used by large organizations as well as innovative startups building the next generation of autonomous drones, delivery robots, self-driving cars, and more.
regions: Belgium; Europe; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Robotics, drone and autonomous driving teams that need to label point cloud and image data to train and validate perception models
problem: Perception teams spend large amounts of time and money labeling multi-sensor data, and existing tools handled 2D images better than 3D point clouds fused with camera data.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for a labeling platform with an SDK, plus managed labeling services
product_category: Data labeling platform, 3D point cloud and multi-sensor annotation
market_need_then: Autonomous driving and robotics companies were scaling perception teams that needed labeled LiDAR and camera data. A January 2021 IEEE Access paper noted a lack of free tools to annotate large 3D point clouds.
outcome_analysis: Segments.ai started in 2020 as a segmentation labeling tool, added point cloud and then multi-sensor support for robotics and autonomous driving customers, and stayed a lean team of about 8 while earning ISO 27001 certification. Uber acquired it in October 2025, with founders and staff joining Uber AI Solutions. The deal price and the funding raised are not public.

name: Sendbox
one_liner: Fulfillment by Amazon for African merchants
long_description: Sendbox helps small e-commerce merchants who sell directly to customers through their own online channels or social media platforms with fulfillment. We now handle local and international fulfillment for over 7,500 merchants within Nigeria.
regions: Nigeria; Africa
target_customer: Small e-commerce and social commerce merchants in Nigeria selling through their own channels, who pay for delivery and fulfillment
problem: Small online merchants in Nigeria struggle with unreliable local delivery and costly international shipping and fulfillment.
business_model: Per-shipment fees on local and international delivery and fulfillment, plus payments
product_category: Logistics and fulfillment for social commerce
market_need_then: Nigerian social commerce was growing and merchants lacked reliable delivery; Sendbox reported over 10,000 vendors and 200,000 deliveries at its Oct 2021 seed.
outcome_analysis: Sendbox raised a $1.8M seed in October 2021 after YC and reported thousands of merchants, then stayed active with a team of 25 but no later round was found. It rides Nigerian social commerce growth, though logistics margins and local competitors limit the upside; the distribution factor is an inference from traction claims.

name: SenpAI.GG
one_liner: Personal gaming coach for PC gamers globally
long_description: SenpAI.gg is a gaming coach for the 1.4 billion PC gamers globally. SenpAI.gg’s desktop application makes personalized recommendations in the game and provides post-game feedback to help gamers improve faster. It is the most comprehensive assistant that supports gamers before and during the game via Voice Assistant, or an overlay that uses computer vision. The company is Boston-based and founded by Olcay Yilmazcoban (MIT researcher & gamer) and Berk Ozer (engineer & gamer). We raised $3M seed funding (ACT Venture Partners) and we are in the Summer 2021 Batch of Y Combinator. https://senpai.gg/
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Sensible Biotechnologies
tags: Synthetic Biology; Biotech; Manufacturing; Therapeutics; Biotechnology
one_liner: Unlocking the next generation of mRNA medicines
long_description: The future of mRNA therapeutics is hampered by manufacturing challenges and unless solved, its exciting potential may never be realised. Sensible enables the next generation of mRNA medicines by turning living cells into factories producing abundant, highly stable and non-immunogenic mRNA in a scalable and cost-effective way.
regions: United Kingdom; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Biotech and pharma companies developing mRNA therapeutics and vaccines, who would pay for mRNA manufacturing and design
problem: mRNA is made by cell-free in vitro transcription, which is costly, cumbersome, produces immunogenic double-stranded RNA and struggles with long sequences.
business_model: Platform and manufacturing partnerships for cell-made mRNA, with co-development deals and grants
product_category: Biomanufacturing platform for mRNA
market_need_then: The 2020 and 2021 mRNA vaccine boom exposed manufacturing constraints and demand for mRNA therapeutics; the YC launch post states the cost and quality problems of IVT.
outcome_analysis: Sensible went from YC in 2021 to a $4.2M pre-seed in 2023, a Ginkgo co-development deal, a Sartorius scale-up agreement in 2025 and a reported $47M Series A in October 2026 with up to $20M of non-dilutive government funding. Deep science and patents drove investor interest despite the long timeline.

name: Sentiyen
one_liner: Conversational AI assistants using your knowledge
long_description: At Sentiyen, we build GPT-based AI assistants that are trained on your content and enable your audience to get the answers they need 24 hours a day. We allow creators and businesses scale themselves to unlimited 1:1 conversations with potential customers, which helps increase revenue, reduce spend, and improve customer satisfaction.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Content creators and businesses that want AI assistants answering audience questions around the clock
problem: Creators and businesses cannot hold unlimited one to one conversations with prospects. Sentiyen builds GPT based assistants trained on a customer's own content.
business_model: B2B and creator SaaS subscription, pricing not sourced
product_category: Conversational AI assistants trained on customer content
market_need_then: Creators monetized audiences and businesses wanted self serve answers, but no source dated near mid 2021 documents specific demand or spend.
outcome_analysis: Sentiyen entered YC in Summer 2021 with two former PeerStreet people building GPT based assistants for creators and businesses. Only YC and aggregator profiles exist, no funding or press was found, and the YC page oddly shows Playhouse news, so the story is unclear. The company is listed as active with two people, and no outcome or failure cause can be stated.

name: Sequin
one_liner: Sequin is building AI Voice Agents to automate collections calls for…
long_description:
Sequin AI is building compliance-first AI voice agents to automate human agent intensive collections calls for consumer lenders and servicers.

CEO and Co-founder Vrinda Gupta, former Visa product leader who built the Chase Sapphire Reserve credit card and ran audits for top 10 issuers, teamed up with CTO and Co-founder Mark Thomas, former PayPal engineering leader, to bring world-class technology to consumer lending and servicing.

Backed by Y Combinator, Sequin AI has raised $5.7M from top investors, including executives at OpenAI, the Schwab family, and leading venture funds like Matrix, Commerce Ventures, and Thomvest - the same firms behind some of the most iconic technology companies of our time.

Reach out vrinda@sequinai.com to learn if Sequin's AI Voice Agents can dramatically reduce your cost of collections today.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Originally young women wanting to build credit via a debit card and banking membership; now consumer lenders and servicers buying AI collections voice agents
problem: Original: women face credit and banking gaps. Current: collections calls are human-agent intensive and compliance heavy for lenders.
business_model: Original: monthly membership debit card. Current: B2B software for AI voice agents (pricing not found)
product_category: Fintech, then AI voice agents for collections
market_need_then: Original pitch rested on a founder anecdote of being rejected for a card plus credit gender gap claims; the sources show press interest (Forbes, Sept 2021) but no usage data.
outcome_analysis: Sequin raised a seed announced in September 2021 with a long list of investors, then pivoted away from the women focused debit card to AI collections voice agents, the move the YC profile describes. It is still listed active with a team of 2 and about $5.7M raised, so the pivot has not yet shown breakout results.

name: Serna Bio
one_liner: Genetic Medicine with Small Molecules
long_description: Serna Bio is developing small molecules to modulate RNA function, unlocking the potential to treat diseases driven by biology intractable by other modalities.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Pharma partners and patients: develops RNA-targeting small molecule drugs and partners programs with pharma
problem: Many disease drivers lie in RNA that antibodies and conventional small molecules cannot reach, so they are considered undruggable.
business_model: Drug discovery with pharma partnerships (milestone payments) and an internal preclinical pipeline
product_category: Biotech, RNA-targeted small molecule drug discovery
market_need_then: RNA drug targets were a recognized frontier after mRNA vaccines and splicing drugs; the BioPharma Dive piece counts at least eight startups in the field, though its date is unknown.
outcome_analysis: Serna Bio, formerly Ladder Therapeutics, stayed active with a small team, a preclinical ALS program and a Chiesi respiratory collaboration reported in July 2025. Disclosed funding is small and unverified, so it appears to be a long-running seed-stage biotech funded through partnerships rather than a large venture round.

name: Shape
one_liner: Get data insights without writing SQL
long_description: Shape lets workers get access to data insights without having to write SQL.
regions: United Kingdom; Europe; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Non-technical workers and small teams that need answers from a database without writing SQL, paying monthly per plan
problem: Business users depend on analysts or engineers for ad hoc data questions. Shape answers plain English questions against a database and returns SQL backed answers and charts.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription tiers ($49 Starter, $499 Team, custom Enterprise per the company site)
product_category: AI data analyst, natural language to SQL
market_need_then: The YC one liner frames the pain as workers lacking SQL access to data. No dated 2021 source quantifying demand was found.
outcome_analysis: Shape remains active as a very small team with a niche AI data analyst product. No funding beyond a possible small YC note, no acquisition and no layoffs were found. The name is generic and the category became crowded after language models improved, so the company's trajectory is unclear rather than a recorded success or failure.

name: Shepherd
one_liner: Modernizing commercial insurance
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Middle market general contractors and builders (about $25M to $250M of projects per year) buying excess and primary casualty, builder's risk and pollution coverage
problem: Construction insurance is slow, opaque and priced off legacy books. Shepherd underwrites with project and technology data and started with excess liability, where the CEO said the pain was greatest.
business_model: Managing general underwriter and insurer earning premium and fees on commercial construction policies
product_category: Insurtech, commercial construction insurance
founder_names: Justin Levine; Mo Mahallawy; Stephen Buonpane
market_need_then: TechCrunch (Sept 2021) describes incumbents with legacy books raising prices and a hard market for excess liability for contractors. Procore, a construction software firm, invested and partnered.
outcome_analysis: Shepherd entered a hard market where incumbents were raising prices, started with excess liability, and used a seed in 2021 backed by a construction software partner. It added product lines, grew written premium, and raised a Series A in 2024 and a $42M Series B in 2026 with a carrier as lead. The company states about $67M raised in total, and the trajectory is strongly positive but not yet an exit.

name: Shimmer
one_liner: 1:1 ADHD coaching, 5-10X More affordable than alternatives
long_description:
Shimmer provides ADHD coaching to people with ADHD or executive function challenges. Shimmer was born from a group of ADHD coaches, psychiatrists, doctors, and engineers to create a personalized, action-oriented playground for you and your coach to explore. We're not another list, calendar, or app: we're real human interactions paired with expert strategies, so that you can make real changes in your life. Come check us out!

Our ADHD coaches partner with you to co-design a plan to achieve your goals. You'll experiment with strategies on a weekly basis to implement a routine fit specifically for you. Our program has been designed off science-backed methods in partnership with NYU, UC Berkeley, and UCSF. 

Get your free ADHD Mastery Score > https://www.shimmer.care/assessment
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Adults with ADHD or executive function challenges paying for coaching, plus employers and payors targeted later
problem: ADHD coaching cost around $300 per hour per TechCrunch, which put it out of reach. Shimmer offers 1:1 coaching with a structured program at lower prices.
business_model: Subscription coaching membership (TechCrunch 2024: $140, $230 or $345 per month by session length), later community membership and AI tools
product_category: Digital mental health, ADHD coaching
market_need_then: Growing awareness of adult ADHD and late diagnoses, and TechCrunch's note that coaching cost about $300 per hour, with the founder's own difficulty finding affordable help.
outcome_analysis: Shimmer launched publicly in October 2022 after the YC batch, raised $1.3M and then $2.2M, and reported more than 15,000 coaching sessions and 30 plus coaches by January 2024. Funding is small and the team is about 9 people, so it is a slow, capital light company with a founder who has the condition the product serves. It later added AI tools and a community tier.

name: ShipBlu
one_liner: Amazon Level Logistics for eCommerce Companies in MENA.
long_description:
ShipBlu provides Amazon level logistics for eCommerce companies in MENA - one of the fastest growing eCommerce markets in the world. As it stands, the majority of delivery providers are still using pen and paper to manage delivery and fulfillment operations, leading to 5x the rate of failed deliveries and 3x the operating costs as compared to global benchmarks.

At ShipBlu, we've built an infrastructure that handles every aspect of delivery and fulfillment operations. We've also added some unique features that tie in various business functions, allowing us to realize significant efficiencies compared to other players. Our platform is managed by ShipBlu AutoPilot - our collection of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning algorithms that constantly make operational predictions and decisions to reduce costs, meet delivery constraints, and refine our operating assumptions. Designed by ShipBlu's CTO, Abdelrahman is currently completing his PhD at Brown University where he explores the applications of AI and ML in optimization problems.

We built a nationwide delivery network in Egypt in about 2.5 months, kicking off operations on Aug 1st, 2021. In under 4 weeks, we have signed on over 40 merchants, and when those merchants fully go live in October, we will be making over $40k in MRR.
regions: Egypt; Middle East and North Africa; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: E-commerce merchants in Egypt and the wider MENA region that pay per parcel for delivery and fulfillment
problem: Most delivery providers in the region used manual dispatch. ShipBlu sells delivery and fulfillment run by software and optimization algorithms.
business_model: Per shipment logistics and fulfillment fees, with payout and cash on delivery services
product_category: E-commerce logistics, last mile delivery and fulfillment
founder_names: Ali Nasser; Ahmed ElKawass; Abdelrahman Hosny
market_need_then: Fast growing e-commerce in MENA with fragmented, manual delivery and a preference for cash on delivery. ShipBlu signed more than 40 merchants in its first month after August 2021 launch per TechCrunch.
outcome_analysis: ShipBlu raised a pre-seed and a $2.4M seed in 2021 from regional and global backers, launched operations in August 2021 and grew to about 300 people per the YC page. No acquisition or shutdown found. Third party profiles claim large revenue but are unverified. It operates against funded local rivals in a growing market, so the outcome is a scaling operator with undisclosed later funding.

name: SigNoz
tags: Developer Tools; SaaS; B2B; Open Source
one_liner: Open source alternative to DataDog
long_description: SigNoz is an open-source observability platform native to OpenTelemetry with logs, traces and metrics in a single application. An open-source alternative to DataDog, NewRelic, etc. Open source Application Performance Monitoring (APM) & Observability too
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Engineering teams that want observability (logs, traces, metrics) without Datadog pricing, via self hosting or SigNoz Cloud
problem: Commercial observability tools such as Datadog and New Relic are closed source and costly. SigNoz offers an open source, OpenTelemetry native alternative that unifies logs, traces and metrics.
business_model: Open source core with paid cloud usage and enterprise tiers (Teams from $49 per month, Enterprise from $4,000 per month per company site)
product_category: Open source observability and APM
market_need_then: Datadog and similar tools were costly and closed, and OpenTelemetry was emerging as a vendor neutral standard. The launch post claimed 11,000 plus GitHub stars by its later count.
outcome_analysis: SigNoz grew through open source distribution, positioning as an alternative to Datadog and riding the OpenTelemetry shift. It raised a small YC and angel round and then $5.4M in 2023, reaching 14K stars then and over 24K by late 2025, with a claim of 10,000 engineering teams. The amount raised is modest for the category, so it is a capital efficient growth story that has not yet reached a priced growth round.

name: Siglo
one_liner: Home Internet for urban Latin America
long_description: Siglo is a wireless ISP for communities in urban Latin America offering a faster, better, and easy-to-pay service.
regions: Mexico; Latin America; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Households in urban Mexico paying in advance for home internet via 7, 15 or 30 day recharges
problem: Residential internet in Mexico required contracts and credit. Siglo sells prepaid fixed wireless access with no contract and rooftop antennas.
business_model: Prepaid recurring home broadband (fixed wireless ISP) with recharge periods
product_category: Fixed wireless ISP, prepaid broadband
market_need_then: The YC page frames the need as faster, easier to pay internet in urban Latin American communities. Soma Capital job listing (undated) cites 1,700 connected homes and $26,000 monthly recurring revenue.
outcome_analysis: Siglo remains an active ISP with about 20 people. Its model of prepaid fixed wireless matches a market with credit and contract barriers, but the only funding figure found is an unverified aggregator seed. Evidence of scale is limited to an undated job listing and a regulatory filing mention in 2024, so success or stall is not determinable from public data.

name: SigmaOS
one_liner: The new home for your internet 🏡
long_description:
SigmaOS is a new type of browser designed for founders, researchers, and content creators to make you better and faster at working on the web.

You work 7+ hours a day on the web. Buried in a sea of 100+ tabs and 10+ web-apps 🤯, you constantly lose context for why you did what you did, and are always one click away from being distracted.

We took apart the browser for you, and rebuilt a new experience from the ground-up, for the FASTEST and most PRODUCTIVE work. ⚡
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; London, England, United Kingdom
regions: United States of America; United Kingdom; America / Canada; Europe
target_customer: Mac users who live in the browser, such as founders, students and researchers with many tabs, paying a monthly subscription
problem: Conventional browsers cause tab clutter and context switching. SigmaOS is a WebKit based Mac browser built around workspaces, vertical tabs and tasks.
business_model: Freemium consumer subscription (Personal Pro $20 and Personal Max $30 per month per company site)
product_category: Productivity web browser
founder_names: Mahyad Ghassemi; Ali Attar; Saurav Mitra
market_need_then: TechCrunch (Nov 2022): many thousands of users with over 30 percent paying and many users keeping hundreds of tabs open, after more than a year in beta.
outcome_analysis: SigmaOS built a paying niche audience in a year of beta and raised a $4M seed led by LocalGlobe in 2022. It is a Mac only product facing Arc, Safari and Chrome, and its founders are now running new YC companies while the product remains available with an AI assistant. It stalled at seed with no later round found and remains a small niche business.

name: Simplify
tags: Generative AI; Machine Learning; Marketplace; Recruiting
one_liner: Helping a billion people build their dream career
long_description:
Simplify is building the AI-enabled infrastructure to power the next generation of hiring – reimagining how people discover and secure their next career opportunity. We believe that everyone deserves an all-star talent agent helping them plan, manage, and accomplish their career goals, no matter their background, location, or education.

Through our flagship product, Copilot, we've helped over 1M+ job seekers discover and apply to over 100 million jobs - and we've done this with a tight-knit team of just 7 people. We're rapidly expanding on both the candidate and recruiter fronts, focused on our vision of building a common app and personal AI agent for your career.

Backed by top-tier investors including Craft and YCombinator, we're a mission-driven team working to democratize the job search and disrupt the way hiring works today.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Job seekers, especially students and new graduates, with a free browser extension, plus paid premium features and recruiters
problem: Applying to many jobs means retyping the same details on each company's form. Simplify Copilot autofills applications and tracks them.
business_model: Freemium job seeker tools with premium subscription and recruiter services; still experimenting with monetization in Feb 2024
product_category: Job search and application autofill
founder_names: Michael Yan; Ethan Horoschak; Rushil Srivastava
market_need_then: Founders felt the pain applying to hundreds of jobs in college (TechCrunch 2024). Simplify's Product Hunt launch was October 2021 per a launch tracker.
outcome_analysis: Simplify reached over 1M users per the YC page with a small team and very little capital, using free tools and community maintained internship lists for distribution. It raised a $3M seed only in February 2024 with about 10 employees. Competition from AI apply tools increased, so the company remains a capital efficient consumer product with an unproven monetization.

name: Sirka
one_liner: Noom for Southeast Asia
long_description: Our program helps people prevent or manage chronic diseases by breaking bad eating habits with plans created by vetted, certified nutritionist / dietitians. Customers get an unlimited chat access to consult with our professionals, and personal recommendations to help adopt new habits into life.
regions: Indonesia; Southeast Asia; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Overweight and chronic disease risk consumers in Indonesia who pay a subscription for coaching
problem: People in Indonesia struggle to change eating habits that drive obesity, diabetes and other chronic disease, and have little access to certified nutritionists.
business_model: Consumer subscription for nutritionist chat coaching, later adding doctor consultations and medication delivery
product_category: Digital health coaching and metabolic clinic
market_need_then: YC pitched it as Noom for Southeast Asia. The YC page and the seed coverage describe a need for chronic disease prevention through eating habits, but no dated demand statistics were found.
outcome_analysis: Sirka raised a 2.6 million dollar seed in February 2022 with Sequoia, YC and regional investors and remains active. Reported user numbers conflict (7,000 active subscribers on one page, more than 10,000 paying out of 100,000 users in 2024 coverage) and no later round was found. It has moved from pure coaching toward a doctor-led metabolic clinic, which suggests coaching alone was not the whole business.

name: Sitenna
one_liner: Compound B2B SaaS for modern infrastructure to deploy and manage sites
long_description:
Modern infrastructure (incl. 5G wireless and EV charging) has a problem. Whilst analysts are claiming exponential growth in deployments in the coming years, the truth is that the process of site acquisition and management is currently manual, archaic and painful. Sitenna has developed software to digitise the process reducing site acquisition from currently 24 months to a matter of weeks. We work with Real Estate, Local Government, Infrastructure Providers and Operators.

Sitenna launched in the UK in late 2021 and was selected as the leading software vendor to a UK government sponsored infrastructure project, with over 1m assets on the platform and all major telecom players active, including BT, EE and BAI. 

The team is led by a group of industry veterans with C-Suite level access to telecom companies worldwide. Daniel has worked in the telecoms industry for over 12 years and he has supported $100bn in transactions in over 30 countries. Brian has over 12 years’ experience as a technical consultant including BAE Systems Applied Intelligence, Norkom and Ericsson. Both are multiple time founders, execs and non-execs in start-ups including exits.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Telecom operators, tower companies, real estate owners and local governments that acquire and manage infrastructure sites
problem: Acquiring sites for 5G masts and EV charging takes up to 24 months through manual, fragmented processes.
business_model: B2B SaaS platform for infrastructure site acquisition, project and asset management
product_category: Infrastructure asset and site management software
market_need_then: The company states site acquisition can take 24 months and that analysts expected a surge in 5G and EV charging deployments; no dated third party spend data was opened.
outcome_analysis: Sitenna raised a 2.1 million dollar seed in early 2022 and about 3 million dollars in May 2023 to expand to the US, won a first US contract in late 2023, and added partnerships through 2025. Telecom industry founders with operator access gave it entry, and it remains active with modest disclosed funding. Whether it can scale past a niche enterprise market is not shown by the sources.

name: Sivo
one_liner: Debt as a service for companies to lend money to their users at scale.
long_description:
Sivo provides debt as a service. Our API and risk protocol allows fintechs, neobanks, and gig platforms to lend money to their users, at scale, without having to raise debt which can take up to two years. You can think of us as Stripe for Debt. 

We started 6 months ago, in March signed a $100m debt capital partnership, and will be launching our API in April. We already have more than 100 companies in our customer pipeline including Uber. 

We’ve been able to move so quickly because we are a team with previous exits and decades of experience in risk, debt, and enterprise software for companies including Goldman Sachs, Revolut, NASA, McKinsey and Citigroup.
all_locations: Vancouver, BC, Canada; San Francisco, CA, USA; Remote
regions: Canada; United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Fintechs, neobanks and gig platforms that want to lend to their users without raising debt capital
problem: Platforms that want to offer loans to their users need debt capital, risk models and servicing, which they lack.
business_model: API and risk protocol for debt as a service, earning on loans originated with partner debt capital
product_category: Embedded lending infrastructure
market_need_then: In March 2021 the company reported more than 100 companies in its pipeline including Uber and a 100 million dollar debt facility; these are company claims reported by TechCrunch, not independently verified.
outcome_analysis: Sivo raised a 5 million dollar seed at a reported 100 million dollar post money valuation within eight months of founding, then launched its API and a 2022 servicing partnership with Canopy. No Series A was confirmed and a profile says the CEO role changed in 2022. The company appears active, but its funding after the seed and its real traction are not publicly verified.

name: Slash
one_liner: Banking, corporate cards, stablecoin payments – available globally.
long_description:
Slash is America's leading business banking platform. Backed by NEA, Menlo Ventures, Stanford University, and the founders of Tinder and Plaid, Slash works with over 5000 mid market businesses and moves $30bn per year across all payment rails. 

Businesses come to Slash for three simple reasons:
1. We are the "Costco" of business banking. You get the highest cashback on your card spend and the highest yield on your treasury account.
2. We offer a bunch of free software that saves you and your finance team time: expense management, accounting automations, invoicing – all for free.
3. We're available worldwide. Businesses in 100+ countries can sign up for a USD account on Slash. 

We offer businesses:
1. Deposit accounts with free outgoing wire and ACH transfers. 
2. Unlimited virtual cards with up to 2% cash back.
3. Integrations to all major accounting platforms.
4. Invoicing, expense management, and bill pay software.
5. Stablecoin payments
6. An powerful card creation and payments API
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Online businesses and SMBs in card heavy verticals such as e-commerce and affiliate marketing, later mid-market companies
problem: Fast growing online businesses that spend heavily on cards are underserved by horizontal banks and corporate card providers.
business_model: Business banking and corporate cards earning interchange, treasury and payment fees
product_category: Vertical business banking and corporate cards
market_need_then: Press says early virtual cards went viral with teenage dropshippers and sneaker resellers; the company later cited underserved card heavy online businesses. Dated demand data was not found.
outcome_analysis: Slash grew from viral cards among young online sellers to a vertical business bank, raising 19 million dollars in 2022, 41 million in May 2025 and 100 million at a 1.4 billion dollar valuation in April 2026. Company and press claims show rapid revenue and volume growth against better funded horizontal rivals, helped by focusing on card heavy industries and a pivot away from a narrow reseller niche.

name: SlashAuth
one_liner: The solution for fine-grained access control in web3
long_description: Slashauth builds a developer platform for web3 enabled apps. Slashauth’s platform provides login functionality, role based access control, data storage, and more to any web3 enabled application.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Sleek
one_liner: Browser automation for businesses.
long_description: Sleek builds AI agents that automate important eCommerce flows for online shoppers. We work with consumer businesses to power these experiences across mobile and desktop via the browser.
regions: Canada; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Online shoppers using a browser extension for one-click checkout and cashback, monetized through retailer commissions; later consumer businesses and browser developers
problem: Filling out checkout forms is slow and shoppers miss savings, while retailers lose sales at checkout.
business_model: Affiliate commission from retail partners shared with shoppers as cashback; later white-label browser extensions and shopping page intelligence for partners
product_category: Consumer fintech and ecommerce browser extension, shopping automation
founder_names: Adam MacEachern; Daniel Baum; Palmer McCutcheon
market_need_then: Online shopping volume was elevated after 2020 and checkout friction and cashback extensions were popular. Dated evidence beyond competitor funding such as Karma raising 25 million dollars in October 2021 was not collected.
outcome_analysis: Sleek launched a one-click checkout and cashback extension in the crowded shopping extension market, raised about 1.7 million dollars in 2022 from YC, Hyde Park, Fiat and Goodwater, and later repositioned toward browser automation and white-label extensions. In September 2025 ZeroClick acquired it and the founders and team joined ZeroClick, which looks like a small team landing rather than a scaled outcome. Terms are not public.

name: Slope
tags: Fintech; Machine Learning; Payments; Fraud Detection; AI
one_liner: The B2B Payments Platform
long_description: Accept and reconcile B2B payments seamlessly.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: B2B merchants and marketplaces whose business buyers want net terms, later lenders needing SMB credit infrastructure
problem: Small businesses buying from suppliers, especially across borders in Latin America, lack trade credit and slow payments hurt sellers.
business_model: Take rate on financed B2B purchases (about 26 percent of a marketplace's gross merchandise value in 2022 per TechCrunch), later credit infrastructure licensing
product_category: B2B buy now pay later and credit infrastructure
market_need_then: TechCrunch in Nov 2021 reported 15 times growth in gross merchandise volume in 30 days; by April 2022 it financed over 2,500 businesses in the US and Mexico. These are company reported figures.
outcome_analysis: Slope raised an 8 million dollar seed in November 2021, a 24 million Series A in April 2022, 30 million in 2023 and a 65 million equity and debt package in July 2024 led by J.P. Morgan. Company reported growth and enterprise partners such as IKEA and Amazon suggest real traction, and the offering moved toward credit infrastructure. No exit, layoffs or shutdown were found.

name: Smartcuts
one_liner: Chrome extension to turn clicks & keystrokes into no-code automations
long_description: Smartcuts is a Chrome extension that lets you automate anything in your browser, without code. Record your clicks and keystrokes, and replay them later on similar web pages to automate repetitive work. It's like Excel macros for any website.
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; New York, NY, USA; Remote
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Knowledge workers who repeat browser tasks and do not code
problem: Repetitive clicking and typing across websites cannot be automated without code or an API.
business_model: Chrome extension with paid plans (pricing not verified)
product_category: No-code browser automation
market_need_then: The pitch compares it to Excel macros for any website; no dated demand evidence was found.
outcome_analysis: Smartcuts is a tiny team (three listed on the YC page) with a single founder who previously cofounded Lever. No outside round, acquisition, shutdown or layoff was found and the site was reported updated in 2026, so it looks like a small going concern. With no verified funding or traction, the story is stalled or quiet rather than clearly failed or successful.

name: SnapCalorie
one_liner: Single photo nutrition tracking.
long_description: SnapCalorie is the world’s first app where you can take a photo of ANY meal and get an accurate calorie count.  It takes seconds to use and is more accurate than a trained nutritionist. The team previously co-founded Google Lens, Cloud Vision API, and published a CVPR paper demonstrating the first algorithm to outperform a professional nutritionist at calorie counting.

product_category: AI food photo calorie tracking
competitors_at_founding: Lose It Snap It; Calorie Mama

name: Soco

long_description: Soco: You talk to it, it brings you hundreds of products.
