problem: Developers had to hand-code HTML email templates or accept rigid editors in legacy email APIs, which kept designers and product managers out of the loop and made deliverability and debugging opaque.
business_model: usage-based email API with free tier and paid plans (listed from 20 USD per month by a third-party directory)
product_category: transactional email API with visual template builder
market_need_then: Transactional email was a mature spend category and a customer quote on the YC page describes moving from SendGrid for better deliverability and onboarding conversion. No dated 2021 demand source was found.
outcome_analysis: Waypoint is a two-founder email API company that is still operating with no public acquisition or shutdown found. Public information is thin: no confirmed funding round was found beyond an aggregator entry, and the public launch on Product Hunt came in May 2023, two years after the Winter 2021 batch. It competes with large incumbents on a mature category, so growth depends on the template builder and developer experience rather than structural advantages.

name: Webiny
one_liner: Open-source framework for building serverless applications
long_description:
When the public cloud appeared migration was easy. Existing apps running on physical servers could just be moved to virtual machines running in the cloud. The cloud is now moving towards serverless, and serverless is not backward compatible. New tools need to be created and existing apps need to be rewritten. Webiny provides developers with everything they need to build those serverless apps.

We are a 100% remote team.
all_locations: Zagreb, Croatia; London, England, United Kingdom; Remote
regions: Croatia; United Kingdom; Europe; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Developers and companies building serverless apps and headless CMS sites on AWS
problem: Serverless is not backward compatible, so teams must rewrite apps and need new tooling, including a CMS that runs serverless.
business_model: Open source core (MIT) with paid enterprise features and managed hosting
product_category: Open source serverless application framework and headless CMS
market_need_then: Serverless adoption was growing and there was no full featured CMS built for it, per the 2019 TechCrunch coverage quoting the founder.
outcome_analysis: Webiny raised a small seed in 2019 and a 3.5 million dollar seed led by Microsoft's M12 in 2021 after YC Winter 2021, riding the serverless trend. It is still active and has repositioned from CMS to framework and then to an AI-programmable CMS. No larger round or exit was found, so growth looks modest.

name: Weekday
one_liner: AI recruiter that runs outbound sourcing campaigns to find top talent
long_description: At Weekday, we have built the most accurate database of talent (250mn+ people in US & India with contact data), we run outbound campaigns to identify top talent for any role you might be hiring for. We generate the highest response rates (30-40%) on our campaigns making sourcing talent as easy as making a job posting
regions: India; South Asia; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Startups and enterprises hiring tech talent, mainly in India and for remote roles

product_category: AI recruiting and outbound candidate sourcing

Its positioning moved from referrals to AI outbound sourcing, and no shutdown, acquisition or layoffs were found.

name: Whalesync
tags: SaaS; Workflow Automation; No-code; Data Engineering; Automation
one_liner: Two-way sync for your CRM, spreadsheets, database, and website
long_description:
Whalesync is a two-way data sync tool for business teams. It keeps records consistent between CRMs such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio, and Pipedrive, databases such as Postgres and Supabase, workspaces such as Airtable, Google Sheets, and Notion, and websites built on Webflow, WordPress, or Wix. When a record is created, edited, or deleted in one app, Whalesync makes the same change in the other, so each team can work in the tool it prefers without copying data by hand.

Its Live Export feature keeps a read-only copy of data from apps like Shopify, QuickBooks, Stripe, and HubSpot in Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, or Supabase for reporting and AI. Syncs are set up in minutes without code, or by an AI assistant through Whalesync's MCP server, and keep running without maintenance.

Its customer stories include Webflow, Descript, and Material Security. Every plan starts with a free trial.

Whalesync launched in Y Combinator's Summer 2021 batch.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Business and operations teams using no-code tools such as Airtable, Notion, Webflow, Google Sheets and CRMs
problem: Data lives in several apps and one-way integrations leave records inconsistent; teams want to edit in the tool they prefer and keep every app in sync.
business_model: SaaS subscription from 20 USD per month with a 7 day free trial
product_category: no-code two-way data sync
market_need_then: The no-code boom of 2020 and 2021 created many sources of truth such as Airtable and Notion with weak two-way integration; a Airtable community thread requests Notion sync. No dated 2021 spend data found.
outcome_analysis: Whalesync grew with the no-code wave, taking a small pre-YC round, joining Summer 2021 and announcing a 1.8M USD pre-seed in January 2023 with Ascend, Liquid2 and Soma. It reports 171 million records synced a year and a 4.9 G2 rating, and relaunched as 1.0 in 2024. No acquisition, shutdown or layoffs were found, and it stays a capital efficient small team.

name: Whaly
one_liner: Whaly is building a self-service analytics platform
long_description:
Whaly helps data teams save time on maintenance and analysis building while making business users more autonomous on the analysis they want to improve their decision making.

We do this by providing a self service data platform where both data and business teams can work together.

We understood that most data teams were ending up being a bottleneck for the rest of the company and needed to give more autonomy to business teams to back their decisions with data.

Emilien, Florian and Pierre were the minds behind the Data advertising platforms of the major media and e-commerce companies in France in their earlier position as Product Manager and head of Customer Success, giving them an edge on how to execute successfully a data project.
regions: France; Europe
target_customer: Data teams and business teams at mid-size companies, later consumer goods and retail field teams
problem: Data teams spent their time maintaining analytics infrastructure and answering requests while business users could not explore data themselves.
business_model: B2B SaaS platform with implementation services
product_category: self-service business intelligence and data platform
founder_names: Emilien Sanchez; Florian Buguet; Pierre de Poulpiquet
market_need_then: Rise of the modern data stack in 2020 and 2021 created demand for self-service tools; no dated external spend source was found.
outcome_analysis: Whaly is a three-founder Paris company that joined the Summer 2021 batch, raised a 1.9M USD seed in mid 2022 and later moved toward AI platforms for consumer goods and retail, with named customers such as Danone and Tropicana on its site. No acquisition, shutdown or layoffs were found, and funding beyond the seed was not found, so growth stage remains unclear.

name: Worksphere
one_liner: Manage your hybrid workplace
long_description: Worksphere helps companies manage a hybrid workplace where employees work from the office and from home. We allow employees to reserve a desk, know who will be in office, and better coordinate in-person meetings. Companies can let go of unused office space and save money.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Companies running hybrid offices that need desk reservation, attendance visibility and space right sizing
problem: As teams split time between office and home, companies did not know who would be in, could not coordinate in-person days, and kept unused office space.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription
product_category: Workplace management, hybrid work
founder_names: Aakhil Fardeen; Mark Piper; Theresa Klaassen
market_need_then: The pandemic return to office planning in early 2021 created sudden demand for desk reservation and attendance tools, covered by GeekWire in 2021.
outcome_analysis: Worksphere launched in early 2021 into a burst of demand for hybrid office tools but faced many near identical desk booking competitors, and with under a million dollars of reported funding it sold to Envoy in September 2022, when Envoy was consolidating the category by also buying OfficeTogether. The price was not disclosed. This looks like a small team exit driven by competitive pressure and a tightening funding market rather than a breakout outcome.

name: Writesonic
one_liner: Track & Boost Your Brand’s Visibility in AI Search
long_description:
Writesonic is the GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) platform that tracks your AI visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, and 10+ AI search platforms. Then helps you take precise actions to boost visibility—create new content, refresh existing pages, or reach out to sites that mention competitors but not you. 

Track, Act, and Win AI search from one platform. 

15,000+ five-star reviews across G2, Trustpilot, and Capterra.
regions: India; South Asia; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Marketing teams, agencies and small businesses that create content and now track brand visibility in AI search
problem: Writing marketing copy is slow and expensive; later, brands need to know and improve what AI search engines say about them.
business_model: Self-serve and enterprise SaaS subscriptions
product_category: Generative AI writing and generative engine optimization
market_need_then: GPT-3 opened in 2020 and 2021 made automated copy practical, and marketers adopted tools like Jasper quickly; Writesonic cites over 10M users creating AI content.
outcome_analysis: Writesonic rode GPT-3 to millions of users with a small seed of about 2.5M USD, and third party estimates put revenue near 8M USD in 2023 (a bootstrapped claim on Latka conflicts with the seed). It has pivoted to AI search visibility as basic writing commoditized, with a team of 35 and unverified revenue estimates above 30M USD. It remains independent and active.

name: Wyndly
tags: Consumer Health Services; Consumer; Digital Health; Healthcare
one_liner: Life's better without allergies
long_description:
Wyndly (https://www.wyndly.com) fixes allergies by training patients' bodies to ignore their allergy triggers. Frustrated allergy suffers come to us when they no longer want to deal with pills and sprays. We diagnose the patient’s unique allergy profile and create a personalized treatment plan to give the patient lifelong allergy relief. Specifically, Wyndly is increasing access to  sublingual immunotherapy (SLIT) for allergy care. For our patients, we're combining the convenience of telehealth and direct-to-consumer care with an exceptional patient experience that never loses the context of care.

Wyndly represents an opportunity to change allergy care forever. With 60 million Americans suffering from allergies today, and with this number doubling over the coming years, there's simply an incredible need for the convenient care Wyndly provides. 

You can read more about us in [Techcrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2021/02/12/wyndly-aims-to-bring-allergy-drops-to-the-masses/).

The Wyndly Model 

At Wyndly, we believe that better connections lead to better care, and we’re committed to making both happen at every step of the patient journey. Our allergy practice allows our patients to work with expert providers to develop personalized treatment plans for long-term allergy relief using clinically proven therapies. From a patient’s initial consultation to their final treatment delivery, we want the Wyndly experience to be a breath of fresh air for allergy sufferers – truly effective allergy relief, simply and efficiently delivered.

Once we've conquered allergies, we're transforming the care model for every chronic condition. While transactional care for purchasing pills has flourished in telehealth, no one has gone after chronic care. Patients with chronic conditions are shuffled between providers, insurance, and more -- and they never feel heard. These patients deserve better, and we're going to give it to them. Wyndly is starting with allergies, but we'll expand into asthma, sleep apnea, and other conditions in the near future.

Our values

**Compassion**: We approach all our patients and partners with an open mind and a genuine desire to be of service.

**Focus**: We do a few things very well, and are always clear about our boundaries and direction of travel.

**Courage**: We embrace ambiguity and discomfort because we know that’s how we grow.

**Progress**: We make something better every single day.

*It boils down to empathy and forward momentum in everything we do.*

The team

Wyndly is proudly backed by Y Combinator and a leading group of angel investors and VCs. The founders are Dr. Manan Shah (Chief Medical Officer), an ear-nose-and-throat surgeon who’s a leading practitioner of telehealth in his specialty, and his cousin Aakash Shah (CEO), who led growth  engineering at SparkGift (acquired by Stockpile in 2016) and Parse.ly (acquired by Automattic in 2021).
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; New York, NY, USA; Remote

It raised a small seed of about 2 million dollars in February 2023 and still operates under its own brand. YC lists the company as acquired, but no acquisition was found, so the directory status conflicts with the sources read and may reflect an unreported or recent deal.

name: Yemaachi Biotechnology
one_liner: Diversifying precision cancer diagnostics and treatments
long_description:
Yemaachi Biotech is diversifying and expanding access to precision cancer diagnostics and therapeutics by collecting  and sequencing samples from all across Africa, which is the most genetically diverse population on the planet. We then use this data to either optimize existing diagnostic tests, or help other companies discover new ones.
With our research activities based in Africa, we are able to leverage access to the most genetically diverse population on the planet to build a first-of-its-kind clinical and molecular knowledgebase on cancer among African people.
regions: Ghana; Africa

business_model: data and research services plus diagnostics and therapeutic discovery partnerships
product_category: precision oncology genomics
founder_names: Yaw Bediako; Yaw Attua-Afari; David Hutchful; Joyce Ngoi
market_need_then: Underrepresentation of Africans in genomic datasets is documented; one funder, the Gates Foundation, gave CEO Yaw Bediako a 1M USD fellowship grant (to the CEO, not the company).
outcome_analysis: Yemaachi built an African cancer genomics research business from Accra, raised a 3M USD seed in March 2022 led by V8 Capital, and kept announcing partnerships such as with Lucence, Roche and Bio Usawa. It remains active with no layoffs or shutdown found. Its strength is founder science credentials and exclusive data; the open question is turning data partnerships into recurring revenue.

name: YourQuote
one_liner: YourQuote is India's largest writing platform
long_description: YourQuote is a social writing app that helps regular people share their short-form creative writing. Much like how Instagram has turned each one of us into a photographer, YourQuote has turned 2.5 million people in India into amateur writers.

name: Z1

name: ZOKO
one_liner: Better Business on WhatsApp
long_description:
Zoko: The Ultimate WhatsApp Commerce Solution for Shopify Merchants

WHY ZOKO IS THE GAME-CHANGING PLATFORM EVERY SHOPIFY MERCHANT NEEDS
Shopify merchants face a critical challenge: while they've built amazing online stores, they're missing out on the world's largest messaging platform where customers actually want to shop. Zoko solves this by seamlessly integrating WhatsApp commerce capabilities with your existing Shopify infrastructure.

THE UNTAPPED OPPORTUNITY THAT'S COSTING YOU SALES
Consider this: 175 million people message businesses on WhatsApp daily - that's more engagement than Amazon generates. With 100 million merchants already using WhatsApp for business globally, those not leveraging this channel are falling behind competitors who are capturing sales directly through conversations.

PROVEN SUCCESS FORMULA
Zoko's founders didn't just theorize about WhatsApp commerce - they lived it. Starting with their own ecommerce business entirely on WhatsApp, they scaled to 200,000 engaged followers who eagerly purchased products through weekly WhatsApp updates. When other businesses began paying for access to their "WhatsApp sales tools," they knew they'd discovered something revolutionary.

THE $50 BILLION MARKET OPPORTUNITY
The WhatsApp commerce market represents over $50 billion annually - a massive revenue stream that traditional ecommerce platforms can't access. For Shopify merchants, this means untapped customers, higher engagement rates, and sales happening through the world's most trusted messaging platform.

COMPLETE SALES, MARKETING & SUPPORT INTEGRATION
Zoko transforms WhatsApp into a comprehensive business channel, enabling Shopify merchants to:
- Convert conversations directly into sales
- Run targeted marketing campaigns through WhatsApp
- Provide instant customer support where customers prefer to communicate
- Build deeper customer relationships through personalized messaging

THE FUTURE OF COMMERCE IS CONVERSATIONAL
WhatsApp represents the internet for the next billion users entering the digital economy. Zoko positions itself as the "Shopify for WhatsApp merchants," giving existing Shopify store owners the tools to dominate this emerging channel before competitors realize its potential.

For Shopify merchants serious about growth, Zoko isn't just another tool - it's the bridge to the next generation of ecommerce where conversations convert to sales.
regions: India; South Asia; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Ecommerce merchants and D2C brands, mainly Shopify stores in India, the Middle East and elsewhere
problem: Merchants sell and support customers over WhatsApp but have no shared inbox, automation or Shopify integration around it.

product_category: WhatsApp commerce platform for Shopify

name: Zealth
one_liner: Software for remote monitoring of cancer patients
long_description:
Zealth is building remote monitoring software to help hospitals provide automated continuous round-the-clock support to their cancer patients post-discharge. 

Hospitals are overburdened with no resources to provide care to their chronic patients once they leave the hospital. For instance, in India, there are only 2200 oncologists for 1.38 billion people. Patients travel 100 miles waiting for hours to get few minutes with the doctors. They have no easy means to manage all the toxicities and symptoms they get once they are back home. This leads to 6X lower patient retention, 4X high emergency readmissions, and poor patient outcomes. 

Zealth bridges this gap through its digital health intervention platform.
regions: India; South Asia; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Hospitals and oncology clinics in India and Singapore that pay for software to monitor cancer patients after discharge
problem: Hospitals cannot support chronic and cancer patients once they go home, so toxicities go unmanaged and emergency readmissions rise. India has very few oncologists per patient.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to hospitals (remote patient monitoring platform called CareShare)
product_category: Remote patient monitoring for oncology
competitors_at_founding: Practo, mFine and other Indian telehealth startups
market_need_then: India had about 2,200 oncologists for 1.38 billion people according to the YC description, and COVID-19 in 2020 pushed hospitals toward remote monitoring. The product was first used for COVID-19 home isolation patients before moving to cancer.
outcome_analysis: Zealth entered YC in Winter 2021 with two founders and a plausible need in Indian oncology, and claimed adoption by 21 hospitals. No institutional funding round was found, and one directory says the product company stopped in 2024 and became an advisory practice, which conflicts with the YC Active label. The cause is not public, so the failure factor is a tentative reading from the absence of any funding and a team that stayed at one or two people.

name: Zeit Medical
tags: Sleep Tech; Consumer Health Services; Medical Devices
one_liner: Immediate stroke detection at home
long_description: Zeit Medical leverages the power of AI and wearable sensors to deliver peace of mind for those affected by stroke. Zeit’s smart headband immediately detects the onset of stroke and notifies 911. Each year more than 90% of the one million strokes in the US go untreated, resulting in life-long disability and exploding medical costs north of $100b. The lack of timely treatment is the result of delays in alerting the emergency services. More than 10 million Americans with an elevated stroke risk live with constant fear that a stroke may go unnoticed for hours, while they are asleep or alone. The company was founded by Orestis Vardoulis  PhD  a biomedical & mechanical engineer and expert in digital health (EPFL/Stanford) and Urs Naber  MD  a critical care physician (Dartmouth/Stanford). They have both seen the devastating effects of stroke in their families and came up with the idea of addressing this unmet clinical need during their Stanford Biodesign Innovation Fellowship.

name: Zepto

name: Ziina

name: Zoios.

name: Zuma

name: aSim

name: arnata

name: authzed
tags: Developer Tools; Security; Open Source; Data Engineering; AI
one_liner: Authorization Infrastructure securing AI at OpenAI, Zoom, & more

name: ALT TEX
tags: Carbon Capture and Removal; Bioplastic; Biotech; Climate; Food Tech
one_liner: Biodegradable and carbon neutral textiles, engineered from food waste.
long_description:
ALT TEX is a Toronto-based biomaterials startup that has developed the world’s first biodegradable and carbon neutral fabric, engineered from the world’s largest landfill contributor - food waste. Polyester alone makes up 60% of the $2.5 trillion fashion industry and is the biggest blocker preventing brands from meeting sustainability mandates. The patent-pending ALT TEX fermentation technology creates a polyester alternative that works with the existing infrastructure to supply a sustainable, high performance and cost competitive polyester replacement to fashion brands, at scale. 

The product solves key problems for fashion brands, consumers, and the environment:

(1) Fashion brands: ALT TEX sells fabric to fashion brands, allowing them to differentiate via sustainable options (sustainable fashion growing 11% CAGR) and hit sustainability targets, without sacrificing performance or changing their current supply chain.

(2) Consumer: The ALT TEX fabric is projected to be half the price vs. other specialized sustainable alternatives (due to low-cost input and scalability), meaning greater accessibility.

(3) Environment: A single shirt produced with ALT TEX fabric can divert 1 kg of food waste from landfills, 9 kg of carbon emissions from the air, and 4 g of micro-plastics from our waterways.

Co-founders Myra and Avneet have worked together managing teams and projects for six years, with backgrounds in serial entrepreneurship, corporate sales at Fortune 500 companies, textile manufacturing and biochemistry. To date, ALT TEX has created their first fabric prototype that’s 70% stronger than cotton, secured $1M in LOIs and raised $2.3M.
regions: Canada; America / Canada
target_customer: Fashion brands seeking sustainable polyester replacements
problem: Polyester dominates apparel and is hard to replace. ALT TEX ferments food waste into a biodegradable polymer that is melt extruded like polyester.
business_model: Fabric and fiber sales to fashion brands
product_category: Biomaterials, bio-based textile fibers
market_need_then: Brands faced sustainability mandates and polyester is a large share of apparel fiber; the company cites 1M USD in letters of intent on its YC page.
outcome_analysis: ALT TEX raised a pre-seed in May 2021 after university prizes and Creative Destruction Lab, joined YC in Summer 2022 and reports 2.3M USD raised in total on its YC page. It remains active with a team of 10, but no later round or commercial scale milestone was found in sources, so it sits in the capital intensive scale up phase typical of materials startups.

name: AYC Fund
tags: Crypto / Web3; Finance; Trading; AI; Cryptocurrency
one_liner: AI-native crypto hedge fund
long_description:
We provides two AI trading services

- ZenTrade.me is AI trading service for retail traders. 

- AYC Fund is AI-native crypto hedge fund.
regions: South Korea; East Asia
target_customer: Retail crypto traders (ZenTrade.me) and qualified clients of a private systematic digital asset program (AYC Fund VIP)
problem: Retail traders lose money trading crypto manually. AYC offers AI driven trading, now through a private invite only managed program.

product_category: AI crypto trading fund

It claims a contest win in a Bybit AI trading event, but no independent funding, assets under management or audited performance were found. The shift to an invite only VIP program suggests narrowing from retail to qualified clients, with the cause not public.

name: AccessOwl
one_liner: Managing your Employees' Access to SaaS
long_description:
AccessOwl automates employee SaaS account provisioning and permissioning for any tool. IT teams from companies like Zeplin and Sary save 30 minutes on every request.

Access management used to be an enterprise problem. With work from home, exploding SaaS usage and the need for SOC2 certifications startups have the same problems as enterprises. 

Mathias and Philip have built several startups and teams before and experienced the same problems around access management over and over again. Philip was the CEO and Co-Founder of blik, an award winning IoT solution that was used by Volkswagen and BMW. Mathias built the leading private payment infrastructure provider in Germany as well as the first digital car insurance as Co-Founder and CTO. Based on these experiences we decided to build a solution we wish we could have used when building our former companies.

AccessOwl can be deployed within minutes instead of weeks by simply installing a Slack application. We save companies that use AccessOwl 30 minutes for every access request, on- and offboarding.
regions: Germany; Europe; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Lean IT teams at startups and SMBs that need SaaS onboarding, offboarding and access reviews for SOC 2 or ISO 27001
problem: Provisioning and removing employee access across many SaaS tools is manual, and many apps lack SCIM or SSO. AccessOwl automates it through Slack and integrations.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription
product_category: Access governance and SaaS management
market_need_then: The YC description cites remote work, SaaS sprawl and SOC 2 pressure on small companies; customer quotes of 30 minutes saved per request come from the company.
outcome_analysis: AccessOwl is active with 15 people and over 120 customer teams according to its own site, and it broadened from provisioning to access reviews, shadow IT detection and spend tracking. Funding appears small and only aggregator data exists, so scale of the company's success cannot be judged beyond its own claims.

name: Accountable
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate
one_liner: Smarter Spending for Vacation Property Managers
long_description:
Accountable is AI-powered accounting automation for vacation rental property managers. These companies spend money on behalf of hundreds or thousands of property owners on cleaning, maintenance, supplies and repairs. Every dollar has to be paid, tracked, and charged back to the right owner, which most teams still do by hand across disconnected systems.

Accountable handles payments, cards, approvals and expense tracking in one place, and syncs everything to the tools property managers already use: their property management software, field operations tools and accounting system. The result is fewer people doing data entry, accurate owner statements, and books that close 90% faster.

Serving tens of thousands of properties.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Vacation rental property managers with 20 to 20,000 properties
problem: Managers pay cleaning, maintenance and supply costs for many owners and must track and charge each back by hand across disconnected systems.
business_model: B2B SaaS and payments: expense management, bill pay and cards with fees (pricing not found)
product_category: Vertical fintech: spend and accounting automation for vacation rentals
market_need_then: Vacation rental managers handle owner expenses manually. Evidence is the company's description and founder's five years as a property manager; no dated third-party source found.
outcome_analysis: Accountable is still active with a two person team on YC and a site claiming more than 35,000 properties and integrations with major vacation rental systems. One aggregator estimates revenue near $1.9M and says it is bootstrapped, unverified. Founder experience as a property manager fits the niche, but no funding, revenue or exit evidence could be confirmed.

name: Actipulse Neuroscience
tags: Mental Health Tech; Neurotechnology; Medical Devices
one_liner: Bringing non-invasive brain stimulation from the hospital to the home
long_description:
Non-invasive brain stimulation is a widely-utilized, FDA cleared treatment used for patients diagnosed with depression, but is limited to a hospital setting due to the cost of the device, and complexity of treatment application.

Our proprietary brain stimulation device allows patients to be treated directly from their home, with the same efficacy, and at a lower cost of treatment.

Currently in FDA pivotal phase for Major Depressive Disorder, and Pilot phase for Alzheimer's and Parkinson diseases.
regions: Mexico; Latin America; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Patients with major depression, Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease treated with home neuromodulation; paid by patients or health systems
problem: Transcranial magnetic stimulation is FDA cleared for depression but limited to hospitals because of device cost and complexity. Actipulse builds a proprietary device for home treatment.
business_model: Medical device, regulated, requires clinical trials and clearance before sales
product_category: Non-invasive brain stimulation medical device
market_need_then: Depression is common and hospital TMS access is limited, which the company cites; dated spend evidence was not found.
outcome_analysis: Actipulse is active with 38 people and describes a pivotal depression trial, after a 2021 crowdfunding raise and YC in Winter 2022. A third party directory says no FDA marketing authorization or US trial registry entry was found and that an earlier Alzheimer's trial's primary endpoint was safety, so commercial proof is still open and the timeline appears to have slipped. Funding is partially known.

name: Activepieces
tags: Workflow Automation; Open Source; No-code; Enterprise Software; AI
one_liner: Open-source, AI-first and no-code business automation tool
long_description:
Activepieces is an open-source (MIT) business automation software.
For example, you can build automations to receive email and Slack notifications about new contacts add to your HubSpot CRM.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Companies and technical teams wanting a self-hostable automation and AI agent platform, now enterprises
problem: Business automation tools like Zapier are closed and costly at scale. Activepieces is an open source, self-hostable no-code alternative with community built integrations.
business_model: Open core: MIT community edition, paid cloud and enterprise features, usage-based per flow run
product_category: Workflow automation and AI agents
market_need_then: Demand for self-hosted open alternatives to Zapier; the YC launch post positioned it that way and launched with 15 apps.
outcome_analysis: Activepieces is active and has grown from a 2022 open source Zapier alternative into an AI agent and automation workspace with named enterprise customers. Funding is documented only by aggregators and a founder interview, so the capital behind the growth is unclear. Community contributed integrations and open source distribution appear to be the main drivers.

name: Ad Army
tags: Generative AI; B2B; Marketing; Creator Economy; AI
one_liner: Generate, iterate, and ship AI ad creatives faster
long_description:
Ad Army is an AI creative tool for brands that need a constant supply of ad creative.

You build your brand's world once — characters, products, locations — each with locked descriptors and reference images. Then you generate against it: @-mention an entity in a prompt and its references are pulled into the model call, so the same product, the same face and the same location hold across images, video, and dozens of variants. Save any chain of steps as a recipe and replay it on the next campaign.

We're model-agnostic by design — video, image, text and audio providers sit behind one interface, and new models land as they ship. For a full narrative spot, the same world scripts, storyboards, animates, voices, captions and exports multi-scene ads in every aspect ratio.
regions: United Kingdom; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Brands and marketers who need a constant supply of ad creative
problem: Producing consistent ad images and video at volume is slow. Ad Army keeps a brand's characters, products and locations consistent across generated variants and replays workflows.
business_model: Credit based subscription tiers for individuals and per seat team plans
product_category: Generative AI ad creative studio
founder_names: Jonathan Aeschlimann; Lourenço Maciel; Pedro Nascimento
market_need_then: Brands need a constant supply of ad creative; dated 2022 demand evidence was not found.
outcome_analysis: Ad Army is still active with a small team and a current multi-tier credit pricing page, after a 2022 start as an AI ad generator. The product has evolved with new video and image models, but no verified funding, revenue or press was found, so success or failure cannot be judged from public sources.

name: Agave
one_liner: Applied AI for Construction
long_description:
Agave builds applied AI for construction, a $12T global industry run on financial software built 20-50 years ago, much of it on-prem with no APIs and no documentation.

We spent 4 years building proprietary rails that read and write across those systems. Our AI agents run on those rails and take over the back-office work contractors still do by hand: invoice matching, expenses, compliance, billing, and financial reporting. Contractors keep the systems they already use; our agents work across them.

600+ contractors run on Agave, including teams building hyperscaler data centers, mass transit systems, and other critical infrastructure. We're backed by Accel and Y Combinator, who both reinvested in our $15M Series A, plus execs from Procore, Autodesk, PlanGrid, and Plaid.

Our three co-founders have worked together for 12+ years, across Graphiq (acquired by Amazon in 2017) and Amazon, and started Agave in YC's W22 batch.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Software developers and construction software vendors who needed API access to contractor systems at founding; later general and trade contractors that buy back-office automation
problem: Construction financial and project systems were old, often on-premises and without usable APIs, so connecting them or automating invoice, expense and compliance work was manual.
business_model: Usage and subscription pricing for a unified API at founding, later B2B SaaS and AI back-office agents sold to contractors
product_category: Construction unified API, then AI financial operations for contractors
founder_names: Tom Reno; Pooria Azimi; John Zucchi; Samantha Zhang
market_need_then: Construction runs on financial software built decades ago, much of it on premises without APIs, so vendors and contractors lacked a way to integrate; Agave's seed coverage cites demand for a single API across project management, ERP and scheduling.
outcome_analysis: Agave started as a unified API for construction software, took a small seed from Accel in August 2023, and moved toward AI back-office agents, announcing a $15M Series A in July 2026 with Accel and YC both reinvesting. The hard integration work with legacy systems is its main asset, while platform risk from Procore API terms in 2025 is the main threat. It is active with no exit.

name: Agency
one_liner: Agency replaces traditional security and compliance headcount with AI.
long_description:
Agency replaces traditional security and compliance headcount with AI without replacing your existing tools.

Our platform is operated by forward-deployed engineers who run your entire security and compliance program including full virtual CISO coverage on your behalf. All powered by our proprietary AI agents.

Agency is a vertically integrated AI platform and services company that enables organizations to achieve and maintain SOC 2, ISO 27001, CMMC 2.0, HIPAA, GDPR, FedRAMP, HITRUST, ISO 42001, and more without building internal teams. We integrate with leading GRC platforms like Vanta and Drata and security tools like CrowdStrike.

At its core is our proprietary cybersecurity and GRC orchestration layer powering a suite of AI systems that execute end-to-end security and compliance operations: control implementation, evidence collection, monitoring, vendor risk, penetration testing, and audit coordination — across complex environments like BYODs, contractor fleets, and multi-party systems. Things that GRC automation platforms can't do.

We deliver this through two distinctly separate products:

Agency Comply — forward-deployed engineers who operate the platform, implement controls, run compliance programs, and manage security end-to-end

Auditsuisse Assurance — our US and Swiss licensed CPA firm, powered by Auditsuisse AI, delivering independent SOC and global audits with speed and rigor. (Auditsuisse does not audit Agency Comply customers).

Agency serves startups through enterprises building in high-stakes environments — AI, defense, aerospace, fintech, and healthcare — replacing fragmented tools and large internal teams with a single AI-driven system of execution.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Startups through enterprises that need SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA and similar compliance, especially in AI, defense, fintech and healthcare
problem: Companies need security and compliance programs but cannot staff them internally, and GRC automation tools alone do not run the work.
business_model: Managed service plus software: forward-deployed engineers operate an AI platform, sold as a subscription program
product_category: AI security and compliance services (Agency Comply, Auditsuisse Assurance)
market_need_then: Startups needed SOC 2 and similar attestations to close enterprise deals, which fueled compliance automation vendors around 2020 to 2022; Agency's own comparison page names Vanta, Drata and Secureframe as the market.
outcome_analysis: Agency is still active with about 50 people and claims over 1,000 customers, but no priced funding round, exit or independent coverage was found, so its trajectory cannot be explained from sources. It moved from compliance services toward an AI platform with a CPA audit arm, and its generic name makes it hard to distinguish in press.

name: Agentnoon

long_description: 🚀 Enable strategic decision making using a fast, flexible, and intuitive org design and workforce planning platform. ⚡

The deal gave an HR suite vendor a fast route to a product, so the outcome looks like a technology and team acquisition at undisclosed terms rather than a venture scale exit; the success code other reflects an acquisition with unknown price.

name: AiPrise
one_liner: AI-powered Global Compliance Platform
long_description: AiPrise is an AI-powered compliance platform for KYB, KYC and AML. Fintechs, payment companies, crypto and stablecoin platforms, and marketplaces use AiPrise to verify and onboard businesses and individuals in 200+ countries in minutes, not weeks. One API connects to 500+ government registries and data sources. AI agents review KYB cases, detect identity fraud, screen against sanctions and watchlists, read documents and check business websites. AiPrise is SOC 2 Type II compliant, backed by Y Combinator and Headline, and trusted by 150+ companies worldwide. Headquartered in San Jose, California.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Fintechs, payment companies, crypto and stablecoin platforms and marketplaces that must verify businesses and individuals
problem: Verifying businesses and people across many countries meant slow manual checks across fragmented registries and data sources.
business_model: Usage-based API plus platform subscription for KYB, KYC and AML
product_category: KYB, KYC and AML compliance platform
market_need_then: Fintech and crypto firms faced KYB and AML obligations across borders; sources opened for this record are current, so dated 2022 demand evidence was not found.
outcome_analysis: AiPrise grew from the YC Summer 2022 batch into a compliance platform with 150+ customers and about 40 to 65 staff, and announced a 12.5M Series A led by Headline in October 2025. Earlier funding is unclear beyond the YC deal. The crowded KYB market is the main risk; no exit or distress was found.

name: AiSupervision
one_liner: The operating system for factory production lines
long_description: We make the operating system to track, manage and improve production in factories with many workers. We automate what the best supervisors would do if they watched everything that’s happening inside your factory.
regions: Germany; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote

name: AirMyne
tags: Carbon Capture and Removal; Hard Tech; Hardware; Climate
one_liner: Building systems to remove carbon dioxide from air at industrial scale
long_description: AirMyne is building machines to capture & remove carbon dioxide from ambient atmospheric air so it can be utilized or sequestered downstream. Our team is based in Berkeley, CA.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Corporations and governments buying carbon dioxide removal, plus industrial emitters wanting point source capture
problem: Direct air capture is energy hungry and expensive, which blocks scaling of carbon removal.
business_model: Carbon removal sold per tonne and capture systems for emitters; revenue not yet reported
product_category: Direct air capture hardware using a regenerable liquid sorbent
market_need_then: Corporate carbon removal purchase commitments and US policy support rose around 2022, and funding for direct air capture companies was large that year, per the competitor coverage.
outcome_analysis: AirMyne launched in 2022 from YC with a liquid sorbent approach that uses low temperature heat, raised a reported 6.9M seed in March 2024, and has since moved toward a commercial pilot. It is capital intensive hardware in a field dominated by far better funded rivals, so milestones depend on follow on funding; no exit or distress was found.

name: Airhart Aeronautics
one_liner: Airplanes anyone can fly
long_description: Airhart is making airplanes anyone can fly. Our semi-autonomous tech will enable 10x more people to fly their own planes and make flying to Tahoe as easy as driving to the grocery store
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Private pilots and owners of light aircraft who buy avionics, and later buyers of a semi-autonomous personal aircraft
problem: Flying light aircraft is hard and expensive, with cluttered legacy cockpits that limit who can fly.
business_model: Hardware sales of avionics (a 49,900 USD package listed on the site), later aircraft kits and aircraft
product_category: General aviation avionics and semi-autonomous personal aircraft
market_need_then: General aviation is costly and pilot numbers are limited; the pitch was that semi-autonomy could widen the market, though sources opened give no dated demand data.
outcome_analysis: Airhart raised a small amount after YC and, by late 2025 and 2026, shipped production avionics hardware, flew a test aircraft in April 2026, and announced about 4.56M in new funding. It remains early with certification still ahead, and incumbent Garmin covers much of the same safety story, so the path depends on certification and further capital.

name: Airtrain AI
tags: AIOps; Developer Tools; SaaS; Cloud Computing; AI
one_liner: No-code data curation for LLM fine-tuning and evaluation.
long_description:
Airtrain AI is a no-code data platform for Large Language Models.

Proprietary AI models such as GPT-4 are very powerful but also very costly, slow, unreliable, and unsecured.

As businesses look to scale their AI prototypes into production-grade products, they struggle with large AI bills, slow APIs and large failure rates.
On the other hand, smaller language models have been proven to be able to perform on-part with large ones with fine-tuned on high-quality datasets.

Airtrain AI lets AI practitioners explore alternatives to proprietary models, build up training datasets, evaluate, fine-tune, and serve a large selection of open-source LLMs.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Airwork
tags: Marketplace; B2B; Recruiting; Enterprise Software; AI
one_liner: On-demand labour that's actually good
long_description:
Airwork is an on-demand labor marketplace for premium blue collar workers. You can get an Airworker the same way you get an Uber, except instead of a taxi, someone shows up at your work site to work for the day.

Airwork fills 98% of shifts in 2 hours. We're currently live in 8 industries across Southern Ontario, Canada, and customers include Tesla, the Toronto Pearson Airport, and the CNE.

We're funded by YCombinator, Expa, Village Global, and SHL Capital.
regions: Canada; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Ontario businesses in warehousing, events, hospitality, catering and manufacturing that need short notice hourly labor
problem: Staffing agencies were slow and charged heavy markups, so employers struggled to fill blue collar shifts quickly.
business_model: Marketplace and staffing with a take rate (site lists a 30 percent platform fee)
product_category: On-demand hourly labor marketplace
market_need_then: The YC launch post framed a Canadian labor shortage; the company claimed filling 98 percent of shifts in two hours and customers such as Tesla and Toronto Pearson, which are self reported.
outcome_analysis: Airwork raised a reported 1.5M pre-seed in late 2021 and stayed regionally focused on Ontario with a small team, selling to employers at a platform fee. No later rounds, exit or shutdown were found, so its trajectory is unclear and funding coverage is partial.

name: Aklimate
one_liner: Software for enterprises to track and reduce supply chain emissions
long_description: With Aklimate, enterprises provide their suppliers with carbon management tools for free, in exchange for their emissions data. You can imagine it as the company paying for a Watershed-lite for each of their suppliers.
regions: United Kingdom; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Albiware Inc.
one_liner: B2B SaaS for insurance damage repair contractors.
long_description: Albiware (Albi) is a B2B SaaS solution for the $100B+ insurance damage repair industry. Albi provides an all-in-one platform for damage repair contractors to manage all aspects of their business including: CRM, project management, field documentation, scheduling, BI, marketing automation, communication, HR management, and much more. Albi is built by contractors who felt the pain that lack of technology brought and set out on a mission to build a SaaS that all insurance damage repair contractors want. Albi helps their customers reduce claims friction between them and the insurance company by providing tools to seamlessly document the work that was performed at projects. Albi helps users sync their communication company-wide through email, text, and phone directly in the platform. Albi helps contractors get paid faster by streamlining the process of a project from first call to completion. Albi also helps their customers make better business decisions through their BI tool with customizable reporting.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Insurance damage repair and restoration contractors
problem: Restoration contractors ran jobs across disconnected tools, which slowed documentation, insurer communication and getting paid.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with Base, Pro and Enterprise tiers
product_category: Vertical SaaS for restoration management
market_need_then: The company cites a 100B plus insurance damage repair industry and says founders felt the lack of technology as restorers; no independent 2022 demand source was found.
outcome_analysis: Albiware built vertical SaaS for restoration contractors, helped by founders who came from the industry. It closed an 8M Series A led by Palm Drive Capital in March 2023 and an undisclosed Series B led by Frontier Growth in August 2025, with YC participating. It remains independent; main risks are incumbents like DASH and the size of the niche.

name: Aldara
one_liner: HOA manager with automated operations
long_description:
Aldara is a modern, efficient HOA manager.
We achieve that by automating back-office and operations with our in-house technology, powered by AI.
regions: Spain; Europe

name: Alfie
one_liner: Democratizing access to precision weight loss medications
long_description:
At Alfie, we've built a rigorous virtual medical program based on the top research from Cleveland Clinic and Harvard that allows us to precisely determine which weight loss regimen and (as needed) medications will be most effective for our members in a multimodal approach. We're optimizing exercise/nutrition/medications in complex care pathways like no one else has before.

Our program has been shown to be 2x more effective than standard prescription medication and 5x more effective than habit change alone.

We've raised capital from Goodwater Capital, Nina Capital, Air Force Ventures, and Phoenix Club, and various super angels including the founder of OpenTrons (medical labs automation; have raised $240 mill). Also, we're a Y Combinator graduate.
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; New York, NY, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Adults with obesity paying for a virtual weight management program
problem: Weight loss programs rarely match medication, nutrition and exercise to the individual. Alfie built a virtual clinic that selects a regimen from medical history.
business_model: Direct to consumer telehealth subscription
product_category: Virtual obesity clinic, digital health
founder_names: Alexander Singh; Hasan Syed; Rohit Rustagi
market_need_then: Obesity prevalence and demand for GLP-1 weight loss medication were rising in 2022 and 2023. No Alfie specific demand data found.
outcome_analysis: Alfie was a small virtual obesity clinic that raised 2.1 million dollars in mid 2023 as weight loss drug demand surged, then was acquired by competitor knownwell in June 2024, six months after knownwell's Series A. The platform was folded into knownwell and standalone access ended, so it looks like a consolidation of a small player rather than a scaled outcome. Price was not disclosed.

name: Alga Biosciences
one_liner: We stop cows from burping methane.
long_description: Alga Biosciences is a fast-moving startup focused on transforming the agricultural industry. Our mission is to make an immediate, dramatic impact on global methane emissions produced by enteric fermentation in partnership with the cattle industry. We believe in leveraging biology to tackle the world’s biggest problems.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Cattle owners and dairies who feed a supplement, with revenue partly from carbon or methane credit programs
problem: Enteric fermentation in cattle produces large methane emissions. Alga makes a kelp or algae based feed additive, about 0.5 percent of diet, that it says cuts methane by up to 97 percent.
business_model: Feed additive sales to cattle producers, paired with methane credit programs via partners
product_category: Agricultural biotech, livestock methane reduction
founder_names: Alexander Brown; Daria Balatsky; Caroline McKeon
market_need_then: Livestock methane is a large share of agricultural emissions, and the seed announcement cites USDA Climate Smart Commodities support. Collaborative Fund's post notes red seaweed is slow and capital intensive to grow, framing demand for faster scaling options.
outcome_analysis: Alga raised a seed round led by Collaborative Fund in April 2023, totaling $4M raised per TechCrunch, after academic trials that reported undetectable methane from beef cattle. It was preparing commercial pilots, partnered with 3Degrees to bring the product to market, and is hiring in 2026. Company claims on methane reduction are not independently verified, and rivals with larger rounds compete for the same buyers, so scale of adoption is still unproven.

name: AlgoTest
one_liner: Ecosystem for options trading in India
long_description:
AlgoTest is an algorithmic options trading platform for Indian retail traders. For the first time ever, day traders will be able to trade using the same technology as the top hedge funds and high-frequency trading firms of the world.

The company is founded by Raghav Malik (Financial Engineering @ Columbia Univ), an HFT technologist and former options market-maker in the US.
regions: India; South Asia
target_customer: Indian retail options traders and day traders who want to backtest and automate strategies without coding
problem: Retail traders in India lacked institutional grade tools for options backtesting and execution. AlgoTest offers a free no-code backtester and a paid live execution engine.
business_model: Freemium SaaS subscription for backtesting and live algo execution
product_category: Algorithmic options trading platform (India)
market_need_then: The YC launch post says retail tools cost a fraction of what institutions pay and claims AlgoTest is more powerful than existing retail tools. Indian retail options trading volumes were large, and Streak's earlier funding shows the category was backed.
outcome_analysis: AlgoTest is a Delhi based options algo platform founded by a former US options market maker and Indian HFT technologist. It reports a community of 35,000 plus traders and a team of 40, and is still publishing and operating in 2026. Funding visible in aggregators is small (about $500K pre-seed in 2022), which suggests a capital efficient business, but revenue figures are unverified.

name: Alima

long_description: Alima is a supply chain tech company that simplifies how businesses procure fresh goods in Latin America. We help restaurants, CPG brands, and retailers plan their buying orders, ordering products, expense management, and logistics.

Our compounds disrupt the metabolic and
inflammatory triggers in both cancer and quasi-cancerous
cells in the tumor microenvironment. By impacting multiple cell
types, we are enabling effective, lasting cancer treatments.

problem: Cancer drug resistance driven by the tumor microenvironment. Alixia's compounds aim to disrupt metabolic and inflammatory triggers in cancer and quasi-cancerous cells.
