name: Almond
tags: Consumer Health Services; Telehealth; Consumer; Healthcare; Femtech
one_liner: We make it easy to get great ObGyn care  in-person and over telehealth
long_description:
Almond is like One Medical but for women’s health: we make it easy to get great ObGyn care fast, both at our in-person offices and over telehealth.

The problem with traditional ObGyn practices is that physician time is misused, so patients get slow care. We're rebuilding back-office tech that saves physicians time, and we're hiring a wider range of care providers roles, which let us deliver better outcomes to patients and reduce the amount of time it takes to get their issue resolved.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Alterya
tags: Fintech; SaaS; Crypto / Web3; Analytics; API
one_liner: Protecting Humans from Scams
long_description: Alterya helps financial institutions, fintechs, and crypto service providers prevent APP fraud by detecting scams targeting their users and exploiting their platform.
all_locations: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
regions: Israel; Middle East and North Africa; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Financial institutions, fintechs and crypto service providers facing authorized push payment (APP) fraud
problem: Scammers run short lived scam sites that trick users into paying, and banks cannot spot them in time. Alterya uses AI agents to detect scams targeting users.
business_model: B2B API and SaaS sold to financial institutions
product_category: Fraud and scam detection
market_need_then: APP fraud was a growing issue for banks, with UK regulation moving toward reimbursement. No Alterya specific demand data found for 2022.
outcome_analysis: Alterya was a Tel Aviv team with elite intelligence unit backgrounds that built AI agents to find scam sites for banks and crypto firms. Chainalysis bought it in January 2025 for a reported 150 to 160 million dollars, about two and a half years after the YC batch, keeping its 28 employees as a local R&D center. The outcome was strong for a company of its size.

name: Amal Invest
one_liner: Investing app for Muslims
long_description:
Amal's an investing app for Muslims. Muslims only invest in Shariah-compliant business, but it's hard to know which businesses are compliant. That's because it's based on complex financial metrics that change over time. We take that burden away entirely.

Amal can filter stocks but also, remarkably, funds. Set your filters up once, and you'll have access to a universe of investments that cater to your specific requirements. Sign up today at https://amalinvest.com
regions: Bahrain; Middle East and North Africa; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Muslim retail investors who want Shariah-compliant stock and fund exposure inside their own brokerage account
problem: Shariah compliance depends on complex financial screens that change over time, so Muslim investors struggle to know which stocks and funds they can hold. Amal says it also screens funds, not only stocks.
business_model: One-time access fee for portfolio and screening tools ($249 Standard or $999 Pro per the company site), assets held at the user's own broker
product_category: Halal investing and Shariah screening app
market_need_then: Muslim investors avoid non-compliant holdings and compliance changes over time; Wahed raised tens of millions by 2020 and 2022 showing paying demand for halal investing. The founder frames the pain as the difficulty of screening funds.
outcome_analysis: Amal Invest remains active with a tiny team and no verified outside funding. The founder has prior fintech exits and the product targets a faith-based niche with clear demand, but no source confirms scale, revenue or a priced round, so the trajectory is unknown rather than good or bad. A one-time fee model suggests a capital-light approach.

name: Anchor
tags: Banking as a Service; Fintech; Payments; B2B; API
one_liner: Embedded finance platform for African businesses
long_description:
Anchor provides APIs, dashboard and tools that help developers easily embed and build banking products. This includes APIs for creating bank accounts, funds transfers, savings products, issuing cards and offering loans.

We also provide regulatory coverage and continuous compliance support to our partners.
regions: Nigeria; Africa; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: African fintechs, SaaS and e-commerce companies that want to embed bank accounts, transfers, cards, savings and lending
problem: Businesses in Nigeria and Africa cannot easily launch financial products because that needs bank partnerships, licenses and compliance. Anchor offers APIs and regulatory coverage through partner banks.
business_model: Banking-as-a-service API with usage and transaction based fees, partner banks provide licensed services
product_category: Embedded finance and banking-as-a-service API
founder_names: Segun Adeyemi; Gbekeloluwa Olufotebi; Olamide Sobowale
market_need_then: Nigerian fintechs and tech businesses needed licensed rails; Anchor reported 30+ signed companies in private beta in May 2022 including the largest telco in Africa, and a stated Nigerian addressable market of at least $7B in 2023.
outcome_analysis: Anchor raised a $1M pre-seed in 2022 and a $2.4M seed in 2023 on the back of early telco and fintech customers. Founders had Nigerian fintech experience at Kuda, Carbon and JUMO, which helped bank partnerships. Competition in Nigerian BaaS was real, and the funding stayed small, so the outcome is still open.

name: Andi
tags: Generative AI; Consumer; API; Search; AI
one_liner: AI Search for the Next Generation
long_description:
Instead of just links, Andi AI gives you answers - like chatting with a smart friend. 

Andi is a new type of search engine that uses generative AI and language models combined with live data to generate factually correct answers to questions, and to explain and summarize information combined from the best sources. 

Andi works as a search chatbot that's ad-free and privacy-focused. Ask Andi to...

✅  Answer questions
🧠  Find, summarize and explain information
🔍  Navigate and search the web

Search is broken because of SEO spam, ads, and surveillance capitalism. Andi cuts through the clutter to get you straight to the knowledge you need. It presents results visually in a way that's easy to understand with a simple chat interface, and protects you from ad tech and distraction.

You can try the search app at https://andisearch.com
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Consumers, especially younger users, who want direct answers instead of ad-filled search results; later a paid search API for AI developers
problem: Web search is cluttered with ads and SEO spam and tracks users. Andi gives conversational, sourced answers that are ad-free and privacy focused.
business_model: Free consumer search with planned paid pro and enterprise subscriptions; later a search API for agents and apps
product_category: Generative AI search engine and search API
market_need_then: Complaints about ad-heavy, spammy search and privacy were widespread in 2022; the TechCrunch article reported about 5,000 users and a demand for ad-free alternatives.
outcome_analysis: Andi raised about $2.5M from YC and angels, got press in 2022 and 2023, and reached roughly 400,000 monthly users around 2024 per MediaPost. Larger rivals copied generative answers after ChatGPT, and the company's current site presents a search API for agents, suggesting a turn toward developers. It remains active.

name: Andson Biotech
tags: Gene Therapy; Hard Tech; Biotech; Healthcare; Therapeutics
one_liner: Empowering Mass Spec for Biotech and Beyond
long_description: Andson Biotech helps pharmaceutical companies measure difficult to detect chemicals that they need to measure while developing and manufacturing drugs like cell-therapies or biologics. Drug companies want to use our technologies to get fast and accurate chemical measurements they do thousands of times per day for drug development and quality control.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Pharmaceutical and biotech labs doing mass spectrometry for biologics and cell and gene therapy development
problem: Sample preparation for mass spectrometry is slow and technically difficult, and hard-to-detect chemicals used in drug manufacturing are hard to measure. Andson sells a microfluidic chip system to speed this up.
business_model: Hardware instrument plus consumable chips sold to labs
product_category: Life science tools, microfluidic sample preparation
market_need_then: Cell and gene therapy and biologics developers needed faster analytics; the company was launched through Georgia Tech with the NSF Engineering Research Center for Cell Manufacturing Technologies.
outcome_analysis: Andson spun out of Georgia Tech research and raised a $3.6M seed in April 2024 and a further $5M reported in October 2025, later than most YC peers, which fits slow hardware sales cycles. It is active with 12 listed staff on YC. The commercial scale is not public.

name: Anfin
one_liner: A multi-asset trading platform dedicated to retail investors
long_description:
Anfin is a modern trading platform that aims to democratize access to financial services and wealth management for Vietnam’s retail investors.

Our mission is to help the underserved retail investor navigate the complexities of investments in Vietnam, from stock market to the underutilized commodity trading.

We are backed by international renowned investors such as YC, Goodwater Capital, Global Founders Capital, and many more.
all_locations: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam; Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
regions: Vietnam; Southeast Asia
target_customer: Beginner and retail investors in Vietnam, later commodities traders
problem: Vietnamese retail investors had limited easy access to stock investing, with high minimums and little social learning. Anfin offers fractional investing from about US$0.5 and in-app communities.
business_model: Brokerage commissions on trading
product_category: Retail trading and wealth app
market_need_then: Vietnamese retail trading accounts were growing fast in 2021 and regional peers like Ajaib and Mynt were unicorns, showing demand for app-based investing.
outcome_analysis: Anfin raised three rounds within about eight months of launch, ending with a $4.8M pre-Series A in June 2022 co-led by YC, and has 40 staff listed. Competition from Finhay and Infina, which raised larger rounds, and Vietnamese regulatory scrutiny of investment apps in 2022 are the risks. No later round found.

name: Anja Health
one_liner: Cord Blood Banking Reimagined
long_description: Helping pregnant parents save the most personal source of stem cells - from their umbilical cord and placenta - to unlock future disease treatments. Offering cord blood banking, cord tissue banking, and placenta stem cell banking.
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Los Angeles, CA, USA; Remote
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Pregnant parents who want to bank cord blood, cord tissue and placenta stem cells
problem: Cord blood banking was costly and opaque. Anja offers a more transparent, doctor backed and cheaper service.
business_model: Direct to consumer collection kit plus annual storage fees, with lab partner Vitalant
product_category: Cord blood and tissue banking, consumer health
market_need_then: Incumbent prices were high, for example first year fees of about 2,470 to 2,625 dollars for Cryo-Cell and CBR on a competitor's page, leaving room for a cheaper, transparent brand.
outcome_analysis: Anja raised a 4.5 million dollar seed in May 2022 led by Seven Seven Six and sold a cheaper, more transparent cord blood service using founder TikTok reach. YC marks it acquired, but no acquirer or date is public, the site is still live in 2026 and a new CEO was named in June 2026, so the structure of the outcome is unclear.

name: Ankr Health
tags: Generative AI; Telehealth; B2B; Digital Health; Telemedicine
one_liner: Virtualizing brick-mortar infrastructures of clinics w/ generative AI
long_description:
Adoption of Telehealth 1.0 has dropped to <5% because it's inefficient and unintelligent. Ankr uses generative AI to recreate functions of clinic staff including front desk, medical assistants and scribe. This allows Doctors to "spin-up" virtual clinics on-demand, anytime, anywhere. 

An average clinic using Ankr generates $1M in new revenue/year.  We integrate with all top EHRs and work with all types of clinics in mid- to large-sized healthcare organizations.
all_locations: Houston, TX, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA; Remote
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Medical practices and specialty clinics, starting with cancer and surgery clinics
problem: Clinics are short of front-desk and clinical support staff, and patients miss follow-up and side effect monitoring. Ankr provides AI and telehealth workflows that act as virtual staff.
business_model: B2B SaaS and services to clinics, pitched as an AI workforce that raises revenue and patient access
product_category: Healthcare AI workflow and patient support platform
market_need_then: In late 2021 the product served 26 clinics and more than 50,000 patients per a Houston Chronicle report cited in a profile, and Ankr won Rice University's Ion Houston startup showcase in November 2021.
outcome_analysis: Ankr is active and has won local startup recognition and attended MedTech Innovator, but no verified funding round, revenue or customer count beyond late 2021 is public. The shift to AI staffing agents suggests the company is adapting to the generative AI wave; its trajectory is unclear.

name: AntWalk
one_liner: An employee up-skilling platform for fast growing companies
long_description:
An up-skilling platform that empowers teams with continuous learning tracks to equip them with the right skills at the right time. 

Our up-skilling programs are customised to business objectives of organisations across sales, customer success, general management, technology & product functions & promote employee development by enhancing their existing competencies and developing newer ones. 

AntWalk is powered by 3000+ Experts from 500+ Global Brands across 40+ Countries to power these courses and 1:1 Interactions.
regions: India; South Asia; Remote; Fully Remote

name: AnythingLLM
one_liner: The open-source AI platform enterprises run on their own hardware
long_description:
AnythingLLM is the open-source AI platform people and enterprises run on hardware they control: laptops, phones, servers, or fully air-gapped networks. It works with any model and any provider, with no lock-in, and your data never has to leave the building.

More than 2.6M people use AnythingLLM every month across Desktop and Docker, and that’s a floor since most users turn telemetry off. It has 56K+ GitHub stars. Most of the tokens generated on AnythingLLM go to on-device or open-source models. People aren’t just trying local AI here, they’re doing real work with it.

That open-source footprint feeds our enterprise business. From small businesses to highly regulated enterprises in government, defense and financial services, teams deploy AnythingLLM where cloud AI isn’t an option. Our enterprise platform adds centralized control of desktop fleets, governance, SSO and SLAs on top of the same app their teams already use.

We work with every major hardware vendor and OEM across PC and mobile. As local AI hardware becomes standard, AnythingLLM is the software layer that makes it useful.

Small models handle small tasks on your device. Big models handle big tasks wherever you choose to run them. You decide where your intelligence lives.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Developers, teams and privacy-conscious users who want to chat with their own documents using local or hosted language models
problem: Running retrieval augmented generation over private documents needed stitching together models, vector databases and interfaces. AnythingLLM packages this as an open-source app.
business_model: Open source (MIT) with a hosted cloud version and enterprise offerings
product_category: Open-source private AI assistant, RAG and agents
market_need_then: In mid 2022 the ChatGPT wave had not started; demand for private document chat surged after late 2022, which explains why the main press and launches (June 2023) came a year after the batch.
outcome_analysis: AnythingLLM grew as an open-source project when interest in private LLM tools surged in 2023, then added a desktop app and hardware partner ports. Funding appears small, about $500K per aggregators, so capital efficiency and developer distribution are the story. Commercial revenue is not public.

name: Apollo
one_liner: Payments & Loyalty Infrastructure
regions: India; South Asia; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Online merchants in India and Southeast Asia who want to accept USDC payments and run NFT loyalty programs
problem: Merchants face high card fees, slow settlement, cross-border fees and chargebacks. BizFirst lets them accept USDC and send invoices; claims of up to 80% lower fees are the company's own.
business_model: Payments fee on crypto transactions plus loyalty tooling, per company claims
product_category: Crypto payments and Web3 loyalty for merchants
market_need_then: A June 2022 survey cited by PYMNTS reported 77% of merchants accepting crypto did so for lower processing fees, but demand among Indian SMBs was unproven in sources found.
outcome_analysis: Apollo launched BizFirst in 2022 during a crypto peak and listed YodaaX as coming soon, but no funding, customers or later news was found in searches. The crypto downturn after 2022 and crowded stablecoin checkout space are context, yet no source states what happened, so the outcome is unknown.

name: Apply Design
tags: Generative AI; SaaS; Computer Vision; Proptech; E-commerce
one_liner: Helping realtors showcase the full potential of their properties
long_description:
Apply Design is a leading AI-powered virtual staging app that empowers real estate professionals to showcase the full potential of their properties to prospective buyers, helping them sell homes faster and for higher prices. 

We virtually stage over 10,000 properties monthly, transforming images of vacant or outdated spaces into fully furnished, captivating property photos. Our proprietary AI-powered software is the only solution capable of generating photorealistic designs in one click while also enabling instant customization of any detail with complete control.

This is a $10B market opportunity, given the 50M properties sold or rented annually in North America and Europe alone.
all_locations: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
regions: Israel; Middle East and North Africa; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Real estate agents, brokerages, photographers and home stagers who need staged listing photos
problem: Photos of vacant or outdated rooms make listings harder to sell, and traditional virtual staging is slow and manual. Apply Design generates furnished, photorealistic listing images with AI.
business_model: Per image fee (site lists about $10.50 per image for full staging and $7 for DIY)
product_category: AI virtual staging for real estate
competitors_at_founding: Zillow; Online real estate marketing agencies
market_need_then: Agents spent on staging and photo editing to sell vacant listings faster. YC page cites 50M properties sold or rented yearly in North America and Europe, a company claim.
outcome_analysis: Apply Design is active and sells AI virtual staging to agents. It raised a reported $3.3M seed in late 2022 and claims more than 10,000 properties staged monthly. Generative AI made the technology easier for rivals to copy, so growth depends on distribution and quality rather than a deep moat. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff reports were found.

name: Aragorn AI
one_liner: Operating system for HR in the AI era
long_description: We’re building a new way of working in People Ops for the AI era—one that starts by solving a painful problem no one talks about: HR data integrations. And from there, it grows into something far more powerful: personalized, agentic HR analysts that any team can create and deploy on their own.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: HR/People Ops teams
problem: HR data is siloed in payroll, benefits, ATS and other systems with brittle integrations; Aragorn unifies it and adds agentic analysts.
business_model: B2B SaaS
product_category: HR data integration and analytics platform
market_need_then: Founders' prior role at YourCause exposed integration pain; press describes reliance on consultants and slow workflows.
outcome_analysis: Aragorn AI joined YC in Summer 2022 and raised a $4.3M seed in October 2025, about three years later, bringing reported total funding to roughly $5.5M. It remains a small active company; the slow timeline suggests capital-efficient but modest early traction.

name: Arc
tags: Banking as a Service; Fintech; B2B; Neobank
one_liner: Banking & Funding for Startups
long_description:
Arc is the cash management and capital markets platform for technology companies. Arc helps businesses manage cash, unlock competitive yield, raise debt capital, and access AI-powered financial services – all in one unified platform.

Founded in 2021, Arc has headquarters in San Francisco and New York City and is backed by investors including Left Lane Capital, NFX, Bain Capital Ventures, Atalaya, Clocktower Technology Ventures, Torch Capital, and Y Combinator. To learn more, visit www.joinarc.com.

Arc is a financial technology company, not a bank. For important information about Arc, see our general disclosures: https://www.joinarc.com/general-disclosures
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Venture-backed software and technology companies that need a bank account, treasury yield and startup-specific credit
problem: Software startups wanted a banking and cash management product built for them, with yield on idle cash and non-dilutive debt that general banks and card companies did not tailor to recurring-revenue businesses.
business_model: Fintech platform: interest and treasury spread, financing fees and software features, with a bank partner holding deposits
product_category: Startup banking, cash management and capital markets platform
market_need_then: Venture-backed software companies held large idle cash balances and wanted yield and non-dilutive financing after the 2021 funding boom. Arc stated it raised 181 million dollars of capital in the 12 months to August 2022, which indicates strong early demand for financing.
outcome_analysis: Arc rode the 2021 startup funding boom by combining a banking account, treasury yield and a large credit facility for software companies, and raised a 20 million dollar Series A in August 2022 led by Left Lane. Without a bank charter it depended on partners, and in July 2026 it agreed to be acquired by Axos Financial, a bank that wanted its software and AI. The price was not disclosed, so whether it was a strong exit is unknown.

name: Argo
tags: Crypto / Web3; Consumer; Entertainment; Social; Infrastructure
one_liner: A social streaming platform powered by creators and fans
long_description: A platform for brands and creator to monetize their video entertainment more efficiently, build an engaged community and reward their fans.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Independent filmmakers and short film viewers; later brands and creators monetizing video
problem: Short films have little distribution and monetization. Argo streams festival-curated shorts, shares revenue with filmmakers and offered NFT collections of films.
business_model: Streaming platform with revenue share to filmmakers, plus NFT sales
product_category: Short film streaming and social platform
market_need_then: Filmmakers lacked monetization for shorts, and the 2021 NFT wave created interest in new film funding models, per the Film Fund blog dated December 2021.
outcome_analysis: Argo joined YC W22 with a reported $500K YC investment and a short film streaming and NFT pitch, then broadened its description to brands and creators. YC lists it Active with ten staff but no jobs. No follow-on funding was verified, and a 2023 Wefunder listing showed a $27M cap SAFE that was marked not funded. The story is unclear and no outcome evidence was found.

name: Argovox
tags: Fintech; Healthcare; LegalTech; Call Center; AI Assistant
one_liner: Voice AI agents for patient billing and collections
long_description:
We help healthcare providers increase profitability and cashflow by automating their patient billing and collections processes.

Today, healthcare providers in the US are leaving up to 20% of their profit margins on the table due to subpar patient billing and collections processes. Billing patients and collecting their payments is a complex process that requires specialized skills and a lot of effort. Traditionally, healthcare providers have done this manually, with limited automation around one-way reminders. This leads to limited engagement with payers and subpar collection results.

Argovox changes this by making new levels of payer engagement possible at scale. Through both voice and text conversations, our AI agents can engage in complex, multi-turn patient billing and collection conversation. This leads higher engagement with payers and optimal collection results.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: US healthcare providers wanting to automate patient billing and collections calls
problem: Providers lose margin to weak patient billing and collections; Argovox used voice and text AI agents for multi-turn billing conversations.
business_model: B2B SaaS for healthcare providers (pricing not found)
product_category: Voice AI for healthcare billing
market_need_then: Providers had large patient balances and manual collections, but no dated 2022 source of demand for voice AI was found.
outcome_analysis: Argovox targeted healthcare billing with voice agents in 2022, ahead of the LLM voice wave, and is now inactive. The cause is not public; a tracker suggests a quiet wind down with the founders turning to Ruffo, but with no funding, traction or post-mortem data a failure cause cannot be assigned.

name: Argument Computer Corporation
one_liner: Accelerate verifiable computing
long_description: Argument combines zero-knowledge cryptography, formal verification and distributed consensus technologies to build systems for unbreakable, scalable, private, decentralized software.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Developers and organizations building zero-knowledge, formally verified and decentralized software
problem: Verifying computation and formal proofs cheaply and privately. Argument builds zero-knowledge tooling around the Lurk language and the Yatima Lean compiler, and now the ix protocol that compresses Lean proofs into small zero-knowledge certificates.
business_model: unclear; open source developer tooling and protocol work
product_category: Zero-knowledge proof and formal verification infrastructure
founder_names: John Burnham; Gabriel Barreto; Samuel Burnham
market_need_then: Crypto rollups and blockchains were funding zero-knowledge proof systems in 2022, with multiple large rounds reported in a 2022 ZK year review.
outcome_analysis: Argument is still listed Active with about eight staff and a protocol focus on compressing Lean proofs into zero-knowledge certificates. Public funding is thin, with an aggregator-reported $500K seed. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff news was found. Its work is research grade, so outcome depends on adoption of its open source tooling, which is not yet evidenced.

name: Arintra
tags: SaaS; Health Tech; Digital Health; Healthcare; Enterprise Software
one_liner: Enterprise-grade AI for revenue assurance
long_description: Arintra is an enterprise AI platform for revenue assurance in healthcare, empowering health systems to get paid accurately, promptly, and fairly. Combining agentic AI with deep clinical expertise, Arintra autonomously codes every chart, explainably, across 23+ specialties and every care setting a health system operates — then cascades that intelligence across the revenue cycle through documentation intelligence (CDI) and denial appeals. Leading enterprise health systems including UC Davis Health, Mercyhealth, Meritus Health, Rochester Regional Health, Reid Health, Mercy Medical Center, and more use Arintra as their centralized, audit-ready revenue cycle platform. Arintra is available in the Epic Toolbox and on the athenahealth Marketplace, is HITRUST e1 certified, and earned a 93/100 with A+ performance rating from KLAS Research.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: US health systems and provider groups that pay coders and fight claim denials
problem: Medical chart coding is manual, slow and error prone, driving denials and lost revenue. Arintra uses AI to code charts autonomously and writes codes back into the EHR.
business_model: Enterprise SaaS for health systems, revenue assurance platform
product_category: Healthcare AI, autonomous medical coding and revenue cycle
market_need_then: Coder shortages and claim denials strained provider revenue cycles. Autonomous coding vendors attracted investment from 2021 onward.
outcome_analysis: Arintra raised a $21M Series A in August 2025 led by Peak XV and a $25M Series B in August 2026 led by Define Ventures, with health system customers named on its site. Its path fits an enterprise AI play with real integrations and credentials. The seed amount is not public, and several funded rivals compete for the same wedge.

name: Armilla AI
one_liner: Liability insurance for generative AI and AI Agents
long_description: Armilla AI (YC W22) is the first YC-backed MGA and Lloyd's Coverholder dedicated to insuring AI-related risks. Armilla's insurance policies cover developers and deployers of generative AI and AI agents for performance and liability -- from errors and hallucinations, to incorrect decisions, data leakage, regulatory violations and more.
regions: Canada; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: AI developers, vendors and enterprises deploying AI, reached through insurance brokers
problem: Companies deploying AI models lack independent assurance and insurance for model errors and AI failures. Armilla started with AI model assessment and performance warranties and moved to affirmative AI liability insurance as a Lloyd's coverholder.
business_model: Insurance MGA and coverholder earning premiums and fees, plus AI assessment and warranty products
product_category: AI risk assurance and AI liability insurance
market_need_then: In 2022 AI governance tools were emerging, and silent AI exposure in existing policies was a later concern; demand for insurance grew with generative AI after 2023.
outcome_analysis: Armilla raised a $4.5M seed in early 2024 and by 2025 launched AI liability insurance with Chaucer, adding a $25M capacity expansion in January 2026. Insurer partners backed it rather than competing. It stayed small on equity funding but built a regulated distribution position as generative AI created insurance demand.

name: Arpari
tags: Fintech; SaaS; Real Estate; Payments; Neobank
one_liner: Multibank treasury management
long_description: Treasury management platform built for multibank finance teams. Seamlessly consolidate company finances, manage payments and financial operations from a single dashboard.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Finance teams with many bank accounts across multiple banks, especially real estate and multi-entity holding companies
problem: Teams with hundreds of accounts across 10+ banks track them in spreadsheets and log into separate portals. Arpari gives one dashboard for balances, payments and reporting.
business_model: B2B SaaS treasury management platform
product_category: Multibank treasury management software
market_need_then: YC launch post says incumbent treasury software prices bank by bank, which does not fit teams with hundreds of accounts at 10+ banks.
outcome_analysis: Arpari reportedly raised a roughly $4M seed in 2024 and sells a multibank treasury platform to real estate and multi-entity finance teams, with 11 customer logos on its site. It is small and active, with no exit or distress reports found. Its slow path suggests integration heavy product work before 2024 growth.

name: Array Labs
one_liner: We're building satellites to create a real-time 3D map of the world.
long_description:
We're designing swarms of tiny satellites which will work together to create the first real-time, high-resolution 3D model of the earth. 

By using clusters of satellites to image the same place on the earth at the exact same time, we can improve image quality by more than 60x over conventional techniques. 

This technology will massively increase the amount of affordable, high-quality 3D data, enabling a host of new applications across an array of industries, including AR/XR/Autonomy, Defense, Climate/ESG, and Insurance Analytics.
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Defense, intelligence, mining, infrastructure, insurance and AR and autonomy customers needing 3D Earth data
problem: Accurate 3D data of the Earth is expensive to collect. Array Labs flies clusters of small radar satellites in formation to build high-resolution 3D models.
business_model: Radar satellite data and capacity contracts, plus radar sensors and elevation datasets
product_category: Space radar and 3D earth observation
market_need_then: Defense and commercial buyers were funding SAR constellations, with NRO awarding commercial SAR contracts to five companies in 2022. The launch post says accurate 3D data is expensive to collect.
outcome_analysis: Array Labs raised a $5M seed in October 2022, a $20M Series A in January 2026 led by Catapult, and reported a $21M strategic round anchored by Mitsubishi Electric in mid-2026. It has multi-year capacity contracts and government work, but its first formation-flying launch has slipped to mid-2027 per Aviation Week. Outcome depends on a hardware launch and defense demand.

name: Artemis Search
tags: Machine Learning; SaaS; B2B; Search; AI
one_liner: A search technology that actually finds what you’re looking for.
long_description:
Artemis Search is a vector database search with a twist. We use special-purpose deep-learning models instead of using textual / semantic similarity to evaluate how good a search result is.

This enables us to actually reason how well search results match the intent of the search query, eliminating the problems that come from evaluating search results on how much they look like the search query.
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; Rochester, MN, USA; Remote
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Originally developers needing better search; the current site targets sales and business development teams prospecting on LinkedIn
problem: Search that ranks by true result quality rather than text or semantic similarity. The current product is AI research agents that find decision makers.

name: Attain
tags: Marketplace; SaaS; B2B; Supply Chain; Food Tech
one_liner: One-Stop Shop for Convenience Store Inventory
long_description:
Attain is a one-stop shop for convenience store owners to buy inventory across all their suppliers with higher reliability, price transparency, and product discovery.

On average, store owners buy products from over 10-15 different suppliers each week. This painful process involves shopping in massive warehouses or spending hours working with wholesaler’s sales representatives (who sometimes don’t even show up). As a result, stores waste countless hours ordering products through extremely inefficient and tedious processes. These store owners are also severely impacted by inventory shortages and revenue loss which many times results in them downsizing their business or shutting them down completely.

Attain solves this problem by providing a single app to purchase products across all of their suppliers, resulting in a one-stop shop for inventory. By aggregating inventory across a multitude of suppliers and wholesalers, Attain helps stores save significant time and money while allowing them to focus on what they do best - growing their businesses.

Feel free to reach out at founders@joinattain.com!
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Food distributors and wholesalers (who pay for the platform) and the convenience store owners who order from them

business_model: B2B SaaS and marketplace for distributors: branded ordering portal, invoicing and payments
product_category: Wholesale ordering software for convenience retail
market_need_then: YC description says store owners spend hours ordering across 10 to 15 suppliers and lose revenue to stockouts; the company page says convenience stores buy from distributors by paper invoice and phone. No independent dated demand data found.
outcome_analysis: Attain started as a marketplace letting convenience stores order from many suppliers and now sells distributors a branded ordering, invoicing and payments portal, with an iOS app in the store. Only a pre-seed record tied to YC and Soma Capital is public and nothing indicates shutdown or exit. With so little public information the company's trajectory cannot be judged.

name: Aurelian
one_liner: Automating non-emergency calls for 911 centers
long_description:
Aurelian builds AI tools that help 911 centers handle more with less, so telecommunicators can stay focused on what matters most and communities get the response they need.

AVA is a conversational AI agent that answers non-emergency calls; the agent routes, triages, and resolves the calls without any human intervention. By handling administrative calls like noise complaints, lost dogs, and parking inquiries, AVA eliminates hold times and lets call-takers focus their energy on actual emergencies.

CORA supports call-takers on the calls that matter most. CORA is an on-screen assistant that delivers real-time SOP checklists, smart reminders, and contextual guidance as an emergency call unfolds, so dispatchers stay calm, consistent, and confident when every second counts. When AVA detects an emergency mid-call, it transfers the caller to a telecommunicator and passes along the caller details, location, incident type, and key statements directly into CORA. The call-taker never starts from scratch.

The problem we're solving is serious. The average emergency communications center is 30% understaffed nationwide. Staffing shortages drive burnout and attrition, which makes the shortage worse. Meanwhile, 60-80% of the calls coming in aren't even emergencies at all. Aurelian addresses both sides of that equation: AVA reduces unnecessary call volume, and CORA makes every emergency call more manageable for the people handling it.


Aurelian is live in centers across the country, answering thousands of non-emergency calls every day, and is backed by New Enterprise Associates and Y Combinator. Aurelian is growing rapidly; we are hiring people who want to help scale this work and make a real difference in public safety infrastructure for communities across the country.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: County and city 911 emergency communications centers (PSAPs) in the US
problem: 911 centers are about 30 percent understaffed while 60 to 80 percent of incoming calls are non-emergencies, leaving dispatchers overloaded.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to public safety agencies (AI call agent AVA and call-taker copilot CORA)
product_category: Voice AI for public safety
market_need_then: At the 2022 batch the company sold salon booking, so 911 need evidence comes from later: a client's parking lot complaint led the CEO to 911 centers; the press release cites 30 percent understaffing nationally.
outcome_analysis: Aurelian entered YC as a salon booking tool, pivoted within a year to answering non-emergency 911 calls, launched in May 2024, and by August 2025 was live in over a dozen centers when it raised a 14 million dollar Series A led by NEA. The wedge is a staffing shortage with measurable call volume savings, with later entrants like Hyper and Prepared now competing. It is active and growing with 45 people.

name: BBy
one_liner: BBy powders breast milk that's immunologically active & lasts 6 months
long_description: BBy's condensing device turns milk into a fine powder that spares the biome leaving it biologically and immunologically active. This allows  hospitals to stop wasting precious nursing time defrosting milk for hours and milk wastage from discarding rules. Simply weigh the powder, add water, shake and serve. No more freezing, no more defrosting, only patient care. NICUs are time sensitive wards in the hospital, time is everything and yet nurses today continue to prepare frozen milk for infants in what's known as the milk shift. A shift where the nurse spends the day defrosting milk for the next shift of nurses. Our tech is now fully peer reviewed and published, yielding safe and reliable results in over 20 hospitals in the New York Tri-State. The company is headed by Vansh Langer MD, a physician (Windsor University, University of Chicago) and Blanca Aguilar Uscanga PhD, a Bioengineering/Food Science PhD (University of Guadalajara /Centro Universitario de Ciencias Exactas e Ingenierías (CUCEI)) team that has over 50 published works in the field between them and are experts in the science of infant nutrition. Vansh saw the immense need for a time critical solution in the NICU and helped solve the puzzle with Dra. Blanca and her team and decided to work together to: Nurture the Future.

name: Ballerine
one_liner: Agentic Intelligence Layer for Merchant Risk Decisions
long_description:
Ballerine is an AI-native risk intelligence platform built for financial institutions, acquirers, and payment providers that need to underwrite and monitor merchants at scale in real time.

Instead of relying on fragmented point solutions, Ballerine unifies data from business registries, transaction patterns, sanctions lists, and web intelligence into one composable infrastructure. 

Its AI Agents continuously analyze these signals to deliver dynamic and explainable risk assessments across the merchant lifecycle.
With a modular architecture, teams can automate underwriting, detect emerging risks, and monitor merchant behavior while aligning to their own policies and compliance frameworks.

Unlike traditional systems with static models, Ballerine’s AI Agents learn and adapt from live data, uncovering changes in merchant behavior that indicate fraud, laundering, or non-compliance.

Already deployed across multiple regions, Ballerine has enabled acquirers and fintechs to accelerate underwriting decisions, reduce manual reviews, and cut false positives, redefining how modern institutions manage merchant risk.

outcome_analysis: Ballerine raised a $5M seed led by Team8 in May 2023 and now lists clients such as DBS Bank, Bybit and EBANX with offices in Tel Aviv, Palo Alto and Singapore. Open source gave early developer adoption, then it shifted to AI agents for merchant risk aimed at acquirers. name: Better Opinions
one_liner: Prediction market of India
long_description:
