It raised a small pre-seed as Payourse in December 2021 and went through YC in Winter 2022. Public funding after YC is not confirmed, so its trajectory is unclear. The company claims 200,000 monthly transactions and well known wallet customers, which suggests real usage, but these are unverified self reported numbers.

name: Pasito
one_liner: AI agents for insurance and benefits
long_description:
Pasito builds AI agents for insurance and benefits—transforming how benefits are built, delivered, and experienced.

Our Core AI ingests and understands plan documents and employee census data to build structured benefit intelligence.

Our Engagement AI Agents orchestrate complex workflows—powering decision support, plan comparisons, guides, highlight sheets, microsites, communications, claims reminders, RFP management, document audits, translations, and more—all from a single intelligent database.

With Pasito, carriers, brokers, and benefits vendors eliminate manual work, accelerate growth, and deliver the personalized benefits experiences employees deserve—all powered by compliant, scalable AI systems.

Backed by Y Combinator, Core Innovation Capital, and other leading investors.
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Benefits consultants and brokers, insurance carriers and employers (originally employees through their employers)
problem: Employees overspend on and underuse health and voluntary benefits, and benefits teams drown in manual document and data work. Pasito started on the employee side and now sells AI agents to the benefits industry.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to brokers, carriers and employers
product_category: AI benefits and insurance workflow software
market_need_then: Employers spend heavily on benefits and employees often pick poorly. The 2022 launch pitched savings on healthcare and payroll costs for both sides.
outcome_analysis: Pasito raised a $3.25M seed in October 2022 after YC, then repositioned toward AI agents for benefits brokers and carriers. In February 2026 it raised a $21M Series A led by Insight Partners. The company claims thousands of employers use it and names large brokers as customers. The shift to selling to the benefits industry plus the AI timing appears to have unlocked the larger round, though those usage figures are self reported.

name: PayCaddy
tags: Banking as a Service; Fintech; B2B
one_liner: Simplified Banking as a Service for Latam
long_description: PayCaddy enables Latam companies to launch financial products with an API based platform. Rather than building fintech from scratch, or dealing with a legacy bank, companies can use PayCaddy to open digital wallets with KYC checks, automate online payments, and issue personalized debit and prepaid cards for customers or employees.
regions: Panama; Latin America; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Latin American companies and fintechs that want to launch wallets, cards and payments without building a bank stack
problem: Launching fintech products in Latin America means building from scratch or working with a legacy bank. PayCaddy offers an API with KYC, wallets, payment automation and debit and prepaid card issuing.
business_model: B2B banking as a service API with usage and issuing fees
product_category: banking as a service and card issuing for Latin America
market_need_then: Latin American fintechs wanted fast card and wallet launches. Pomelo's CEO said a simple prepaid card took 12 to 18 months to launch locally, and PayCaddy pitched speed.
outcome_analysis: PayCaddy remains active in Panama as a supervised e-money issuer and says it helps Latin American companies launch cards and wallets. Press from January 2022 followed the YC announcement. Funding is poorly documented: one aggregator lists a $2M seed, and the CEO has said early money came from family offices. Without confirmed rounds it is hard to say whether growth is strong or constrained.

name: PayCrunch
one_liner: Credit Card for college students based on UPI.
long_description: More than 150 million people in India are not able to access formal Credits in India either because of lack of financial data or low credit scores. We use Alternative Credit scoring models to provide a Pay Later option on UPI to a wider audience.
regions: India; South Asia; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Indian college students and others without formal credit history
problem: Over 150 million Indians lack access to formal credit; PayCrunch offers a UPI-based pay-later credit line scored on alternative data.
business_model: consumer credit line (interest/fees via lending partners; details not found)
product_category: Consumer fintech / UPI credit
market_need_then: YourStory (Feb 2022) describes students with no credit access and a UPI credit line as the first of its kind; no usage data verified.
outcome_analysis: PayCrunch launched a UPI credit line for students in 2022 and is listed Active, but no verified funding beyond aggregator reports, no later news and no traction figures were found. It competed with larger BNPL players, so any outcome statement would be speculation.

name: Payfura

one_liner: Global payment gateway to buy/sell crypto

Payfura is a fiat<>crypto on/off ramp payment gateway for web3 applications. We are a bridge between fiat and crypto so web3 applications can seamlessly onboard users across different geographies with local payment methods.

Key Features:
- Currencies supported: 150+ fiat currencies, 100+ crypto currencies.
- Regions supported: US, Europe, LATAM, SEA, Africa.
- Payment methods: Credit/Debit cards, E-wallets, Bank transfers and many more.
- Partner Dashboard: A powerful dashboard for partners to get detailed insights and analytics for their orders
- Handle KYC and AML compliances of local regions.
- API and SDK integration.
all_locations: Delaware City, DE, USA; Delhi, DL, India; Remote
regions: United States of America; India; America / Canada; South Asia; Remote; Fully Remote

name: Payload
one_liner: Developer-First Headless CMS and Application Framework
long_description:
Payload is a developer-first headless CMS and application framework built to finally give developers a better choice in the world of CMS. From documentation to design, Payload is crafted from the ground-up to save engineers time and effort while building the backend and admin panel for websites, native apps, ecommerce, SaaS, and any other product that needs to manage content. Payload is changing the CMS status quo—working to give developers the tools they want to build the CMS they need, all in clean and well-structured code.

Learn more at https://payloadcms.com.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Developers and agencies building websites, apps and SaaS backends who want a code-first headless CMS they own
problem: Existing headless CMS products were GUI-driven or hosted-only, forcing developers to work around them instead of using clean code and their own database.
business_model: Open source core (MIT) with paid Payload Cloud hosting and enterprise features
product_category: Headless CMS and application framework
founder_names: James Mikrut; Elliot DeNolf; Dan Ribbens
market_need_then: Developers complained about GUI-first CMS tools and the shift to Next.js and TypeScript raised demand for code-defined content backends; no dated metrics found for 2022.
outcome_analysis: Payload grew as an open source, TypeScript-first CMS built by three founders in Grand Rapids, raised a 4.7 million dollar seed in November 2022 led by Gradient Ventures and was acquired by Figma in June 2025. Its community, developer focus and the Next.js shift made it attractive to Figma as a content backend; price was not disclosed.

name: PeakPath
one_liner: Smartwatch powered coaching to improve teams sustainable performance
long_description: PeakPath is a service that helps enterprises improve team performance and employee retention. We pair each employee with an online coach and use smart watch data to improve their physical and mental health.
regions: Sweden; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Peakflo
one_liner: Agentic workflows that automate your back‑office operations
long_description:
Peakflo, with its Agentic Workflows and one-click ERP integrations, helps finance teams eliminate manual work across the entire invoice-to-cash, procure-to-pay, travel and expense reimbursement, and operations. 100+ businesses—from scale-ups to enterprises, use Peakflo each to:

✅ Save 1000 man-hours/month on finance ops
✅ Get paid faster on customer invoices by 15-25 days
✅ Cut vendor bill payment time by 50%
✅ Automate three-way matching
regions: Singapore; Southeast Asia; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Finance teams at small and mid sized companies in Southeast Asia and beyond
problem: Finance teams chase invoices and pay vendors through manual work. Peakflo automates accounts receivable, accounts payable and expenses with ERP integrations, and now uses agentic workflows.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with payment fees
product_category: AP and AR automation software
market_need_then: Southeast Asian small and mid sized businesses relied on manual invoicing and cash collection, and the seed coverage described slow collection as the core pain.
outcome_analysis: Peakflo is active with about 45 staff and claims 100 plus business customers across Southeast Asia and India. It raised a $4.1M seed in July 2022 and no later round was found in public sources. It has shifted toward AI agent positioning in 2025. Whether it has raised an A round is unknown, so its growth is uncertain, though its customer list suggests real traction.

name: Pelm
one_liner: Plaid for utilities
long_description: Pelm is building an API that allows companies to access their user's energy data from utilities. Using Pelm, you can query hourly electricity usage or transfer service for a specific property. Instead of building clunky integrations with hundreds of utilities across the U.S., you only need to integrate with one seamless API to start harnessing energy data. Our platform will provide the infrastructure for a whole new wave of climate focused technology companies to flourish. As sustainability-oriented efforts like automated demand response, home electrification, or solar installations (to name a few) become more popular, they will need certain tools to succeed. We at Pelm hope our universal API will help our world reduce carbon emissions, meet climate goals, and create a more sustainable life for everyone.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Penguin AI
one_liner: AI Sales Rep for Website Intent Signals
long_description: Penguin AI help B2B companies identify the exact PEOPLE and companies visiting their site and auto-sequences them in a personalized way; book more demos without scaling headcount.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada

name: Peoplebox.ai
tags: SaaS; B2B; Recruiting; HR Tech; AI
one_liner: AI talent platform to hire, manage, and grow your people
long_description:
Peoplebox.ai is an AI-native talent platform used by 500+ companies to hire, manage, and grow their people.

At the center is Nova, the world’s most human-like AI Recruiter. Nova screens candidates over chat, text, call, or video, before they even apply, then seamlessly screens resumes, takes pre-screening calls, and runs first-round interviews with live assessments and advanced proctoring.

The talent management platform brings together OKRs/goals, performance reviews, career growth, 360 feedback, calibration, and compensation into one unified system, helping companies align, assess, and develop talent faster.
regions: India; South Asia
target_customer: Mid sized and growing companies buying OKR, performance and now AI hiring tools (HR and talent teams)
problem: Companies struggle to align teams on goals and run performance reviews. Peoplebox began as an OKR and performance platform and now sells an AI recruiter, Nova, plus talent management.
business_model: B2B SaaS per user subscription
product_category: OKR, performance management and AI recruiting software
market_need_then: Remote and hybrid teams needed goal alignment tooling. Peoplebox's October 2022 coverage listed customers such as Razorpay, Postman, Exotel and Khatabook.
outcome_analysis: Peoplebox is active with about 75 staff and claims 500 to 600 customers. It reinvented itself in 2025 around the Nova AI recruiter, riding the AI hiring wave. Public funding is thin: a Nexus investment in 2019 and a YC investment reported in October 2022, with no sourced amounts. Growth appears real but its capital history is unclear.

name: Perl Street
one_liner: Financing the next-generation of infrastructure projects
long_description:
Perl Street is democratizing structured finance through our platform, unlocking billions in financing for sustainable infrastructure and next-generation hardware technologies. 

Perl Street has already helped multiple hardware startups receive over $140M in debt financing offers from some of the world’s most reputable institutions.

Climate change is a massive hardware problem. According to IEA estimates - reaching net zero emissions would require over $4 trillion per year in global clean energy investment. 

This means we need to upgrade nearly everything with new hardware - from energy storage devices to electric vehicles, charging stations and building electrification. 

The future of infrastructure is both distributed and resilient. And none of it is possible without financing new hardware.
all_locations: Sydney, NSW, Australia; Austin, TX, USA; Remote
regions: Australia; United States of America; Oceania; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Hardware startups and developers of distributed energy and infrastructure projects that need debt and structured finance
problem: Climate hardware companies struggle to access project financing. Perl Street originates and structures financing and has built software to track and finance distributed energy assets.
business_model: Financing origination fees and B2B software subscriptions
product_category: climate infrastructure finance platform
market_need_then: The YC description cites IEA estimates that net zero needs over $4 trillion of clean energy investment a year, and claims hardware startups received over $140M in debt financing offers through Perl Street.
outcome_analysis: Perl Street is active with a tiny team and claims 60 plus customers and 14 GW of clean energy investment supported. A July 2023 press release shows a financing deal with The Energy Coalition. No verifiable funding rounds were found, so its progress cannot be compared with other YC companies, and the company claims are self reported.

name: PermitFlow
one_liner: Construction's AI Platform
long_description: Intuitive AI platform that helps general contractors and developers manage their preconstruction process
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: General contractors, home service contractors, builders and developers who file building permits
problem: Construction permitting is slow and bureaucratic, with different rules in each jurisdiction. PermitFlow automates permit research, filing and tracking, and now uses AI agents; the early pitch was a TurboTax for permitting.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription plus services
product_category: construction permitting software
market_need_then: Permit delays add cost to every construction project. Accel's post describes regulation as a drag on building pace, and TechCrunch (February 2024) framed PermitFlow as a TurboTax for construction permitting.
outcome_analysis: PermitFlow is a standout of its batch, raising a $5.5M seed in 2023, a roughly $31M Series A led by Kleiner Perkins in February 2024 and a $54M Series B led by Accel in December 2025. Accel reports revenue grew over four times in the year before. Its edge looks like focused workflow automation and growing jurisdiction data in a hated process, helped by AI tailwinds. The company has about 80 staff.

name: Phase Biolabs
one_liner: We make carbon negative chemicals from CO2 using fermentation
long_description:
Phase Biolabs makes carbon negative solvents and electro-fuels from carbon dioxide (CO2) using fermentation.

You can read more about what we are building in our Hacker News article: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=30557288

Phase Biolabs is also supported by Bill Gate's Breakthrough Energy Foundation via their Innovator Fellowship program.
regions: United Kingdom; Europe
target_customer: Industrial CO2 emitters (the technology is sold to them) and buyers of low carbon solvents in pharma, cosmetics and paint
problem: Carbon dioxide emissions are waste, while chemicals and fuels are made from fossil carbon. Phase engineers acetogen microbes to turn CO2 and hydrogen into ethanol and other chemicals.
business_model: technology licensing and sale of units to CO2 emitters, plus chemical sales
product_category: CO2 gas fermentation biomanufacturing
market_need_then: Corporate and policy pressure to cut emissions, with Breakthrough Energy supporting climate hardware founders through its Innovator Fellowship, per the YC description.
outcome_analysis: Phase Biolabs is active as a small University of Nottingham spinout. It won a UK government feasibility grant in 2020, joined YC in Winter 2022 and was supported by the Breakthrough Energy fellowship. No priced venture round was verified. As a research grade climate biotech it needs years and capital to reach pilot scale, so the lack of public follow on funding says little yet about success or failure.

name: Phind

We’re uniquely able to build one because we’re already working with big utilities on a fulfillment platform: a 1000'-tall underground warehouse for hydrogen.

name: Pigeon
one_liner: Simplifying loans with your friends & family.
long_description:
Pigeon is a relationship based technology platform that facilitates the creation and management of loans between friends, family, loved ones, and anyone who trusts one another.

By providing smarter ways for people to mix money with their relationships, Pigeon seeks to empower individuals to borrow and lend money with the people they trust.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote

name: Pina Earth
one_liner: Unlocking carbon markets for European forest owners
long_description:
Pina Earth is building a suite of digital tools for data collection, monitoring, and certification of forest carbon projects. EU forests are at high risk due to climate change. With Pina Earth, forest owners can start high-quality carbon projects on their properties and use the new income stream to prepare their forests for a changing climate. 

Pina Earth and Tree.ly recently joined forces to create Europe's leading forest carbon platform: https://tech.eu/2025/07/29/pina-earth-and-treely-merge-to-create-europes-largest-forest-carbon-platform/
regions: Germany; Europe
target_customer: European forest owners earning carbon credit income and companies buying forest carbon credits
problem: Small European forest owners could not afford the monitoring and certification needed to sell carbon credits, while forests were at risk from climate change.
business_model: Carbon project developer taking a share of credit sales, supported by monitoring and simulation software
product_category: Forest carbon project development and monitoring
founder_names: Gesa Biermann; Florian Fincke; Jonas Kerber
market_need_then: Corporate demand for credible European credits and forest damage from climate change created need; TechCrunch coverage in February 2022 described carbon credits for forest improvement as emerging.
outcome_analysis: Pina Earth raised about 2.5 million dollars in July 2022 and grew into Germany's leading forest carbon project developer with 100 plus corporate buyers. In July 2025 it merged with Austria's Tree.ly under the Pina Earth brand, with Tree.ly's founders leading and the Pina founders moving to advisory roles, which looks more like a consolidation than a clear win; terms are not public.

name: Ping
one_liner: The global neo-bank for contractors and freelancers
long_description: Ping enables international contractors and freelancers to have access to a personal Dollar account in the US, a crypto account, and generate invoices to get paid.  With Ping, workers make on average 4% more money and get paid the same day.
all_locations: Buenos Aires, CABA, Argentina; Miami, FL, USA; Remote
regions: Argentina; United States of America; Latin America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: International contractors and freelancers, mainly in Latin America, paid by foreign clients
problem: Remote workers stitch together three or more platforms to get paid by foreign contractors and convert funds to local currency, which is slow and costly.
business_model: Neobank fees, with a paid professional tier
product_category: Freelancer neobank and cross-border payments
founder_names: Mary Saracco; Pablo Orlando; Jack Saracco
market_need_then: Latin American freelancers paid in USD face fees and delays; the launch post describes workers using three or more platforms to get paid. The company reports 4% higher pay and same day payment.
outcome_analysis: Ping raised a $15M seed in November 2022, large for a YC company, backed by crypto and fintech investors. Founders with Latamex and banking backgrounds fit the LatAm freelancer payments niche. No later round, exit or shutdown was found, and the team stayed near 20 people, so it has neither clearly scaled nor stalled in public sources.

name: Pivo Technology Inc
tags: Fintech; Payments; B2B; Supply Chain; Neobank
one_liner: Digital Bank for Freight Carriers in Africa.
long_description:
Africa has experienced robust macroeconomic growth over the last five years and was the second fastest growing region in 2019 with a GDP of $2.6T, a 3.7% increase on 2018. Nigeria makes up $0.5T, 50% of which comes from Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) – a huge number of these operate within large manufacturing supply chains.

Starting with Freight Carriers Pivo makes financial services easily accessible for truck owners and truck drivers by providing a bank account, debit card and digital invoicing tools so they can get paid faster and avoid cash flow problems.

This will be further augmented by more fundamental financial products such as credit, transaction management, and expense management, to improve their cashflow.
regions: Nigeria; Africa; Remote; Partly Remote

The long description now stresses stablecoins and AI invoicing, which suggests product evolution, but no dated source confirms a pivot.

name: Pluralith
one_liner: Automated infrastructure compliance and documentation
long_description:
Pluralith automates compliance by documenting cloud infrastructure directly from the codebase. Companies like Jefferson Health pay us to automate their infrastructure compliance and save 5h a week per infrastructure engineer.

More simply put: We generate infrastructure diagrams directly from Terraform state.
all_locations: Vienna, Vienna, Austria; New York, NY, USA
regions: Austria; United States of America; Europe; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: DevOps and platform engineers using Terraform, in regulated companies
problem: Infrastructure documentation and diagrams go stale; teams spend hours hand drawing diagrams for compliance.
business_model: Open source CLI plus paid CI and dashboard plan, listed at $250 per month for 500 CI runs
product_category: Developer tools, infrastructure visualization and compliance
market_need_then: Compliance and audit teams need current infrastructure diagrams; the company claims customers save 5 hours a week per engineer, naming Jefferson Health, but the claim is not independently verified.
outcome_analysis: Pluralith is a two person team with an open source CLI and a paid CI plan. The only funding signal is a small YC pre-seed from aggregators. No later round, customers beyond one named logo, or exit was found, and the site looks unchanged since 2023, so the story is a stalled or quiet developer tool with a copyable product.

name: Pluto.markets
one_liner: Modern Investment Product for 100m underserved Europeans
long_description:
Technology is a massive enabler for stock market participation. This was the case when the phone, the internet and apps were invented granting access for more people.

For 100m Europeans living in countries without the Euro however, there has been no innovation for the past 30 years. High commissions, clunky interface, high minimum amounts and a brand that speaks to the few.

We are on a mission to drive financial inclusion by bridging the innovation gap for the overlooked regions of the EU.
regions: Denmark; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Retail investors in Denmark first, then non-euro EU countries
problem: Investors outside the euro area faced high commissions, clunky interfaces and high minimums from brokers.
business_model: Brokerage commission (0.03% above a monthly free threshold per its site) and crypto trading fees
product_category: Neo-broker, commission-light investing app
market_need_then: The YC page cites 100 million Europeans in non-euro countries underserved by high commissions and clunky brokers. Later press reports 10,000+ users in Denmark by early 2026 and the company site claims 20,000 users.
outcome_analysis: Pluto.markets spent roughly three years on licensing before launching in Denmark in November 2024, funded by a 2024 seed and a 2026 seed. Founders with trading backgrounds from Goldman Sachs and Danske Bank fit the product. It is active and growing in a crowded neo-broker field, with the license serving as its main structural advantage.

name: Plutto
tags: Fintech; Identity; Latin America; Enterprise Software
one_liner: Supply-chain risk management and compliance platform for Latin…
long_description: Plutto is a supply-chain risk management and compliance platform for Latin America. We automate due diligence, compliance checks, and conflict-of-interest reviews—helping corporates across LatAm work with vendors and contractors safely.
regions: Chile; Latin America; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Latin American corporates (retail, energy, mining, construction) vetting suppliers, clients and contractors
problem: Companies in Latin America do slow, manual due diligence on vendors and miss conflicts of interest and compliance risks.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for KYB and third-party risk management
product_category: KYB, compliance and supply-chain risk
founder_names: Antonia San Martin; Felipe Dominguez; Ignacio Marquez; Sebastian
market_need_then: Chile and Latin America had rising compliance expectations and anti-corruption rules; Plutto's site lists large clients such as Entel, Falabella and Arauco and claims 590,000+ entities evaluated.
outcome_analysis: Plutto pivoted from a travel startup into business verification and joined YC in 2022, raising about $500K. Its site now lists large Chilean corporates and 100+ customers, with a 20 person team. No later round or exit was found, so it looks like a steady regional B2B SaaS business with a sales driven motion and strong local competition from MetaMap and Truora.

name: Poko
tags: Developer Tools; Crypto / Web3; Payments; Gaming; Creator Economy
one_liner: Seamless Fiat Payments for Web3
long_description: Poko enables seamless transfers from local payment rails to web3 infrastructure enabling web3 wallets, marketplaces, games and DApps to acquire more users. With Poko’s SDK, web3 builders can easily enable fiat-to-crypto onramping with 100+ common local payment methods or easily pay for NFTs with local payment methods. Poko's fiat-to-cryptoonramp aggregator reduces onramping costs by up to 70% and increases transaction success rates by up to 5x through a smart routing logic and a single integration to multiple onramps. It's Direct Checkout solution enables one step purchasing from fiat payment rails from any smart contract for 79% higher user conversion. The co-founders’ experience includes being chief strategy officer of a $2.4B coincap protocol, leading technical implementation of Singapore’s central bank’s experiment in cross-border payments on blockchain rails, policy experience as payments task force member at the World Economic Forum, ex-Ethereum Foundation Fellow, and CTO of a 2M+ user play to earn game.
regions: Singapore; Southeast Asia; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Web3 wallets, marketplaces, games and dApps in emerging markets needing fiat onramps
problem: Web3 apps lose users because local payment methods are not supported by fiat-to-crypto onramps, and onramp costs and failure rates are high.
business_model: SDK and aggregator with transaction fees on onramp volume
product_category: Crypto payments infrastructure, fiat onramp aggregator
founder_names: Geoffrey See; Van Tran; Sean Ang
market_need_then: Web3 builders needed fiat onramps; the company claims up to 70% lower onramp costs and 5x higher transaction success. Demand during the 2022 to 2023 crypto downturn weakened.
outcome_analysis: Poko raised a $4.5M seed in June 2023 during a crypto downturn, with YC and regional investors, led by founders with Zilliqa and Netflix experience. Its aggregator sits in a crowded onramp market. Status is unclear: CB Insights reports an acquisition by Torus Labs on 13 October 2023, but the YC directory still lists it as active.

name: PolicyFly
one_liner: Modernizing Specialty Insurance
long_description:
PolicyFly empowers insurers to sell and manage specialty insurance in minutes instead of in weeks.

Every year, $200B of specialty insurance like Cyber, Flood or Trucking is processed over email between agents and insurers – PolicyFly connects both parties to automate these workflows and to consolidate all data. 

We bring growth, efficiency and transparency to otherwise hard to insure markets.
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Specialty insurers, MGAs, coverholders, carriers and syndicates
problem: About $200B of specialty insurance (cyber, flood, trucking) is processed by email between agents and insurers, with no consolidated data.
business_model: B2B SaaS for submission intake, underwriting and policy management
product_category: Insurtech software for specialty insurance distribution
founder_names: Cory Crosland; Marcel Esser; Michael Fiedel
market_need_then: The YC page and company site describe specialty insurance running over email at roughly $200B a year; no independent spend data opened.
outcome_analysis: PolicyFly began as a product studio building custom platforms for insurers, then productized that into submission and policy software, joining YC in Winter 2022 with about 30 staff by directory data. A reported $7M seed from Bain Capital Ventures in July 2024 suggests continued investor interest, and no shutdown or acquisition was found.

name: Poly
one_liner: Intelligent Personal Cloud Storage
long_description: A personal cloud storage platform that's so good, it'll replace Finder / File Explorer on your desktop. Find anything with multi-modal, natural language search. Browse with a lightning fast interface that feels just like native. Organize, tag, view, edit, share, and more.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Individuals and creators with large personal file libraries
problem: Personal files are scattered and hard to search; desktop file managers lack natural language and multimodal search.
business_model: Freemium cloud storage subscription (100GB free, paid tier at $10 per month for 2TB per TechCrunch snippet)
product_category: AI cloud file storage and browser
market_need_then: In 2022 the original idea was an AI 3D asset generator, with no demand evidence opened. The 2025 pivot followed user interviews that found organizing files was a big unmet need, per TechCrunch coverage.
outcome_analysis: Poly started in YC in 2022 with an AI 3D asset product, shut that iteration in 2023, then relaunched in November 2025 as an AI file browser with an $8M seed led by Felicis. It is early after the relaunch, with a strong investor group but a crowded storage market and skeptical early user reaction.

name: Polymath Robotics
tags: Hard Tech; Machine Learning; Robotics; Unmanned Vehicle; AI
one_liner: General Autonomy for Industrial Vehicles
long_description:
Polymath is building a general autonomy stack for cautious vehicles.  Our software allows any industrial vehicle - whether it's a tractor in a field or a bulldozer in a mine, drive itself.  We bundle together AI, ML, Controls, ROS, Safety and best-in-class deployment practices to enable our customers to tell automated vehicles to do via a REST API.

We're on more robots than we have engineers, are seeing our revenue (and robotic fleet) grow rapidly, and are looking for folks who want to help automate the world.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Makers and operators of off-highway and industrial vehicles (agriculture, mining, ports, yards, defense) that want autonomy without building a robotics team
problem: Automating an industrial vehicle normally needs a full in-house robotics stack. Polymath sells a hardware-agnostic autonomy layer controlled through a REST API.
business_model: Software licenses and retrofit autonomy programs for vehicle fleets, with a free simulation tool (Caladan) as top of funnel
product_category: Autonomy software for industrial vehicles
market_need_then: In 2022 TechCrunch described customers in agriculture and industrial sites wanting autonomy without a robotics team, and the founder said they were already driving unmanned and talking to potential customers.
outcome_analysis: Polymath is still operating per the YC page. It launched in July 2022 with a small angel seed and a demo that drew press, helped by a founder with prior autonomous trucking experience. No later priced rounds or exits were found, so its trajectory beyond early traction is unknown.

name: Ponyrun
tags: Analytics; Sales; Operations; AI; AI Assistant
one_liner: Automate prospect research at scale
long_description:
Ponyrun evaluates people for you. We help you answer questions like: Should you sell to them? Are they a good fit for your product? Should you interview them? 

Its easy to use. Give it a search URL or a list of people. Tell Ponyrun what you want to evaluate the person on. And Ponyrun will go through the person's information (e.g. LinkedIn), and evaluate them.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote

name: Popsy
one_liner: AI tool that finds you leads on Reddit and sends them hyper…
long_description: Popsy is an AI tool that finds you leads on Reddit and sends them hyper personalized DMs.
regions: Slovenia; Europe; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Founders and sales or marketing teams who want Reddit leads (current); creators and small businesses wanting a Notion-style site (original product)
problem: Current: finding people on Reddit asking for relevant products and reaching out personally. Original: turning Notion-style pages into branded websites without code.
business_model: Self-serve SaaS subscription
product_category: No-code website builder, later AI Reddit lead generation
market_need_then: Notion users in 2022 wanted custom-domain public sites; Product Hunt launch drew reviews averaging 3.7 across 10.
outcome_analysis: Popsy began as a Notion-style website builder, then moved to an AI Reddit lead tool with a two person team. No priced round or exit was found and users reported stability and support problems, so the story is unresolved; it is listed Active but with thin evidence of traction.

name: Posh
one_liner: Turning power into AI compute at speed with modular data centers at…
long_description:
Posh develops AI-ready modular data centers at existing, qualified power sites, turning pockets of available power into GPU compute. Gigawatt campuses take too long to build, held back by supply chains, power constraints, labor shortages, and community pushback. We find power-ready industrial, mining, and legacy data center sites, then drop in standard liquid-cooled modules with N+1 power and cooling, aiming for 6 months to ready-for-service. Customers bring the GPUs; we deliver the rest.

We have 20 sites in pipeline and over 100 MW of LOIs signed with AI cloud operators. The team are repeat founders and energy veterans with 100+ energy projects delivered across the U.S.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Originally battery recyclers and EV battery owners; now AI cloud operators needing GPU-ready data center capacity
problem: Originally, sorting and processing end-of-life EV batteries safely and at scale. Now, getting AI compute online faster by using already-powered industrial sites.
business_model: Project-based: modular data centers delivered at power-ready sites for AI cloud customers (current); automated recycling services (original)
product_category: Modular AI data centers (originally robotic battery recycling)
market_need_then: Mid 2022 coverage described a coming wave of retired EV batteries and investor interest in recycling. Today the need is AI compute and power constraints on gigawatt campuses.
outcome_analysis: Posh raised a $3.8M seed in June 2022 for robotic EV battery recycling, then appears to have pivoted into modular AI data centers, claiming 20 sites and 100 MW of letters of intent. No later priced rounds were found, so funding after the seed is unknown and the pivot's success is unverified.

name: Postal
one_liner: An AI native virtual address & mailroom for businesses.
long_description:
Postal offers a modern virtual mailbox for businesses. Postal provides an official address for government, IRS, and vendor communications so companies don't have to use an apartment / shared office address.

Postal's AI summarizes mail and recommends compliance actions, and its marketplace of service providers are ready to perform the mundane compliance work that otherwise falls through the cracks. 

Companies get 6 months free (a $300 value), plus three free hours of compliance services (a $600 value).
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Startups, small businesses, law firms, accountants and international companies needing a business mailing address and compliance help
problem: Companies use apartments or shared offices as official addresses and miss compliance mail from the IRS and governments.
business_model: Subscription virtual mailbox plus marketplace and services for compliance and registered agent work
product_category: Virtual mailbox and compliance operations
competitors_at_founding: Earth Class Mail; iPostal1; Anytime Mailbox
market_need_then: Registered agent and address services were a common startup purchase; the company's own pitch says compliance mail often falls through the cracks. No dated demand data was found.
outcome_analysis: Postal is listed Active as a four person team selling an AI virtual mailbox with compliance services. No funding, acquisition or shutdown was found, so its traction is unknown. Founders' Palantir and legal backgrounds fit the compliance angle, but evidence of outcomes is absent.

name: Powerdocs
one_liner: Create professional proposals, quotes, and documents in seconds.
long_description: Powerdocs is an AI-powered proposals creation platform for businesses, agencies, and freelancers. We help you create professional documents like proposals, quotes, and user requirement documents effortlessly, saving you hours of manual work. With a passion for automation, we’ve built the ultimate tool to simplify collaboration, streamline workflows, and let you focus on what truly matters—delivering exceptional results and winning clients.
regions: Germany; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Freelancers, agencies and businesses writing proposals, quotes and requirement documents
problem: Writing proposals, quotes and user-requirement documents is slow; Powerdocs drafts them with AI in seconds.
business_model: SaaS subscription (pricing not sourced)
product_category: AI proposal and document generation
market_need_then: Not evidenced by a dated source; the category already had several vendors in 2022.
outcome_analysis: Powerdocs is an active four-person Berlin company (YC W22) selling AI-generated proposals and quotes. No funding, customer, revenue or exit data was found, and positioning appears inconsistent across profiles (freelancer gigs versus government tenders), so no outcome can be assessed.

name: Powerhouse AI
one_liner: Vision-powered warehouse automation: maximizing performance and value
long_description:
Powerhouse AI offers automation at a fraction of the cost of regular automation solutions. Enabling warehouses to become more competitive, fast. 


- How? By making warehousing as easy as taking pictures with a mobile device; digitizing processes and using the power of the camera to automate counting and checking tasks.


Four core functionality areas:

- Workflow Digitization: simplify and automate warehousing with AI powered workflows. 
- AI Counting: automate the tedious and error-prone counting of inventory. 
- AI Label Processing: scan everything [not just barcodes]. Fast. 
- AI Document Processing: reading logistics documents with the click of a button.  


Core benefits: de-risking and future-proofing your warehouse operations 

- Increasing efficiency and accuracy with 20% to 40%
- State-of-the-art technology
- Making “dumb” boxes smart 
- Easily deal with supplier data inconsistencies 
- Enabling a data driven way of working 
- Real-time access to data
regions: Singapore; Southeast Asia; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Warehouse and logistics operators that count and check inventory by hand
problem: Manual counting and checking in warehouses is slow and error prone. Powerhouse AI uses phone cameras to count items, read labels and process documents.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription (starts at $99 per month per an aggregator, unverified)
product_category: Computer vision warehouse automation
market_need_then: Warehouse labor and accuracy pressure in 2021 and 2022; the company claims 20 to 40 percent efficiency gains (claim).
outcome_analysis: Powerhouse AI came from Entrepreneur First Singapore and joined YC in Winter 2022. It sells phone camera based warehouse counting and remains listed as active with six people. Funding is only aggregator sourced and no outcome events were found, so no judgment on success or failure is made.

name: Prembly (formerly Identitypass)
one_liner: Identity Verification API for Emerging Markets
long_description: We are making it possible for digital businesses to easily verify individuals and businesses within seconds across Emerging Markets.
regions: Nigeria; Africa; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Digital businesses in Africa and other emerging markets (fintechs, banks, mobility, e-commerce) that must verify customers for KYC
problem: Verifying individuals and businesses against fragmented national ID, biometric and business registry data in emerging markets.
business_model: Usage-based API priced per verification (about 10 to 20 cents per TechCrunch in 2022)
product_category: Identity verification, KYC and compliance API
market_need_then: Nigerian fintechs needed KYC at scale. TechCrunch in May 2022 reported over one million unique verifications processed since launch.
outcome_analysis: Prembly grew from Identitypass into a parent brand, raised a small pre-seed and a $2.8M seed in 2022 and reached a team of about 80. It acquired Tunnel in 2023 and merged with Peleza in 2024. No Series A was found, so growth appears capital efficient but later funding is unverified.

name: PrimeVault
tags: Fintech; Crypto / Web3; Payments; B2B; Infrastructure
one_liner: Infrastructure powering stablecoin and digital finance
long_description:
PrimeVault is the all-in-one digital asset and stablecoin platform for enterprises and financial institutions. Built for modern finance, PrimeVault combines secure wallets, programmable treasury, compliance, and market access in one seamless solution. 

With robust security and modular infrastructure, PrimeVault empowers institutions to issue, manage, and move digital assets at scale.

Discover how we makes digital asset finance simple at primevault.com.
regions: India; South Asia; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Enterprises, fintechs and financial institutions that need to hold, move and issue crypto and stablecoin assets
problem: Institutions need secure wallets, treasury, compliance and market access for digital assets without building custody infrastructure.
business_model: B2B SaaS and infrastructure fees for custody, treasury and stablecoin tooling
product_category: Institutional digital asset custody and stablecoin infrastructure
founder_names: Prashant Upadhyay; Vivek Kumar; Tanmay Chaudhari
market_need_then: Institutional crypto adoption in 2021 to 2022 drove heavy funding of custody vendors, shown by Fireblocks' rounds.
outcome_analysis: PrimeVault is active with an 11 person team and builders from Rippling. Funding is not publicly verified, with aggregators pointing only to a YC convertible note, so growth capital is unknown. Its positioning moved toward stablecoins as that market grew, but outcomes are not demonstrated in sources.

name: PromptLoop
tags: Generative AI; SaaS; Sales; Market Research; AI
one_liner: AI agents to build B2B datasets
long_description:
PromptLoop helps GTM teams automate account research and data enrichment at scale. We turn manual web scraping and qualification workflows into automated processes, enabling teams to enrich thousands of accounts with detailed company data and buying intent markers in minutes.

Why PromptLoop? Sales and marketing teams traditionally spend hours manually researching accounts or rely on outdated data providers. We automatically crawl and extract precise data points from company websites, social profiles, and public sources at 10% the cost of manual research, with built-in quality controls and strict sourcing. Teams can process 10k+ accounts simultaneously, turning raw URLs into actionable qualification data tailored to your goals.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Sales, marketing and go-to-market teams that need account research and data enrichment
problem: Teams spend hours manually researching accounts or depend on stale data providers.
business_model: SaaS subscription with usage, integrated with Salesforce, HubSpot and Excel
product_category: AI agents for B2B data research and enrichment
market_need_then: Sales teams pay for data enrichment, and the company claims customers save most of the cost of manual research (company-stated).
outcome_analysis: PromptLoop is active with a two person team and named customers such as Arketa and BCG. Its positioning shifted from spreadsheet AI functions to GTM data agents. Funding beyond a YC deal was not found, so scale and outcome are unclear.

name: PropelAuth
one_liner: Team-based authentication for B2B SaaS
long_description:
PropelAuth provides the right level of authentication for all stages of a company. New startups can use our hosted pre-built UIs which provide the simplest possible integration. Out of the box, our customers immediately have the same auth experience as large tech companies like Slack. As those startups grow, they can use our APIs and component libraries to pull aspects of the experience into their product.

More than just authentication, we will also provide useful functions tied to a "user" or "organization", like analytics, billing/subscriptions, referral programs, etc.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: B2B SaaS startups and growing software companies that need authentication with organizations, roles and enterprise SSO
problem: B2B products need team accounts, invitations, roles and SSO, which generic auth tools handle poorly and take months to build.
business_model: Usage and seat-based SaaS pricing for hosted authentication
product_category: Authentication and user management for B2B software
market_need_then: In 2022 B2B SaaS teams needed organizations and SSO from day one. Launch HN post drew 26 points and 14 comments in March 2022.
outcome_analysis: PropelAuth raised a $2.59M seed in July 2022 after the W22 batch and still operates with a B2B auth niche serving thousands of businesses per its site. No later priced round was found, so it may be capital efficient or simply unreported.

name: Proper
one_liner: Reconciliation and financial operations platform
long_description:
Proper provides software & APIs to help companies manage their payments data across providers. We connect banks, API providers, and networks in a single platform and provide automated reconciliation and accounting, so companies can maintain financial accuracy at scale.

Our integrated financial operating system gives companies a unified back-office data platform across their services and providers. With Proper, companies can spend less time on low-level financial system infrastructure and more time focused on building for their end-users.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Fintech companies and payments-heavy businesses that need to reconcile data across banks, processors and API providers
problem: Fintech teams spend large parts of engineering and finance time building internal reconciliation and ledger infrastructure across many payment providers.
business_model: B2B SaaS and API, tiered pricing by number of financial records
product_category: Reconciliation, ledger and financial operations infrastructure
market_need_then: Fintech founders reported infrastructure work such as reconciliation consumed most of engineering time, and the fintech boom of 2021 created many payment-heavy companies with that pain. Customers were added weekly at the time of the seed round per the founders.
outcome_analysis: Proper raised a $4.3M seed from Redpoint in June 2022 with former Marqeta engineers who knew the payments pain firsthand. It did not announce a later round before Intuit acquired its IP and hired the team in March 2024, which looks like a soft landing rather than a large product exit, in a crowded space with Modern Treasury and similar tools.

name: Provision
tags: Documents; Machine Learning; Construction; AI; AI Assistant
one_liner: Ironclad for construction
long_description: Provision is building the AI Estimator for construction. We identify risks and obligations in contracts, specs, and drawings so contractors can reduce time spent reviewing documents and focus on winning and delivering projects profitably. Backed by Y Combinator (S22).
regions: Canada; America / Canada
target_customer: General contractors and constructors (estimators, pre-construction and commercial teams) bidding on large projects
problem: Contracts, specs and drawings are long and complex, so estimators miss risks, scope gaps and obligations that later become costly disputes.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for contractors
product_category: AI document review for construction estimating and contract risk
market_need_then: The YC launch post cites roughly $500B a year (about 4 percent of market value) lost to issues from document complexity. A competitor raised seed funding for construction contract review in April 2022.
outcome_analysis: Provision stayed small after the 2022 YC batch, then raised a $7M seed in 2025 led by Cercano, after reporting nearly 10x growth in 2024 and signing large contractors such as PCL, EllisDon and Bird. Better language models gave it a tailwind for contract and drawing review, and enterprise contractor logos suggest a working sales motion. The company is still active and no shutdown or sale was found.

name: Pulppo
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate
one_liner: Shopify for Real Estate Agents in LATAM
long_description:
Pulppo is building Shopify for the real estate brokerages in Latin America. We provide them with performance analytics software, automatic online property listings, a valuation tool and a CRM. We will charge 20% of the 166 billions dollars in annual commissions they generate. 
From our integrated tool we automate non-value added activities, and give visibility and transparency to agents (CRM) and customers (buyer collaboration, seller dashboard). By integrating the entire process, we empower agents to deliver an improved customer journey and more efficient process.
regions: Mexico; Latin America; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Real estate brokerages and agents in Latin America, starting in Mexico
problem: Brokerages and agents lack integrated software for listings, CRM, valuation and analytics, and agents feel their brokerage brand adds little for them.
business_model: Commission share on transactions (stated target of 20 percent of commissions) plus SaaS tools for brokers
product_category: Proptech broker platform and CRM
market_need_then: Founders cited a large annual commission pool for LATAM brokerages and agents who felt their brokerage brand gave them little, per Bloomberg Linea coverage in 2022. Both founders had built and sold earlier real estate or delivery businesses in the region.
outcome_analysis: Pulppo was built by two repeat founders from real estate and delivery who raised a $1.7M pre-seed in February 2022 and about $5M seed by November 2022. It grew a broker network across Mexico, Colombia and Argentina and was acquired by Habi in early 2026 with founders staying, which reads as a positive regional consolidation exit.

name: Pump.co
one_liner: The Costco for cloud is here 🔥🔥
long_description: Pump saves up to 60% off AWS for early stage startups, and for free (yes, that's right). Using group buying and AI, Pump automates cost savings that require no engineering effort. #GetPumped
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Early-stage startups spending on AWS, later broader cloud and AI spend
problem: Startups pay full on-demand cloud prices because they cannot make large long-term commitments that unlock discounts.
business_model: Free to customer; Pump is paid by cloud providers or by a share of savings (company says providers pay it)
product_category: Cloud cost optimization, commitment pooling (FinOps)
market_need_then: Cloud bills were a large startup expense in 2022 and AWS rewards upfront commitments. Pump's launch reached 100+ signups and #1 on Product Hunt per its YC launch post (company claim).
outcome_analysis: Pump launched a free AWS discount service in 2022 and later claims 2,500+ customers and about $10B of managed spend, all company claims. Press coverage in 2023 and 2024 and a Product Hunt win helped distribution, and the company is still active after expanding into multi-cloud and AI cost. Funding is only seen on aggregators, so the funding story is unverified and no shutdown or sale was found.

name: Pursuit
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate
tags: Marketplace; Sustainable Tourism; Real Estate; Travel; Investments
one_liner: Turnkey co-ownership & management of properties
long_description:
Pursuit (also dba Hearth) offers you the opportunity to own and enjoy properties via turnkey co-ownership and ongoing property management. 

- We specialize in top-tier recreational properties throughout the world that possess scarce natural resources. 

- We coordinate small ownership groups (ten or fewer) that cooperatively steward the land, enjoy it together, and benefit from investment growth. 

- We manage the property on your behalf with your enjoyment and investment goals in mind.

Don’t play for a day. Own the whole playground.

hearthcoownership.com
AND
pursuit-properties.com
all_locations: Denver, CO, USA; Ottawa Hills, OH, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Pyrls
one_liner: Modern medical reference app for healthcare providers
long_description:
Pyrls is a website and mobile app that enables healthcare providers to more effectively prescribe, dispense, and educate patients on their prescriptions.

Currently trusted by 50,000+ clinicians and trainees and hundreds of organizations, Pyrls is building the future of how clinicians learn and manage their clinical practice information.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Clinicians and pharmacists, plus healthcare organizations licensing drug information
problem: Providers need fast, readable drug reference to prescribe, dispense and counsel, and existing tools are clunky or expensive.
business_model: Free consumer app plus organization licensing and partnerships
product_category: Medical and drug reference app
market_need_then: Clinicians use drug reference many times a day; competitors listed in a 2010 comparison show a long-standing paid and free market.
outcome_analysis: Pyrls is a three-person, pharmacist-led reference app that grew to tens of thousands of clinicians (50,000+ per YC, 100,000+ in a 2025 partner release) on little capital. A pharmacist founder who also codes gave it founder-market fit and low costs. Its December 2025 partnership with Pharmacy Quality Solutions is the main milestone found. No priced round was verified and the company is still active.

name: QUIK
one_liner: Building the operating system for business in LATAM
long_description:
QUIK is building the operating system for business in LATAM.

On one side, powering users on QUIK Super App, where they can order foods, groceries and goods and get them on 30 minutes, while paying using any currency they want and logistics enterally handled by QUIK team. 

On the other side, powering business with QUIK Pro, giving them a complete set of software to manage their business and online presence, with their own website, inventory management, logistics solutions, all in perfect sync with QUIK Super App, increasing sales and customer satisfaction.
regions: Venezuela; Latin America; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Venezuelan consumers and local merchants
problem: Venezuelans face fragmented payments, dollar and remittance access, and unreliable delivery; merchants lack online presence and logistics.
business_model: Marketplace and delivery fees, payments, and SaaS for merchants (QUIK Pro)
product_category: Super app: payments wallet, delivery marketplace, merchant software
market_need_then: Bloomberg Linea (March 2022) reported about 40,000 users in Maracaibo and demand for QR payments, a dollar-friendly wallet and delivery.
outcome_analysis: QUIK built a Maracaibo-based payments and delivery app that reached about 40,000 users by March 2022, expanded to Caracas, and is listed active with a 20-person team. Founders are local, which helps with merchant and courier access. No funding round could be verified from a primary source, so the funding story is incomplete. No shutdown or confirmed sale was found.

name: Quan
tags: Mental Health Tech; SaaS; B2B; HR Tech; Subscriptions
one_liner: End-to-end platform to improve wellbeing and team performance.
long_description:
We provide a self-assessment which identifies the underlying causes of poor wellbeing and match proven solutions for individuals and teams.

https://www.quanwellbeing.com/
regions: Netherlands; Europe; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Companies and teams (HR and team leads) that want to measure and improve employee wellbeing
problem: Teams struggle with burnout and poor wellbeing but generic perks do not identify the underlying causes for a given team.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for teams and organizations
product_category: Employee wellbeing and team performance assessment platform
market_need_then: Post pandemic burnout and remote work drove employer interest in wellbeing in 2021 and 2022, and TechCrunch framed the raise around that burnout wave.
outcome_analysis: Quan raised a $1.15M pre-seed through YC in January 2022, then relied on a bridge round in April 2024 led by HearstLab and 4impact. Without a clearly larger round and in a crowded wellbeing market, it was acquired by TrueTribe in July 2025, which suggests a modest outcome rather than a breakout.

name: Query Vary
one_liner: No-Code LLM Application / Workflow Builder
long_description:
Query Vary is a no-code tool for building LLM-powered automation. 

Example use cases include extracting information from a sales call transcript and piping it into a CRM, creating a Slack bot trained on product documentation, or transforming Google forms into fully formatted reports.

Input Software --> LLM --> Output Software

Our extensive toolset to make each workflow reliable sets Query Vary apart. 

Book a demo:
https://calendar.app.google/6oxEvZA2k4kK6dBa8
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Operations and business teams wanting LLM automations without code
problem: Connecting LLMs to business software reliably requires engineering for prompts, testing, latency and cost.
business_model: SaaS subscription (inferred from demo booking; pricing not seen)
product_category: No-code LLM workflow builder
market_need_then: GPT-3 had been public since 2020 and no-code tools were popular; demand for non-technical LLM automation was early and unproven in early 2022.

name: Quindar
one_liner: Datadog for Space
long_description:
Quindar is a web app used by satellite owners to analyze, test and operate their constellation. For example, Airbus could use Quindar to operate their satellite fleet with minimal human intervention.
  
We’re six former OneWeb engineers who helped build the software platform that currently operates the second largest satellite constellation in the world.
 
The space industry is shifting from companies launching a handful of satellites over a decade, to launching hundreds of satellites EACH in just a few years. Our SaaS platform automates mission management and for a single engineer to operate hundreds of satellites instead of the traditional model of many engineers operating a single satellite.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Satellite operators and constellation owners, plus government space programs
problem: Operating satellites requires many engineers per spacecraft; constellations of hundreds need automation.
business_model: B2B SaaS mission management platform
product_category: Satellite mission operations software
founder_names: Nate Hamet; Sunny Bhagavathula; David Lawrence; Zach Meza; Shaishav Parekh; Matt Regan
market_need_then: Constellations were growing from handfuls to hundreds of satellites per operator, making one-engineer-per-satellite operations unsustainable (company statement).
outcome_analysis: Six ex-OneWeb engineers built a SaaS satellite operations platform, raised $2.5M in 2023, $6M in 2024 with partner KSAT, and an $18M Series A in November 2025 for classified work, about $28M in total. Their direct experience building OneWeb's platform gave strong founder-market fit, and growing constellations and government demand gave tailwind. The company remains active and no exit has occurred.

name: Quinn
one_liner: Your biopharma team, from molecule design to portfolio strategy
long_description: Quinn is your biopharma team. From molecule design to portfolio strategy, Quinn delivers comprehensive reports and supporting analyses, models and designs in 3–5 days instead of months.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Biopharma companies and biotech teams needing research, analysis and strategy reports

business_model: Per-engagement AI-generated reports and analyses (3 to 5 day turnaround)
product_category: AI biopharma research and strategy services
market_need_then: Consultancies and AI drug discovery firms were active in 2022 but a 3 to 5 day turnaround offering was not documented in sources found.
outcome_analysis: Quinn (quinnbio.com, a product of iollo, Inc.) is a small Stanford-linked company that sells AI-generated biopharma analyses in days. The YC page lists it active with five people, but no funding, press or exit was found, so there is no clear success or failure story. Credibility rests on the founders' Stanford ties and logos of research organizations, with no verified revenue.

name: RDash
one_liner: AI Powered Construction Management Software
long_description: RDash is an AI powered construction management software that unifies site teams, procurement, design and finance - out of box; Without requiring customer to stitch anything. We are fastest to deploy and compatible with most accounting and ERP tools.

business_model: B2B SaaS construction ERP, sister to 91Squarefeet design-and-build services
product_category: Construction management and ERP software
market_need_then: Indian construction projects rely on spreadsheets and chat; investors funded construction software in 2021 (Powerplay), showing demand.
outcome_analysis: RDash grew out of 91Squarefeet, a design-and-build firm run by the same founders who previously co-founded Quifers, a logistics SaaS company acquired in 2021. A $10M round led by Stellaris with Y Combinator was reported in September 2022 under the 91Squarefeet name, and the YC page now lists RDash at 80 people. Founder domain experience supported its growth; no failure signals were found.

name: REVER
one_liner: Changing the way people buy by giving superpowers to shoppers
long_description:
We receive any product in 24h anywhere on the planet, but... Why can't we also return & get refunded just as quickly?

REVER is a game-changing shopping experience that makes eCommerce returns possible in 2 clicks and refunds in 24h.

The REVER team is shaping the future of eCommerce bringing frictionless, superfast and sustainable returns to everyone, anytime, anywhere. Because returning should be as easy as buying. 

REVER's ambition is to dominate ALL eCommerce post-sale services by creating the world's first global platform for online returns.

REVER is currently handling +100M€ in yearly returns, with more than 50M€ in revenues

If you are an eCommerce and want to revolutionise your returns experience find out more at: www.itsrever.com
regions: Spain; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Ecommerce merchants (fashion and general retail in Spain, Portugal, Italy, Germany and later US) that pay to run returns and refunds
problem: Online returns are slow and refunds take two weeks or more in Europe, which hurts shopper loyalty and merchant economics.
business_model: B2B SaaS and returns services for merchants with instant refunds financed by REVER
product_category: Ecommerce returns and reverse logistics software
founder_names: Oriol Hernandez i Fajula; Marius Montmany
market_need_then: Ecommerce volume grew during the pandemic and retailers such as Boohoo began charging return fees. The founders cite refund waits of 14 days or more in Europe versus near instant delivery.
outcome_analysis: REVER got into YC four months after founding, raised about $1M pre-seed in 2022 and a seed of roughly 7.5 to 8.5 million euros in June 2023 with 130 plus customers and about 25 staff. It is active with a reported TikTok Shop returns partnership, but its own revenue and volume claims are unverified and it faces well funded returns vendors.

name: RTHM

long_description: RTHM is the self-learning digital clinic for medicine's new normal: complex patients with lots of data and/or multiple chronic conditions. We are focused on infection-associated chronic conditions and autoimmune conditions impacting 70M individuals in the US.

business_model: Free data intelligence platform plus paid clinic membership (reported $1,000 per month with 3 month minimum and $1,500 onboarding), prescriptions and lab testing; cash pay, no Medicare or Medicaid
product_category: Digital clinic for complex chronic illness
market_need_then: Long COVID created a large new population of patients with unmet needs in early 2022; YC page claims 70M US individuals are affected by infection-associated chronic and autoimmune conditions (company figure, not independently checked).
outcome_analysis: RTHM is active as of the directory and built from founders with lived and clinical experience of Long COVID and ME/CFS, which gives it founder market fit. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff reporting was found in an outcome search. Funding is not reliably documented, so the trajectory beyond a small team of 10 and a widening product line from intelligence platform to clinic and direct prescriptions cannot be judged.

name: Railbird
one_liner: A futures market for events.
long_description: At Railbird, we are building a prediction market exchange designed to hedge and mitigate risk for the services sector. The Railbird team has years of experience analyzing companies in the service sector and has seen firsthand how little opportunity there is to hedge risk in volatile markets like hospitality, tourism, recreation, entertainment, and sports. The platform is designed to be open to all traders.
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; New York, NY, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Businesses in the services sector (hospitality, tourism, entertainment, sports) hedging event risk, plus retail traders
problem: Service businesses have little way to hedge volatile event driven risks, and prediction markets in the US were restricted without a CFTC license.
business_model: Exchange fees on event contracts (regulated prediction market exchange)
product_category: Regulated event contracts exchange

outcome_analysis: Railbird started as a niche hedging exchange for service businesses, spent roughly three years obtaining a CFTC Designated Contract Market license in June 2025, and then sold to DraftKings in October 2025 as prediction markets went mainstream. name: Rally
one_liner: Agentic User Research Infrastructure
long_description:
Rally is agentic user research infrastructure. Our agent runs recruitment end to end, from finding participants through scheduling and sending incentives. Underneath, our infrastructure enforces the guardrails enterprises require: consent, permissions, templates, data governance, and more. Trusted by teams building the future of product research: Google, Meta, Ramp, Figma, and Perplexity.

Talk to your users today with Rally.

business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for a user research CRM and agentic recruitment infrastructure

market_need_then: Research teams relied on spreadsheets and generic CRMs; the company's March 2023 launch post says tools stitched together for research caused lengthy cycles. Funding of rivals in 2021 indicates investor demand for the category.
outcome_analysis: Rally went from YC W22 to an $8.8M seed in April 2024 and an $11M Series A in June 2025, with enterprise logos such as Google, Figma and Meta claimed on its site. It reached a niche with funded rivals but won customers by focusing on research recruitment and governance. The long gap between the batch and the seed suggests slow early growth, and the 2025 repositioning around agents follows the AI shift.

By November 2025 it rebranded as Rank and bought AjoMoney and a microfinance bank to gain a license and expand into savings. The record shows an active company that moved from lending to broader banking, with funding totals poorly documented in primary sources.

name: Raven

At Raven, we are building AI assistants for manufacturing plants which can offer intelligent assistance for day-to-day operations like training, job planning, troubleshooting, reporting and also helps with real-time analytics — all while seamlessly integrating with your existing systems.
We’re taking decades of manufacturing expertise and combining it with AI to solve real operational problems. We’re a small, focused team working to make industrial operations safer, smarter, and more efficient.

No funding or exit was found, so success or stall cannot be judged. The pivot suggests the first market was crowded by open source rivals such as Novu.

name: Ravion
one_liner: The easiest way to use AWS for agents and humans
long_description:
Ravion is the easiest way to use AWS for agents and humans. Get a Vercel-like experience in your own AWS account, with one place to manage and monitor Terraform resources, builds, and deploys.

Use your existing Terraform or start with our standard library of modules. Build and deploy applications, inspect logs and metrics, and customize modules and pipelines as your needs grow.

Your agents get structured configuration, complete CLI and API access, and connected context across infrastructure and deployments. Reviewable plans, permissions, approval gates, and audit history keep your team in control.

You get a production-grade AWS system without assembling every DevOps capability from scratch.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Engineering teams running apps on their own AWS account (startups and growth stage), and their AI agents

market_need_then: The Flightcontrol pitch cites the migration away from Heroku due to cost and limits; the CEO's open source Blitz.js community gave a developer audience.
outcome_analysis: The YC W22 company was Flightcontrol, a deployment layer on customers' AWS accounts built by the creator of Blitz.js. The company says it ran in production since 2021 and reached profitability, then rebuilt the product as Ravion for the agent era. name: Rebill
one_liner: Financial infrastructure for the Americas
long_description:
Rebill is the financial infrastructure platform for the Americas.

The companies shaping software, AI, travel, and digital services use Rebill to operate across Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and the United States.

Rebill brings local payments, installments, recurring billing, stablecoin rails, treasury, global payouts, and financial operations into one platform built for how money actually works across the Americas.

Every market is different. Rebill makes the infrastructure consistent. Engineering, finance, and operations teams can manage local currency acceptance, market-specific payment behavior, funds, and financial workflows from the same platform.

Companies can launch in Latin America in as little as a day and expand across markets without rebuilding their financial stack country by country.

Built locally. Designed to scale globally.

outcome_analysis: Rebill began as a subscription collection tool for Argentine merchants, raised a $3.6M pre-seed and seed in August 2022 led by Tiger Global, and kept a small team of about 10 to 11. It broadened to cross-border payments across six countries and raised a $5.4M pre-Series A reported in October 2026. Progress appears steady but slow, with a modest total raised of about $9M.

name: RedBrick AI
one_liner: Rapid medical data annotation
long_description:
RedBrick AI's mission is to accelerate the adoption of artificial intelligence in radiology by building world-class software infrastructure. Currently, we are focused on helping radiology AI teams prepare high-quality datasets to train their algorithms.

Radiology data, such as CT and X-ray scans, is an incredibly important source of truth in healthcare delivery. In fact, over 90% of all healthcare data is medical imagery! However, the global radiology workforce is overburdened. In the UK, for example, only 2% of radiology departments are able to fulfill their reporting requirements, and this trend is reflected worldwide.

The acute state of radiology, coupled with the abundance of data, makes the use of AI in radiology a prime candidate. In 2022, $5.6 billion was invested in the development of AI in healthcare! However, a key hindrance to further adoption is the lack of sophisticated tools to build and deploy AI algorithms in clinical environments. This is the problem we’re focused on at RedBrick AI

We're a team based out of Bangalore India, and USA. We're backed by leading institutional investors like Y Combinator and Peak XV (formerly Sequoia Capital India).
regions: United States of America; India; America / Canada; South Asia; Remote; Partly Remote

problem: Training radiology AI needs high quality 2D and 3D labeled medical images, and general purpose annotation tools handle DICOM volumes poorly.
business_model: B2B SaaS annotation platform, enterprise subscription
product_category: Medical imaging data annotation
market_need_then: Radiology AI developers needed ground truth labels for imaging models and the company cited radiologist shortages and growing AI investment in healthcare as drivers in its YC description.
outcome_analysis: RedBrick AI joined YC in Winter 2022 and raised a 4.6 million dollar seed in November 2022 led by Sequoia India's Surge, with early customers in radiology AI and hospitals. It remains active with a customer logo wall of radiology AI firms. No later round was found, so the stage after seed is unknown rather than absent. Competition from Encord and others in DICOM labeling is the main ongoing risk.

long_description: Redbird is an AI-powered analytics platform for the enterprise - empowering anyone within an organization to easily automate and unify their analytics work in minutes, without writing code. Redbird connects to all of an organization’s data sources and accelerates analytics work across data prep, wrangling, analysis, reporting and data science.
