Its CEO said customers grew sevenfold since the seed. No later priced round, exit or distress was confirmed, so its trajectory beyond seed is unknown.

name: RefineTrain AI
one_liner: AI agents rewriting & optimising your internal documentation for LLMs
long_description:
We rewrite and optimise your internal documentation for AI, giving it deep enterprise context. This unlocks substantially better LLM results across all AI workflows.

PROBLEM:
--------------
• AI teams struggle with LLM accuracy building AI workflows and agents because of messy, conflicting, fragmented internal knowledge.
• Internal knowledge conflicts, uses undefined jargon and rely on unstated company assumptions & context.
• LLMs are like Day 0 fresh hires – they can’t understand this documentation properly without someone explaining context to them.
• Furthermore, vector search suffers from poorer retrieval accuracy when company context and terms are not present in a knowledge article

WHAT WE DO
-------------------
• Clean & De-Conflict: Our AI agents read every doc, resolve contradictions, and builds content relationships.

• Context Distillation: Our AI agents read & compare related docs, distills context and rewrites an LLM-optimised version of your internal documentation. Optional human-approval ensures 100% confidence in the output.

THE OUTCOME
----------------------
• Agents and chatbots that actually understand your enterprise context.
• Retrieval that delivers precise, policy-aligned answers on the first try.
• A living knowledge base that stays synchronized with every new doc revision.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Enterprise AI teams (YC description); company site now sells custom AI agents to businesses
problem: Messy and conflicting internal documents lower LLM accuracy (YC description).
business_model: Custom AI agent services and pilots; pricing not found
product_category: Enterprise AI agents and documentation optimisation
market_need_then: Not documented for 2022. The YC description in its current form is an LLM era pitch, so it likely postdates the 2022 batch.
outcome_analysis: Little is public about RefineTrain AI. The YC page and the company website describe different products, documentation rewriting versus custom business agents such as support QA and compliance checks, and one directory says it began as Power to the Brand. No funding, exit or shutdown was found, so no outcome can be assigned and unknown funding is not zero.

name: Relay Health
tags: Mental Health Tech; Health Tech; Community; Productivity

Nearly 7 billion hours are spent on porn every year.

Relay provides a modern solution to one of the most widespread yet hidden epidemics of our time: pornography. Despite being one of the biggest drains on focus, relationships, and mental health, it remains one of the most silent and stigmatized problems in society. We are tackling this head-on.

Our mission goes beyond quitting porn. Relay exists to help people heal the isolation and pain that drive destructive habits—so they can rebuild intimacy, reclaim focus, and live with greater connection, purpose, and wholeness.

product_category: Digital peer support app for behavioral recovery

It remains active and no shutdown, sale or layoffs were found. name: Relevium Medical
tags: Medical Devices; Healthcare; Therapeutics; Drug discovery
one_liner: Platform injectable gel based therapeutic for osteoarthritis
long_description:
Relevium Medical is developing an injectable gel for knee osteoarthritis. Approximately half the population will be diagnosed with this pain and progressive disease.
Right now, patients have to undergo not only repeat injections to control their pain, but also have to take strong oral medications. Because the disease is progressive and only gets worse over time, many patients end up on highly addictive, high-dose opioids. 
To date, we have secured $3.7 million in non dilutive funding and completed preclinical testing. We demonstrated that our drug is safe, selectively blocks nerves that transmit pain, and provides pain relief that lasts four times as long. 
Insurance currently pays $770 per six-monthly treatment for knee osteoarthritis. With 5 million patients in the US, this represents a $7.7 Bn market opportunity.
This platform biotherapeutic can also be used to treat other joints affects by osteoarthritis such as the hip and ankle, where the same problems exist in treatment care.
regions: Ireland; Europe
target_customer: Pharma and clinical partners; end users are knee osteoarthritis patients and treating physicians
problem: Knee osteoarthritis pain needs repeat injections and strong oral drugs, and capsaicin type treatments cause burning pain.
business_model: Drug and device development company, non dilutive grants then equity, future product sales or licensing
product_category: Injectable hydrogel and prodrug therapeutic for osteoarthritis pain
market_need_then: YC page cites about 5 million US patients, 770 dollars insurance payment per six month treatment, and opioid use in progressive disease.
outcome_analysis: Relevium Medical has funded itself through non dilutive money, including a 4.6 million euro DTIF award announced in November 2024, while planning a 10 million euro Series A for clinical trials. No Series A close or trial readout was found, so its progress past preclinical is unconfirmed. Capital intensity and clinical risk define the path.

name: Remedial Health
one_liner: B2B E-commerce & Fintech platform for Pharmacies & Hospitals in Africa
long_description: Remedial Health sells medicine wholesale to the 1 million pharmacies and hospitals in Africa. Today in Africa, pharmacies shop in open-air medicine markets where they pay higher prices for counterfeits medicines. We offer a managed marketplace with all the stock they'll need, deliver within 24 hours and offer credit to help them grow.
regions: Nigeria; Africa; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Pharmacies, hospitals, clinics and HMOs in Nigeria
problem: Pharmacies buy from open air medicine markets at higher prices with counterfeit risk and little credit.
business_model: B2B marketplace margin on drug wholesale plus inventory financing and services
product_category: Pharmaceutical B2B e-commerce and fintech
market_need_then: Pharmacies bought from open air markets with counterfeit risk; the founder said COVID era medicine demand as an importer inspired the business (Techpoint, 2023).
outcome_analysis: Remedial Health raised a pre-seed and 4.4 million dollar seed in 2022 and a 12 million dollar Series A in August 2023, 8 million equity and 4 million debt, led by QED with Ventures Platform. It claims over 10,000 customers and the Financial Times fastest growing recognition in 2025. No later round was found, so Series B status is unknown.

name: Remi
tags: SaaS; Solar Power; Construction; Proptech; Climate
one_liner: Simplifying roofing for homeowners, roofers and enterprises.
long_description:
We find roofers more roofs, and homeowners the right roofer.

There are over 80 million homes in the US, and eventually, every one of them will need a new roof. Our technology  allows contractors to focus on what they do best—getting a repaired roof over homeowners' heads quickly.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Homeowners needing reroofs, roofing contractors and enterprises such as solar installers
problem: Homeowners struggle to find a trusted roofer at a fair price and contractors struggle to find more roofs.
business_model: Managed roofing marketplace and contractor of record with guaranteed price, margin on jobs
product_category: Roofing marketplace and services
founder_names: Doug Barnett; Brant Choate; Reno Mendenhall
market_need_then: Over 80 million US homes will need new roofs (YC page); Pelion cited 650 percent growth and profitability in the year before the Series A.
outcome_analysis: Remi raised a 21 million dollar Series A in August 2024 led by Pelion with Cervin, citing 650 percent growth and profitability. The site claims 40,000 projects and 500 five star reviews. No later round or distress was found. Success so far rests on operating a licensed service rather than a pure marketplace.

name: Requestly
tags: Developer Tools; SaaS; Open Source; API
one_liner: Open-Source Postman alternative
long_description: Requestly helps developers build faster by intercepting, mocking, and testing API responses. No more waiting for backend developers, struggling with flaky staging environments, or fighting over API contracts. With 200,000+ active installs, Requestly is trusted by Google, Amazon, Workday, Indeed, and many other Fortune 500 companies.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Software developers and QA teams, with paid team and enterprise plans
problem: Developers wait on backend teams or flaky staging environments; testing front end changes against production data or mocked APIs requires redeploys.
business_model: Open source core with paid team and enterprise subscriptions (freemium SaaS)
product_category: Developer tools: HTTP interception, API mocking and API client
market_need_then: Developers relied on tools like Postman, proxies and header modifiers, and the founder's extension spread among developers on its own; the company cites 200,000 installs used at large enterprises.
outcome_analysis: Requestly grew bottom up from a developer's Chrome extension to 200,000 plus installs, backed by YC and Sequoia Surge, and was acquired by BrowserStack in May 2025 after adding an API client. Public funding amounts are unknown, but the product led spread and small footprint suggest a capital efficient path to a strategic exit.

name: Reviving Mind
tags: Consumer Health Services; Digital Health; Healthcare; Telemedicine
one_liner: Addressing Loneliness and Isolation for Seniors
long_description:
Navigating chronic illness is an isolating and lonely process which ultimately reduces medical adherence and adversely impacts outcomes. There are over 100 deadly chronic conditions as 1 out of 2 Americans is currently living with at least 1 chronic condition. The US healthcare system has over $1 trillion dollars in direct costs. Medical adherence rates for therapeutic programs and medicine are only 50% because patients feel lonely, isolated, and unsupported in their chronic illness journey.

Reviving Mind is an in-network telehealth provider that improves clinical outcomes and program adherence for the senior medicare and medicare-advantage population that is plagued with loneliness and chronic illness. This is done through a novel and proprietary clinical program and technology platform that integrates virtual, private, curated, and professionally led groups that scale up to 8-patients with individualized and goal oriented lifestyle medicine coaching that is automated but managed by a licensed provider.

Scaling rapidly across the United States.
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; Boston, MA, USA; Remote
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Medicare and Medicare Advantage seniors with chronic illness, billed through insurers
problem: Loneliness and isolation lower medication adherence and worsen outcomes for seniors with chronic conditions.
business_model: In-network telehealth provider billing Medicare for collaborative care and group programs
product_category: Telehealth, behavioral health and collaborative care management
market_need_then: The YC page cites one in two Americans with a chronic condition, 50 percent medication adherence, and over 1 trillion dollars in direct costs.
outcome_analysis: Little public information exists for Reviving Mind beyond the YC listing and directory profiles. It is described as active, scaling in the US, and offering collaborative care management, with no funding, exit or distress reported. Unknown funding is not zero, so no outcome can be assigned and no success or failure factors are supported by sources.

name: Revoy
one_liner: Make diesel semi trucks hybrid-electric
long_description: SixWheel makes diesel trucks hybrid-electric in 3 minutes at zero upfront cost while delivering $25k more profit per truck annually.
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; San Mateo, CA, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Trucking fleets running Class 8 diesel semis, such as Ryder, that want lower fuel cost and emissions without buying electric tractors
problem: Battery-electric semis are expensive and diesel fleets need fuel savings now. Revoy sells a swappable electric dolly that sits between tractor and trailer so a diesel truck becomes a hybrid in minutes.
business_model: Hardware as a service, fleets pay per mile with fees tied to diesel saved and nothing up front
product_category: Hybrid-electric add-on dolly for diesel semi trucks
market_need_then: Diesel fleets faced fuel cost and emissions pressure while battery-electric semis such as the Volvo VNR Electric and Freightliner eCascadia were costly (Electrek 2026 compares range and weight). The YC page claims $25k more profit per truck per year, a company claim.
outcome_analysis: Revoy started as SixWheel in 2020, joined YC in Winter 2022, ran a year-long Ryder pilot and then raised a $27M Series A in July 2026 led by Standard Capital, bringing reported total funding above $41M. The no-upfront per-mile model lowers the barrier for fleets, and the company still has to prove deployments beyond the first Pacific Northwest route and swap stations.

name: Rider
one_liner: Modern parcel delivery for online sellers in Pakistan.
long_description: Rider is building modern parcel delivery for online sellers in Pakistan. We are doing $130K in monthly revenue, delivering 200K orders per month across 60 cities. Unlike traditional logistics players, Rider’s solution is: Easier to use (integration with shipper portals, delivery agent app, end- customer app); Quicker (route optimization, next day deliveries, 24-hour cash repayment); Transparent (resolves ‘fake attempt’ deliveries, offers live tracking) and Flexible (shipper and customer control on delivery location and times).
regions: Pakistan; South Asia; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Online sellers and SMEs in Pakistan shipping cash on delivery e-commerce parcels
problem: Traditional couriers in Pakistan were not built for e-commerce: slow, opaque, with fake delivery attempts and delayed cash remittance.
business_model: Per parcel delivery fees with cash on delivery collection and fast repayment to sellers
product_category: E-commerce last mile logistics
market_need_then: Pakistani e-commerce was growing fast and sellers complained about fake delivery attempts and slow remittance; startups raised money to serve the gap in 2021.
outcome_analysis: Rider scaled quickly to about 200K orders a month across 60 cities, raising 2.3M in October 2021 and 3.1M in June 2022. YC lists it as acquired but no acquirer or date was found; in 2023 it was itself seeking to buy BlueEx's logistics arm, so the acquired label may reflect a later deal that is not public.

name: Rima AI (formerly Garage)
one_liner: Document and spreadsheet automation for accountants
long_description:
Rima helps accountants automate document and spreadsheet work with accuracy and cell-level audit tracking.

For accountants that deal with messy docs and spend their time in Excel, Rima enables them to build workflows in natural language to extract and process financial data from PDFs or ERPs into their Excel templates and reconcile their spreadsheets in minutes. Accountants build these workflows once and our agents do the work for them going forward, preserving their institutional memory and know-how.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Accounting and tax firms (originally wholesale auto parts retailers in Africa as Garage)
problem: Accountants lose time on messy PDFs and spreadsheets and cannot trust generic AI without cell-level audit trails.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for accounting and tax firms (pricing not found)
product_category: AI document and spreadsheet automation for accountants
market_need_then: Garage's launch pitch was a wholesale auto parts marketplace serving about 2M retailers in Africa; the accounting pivot responds to widespread AI adoption by accountants but no demand data was captured here.
outcome_analysis: Garage entered YC in Summer 2022 as an African auto parts marketplace, then pivoted to AI for accountants under the Rima name and later toward tax resolution firms. The company remains active with five people and a small funding record that is not verified. It is early, with no exit and no public traction figures beyond self-reported claims, so success factors are limited to the pivot itself.

name: Rio
tags: Fintech; Crypto / Web3; Payments; Latin America
one_liner: LATAM’s largest stablecoin FX and liquidity provider
long_description: Rio is the premier stablecoin liquidity provider for the LATAM market. We enable access to stablecoins for financial innovators to scale their products.
regions: Mexico; Latin America; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Fintechs, exchanges and businesses in Latin America that need to move between stablecoins and local currencies
problem: Access to stablecoin liquidity and FX in Latin America is thin. Rio offers OTC trading and market making between stablecoins and local currencies in Mexico, Colombia, Peru and Brazil.
business_model: Stablecoin FX spread and market making fees (OTC and liquidity provision)
product_category: Stablecoin FX and liquidity provider
founder_names: Eudelio Garza; Javier Roberts; Ricardo Villarreal Chapa
market_need_then: Stablecoins such as USDC and USDT were widely used in Latin America for cross border payments and savings. Circle's partner directory lists Rio as an OTC and market making provider in four countries. No 2022 dated demand source was captured.
outcome_analysis: Rio joined YC in Summer 2022 and positions itself as a stablecoin liquidity provider for Latin America, with Circle listing it as a partner. No funding announcement, exit, shutdown or rebrand was found, and one profile says its beta products were pending regulatory approvals, so the outcome is unknown and regulation is the main open risk.

name: Roforco
one_liner: Creating viral AI consumer apps and games
long_description:
Roforco is one of the top game studios on Roblox. The team has launched 7 original titles played by over 100 million users and reaching a peak of 10.2 million monthly active users. Top games include:

* https://www.roblox.com/games/10975855395/Korrupt-Zombies-UPDATE
* https://www.roblox.com/games/9746160797/Sunsilk-City
* https://www.roblox.com/games/4983678402/Disney-World-Magic-Kingdom-Theme-Park
* https://www.roblox.com/games/6497455705/UPDATE-Iron-Seas

Roforco drives virality through social reach, with 100K+ TikTok followers, 64K+ Discord members, and tens of millions of views across TikTok and YouTube.

Founded by two 17-year-old high school dropouts who’ve been building viral consumer products since they were 12.
regions: Norway; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Roblox players (consumers who play and spend Robux) and brands paying for branded Roblox games
problem: Roblox hit games are unpredictable. Roforco completes unfinished or abandoned Roblox projects with their developers and cross promotes them across a portfolio to reduce hit risk.
business_model: Game studio revenue from in-game purchases plus brand partnership games
product_category: Roblox game studio
market_need_then: Roblox was described in the YC launch post as a $2bn market with over 200 million monthly users and about 10 million registered developers, versus 44k on Steam. These are the founders' claims. The studio reported 51.8 million play sessions at launch.
outcome_analysis: Roforco completes and cross promotes Roblox games, reported 51.8 million play sessions and seven titles at YC launch, and drew a Dentsu Ventures investment in 2022. No acquisition, shutdown or later round was found, and growth stays tied to Roblox platform rules and its ability to keep producing hits.

name: Rome AI
one_liner: AI lab in San Francisco
long_description: Rome AI (formerly Rome Trucking) started in 2022 as a freight marketplace for truck drivers. We helped 80+ drivers earn up to 40% more by finding 10x more loads. What we learned there pointed us toward something bigger, and that's what we're building now, in stealth. More soon.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Independent truck drivers and small carriers (original Rome Trucking load board); the current product is in stealth
problem: Independent truckers struggle to find high rate loads. Rome Trucking began as a freight marketplace and has since become Rome AI, an AI lab building a stealth product.
business_model: Freight load marketplace for drivers (original); current model not public
product_category: Freight marketplace, then AI lab
market_need_then: The YC page reports the product helped 80+ drivers earn up to 40 percent more by finding 10x more loads. This is a company claim without an outside source.
outcome_analysis: Rome Trucking launched a freight load marketplace in 2022 and reported helping 80 drivers, then became Rome AI, a one person AI lab in stealth. No funding, exit or shutdown was confirmed. The new product is unknown, so the outcome is unclear.

name: Rosebud Biosciences
one_liner: Growing micro-organs to find new drugs
long_description: Rosebud Biosciences accelerates drug development by screening drugs against organoids (micro-organs) that have the same gene mutations as the patients. We partner with therapeutics companies to screen their drugs, and we perform our own drug discovery for rare diseases that have no existing treatments. Our organoids are also fetal-like and enable discovery of novel drug targets for pediatric diseases. This technology was validated at Stanford, published in a prestigious journal, and has already led to the discovery of a drug target in a pediatric heart disease that could not have been found using traditional disease models.
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; San Carlos, CA, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Therapeutics companies and rare disease drug developers that pay for organoid based drug screening and safety work
problem: Standard disease models miss targets for rare and pediatric diseases. Rosebud screens drugs against organoids that carry patient gene mutations.
business_model: Fee for service organoid screening and partnerships, plus own rare disease discovery
product_category: Organoid drug discovery platform
market_need_then: Pediatric and rare diseases lack models and treatments, and the YC page says a fetal-like organoid model found a heart disease drug target that traditional models could not. This is a company claim.
outcome_analysis: Rosebud was founded in 2020 by a Stanford pathologist and a neuroscience PhD, joined YC in Winter 2022, won an NSF grant of about $275K in 2023 and announced a partnership with iXCells in January 2026. Venture funding is not verified, so the company looks capital efficient or quiet rather than failed.

name: Rownd
tags: Autonomous Delivery; Drones; Open Source; AI
one_liner: Fully autonomous defense solutions for the global edge.
long_description: Rownd AI builds fully autonomous drones that use local edge intelligence and global LTE/5G/SatCom failover to eliminate the 1:1 pilot bottleneck anywhere on earth or space. We are currently field-deployed with active customers across U.S. Special Operations Command (SOCOM) via our defense business line, ArcEdge AI. Operating out of Raleigh, NC and Wisconsin, we leveraged our team's background in mobile hardware optimization and zero-trust architectures to build true cognitive autonomy directly onto physical aircraft. While we are heavily focused on defense technology today, our ultimate mission is scaling this physical autonomous infrastructure across commercial enterprise edge applications.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: App and website developers needing passwordless sign-in (original); US defense customers such as SOCOM for autonomous drones (2026)
problem: Passwords hurt conversion for consumer apps, so Rownd sold passkey and magic link authentication. It later shifted to autonomous drones with edge AI for defense.
business_model: B2B SaaS authentication (original); defense contracts (2026)
product_category: Authentication, then autonomous drone systems
founder_names: Robert Thelen; Matt Hamann; Rachel Orrino
market_need_then: Developers wanted frictionless sign-in. A press item reports the company began as a data privacy company and pivoted to authentication after YC (GrepBeat, February 2022).
outcome_analysis: Rownd began as a data privacy company, pivoted to passwordless authentication around its YC batch, raised a $2.2M seed in late 2022 and by October 2026 was a defense drone company reportedly with a $10 million contract and a Wisconsin R&D center. The authentication market was crowded, and the second pivot suggests it found stronger demand in defense, though contract details are from single reports.

name: Ruleset
one_liner: The SaaS Decision Engine for Lenders
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote

name: SALT
one_liner: B2B Cross-Border Payment & Compliance Platform
long_description: Salt is a neo banking solution stitched together to ease payments and documentation which comes with business banking by moving it to a digital-first and automated end to end platform.
regions: India; South Asia; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Indian SMEs, startups, freelancers, agencies and consultants that receive or send international payments
problem: Receiving foreign payments in India is slow, costly and paperwork heavy; the founders describe their own bad experience with global banking as the trigger.
business_model: Transaction fee on cross-border payments plus paid compliance paperwork services (one 2021 report cites a fee of about 1.75 percent for freelancers)
product_category: Cross-border payments and compliance neobank
market_need_then: Founders cite a bad global banking experience; a 2021 launch report frames Salt as India's first cross-border banking platform for businesses, aimed at freelancers and exporters who face slow transfers and paperwork.
outcome_analysis: Salt is an active early stage company: a small pre-seed in 2021 followed by YC in Winter 2022, with a 14 person team and a product covering inward remittance and foreign investment paperwork. Public data shows no large priced round, so it is unclear whether growth has been slow or simply unreported. No shutdown, acquisition or layoff news was found. Incumbent payment firms later gained RBI approvals, which raises competitive pressure on the wedge.

name: SNAB
one_liner: A global finance automation platform for complex multi-entity…
long_description: Snab aims to automate & centralize access and management of global banking for complex business groups with multiple subsidiaries, and digitize their access to financial services.
all_locations: Madrid, Community of Madrid, Spain; Remote
regions: Spain; Europe; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Finance teams of business groups with multiple subsidiaries, banks, asset managers and private equity portfolios, mainly in Spain
problem: Groups with many entities and bank accounts manage treasury, payables and invoicing manually. Snab centralizes banking and automates finance operations.
business_model: B2B SaaS modules (accounts payable, receivables and e-invoicing, treasury, AI financial analyst)
product_category: Finance automation and treasury management
market_need_then: Founder Aguirre said in tech.eu coverage that he saw first hand the finance and treasury difficulties of businesses during his New York career. Spend data was not captured.
outcome_analysis: Snab joined YC in Winter 2022 and closed a EUR 1.1M pre-seed in February 2023 from 4Founders Capital, Glenfarne Group, Y Combinator and angels. Its site now lists bank and asset manager customers such as Banca March and Kutxabank. No later round, exit or shutdown was found, so it looks like a small steady company.

name: SOTERI SKIN
one_liner: D2C Skincare for Eczema
long_description:
Soteri Skin is D2C skincare for chronic skin conditions like eczema. We’re the only non-prescription product proven to provide long-lasting relief for the 30 million Americans who suffer from eczema.

How it works:
Skin surface pH is constantly in flux, and many of your daily activities can throw it out of balance. People with chronic skin conditions such as eczema have a harder time regulating their skin's pH. 

Soteri's patented pH/LOCK™ locks skin in at a therapeutic pH for 12+ hours, which is shown to help break the cycle of skin sensitivity, whether you have eczema, psoriasis, or just a bad sunburn.

Our formulations are aesthetically elegant (non-sticky, sit well under makeup, etc), safe for anyone to use, and don't require a prescription. Most people see skin health improvements within the first few weeks of application, even for tricky, chronic skin conditions like eczema and psoriasis.

With Soteri Skin, anyone can enjoy healthy, glowing, pH-enomenal skin!
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Consumers with eczema and chronic skin conditions, including parents buying for babies
problem: Eczema sufferers rely on steroids or generic moisturizers. Soteri sells non-steroidal creams that correct skin pH using a patented pH/LOCK complex.
business_model: Direct to consumer skincare with subscriptions (15 percent subscription discount) and some retail
product_category: Over the counter eczema skincare
market_need_then: Eczema is common and parents seek steroid-free options. The company site cites a 4 week trial of 30 participants run by dermatologists, a company claim.
outcome_analysis: Soteri Skin joined YC in Winter 2022 and sells four pH correcting eczema creams direct to consumers, with a patent claim, a small clinical trial and retail presence at Showfields. No verified funding, exit or shutdown was found, so the outcome is unknown and the stage stays early.

name: Samos Insurance
tags: Fintech; Consumer Health Services; Health Tech; Healthcare; Insurance
one_liner: Accidental Death Insurance for Surgery
long_description: Samos sells accidental death insurance for individuals undergoing surgery. Just like travel insurance but covering a hospital stay.
regions: Canada; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Canadian (later US) adults facing a planned surgery, sold through brokers and employer benefit plans, with the premium paid per procedure
problem: People going into planned surgery with no life cover, for example after leaving a job with group benefits, have no short term product that pays their family if they die from the procedure.
business_model: Insurance MGA selling one time, per procedure accidental death policies (about CA$90 to CA$150 per policy) underwritten by a partner carrier
product_category: Insurtech: surgical accidental death insurance
founder_names: Eric Blondeel; Matt Eggertson; Leon Punambolam
market_need_then: The founder's own experience of facing surgery without life cover. Samos cited consumer research in its seed announcement that three in five Canadians would buy such a product (newswire headline). Travel insurance was the analogy: a short, statistically predictable risk window.
outcome_analysis: Samos launched in March 2022 as a first of its kind surgical accidental death product, raised a US$3 million seed led by SiriusPoint in July 2022, and remains active per the YC directory. The founder's personal experience gave a clear story and the underwriting model plus carrier backing form a modest moat. A later report mentions a management shake-out at the MGA, so execution risk exists, but no shutdown or exit was found.

name: Sanifu
tags: SaaS; B2B; Analytics; Data Engineering; AI
one_liner: Automate the repetitive work spreadsheets are used for
long_description:
Sanifu automates the repetitive work spreadsheets are used for. Teams across finance, marketing, operations, and revenue simply describe their repetitive work like cleaning and validating data, matching records, preparing reports and moving data from emails, PDFs and Excel exports into dashboards and other systems. Sanifu captures the steps, rules and outputs so the work is repeated reliably every time

Some of these work never needed spreadsheets to begin with; the likes of data cleanup, bank reconciliations, report consolidation, payment allocations, channel attributions. Spreadsheets have become the standard workbench for handling these tasks and in the process, teams lose valuable time doing manual data entry, filling templates, formatting data, applying formulas, deleting rows or columns.

Sanifu is replacing the spreadsheet while maintaining the logic and processes behind the work, getting you from inputs to your desired outputs in seconds. This significantly reduces time spent on copy-paste work, spreadsheet cleanup, and manual entries and checking, while improving accuracy, consistency, and operational visibility. Sanifu helps teams scale critical back-office processes without relying on brittle spreadsheets, scripts, or general AI tools that reinvent the logic every run.

Sanifu is a full operational platform with 5k+ app integrations, 1k+ native functions, forms, scheduler, data stores, dashboards, approvals, reviews, AI-powered entity matching among many other features that make it an end-to-end data app management platform
regions: Kenya; Africa; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Finance, marketing, operations and revenue teams, and manufacturers that process orders by hand in spreadsheets and email
problem: Teams spend hours cleaning data, matching records and moving data from emails, PDFs and Excel exports into other systems, using brittle spreadsheets and scripts.
business_model: B2B SaaS platform, with an order to ERP automation product for manufacturers described by profiles
product_category: Back office automation, spreadsheet replacement and AI order processing
market_need_then: The launch post says spreadsheets, macros and scripts are brittle and general AI tools reinvent logic each run. The company later narrowed to turning emailed, WhatsApp and PDF orders into ERP entries for manufacturers. No dated 2022 evidence of demand was found.
outcome_analysis: Sanifu is active with a five person team in Nairobi after the Summer 2022 batch, and appears to have been called Patika before. It has moved from a generic spreadsheet automation pitch toward AI processing of manufacturers' orders into ERP systems. No funding beyond aggregator figures, no exit and no shutdown were found, so success or failure cannot be judged from public data.

name: Sarus
one_liner: Use personal data for analytics and ML, safely and seamlessly
long_description:
Sarus solves the problem of accessing or sharing personal data for analytics or machine learning. 
The solution deploys natively in data infrastructures and lets practitioners work on data they cannot see. Every interaction with the sensitive data is protected with the highest privacy standard: differential privacy
Sarus makes traditional anonymization methods irrelevant, saving months in compliance and data engineering while preserving all of the value of data.
regions: France; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Data teams at enterprises in finance, healthcare, marketing and the public sector that hold sensitive personal data
problem: Companies cannot easily let analysts and ML teams use personal data without long anonymization and compliance work.
business_model: Enterprise software licence deployed in the customer's own infrastructure
product_category: Privacy preserving analytics and ML (differential privacy)
founder_names: Maxime Agostini; Nicolas Grislain; Vincent Lepage
market_need_then: GDPR driven compliance cost and months of anonymization work for data teams, with differential privacy maturing as a practical technique by 2022.
outcome_analysis: Sarus had repeat founders with a prior exit to Yahoo and Verizon Media, a hard privacy technology and a 2 million euro seed in 2020 plus YC in 2022. The directory lists it as acquired but the buyer and timing are not public, so the cause and quality of the outcome cannot be judged.

name: SaveIN
one_liner: Making private healthcare in India accessible and affordable
long_description:
SaveIN connects people with quality healthcare practices near them and enables them to split their entire medical and wellness bills into monthly instalments. 

Over 80% of healthcare expense in India is borne out of pocket since less than 10% of Indians have private health insurance. On top of this medical inflation is 15% per annum, thereby making paying for private care expensive and frictional.

5000+ healthcare practices in India now use SaveIN to be discovered by millions of high intent customers near them and offer instant, monthly payment plans for all healthcare services, thereby making it a win-win proposition for all.
regions: India; South Asia; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Indian patients paying out of pocket for outpatient and elective care, and the private clinics that offer them monthly instalments
problem: Over 80 percent of Indian healthcare spending is out of pocket and few have private insurance, so elective care is hard to afford up front.
business_model: Healthcare BNPL and no cost EMI financing, earning fees from providers and lending partners, plus a provider discovery marketplace
product_category: Fintech: healthcare consumer lending and marketplace
founder_names: Jitin Bhasin; Gaurav Luthra; Anurag Varma
market_need_then: The YC page states that over 80 percent of Indian healthcare spend is out of pocket, fewer than 10 percent of Indians have private health insurance and medical inflation runs at about 15 percent a year. The April 2022 coverage reported 500 plus clinics onboarded across five cities.
outcome_analysis: SaveIN raised a $4 million seed in April 2022 right after Winter 2022, a further Pioneer Fund led seed in December 2022, and Rs 37 crore in April 2025, and reports over 5,000 to 7,000 partner clinics. The Indian healthcare affordability problem and a provider network drive its position, while BNPL rivals and lenders remain close. It is still active, though sources do not give revenue or profitability beyond a company target of break even in FY26.

name: Scout
tags: Consumer Health Services; COVID-19; Health Tech; Diagnostics; Consumer Products
one_liner: The smart testing platform that unlocks digital health at home.
long_description:
Digital health holds a lot of potential but is ignoring a growing problem: diagnostic testing. Without this data, providers and organizations will be limited in the services they can provide patients at home.

Scout has developed a platform - Hub, test kits, and app - that delivers health testing at home with 10x lower development cost and 3x lower per-test price. Our patented tech also meets performance requirements for medical diagnoses and integrates with the current healthcare tech stack. Scout’s technology is poised to disrupt the outdated $33Bn diagnostic market by democratizing testing while dramatically improving the patient experience.

Scout has received $16M in non-dilutive funding from the NIH and other organizations to fully de-risk our platform, and our pipeline includes a diverse test menu for primary care (e.g. respiratory and sexual health), wellness (e.g. gut health), and chronic conditions (e.g. certain cancers). We have already received FDA authorization for our platform in clinical settings and are planning to launch our flagship Scout Hub in 2024.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Clinics, healthcare providers and consumers who need fast molecular diagnostic tests at the point of care or at home
problem: Accurate molecular diagnostic testing is expensive to develop and run, and is tied to central labs, limiting at-home and point-of-care digital health services.
business_model: Hardware plus consumables: a reader (Hub), single use test kits and an app, sold to clinics and consumers, funded so far mainly by non-dilutive grants
product_category: Molecular diagnostics hardware and at-home testing
market_need_then: The pandemic drove demand for at-home molecular testing in 2021 and 2022, and the company says a $33 billion diagnostics market is poorly served. The NIH RADx initiative funded the COVID assay.
outcome_analysis: Scout, formerly Uh-Oh Labs, built a molecular test platform on large non-dilutive funding (the company claims 16 million dollars from NIH RADx and others) and a CARB-X award in April 2024 for an STI test. Its COVID emergency use authorization was revoked at the company's request in May 2026, reflecting the end of the COVID market. It remains active with no exit, so the outcome is still open and depends on its STI and respiratory pipeline.

name: Sculpt
one_liner: World Models for Aviation MROs
regions: India; South Asia

business_model: Enterprise software (B2B SaaS), pricing not found
product_category: AI should-cost analysis for manufacturing, later aviation MRO software

Its founder bio describes AI should-cost analysis for manufacturers while the current tagline says world models for aviation MROs, which suggests a change of focus, but no source dates or explains it. No funding, customers, website or exit were found, so no outcome judgment is possible.

name: Seabound
one_liner: Carbon capture equipment for ships
long_description: Seabound builds carbon capture equipment for ships. We're the only way for existing ships to reduce up to 95% of CO2 emissions and meet new global regulations.
regions: United Kingdom; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Shipowners and operators that must cut CO2 on existing vessels under new global regulation
problem: Existing ships cannot easily switch fuels, so shipowners need a way to cut exhaust CO2 on current vessels to meet regulation.
business_model: Hardware sales or leasing of retrofit carbon capture containers plus handling of the captured carbonate at ports
product_category: Climate hardware: onboard carbon capture for ships
market_need_then: In May 2022 TechCrunch reported six letters of intent with major shipowners and the company cited new global regulations; shipping is a large CO2 emitter with a slow fleet turnover.
outcome_analysis: Seabound raised a $4.4 million seed led by Lowercarbon in May 2022, ran sea trials on commercial ships, won UK and European grants, and completed its first full scale commercial units in February 2026 with a cement carrier customer. Regulation pushing shipping decarbonisation is the tailwind, while Wartsila and others entering in 2025 show the risk from larger suppliers. It is active and pre-scale on commercial revenue.

name: Seaflight Technologies
one_liner: We make the world's most efficient aircraft
long_description:
Seaflight Technologies has developed a new form of Aerodynamic Flow Control for electrified aircraft that increases range and payload by 30%. That's the same performance improvement you'd get from hopping in a DeLorean to 2035 and coming back with batteries from the future. But it's available today - our tech has been derisked by testing supported by the National Science Foundation, the US Air Force, and the Australian Government. 

Our first product is a simple fixed-wing large cargo drone that is efficient enough to remove the "green penalty" currently associated with electric aviation. That's a step change from today's conventional platforms.  

First generation electric aircraft are heavy, expensive, complicated, and limited in terms of range and payload. In the entire history of aviation, that's never been a winning formula. When everyone already has access to the same batteries, materials, and motors, what really makes the difference? The answer is revolutionary aerodynamics, but in a form factor that suits today's operations and manufacturing. 

Beyond our own drone product line, we have partners across Aerospace helping incorporate our tech into their products. In the future, if you want to have the most efficient and cost-effective flying machine of any description, you'll need Seaflight's Flow Control inside.
all_locations: Sydney, NSW, Australia; Torrance, CA, USA
regions: Australia; United States of America; Oceania; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Cargo operators and aerospace manufacturers wanting efficient electric aircraft, plus defence and maritime users of its drones
problem: First generation electric aircraft are heavy and have limited range and payload, creating a green penalty compared with conventional cargo aircraft.
business_model: Aircraft and drone product sales plus licensing of aerodynamic flow control technology to aerospace partners, funded largely by government grants so far
product_category: Aerospace hardware: electric cargo drones and aerodynamic flow control
market_need_then: The YC launch post argues electric aircraft lacked range and payload and that smaller wings and flow control would remove the green penalty; no dated demand evidence beyond that was found.
outcome_analysis: Seaflight pivoted from ground effect wingships to aerodynamic flow control for electric aircraft, and funds itself through grants from NSF, the US Air Force and the Australian Government. It unveiled a cargo drone in February 2026 and is active. Capital intensity and aerospace certification are the risks; equity funding is only partly known from aggregators.

name: Sei AI

business_model: Enterprise B2B SaaS of AI agents (pre-underwriting assistant, voice AI, call monitoring) on top of existing loan origination systems
product_category: AI agents for mortgage and banking operations

outcome_analysis: Sei AI is listed as active in NYC with the product and customers described on its site, but the YC record gives a founding year of 2025 against a Winter 2022 batch, so the history before 2025 is unclear and may involve an earlier product or company. No verified funding, exit or failure was found, so the outcome cannot be judged from public sources.

Our mission is to treat our customers as 1st class citizens and *end dial #2 for español*

name: Sekilo
one_liner: Building the AI powered halal protein supply chain for foodservice in…
long_description: Sekilo is building the AI powered halal protein supply chain for foodservice in Indonesia, starting with poultry. The middle downstream food ecosystem is highly fragmented, with SMEs, F&B chains, industrial buyers, and government kitchens relying on multiple vendors, leading to inconsistent quality, pricing, and fulfillment. Sekilo unifies this through an asset light operating layer that integrates procurement, processing, cold chain, and delivery into a single system, layering AI across negotiation, pricing, inventory, and demand planning to automate workflows and improve margins.
regions: Indonesia; Southeast Asia
target_customer: Indonesian foodservice buyers of poultry: catering SMEs, restaurant and hotel chains, industrial buyers, e-grocery startups and government kitchens
problem: The middle and downstream poultry supply chain in Indonesia is fragmented, so buyers deal with many vendors and get inconsistent quality, pricing and fulfillment.
business_model: Asset light poultry processing and distribution with margin on resale, plus value added services such as marination and repackaging
product_category: B2B food supply chain, halal poultry distribution
market_need_then: Fragmented Indonesian foodservice supply with inconsistent quality and pricing, per the company description. Quick commerce funding dried up in 2023, which pushed the pivot.
outcome_analysis: The company started in 2019 as Dropezy, raised about 2.5 million dollars in 2021 for dark store quick commerce, then joined YC in Winter 2022. By 2023 quick commerce funding had tightened and its dark stores were reportedly closed, so it pivoted to poultry distribution and rebranded as Sekilo in December 2023. It is still active with about 15 people, and the pivot outcome is not yet proven.

name: Selia
tags: Mental Health Tech; Consumer Health Services; Digital Health; Health & Wellness
one_liner: Selia is an online platform connecting individuals with top-quality…
long_description:
Selia Connects individuals and certified psychologists and psychiatrists with an online platform for one-on-one therapy delivered via video call. 

Selia offers convenient and affordable access to a fully-credentialed network of highly qualified providers while giving individuals self-guided tools, journaling and mood tracking to help them achieve their goals. 

We created Selia to address the unmet and growing demand for mental health services for Spanish speaking Latam everywhere.
Our business-to-consumer (“B2C”) channel, made of individual consumers who pay directly to our platform, and our business-to-business (“B2B”) channel, that consist  from start ups to enterprise clients such as Experian, Starbucks, Habi and more
all_locations: Miami, FL, USA; Bogotá, Bogotá, Colombia

business_model: Marketplace connecting users to independent specialists with per session fees (B2C) plus B2B employee wellbeing contracts
product_category: Online therapy marketplace, digital mental health

Company figures claim more than 400 thousand sessions and 700 specialists, and Valora Analitik reported 2024 revenue expectations above 4 million dollars. Funding visible in public sources is small, so growth appears to be driven largely by revenue; the long term outcome is not yet known.

name: Serif Health
tags: Health Tech; Analytics; Healthcare; API; AI
one_liner: Healthcare Price Transparency APIs and Data Products
long_description:
At Serif Health, we are taking the complexity out of the cost of healthcare. Our mission is to make healthcare pricing and contracting more transparent, easier to understand, fairer, and ultimately more affordable for all. New price transparency regulations have made a wealth of healthcare pricing and reimbursement data publicly available for the first time, but it is still extremely hard to ingest, organize, and actually use this data to understand the cost of care. That’s where we come in. Serif Health is building healthcare price intelligence data products and APIs to power the future of more transparent healthcare.

We are an early-stage, venture-backed startup with a small, collaborative team of healthcare experts, engineers, and designers. We are excited to add new team members motivated by our mission, passionate about making a difference in healthcare, and looking forward to learning and growing from the challenges we will face along the way!
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Healthcare providers, payers, benefits firms and life sciences companies that buy negotiated price and reimbursement data
problem: Price transparency rules published huge machine readable pricing files, but they are very hard to ingest, normalize and use.
business_model: Data products and APIs sold by subscription, plus bulk data feeds
product_category: Healthcare price transparency data and API
market_need_then: The CMS Hospital Price Transparency Rule (effective January 2021) and the payer Transparency in Coverage rule created large public datasets with demand from payers, providers and employers.
outcome_analysis: Serif Health built price data products on top of newly mandated price transparency files. It raised a 2.5 million dollar seed in June 2022, stayed small and capital efficient, and grew to about 25 people serving payers, providers and life sciences. In August 2026 SEVA Growth took a significant minority stake described as its first outside institutional capital, which points to a profitable or efficient path rather than repeated venture rounds.

name: Serinus Biosciences
one_liner: Combinations therapy by rational design
long_description: Serinus Biosciences is tackling one of the toughest problems in cancer treatment: creating combination therapies to override treatment resistance. We leverage cutting edge technology to design a fully explainable AI platform primed with decades of system biology knowledge. Uniquely powered for biological inference, our AI engine uncovers how cancer cells evolve treatment resistance and identifies molecules to overcome resistance escape routes. We design combinations that are safer, more effective, and can get to patients quickly. Founded by MIT PhDs and supported by a scientific advisory board of top academics from the Broad Institute, Dana-Farber, and UCSD, Serinus is powered by Y Combinator and other top investors to revolutionize precision medicine.
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; New York, NY, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Pharma partners and eventually oncology patients; revenue would come from licensing or drug development milestones
problem: Cancer cells evolve resistance to single targeted drugs, and traditional drug development is too costly for proteins that drive cancer in few patients.
business_model: Drug discovery biotech: AI platform to design combination therapies, value from licensing or partnerships
product_category: Oncology therapeutics, AI drug discovery
market_need_then: YC launch post states over 80 percent of cancer patients are ineligible for targeted therapies and that drug development costs over 2.5 billion dollars per drug, which makes small patient populations uneconomic.
outcome_analysis: Serinus is a very early AI drug discovery company from two MIT PhDs, admitted to YC in Summer 2022. Public information is thin: the website was a placeholder, no verified funding round was found, and the team was listed at 6 people. There is no evidence of failure or of a breakthrough, so the outcome is undetermined.

name: Sero

long_description: We help onboarding, implementation and professional services teams at B2B companies onboard customers faster, more consistently and more efficiently with AI agents.

business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for an AI agent assisted implementation platform
product_category: Customer onboarding and implementation software

name: Shaped
one_liner: The real-time retrieval engine for search, feeds, and agents.
long_description: Connect your data. Train your models. Query text, user or session context and retrieve relevant results in milliseconds. Explore our case studies to see how we’ve helped leading brands drive significant engagement and revenue: https://www.shaped.ai/case-study.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada

business_model: Platform subscription for recommendation and retrieval APIs
product_category: Recommendation and search infrastructure
founder_names: Tullie Murrell; Daniel Camilleri; Shai Bruhis
market_need_then: Personalization and feed ranking were costly in-house work for mid-size marketplaces; TechCrunch coverage in 2024 describes demand for self-serve alternatives.
outcome_analysis: Shaped, founded by a former Facebook AI researcher, raised an 8 million dollar Series A led by Madrona in July 2024 and was acquired by Whatnot in July 2026 for undisclosed terms. It ended as a team and technology acquisition rather than a large independent outcome.

name: Shinkei Systems
one_liner: Robots for longer-lasting, better-tasting fish at scale.
long_description:
1.2B lbs of fish are caught everyday yet as little as 1 in 3 fish make it to a plate — most of this waste arises because fish are suffocated on boats or electrocuted on farms. 

Suffocation and inaccurate electrocution create stress and so acidify meat, damage quality and significantly reduce shelf-life. 

Artisanal techniques in high-end sushi multiply shelf-life and taste but, because of the variation in fish, are difficult to perform in a mechanical fashion. 

Shinkei automates traditional techniques using robotics to provide long-lasting and delicious fish for farmers and harvesters at scale.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Fishing vessels and fish farms (supply) and retailers and restaurants buying premium fish (via its Seremoni brand)
problem: Fish killed by suffocation or electrocution are stressed, which acidifies meat, cuts quality and shelf life; artisanal ike jime fixes this but is hard to do at scale.
business_model: Robots placed on vessels at no charge, with the company buying the fish at a premium and selling it through its own distribution brand
product_category: Seafood robotics and distribution
market_need_then: Large losses in fish quality and shelf life from conventional killing methods as stated by the company; premium Japanese style quality demand in sushi.
outcome_analysis: Shinkei automated ike jime fish handling with a robot. After YC in Winter 2022 it launched the Seremoni brand in October 2022, signed its first customer LocalCoho, and raised a 22 million dollar Series A in June 2025 led by Founders Fund and Interlagos, with 30 million total reported. It has grown to about 80 people, so it is a hardware company that found traction with a vertically integrated model.

name: Shipmates
one_liner: Shipping platform for online merchants in the Philippines
long_description:
Shipmates is a shipping platform that enables online business owners to book on-demand and standard orders using multiple couriers in the Philippines. An alternative to the hassles of manual booking and shipping. Shipmates helps e-commerce businesses grow by making their shipping process easier and faster.

Launched in 2021, Shipmates was engineered to simplify logistics and scale businesses by allowing business owners to book shipments in bulk from different couriers in just a few clicks. Users have the option to connect their Shopify website to our platform or upload their orders using an excel file. Shipmates is currently in partnership with six couriers: Lalamove, Borzo, Grab, XDE, Entrego, and J&T as we work on adding more courier options. The platform also allows for nationwide shipping, Cash on Delivery and free courier pick-ups for the convenience of business owners.

We believe that online businesses deserve more support for shipping which is why we built solutions through continuous product development and simplicity in design.
regions: Philippines; Southeast Asia; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Online sellers and small e-commerce merchants in the Philippines
problem: Merchants book deliveries manually across several couriers, which is slow and makes rate comparison hard.
business_model: Per order booking fee on a multi courier shipping aggregator (30 cents per order per TechCrunch)
product_category: Logistics aggregator for e-commerce shipping
market_need_then: E-commerce boom in the Philippines during the pandemic, with fragmented couriers and cash on delivery needs for small sellers.
outcome_analysis: Shipmates launched a beta in August 2021, joined YC in Summer 2022 and raised a 2.2 million dollar seed in September 2022 from regional investors. Its website now shows service discontinued, while the YC directory lists it as active and no shutdown reporting was found, so the cause and timing of any wind down are not public. The aggregator model faced courier networks that could offer similar tools.

name: Sieve
tags: Developer Tools; Video; Data Labeling; Data Engineering; AI
one_liner: The multimodal data lab
long_description:
Sieve builds the data and environments frontier AI labs use to train the next generation of multimodal systems.

AI is moving beyond chatbots into video, audio, images, software, robotics, and interactive worlds. The next generation of models will need to understand how the world looks, sounds, moves, responds, and changes over time. Progress is bottlenecked by one thing: high-quality data.

Sieve brings together exabyte-scale infrastructure, novel multimodal understanding techniques, large-scale sourcing, and deep research partnerships to create datasets and environments with unmatched precision, quality, and speed. This has earned the trust of frontier AI labs, Fortune 100 companies, and fast-growing AI startups working on generative media, robotics, computer use, world models, and agentic systems.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Frontier AI labs, Fortune 100 companies and AI startups buying multimodal training data; originally developers who needed video search and editing APIs
problem: Progress on video, audio, image and world models is bottlenecked by high-quality multimodal data. At founding the problem was that developers found it hard to search and process large amounts of video.
business_model: Usage-based video AI API at launch, later custom dataset and environment sales to AI labs
product_category: Multimodal data and video AI infrastructure
market_need_then: Developers wanted to search and edit video with a few API calls, as the Launch HN thread of early 2022 framed it. Spend and complaint data were not found.
outcome_analysis: Sieve launched in early 2022 with a developer video API and raised an announced seed of about four million dollars in November 2022. Its YC page now shows 34 people and a repositioning toward data for frontier labs, which suggests the video API market was too thin and the team found demand in training data. Customer claims are the company's own and revenue is not public, so the success of the pivot is unverified.

name: Siftly
one_liner: Get your brand discovered and recommended by ChatGPT
long_description:
Siftly helps brands measure, improve, and scale their visibility inside AI assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity.
We track how your brand is surfaced, compared, and recommended and give you actionable insights to win AI-driven discovery.
Think of it as SEO for the AI era, built for B2B, B2C, D2C, and e-commerce growth teams.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Growth and marketing teams at B2B, B2C, D2C and e-commerce brands wanting visibility in AI assistants
problem: Brands do not know how ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity describe or recommend them and cannot easily improve it.
business_model: SaaS subscription with a free plan and four published tiers (per company site)
product_category: Generative engine optimization (GEO) / AI search visibility
market_need_then: Unknown for the 2022 product. Current demand: customer case studies on the company site and a Maruti Suzuki incubation selection in June 2026.
outcome_analysis: Siftly joined YC in Winter 2022 and is still listed Active, with a small team. Its current GEO product fits a fast-growing 2025-2026 category, and it was one of five startups picked for Maruti Suzuki's incubation program in June 2026. Its early history, funding and traction are not documented in reliable sources, so whether it succeeded is unproven; it is alive and finding customers on the evidence available.

name: SigmaMind AI
tags: SaaS; B2B; Call Center; AI; Conversational AI
one_liner: Voice AI platform purpose-built for contact centers.
long_description: SigmaMind AI is a platform for building voice AI agents purpose-built for call centers. Our agents make and answer calls for lead generation, appointment setting, follow-ups, collections, customer intake, and basic support. Instead of replacing the phone systems a center already uses, we connect on top of them. Because the AI handles many calls at once, a call center can reach far more people than a human team, lower its cost per lead, and stop wasting agent time on calls that go nowhere. Our customers are usually non-technical operators running centers with 25 or more agents, with the strongest traction in insurance, home services, solar, and lending.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Contact centers with 25 or more agents, mostly in insurance, home services, solar and lending; at the YC launch, Shopify brands handling support tickets
problem: Call centers waste agent time on calls that go nowhere and pay high cost per lead. At launch the problem was repetitive customer support tickets for e-commerce brands.
business_model: Usage-based voice and chat AI agents (Gorgias listing shows pay as you go per conversation)
product_category: Voice AI agents for call centers
market_need_then: E-commerce support volume and repeat tickets were a known cost center, shown by Gorgias raising $30M to build automation in 2022.
outcome_analysis: SigmaMind joined YC in Summer 2022 with a support-ticket automation product and later repositioned as a voice AI platform for contact centers with about 12 staff. Public data is thin: no press coverage of funding, acquisition or shutdown was found, so how well the voice pivot worked is unknown. A Deepgram case study snippet claims about a million voice agent calls per month, which is unverified.

name: Signatur Biosciences
one_liner: Simple tests for complex diseases.
long_description: We make precision diagnostics more accessible, starting with breast cancer prognosis. Current tests that guide the use of therapy are really slow and expensive because they need to be run in complex centralized facilities. Our tests are designed to be easily run by local hospital labs, reducing turnaround time from over three weeks to a few days and for a fraction of the price.
regions: United Kingdom; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Hospital and local clinical labs running qPCR, starting with breast cancer prognosis
problem: Breast cancer prognostic tests are mostly processed in specialised US labs at high cost with turnaround of up to three weeks. Signatur wants to run them locally in a few days at lower cost.
business_model: Diagnostic test kits sold to labs (per test)
product_category: Molecular diagnostics, PCR-based prognostic tests
competitors_at_founding: Oncotype DX, Prosigna, EndoPredict, Breast Cancer Index and MammaPrint
market_need_then: Existing tests are costly, centralised and slow, with turnaround up to three weeks per the 2025 seed announcement, and Wallonia, Innovate UK and SBRI support is shown on the company site.
outcome_analysis: Signatur spun out of Imperial College bioengineering work, joined YC in Summer 2022 and raised a reported seven million dollar seed in May 2025 led by the Discovery Lab of IBA. The test is still in development, so the long regulatory and validation path is the main risk and no revenue is shown. Grants from UKRI, Innovate UK, SBRI and Wallonia are shown on the company site.

name: SilkChart

one_liner: AI Sales Assistant to increase playbook adoption and win more deals
long_description: SilkChart analyzes sales calls and measures how well playbooks are executed. It proactively surfaces coaching opportunities to managers, and provides reps with actionable feedback to close more deals.
