It is still active with about eight people, and its site shows startup logos such as Ramp and Rippling but does not say they pay. Revenue and later rounds are not public.

name: SimpleHash
tags: Developer Tools; SaaS; Crypto / Web3; NFT
one_liner: Multi-chain token data platform
long_description:
SimpleHash allows developers to query all blockchain data from a single platform. We index multiple blockchains, take care of edge cases, and can be integrated in a few lines of code. We make the lives of developers working with token data easier by abstracting away all the complexity.

We serve some of the leading names in crypto, including Coinbase, Phantom and Uniswap. We're growing quickly, are well-funded, and have an ambitious vision to organize the world of digital assets.

Join us if you're excited by a high impact role on a lean, fast paced team at the forefront of the revolution in digital assets.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Crypto wallets, exchanges and dapps that need NFT and token data across chains
problem: Developers had to integrate and maintain separate indexers per blockchain to get token and NFT data.
business_model: Usage based API subscription
product_category: Multi-chain token and NFT data API
market_need_then: The 2021 NFT boom and rapid growth of new chains created demand from wallets and marketplaces for unified token data.
outcome_analysis: SimpleHash won blue chip crypto customers such as Coinbase, Phantom and Uniswap with a multi-chain data API and was acquired by Phantom in February 2025, after which the public API was shut down. The exit looks like a strategic acquisition of a lean, well used infrastructure product.

name: Simplifyd Systems
one_liner: We deliver toll-free internet apps
long_description:
Simplifyd enables businesses deliver their internet apps (websites/mobile apps) data-free, similar to toll-free telephone lines. We do this through our Zerodata app

Founded in August of 2021 and based in Lagos, Nigeria and Nairobi, Kenya, Simplifyd through its Zerodata platform is a trusted marketplace for data-free internet apps. 

Businesses list their internet apps (websites/mobile apps) on the Zerodata platform so end users can access them data-free!

End users simply need to download the Zerodata app, available for both mobile and desktop, toggle on and enjoy access to listed apps data-free!

We are on a mission to make apps accessible to over ~2B people in emerging economies who simply cannot afford the costs of internet data subscriptions.
all_locations: London, England, United Kingdom; LA, Nigeria
regions: United Kingdom; Nigeria; Europe; Africa; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Businesses and app makers in emerging markets who want users to access apps without paying for mobile data; later cloud hosting customers in Nigeria
problem: Many people in emerging economies cannot afford data subscriptions, so they cannot use websites and apps. Simplifyd lets businesses cover the data, like a toll-free phone number.
business_model: Businesses pay for user data access (toll-free internet) and, later, usage-billed cloud hosting
product_category: Toll-free internet apps and cloud hosting
founder_names: Tomi Amao; Sam Keiru; Mayowa Amao; Abiola Fajimi
market_need_then: Data affordability limited internet use in emerging economies, though a Nigeria survey cited found zero-rating awareness low and local data fairly cheap.
outcome_analysis: Simplifyd raised a half million dollar pre-seed from Future Africa and YC in March 2022 and launched Zerodata. The current site is a usage-billed cloud in Nigeria with Zerodata as a feature and no named customers, suggesting a widening from toll-free apps toward infrastructure. No later funding or customer metrics were found, so traction is unknown.

name: Skillza
one_liner: Skillza builds simple tools for teachers and schools in MEA
long_description:
Skillza works with schools, teachers, students, and their parents in the Middle East and Africa to build tools to maximize learning outcomes.

We help today's teachers to integrate new technologies into their classrooms to improve the learner-centeredness of their classrooms.

Our flagship product Quest is a tool that helps teachers and schools to simplify the process of creating and managing assessments. Teachers create and distribute assessments as well as measure and manage student performances in seconds saving them hours everyday to allow for them to focus on what they do best - teaching.
all_locations: Dubai, United Arab Emirates; Cairo, Cairo Governorate, Egypt; Riyadh, Riyadh Province, Saudi Arabia; Remote
regions: United Arab Emirates; Egypt; Saudi Arabia; Middle East and North Africa; Remote; Fully Remote

name: SkyLink
one_liner: Travel Management Meets AI
long_description:
SkyLink is transforming corporate travel into a hassle-free, efficient experience. By integrating advanced route optimization and reducing the need for traditional travel agents, we're not only saving companies millions but also simplifying the travel process. 

With SkyLink, employees can effortlessly book their travel, just like sending a Slack message. Trusted by leading global corporations, our platform acts as a pocket-sized travel agent, ensuring smart, cost-effective travel decisions and a smoother journey for everyone involved. 

SkyLink is where simplicity meets innovation in corporate travel.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Corporate travel buyers and travel management companies, with employees booking through Slack, Teams or email
problem: Corporate travel booking is slow and agent dependent; employees want to book as easily as sending a chat message while staying within company policy.
business_model: B2B SaaS for companies and travel management companies
product_category: AI corporate travel booking agent
market_need_then: Corporate travel managers and travelers disliked clunky booking tools and agent dependence in the post-2020 recovery; no specific dated spend figures were found in the sources reviewed.
outcome_analysis: SkyLink built an AI chat based corporate travel booking agent, raised a seed of about $4M after YC in 2022, won travel management company partners such as BCD Travel in 2025 and enterprise customers, and was acquired by Amadeus in February 2026. The conversational AI wave made its wedge valuable to incumbents, who chose to buy rather than build; price is undisclosed.

name: Slauth.io
tags: Developer Tools; DevSecOps; Productivity; Compliance; Security
one_liner: The IAM Policy Copilot
long_description: Slauth.io generates and rightsizes IAM policies in order to save engineering time and secure the organization. We use PR's to suggest what good functional and secure IAM policies should look like and integrate with IaC (Terraform)  to have a seamless end-to-end IAM policy creation and deployment. Save hundreds of DevOps engineering time each year and increase your security to scale faster.
all_locations: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
regions: Israel; Middle East and North Africa; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Slidely AI
one_liner: AI for professional PowerPoint presentations, available in PowerPoint
long_description:
Create new slides or upgrade existing ones with AI that works natively inside PowerPoint and stays true to your company’s branding, templates, and standards.

How Slidely AI is different -

1. Works directly in PowerPoint
Native PPTX support — no HTML-to-PPT hacks, exports, or broken layouts.

2. Improves slides you already have
Because it understands real PowerPoint files, Slidely AI can rewrite, redesign, and tighten existing decks — not just generate new ones.

3. Agentic, consulting-grade output
Unlike other tools which can only use simple templates, Slidely AI agent puts each shape individually on slides to express your complex data.

4. Truly on-brand, every time
Learns from your past decks to follow your colors, fonts, layouts, and slide patterns — so every slide looks like it came from you, not a generic AI tool.
regions: India; South Asia
target_customer: Professionals and companies that build PowerPoint decks and need brand-consistent slides
problem: Making professional slides that follow company templates and branding takes hours; general chat tools do not edit native PowerPoint files.
business_model: B2C and team SaaS subscription (third-party listing shows Pro at $16 per month billed annually, unverified)
product_category: AI presentation copilot inside PowerPoint
market_need_then: Slides are a universal office task, and later tools proved heavy demand, but 2022 evidence for demand specific to this team was not found.
outcome_analysis: Slidely AI, legally Tersho, Inc., came out of YC in Summer 2022 and has raised only small sums, mainly a Wefunder crowdfunding round around April 2023. It has about 5 people, a PowerPoint add-in, and a crowded field including Microsoft Copilot, so growth looks capital-light but unproven. No acquisition, shutdown or revenue data was found.

name: Slingshot
one_liner: Analyze medical records in seconds
long_description:
Slingshot is AI  that analyzes medical records to determine if the diagnosis is supported by the clinical evidence.

The company is founded by Pranov Duggasani, a former Google and Microsoft AI engineer, and Zoe Holderness, a former Lyft and Tesla engineer. They started working on Slingshot after facing their own frustrations with inflated and erroneous medical bills with the goal to save patients more money with less work.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Self-funded employers and payment integrity teams at payers that pay medical claims
problem: Medical bills and records contain coding errors, upcoding and unsupported diagnoses, and patients or plan sponsors lack the time and expertise to audit them.
business_model: Success fee as a small percentage of savings, later AI software for payment integrity teams
product_category: Healthcare AI, medical bill and record auditing
market_need_then: Founder experience of an erroneous bill plus a widely cited belief that many US claims contain errors; the Alaffia coverage in 2022 cites an estimate that about 80 percent of claims have at least one error.
outcome_analysis: Slingshot joined YC in Summer 2022 with a four person team and a consumer and employer medical bill audit product, later describing itself as AI that checks whether diagnoses are supported by clinical evidence. YC lists it as acquired, but no acquirer, date, price or funding round beyond YC and Pioneer Fund as investors was found, so the outcome cannot be explained further.

name: SmartHelio
tags: Solar Power; Climate; Enterprise Software; AI
one_liner: Software to prevent downtime in a solar plant
long_description:
SmartHelio provides a software that helps solar utilities automatically predict and prevent downtime disruptions. We help solar utilities to generate extra $200k per plant income on $10k spent using our software, by preventing 700 faults per year.

We have a platform which reads live data (current, voltage, weather parameters) from a solar plant, runs algorithms to decouple various factors for the underperformance and provides recommendations to fix it. This data is 100% available for the large scale solar in the world just using software (e.g. APIs). 

Product launch: https://www.producthunt.com/posts/heliocloud

Our cloud software is being used by 40+ leading solar developers in Europe and Asia. We have analyzed 25+ billion of  data points from over 3 GW of solar assets spread across the globe in the last 2 years.
regions: Switzerland; Europe
target_customer: Solar plant owners, developers, asset managers and operators
problem: Solar plants lose output to hidden faults and degradation; operators lack tools to isolate causes of underperformance and prevent downtime.
business_model: B2B SaaS and per-plant analytics subscription
product_category: Predictive analytics for solar plants
market_need_then: Solar capacity was growing fast, and the 2020 Swiss funding report framed demand for diagnostic and prescriptive tools to extend plant lifespan.
outcome_analysis: SmartHelio began in Switzerland in 2019, raised a small Swiss round in 2020 and a five million dollar seed in December 2022 around its YC batch. Its site claims 8 GW under management, but those figures are unverified, and the YC page cites 3 GW and 40 developers. Further grants are reported by aggregators. With 25 staff and no exit, it looks stable with modest capital.

name: SnapTrade
one_liner: Plaid for trading
long_description: SnapTrade is an API to connect retail brokerage accounts to any fintech app. We enable API access to real-time account data, historical transactions, and trading. This makes it possible to build new investing experiences with existing brokerage accounts, so users don't need to transfer and it's easier to get started.
regions: Canada; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Fintech and investing apps that need to connect users' retail brokerage accounts for data and trading
problem: Bank-focused aggregators offer limited investment support and no trading, so developers cannot easily read or trade in users' existing brokerage accounts.
business_model: Usage-based API (per connected user)
product_category: Brokerage account aggregation and trading API
market_need_then: The seed announcement said 20+ investing apps already used SnapTrade and that the parent Passiv had run a consumer app for five years to learn developers' needs.
outcome_analysis: SnapTrade is the B2B product of Passiv, a Fredericton fintech founded in 2017, and it reached YC in Winter 2022 after Passiv's consumer app taught it what developers needed. It raised a 2.2 million dollar seed in October 2022 and grew to 17 people, and reports that it facilitated data access for over a million accounts in 2025. Later investment from TLT East Ventures was undisclosed.

name: Solum Health
one_liner: AI Automation for Therapy Practices
long_description:
Turning therapy admin chaos into automated calm—VoiceAI for intakes, seamless prior auths, referral and scheduling management.

Built by practice owners, for practice owners (www.getsolum.com).
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Outpatient therapy practices (ABA, PT, speech, OT), imaging centers and revenue cycle teams that pay for admin automation
problem: Therapy and outpatient practices lose staff time to intake, insurance verification, prior authorizations, referral faxes and scheduling.
business_model: B2B SaaS for practices, pricing not public
product_category: Healthcare administrative automation with a voice and workflow AI agent (Annie)
market_need_then: Momentu launch post cites that 75 percent of Latin American employees face a mental health challenge while under 25 percent get support. The therapy admin need behind the later Solum product is stated by the company, not independently measured here.
outcome_analysis: Solum is active with a team of three and named customers in ABA and physical therapy. It entered YC as Momentu in S22 and appears to have pivoted into therapy practice automation about two years later, with the founder drawing on his own practice. Funding beyond YC is not verified, so the stage and runway are unknown. The space is crowded with practice management suites adding AI prior authorization.

name: Sonnet
one_liner: Meeting notes and CRM, automated
long_description:
Sonnet is an end-to-end meeting assistant, combining a human-quality notetaker with an auto-updating CRM.

Our AI notetaker uses the most powerful AI models to transcribe, summarize, and generate notes for your meeting recordings. With Sonnet, collaboration and recollection is both faster and better. 

Sonnet CRM updates itself automatically using conversation data, so you'll never have to wrangle with CRM fields again. Get up to speed on the context of an entire relationship, in seconds.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Soon
one_liner: Automated sweep account, invest without the stress of speculating
long_description:
With Soon you can invest without the stress of speculating. Our fully automated sweep account attaches to your bank and uses routine spending activity to signal market trades.
By investing on a schedule and selling available gains when you spend, Soon automates investing from beginning to end. No investing experience required, no need to time the market, just connect Soon to your spending account and build wealth.
all_locations: Salt Lake City, UT, USA; Remote
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Retail consumers who want hands-off investing tied to their spending
problem: Everyday people find investing decisions and market timing stressful, so they do not invest or buy and sell badly.
business_model: Consumer subscription, plans from 19.99 to 159.99 USD per month per the company site
product_category: Automated investing and spending-linked sweep account (consumer fintech, crypto exchange connected)
market_need_then: Utah Business in 2022-04 describes a first quarter 2022 market drop and founders who found investing hard after using Robinhood and Coinbase. Consumer demand is evidenced only by founder statements.
outcome_analysis: Soon is still listed as active with four people and a small angel round. It remains a thin consumer fintech with a generic name against well funded incumbents, and its current site frames it as a crypto automation tool rather than the original sweep account. No shutdown or acquisition was found, and later rounds are not found, so its trajectory is unclear.

name: Sophys
one_liner: AI Agents for Healthcare Intake
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Wellness platforms, mental health apps, coaching services and healthcare intake teams that embed AI chat and voice agents
problem: Care and wellness providers spend staff time on patient intake and between-session support that conversational agents could handle.
business_model: Custom AI agent development and deployment for B2B platforms, pricing not public
product_category: Conversational AI agents for healthcare intake and wellness
market_need_then: Healthcare intake funding in 2022 (DexCare 50 million USD in January, Health Note 17 million USD in July) signals investor demand, but no direct customer evidence for Sophys was found.
outcome_analysis: Sophys is a one person company listed as active, with the current site pitching custom AI agents to wellness and mental health platforms rather than clinical intake. No funding beyond the YC deal, named customers or press was found, so traction is unknown. Rivals in intake raised much larger rounds during 2022. The record shows a solo technical founder with a clinical research background and an unproven market position.

name: Sota2
tags: B2B; Sales Enablement; Enterprise Software; AI
one_liner: Help business find and discover AI solutions
long_description: Sota2 is Yelp for AI products. We help companies find and compare best AI solutions for their businesses using reviews, benchmarks, and compar tools.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Businesses choosing AI software, plus AI vendors who want ranked listings
problem: Buyers cannot easily compare the growing number of AI products for a given business task or industry.
business_model: Directory and ranking site; revenue model not stated (site says rankings are never paid for and invites vendors to claim profiles)
product_category: AI product directory and ranking platform
market_need_then: In early 2022 the AI product market was small, so demand for a dedicated AI buyer directory was unproven. No dated demand evidence was found.
outcome_analysis: Sota2 is active with four people and operates a ranking directory of more than 3,500 AI products, a shift from the original Yelp for AI reviews pitch toward evidence scored rankings. Funding beyond YC is not found and the founders' other projects (AgentDiscuss, Wizwand) suggest a portfolio approach. Traction and revenue are unknown.

name: Spade
tags: Fintech; Machine Learning; Payments; Data Labeling; AI
one_liner: Spade is the data and AI platform for modern finance.
long_description: We take messy transaction data and turn it into structured, verified records — with a platform, models, and tooling that help our customers use it everywhere it matters.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Card issuers, banks, neobanks and fintechs that pay for verified merchant data on transactions
problem: Raw card and bank transaction strings are messy, so issuers cannot reliably tell who and where a payment was with, which hurts fraud decisions, rewards and customer service.
business_model: API and data platform sold to financial institutions (usage and contract based, pricing not public)
product_category: Transaction enrichment and merchant intelligence data platform
founder_names: Oban MacTavish; Cooper Hart; Tess Bloch
market_need_then: Fintech and issuer demand for merchant enrichment was visible by 2021 through startups such as Heron (2020) and Ntropy, and issuers needed better data for fraud and rewards. Direct demand metrics at 2021 were not found.
outcome_analysis: Spade is a growth stage company of about 30 people that raised a 5 million seed from a16z in 2023-02, a 10 million Series A in 2023-12 and a 40 million Series B in 2026-03. Its hand labeled merchant database, API partnerships such as Stripe and named customers like Mercury and Bilt support its position, and the company reports 470 percent year over year growth. Rivals Ntropy and Heron offer enrichment, so the data moat is the key variable.

name: SpadeWorks
one_liner: AI agents that turn every call into revenue for trade businesses
long_description: Spadeworks transforms how trade contractors handle customer service through AI agents that work 24/7. We answer every call, schedule every job, send every reminder, and follow up with every customer - turning missed opportunities into booked revenue. Trade businesses grow faster because they never miss a lead again.
regions: India; South Asia; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Small and mid-sized trade contractors and home service businesses that depend on phone leads
problem: Contractors miss calls while on jobs and lose leads, and traditional call centers are expensive and lack trade knowledge.
business_model: B2B SaaS for contractors, pricing not public
product_category: AI voice and front desk agents for trade businesses
market_need_then: The YC launch post says contractors lose revenue when they cannot answer calls during jobs. Independent demand measures for 2022 were not found.
outcome_analysis: SpadeWorks is listed as active with 13 people in Hyderabad and a current pitch of AI agents for trade contractors, which is a product framing shaped by the 2023 to 2025 wave of voice AI. Funding beyond the YC deal is not found, so runway and traction are unknown. The category became crowded with AI receptionists, and no outcome news was found.

name: Speechly
one_liner: Natural Language Understanding API for Speech that runs on device
long_description:
Speechly makes it cost efficient to understand human conversations, in real-time. We do this by enabling high-accuracy spoken language understanding processed right on the end user’s device.

Hundreds of millions of hours of audio data are generated every single day online. Speechly is the first solution that can affordably turn this audio into actionable insights.
regions: Finland; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Developers and companies adding voice interfaces and spoken language understanding to apps
problem: Understanding speech in real time with cloud APIs is costly and slow; Speechly offered high accuracy spoken language understanding processed on the end user's device.
business_model: Usage-based developer API and SDK
product_category: Speech recognition and natural language understanding API
market_need_then: Rapid growth of voice interfaces and audio content; the YC page cites hundreds of millions of hours of audio produced daily with no affordable way to turn it into insight.
outcome_analysis: Speechly raised a small seed in December 2019, joined YC in Winter 2022 and was acquired by Roblox in September 2023 for total consideration of about 10.1 million dollars, with 4.8 million paid at closing and the rest held back. The value was its on-device speech technology and team, repurposed for voice chat moderation, a technical exit rather than a venture scale outcome.

name: Sphere
one_liner: AI-powered sales tax, VAT and GST compliance
long_description:
Sphere is an AI-powered cross-border compliance platform. 

We help companies like Lovable, Eleven Labs, Replit and Windsurf automate their sales tax, VAT, GST compliance obligations. 

What makes us different to other vendors on the market is: 

1. we have spent the last 1.5 years building local rails into 100+ tax authorities in both the US and internationally to properly automate compliance processes, and 
2. we've built the world's first AI-native tax engine which ingests, codifies and monitors tax law globally.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Global software and AI companies, billing and commerce platforms and accounting firms that need cross-border sales tax, VAT and GST compliance
problem: Companies selling across borders must register, calculate, file and remit indirect tax in many jurisdictions, and legacy vendors rely on manual research and partners.
business_model: B2B SaaS and managed compliance for indirect tax, pricing not public
product_category: AI native cross-border tax compliance platform
market_need_then: The marketplace had enough traction to raise a 4.3 million seed, but its tax liability on gross merchandise value is what the founder says exposed the tax compliance need that became the later product. Direct demand evidence for the tax product at founding is not applicable.
outcome_analysis: Sphere entered YC as an edtech marketplace, nearly shut down, and then rebuilt itself in 2023 as a cross-border tax compliance vendor serving fast growing AI companies. After about two years in stealth it announced a 21 million Series A led by a16z in 2025-11. The pivot drew on the CEO's own marketplace tax pain, and competition from Anrok, Avalara and Fonoa remains intense.

name: Spinach AI
tags: SaaS; Productivity; AI; Conversational AI; AI Assistant
one_liner: The System of Record for Conversation Data
long_description: Backed by Y Combinator, Zoom and Atlassian, Spinach AI is the system of record for conversation data. Industry leaders like Abnormal AI and eToro use Spinach to capture and transform raw conversations into structured knowledge that powers people, agents, and LLMs across the enterprise, driving productivity for workers and strategic insight for leaders.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Engineering and product teams, then enterprises that want meeting and conversation data captured and structured
problem: Agile teams waste time in daily standups and meetings, and the knowledge in conversations is lost instead of becoming tickets, updates and structured data.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription per seat or team, pricing not verified
product_category: AI meeting assistant and conversation data platform
founder_names: Matan Talmi; Yoav Grossman; Josh Willis
market_need_then: TechCrunch in 2022-08 framed the daily standup of agile engineering teams as the focus, a recurring meeting pain. Demand evidence beyond the launch coverage was not found.
outcome_analysis: Spinach launched as a standup tool, raised a 6 million seed in 2022-08 led by Atlassian Ventures with Zoom Ventures participating, and broadened into an AI meeting assistant and enterprise conversation data product with SOC 2 and HIPAA claims. It remains active at about six people with no later rounds found. The category is crowded with Otter, Fireflies and native Zoom and Teams features, so the strategic backers matter.

name: Spot Health
one_liner: At-home diagnostics as a service
long_description: Spot is building the infrastructure to support the future of at-home diagnostics. Our fully white-labeled platform helps brands offer lab-analyzed diagnostic tests using at-home collection kits. Companies simply order tests via our API, and we handle the rest—the collection kits, the logistics, physician authorization, and the lab integrations.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Telehealth, wellness and digital health brands and health systems that want to offer lab-analyzed at-home tests
problem: Brands wanting to sell at-home diagnostics must assemble kits, logistics, physician authorization and lab integrations themselves.
business_model: B2B usage-based API, per test kit
product_category: At-home diagnostics infrastructure (white-label API)
market_need_then: Growth of telehealth and direct-to-consumer health brands in 2021 created demand for at-home testing, per the company's own positioning. No dated spend figures found.
outcome_analysis: Spot appears to be a small active B2B diagnostics infrastructure company that sells white-label at-home test kits through an API. Public sources show no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs, and a job listing claims tens of thousands of kits shipped, though undated. Funding is unclear, with aggregators showing about 600 thousand dollars in total, so the outcome is still open.

name: Sprites
one_liner: The proactive agent that achieves growth goals for businesses, fully…
long_description:
Sprites is a proactive agent that achieves growth goals for businesses fully autonomously, starting with performance marketing. 

Today, Sprites manages $30M of annualized growth spend for 50+ businesses in a self-improving loop. Sprites has grown 5x this quarter with customers including Gameloft, Klarity Health, Hyperice, and leading AI labs.

You give it a growth goal and a budget - like "Book me demoes with PMs at AI startups for up to $500 per demo" or "Get me trial sign ups from UGC video creators, up to $50 per sign up". It does the work. Every week it gets better at your business.

Teams use it instead of hiring an agency or a growth team.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Startups and small marketing teams that buy paid ads and SEO
problem: Running performance marketing across ad platforms needs agencies or growth hires.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for an autonomous marketing agent
product_category: AI marketing agent (paid ads, SEO)
market_need_then: The YC page describes 50 plus businesses and 30M annualized spend managed (company claim, current). Need at the 2022 batch date is not documented.
outcome_analysis: Sprites is an active AI marketing agent whose YC page claims 50 plus customers and 30M of annualized spend under management. The record is unclear on its history since the YC page lists founded 2025 against a Winter 2022 batch, and no outside funding was verified. It is therefore hard to say whether it succeeded, so the story is open rather than a result.

name: Stably AI (Orca)
tags: Developer Tools; SaaS; DevOps; Web Development; AI
one_liner: We make Orca, MIT open source terminal-based agent orchestrator
long_description:
Orca is an ADE built for engineers who run 10 to 100 coding agents at once. Termina-based. Any coding agent. Bring your own subscription (Claude Code, Codex etc). Mobile app included. Browser, CUA, Mobile emulator, and other. Minimal yet powerful.

Includes CLI to let agents control it

https://github.com/stablyai/orca
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Engineering teams (testing agent) and individual engineers running many coding agents (Orca)
problem: Hand-written end-to-end tests are costly to write and maintain; engineers running many coding agents need an orchestration environment.
business_model: B2B SaaS (Stably testing, starter plan) plus free MIT open source Orca
product_category: AI testing agents and agent development environment
market_need_then: Not documented for 2022. The launch post claims customers replaced six figure outsourced QA contracts (company claim).
outcome_analysis: Stably is an active developer tools company that sells an AI end-to-end testing agent and also ships the open source Orca agent environment. Verified funding is limited to an undisclosed Vercel Ventures investment in August 2025, with aggregators disagreeing on seed amounts. Its path appears to be steady and product led, but the outcome is not yet clear.

name: Stackshine
tags: Robotic Process Automation; Productivity; Analytics; Enterprise; Data Engineering
one_liner: Automating all IT operations
long_description: Stackshine is creating mission control for enterprise IT teams. We discover all the software being used across their organization and then automate workflows related to onboarding/offboarding, cost savings, and security.
all_locations: Portland, OR, USA; Providence, RI, USA; Remote
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: IT and finance teams at companies that need to track SaaS spend and usage
problem: Companies lose track of the software employees use, which drives wasted spend, slow onboarding and offboarding and security gaps.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription
product_category: SaaS management and IT operations automation
market_need_then: Rising SaaS sprawl and per employee tool counts created demand for visibility; sources found do not give spend figures.
outcome_analysis: Stackshine entered YC in Winter 2022 as mission control for enterprise IT and was acquired in August 2023 by LeaseQuery, which wanted a SaaS spend management product, with terms undisclosed. Little is public about traction or funding, so the story is a small team exit about 18 months after the batch rather than a documented venture result.

name: Stackup
tags: Developer Tools; SaaS; Crypto / Web3; B2B; Open Source
one_liner: Stackup helps businesses manage their crypto assets.
long_description: Stackup is transforming how businesses manage their on-chain operations by offering a smart account platform designed to simplify and automate complex blockchain tasks. As the need for seamless, secure, and efficient crypto transactions grows, Stackup provides centralized control over decentralized assets, allowing businesses to take charge of every detail of their operations with ease. Our platform integrates advanced security and adaptive features to eliminate the chaos of traditional crypto wallets, empowering businesses to manage their crypto stack in real-time. Whether you’re orchestrating large-scale transactions or ensuring complete transparency, Stackup’s solution brings order and precision to blockchain management—turning crypto chaos into structured, seamless business flow.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Crypto companies and businesses managing on-chain payments and treasury
problem: Businesses operating on blockchains lack spending controls, approvals and compliance in wallets.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for smart account platform (earlier: infrastructure for wallets)
product_category: Crypto smart account and treasury platform
market_need_then: Pain in 2022 centered on wallet usability, per Stackup's own posts. Spend figures not found.
outcome_analysis: Stackup started as a wallet infrastructure provider for ERC-4337 account abstraction with Coinbase and Trust Wallet as clients, then walked away from that business in November 2024 to build a business on-chain operations platform. It raised a 4.2 million dollar seed in June 2025 led by 1kx. The company is still small with four people and the outcome is open.

name: StafBook
one_liner: Rippling for Southeast Asia
long_description:
StafBook help SMEs  to simplify HR & expense management.

With StafBook, business managers can manage the People administration starting from HR (onboarding, leave & attendance, payroll, until off-boarding) and also expense management (reimbursement, cash advance). Thus, people can save their time on administrative task, and focus on core business
regions: Indonesia; Southeast Asia; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Indonesian SMEs
problem: SMEs handle HR administration, payroll and expense reimbursement manually.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription HRIS
product_category: HRIS and expense management
market_need_then: Jakarta Post (Jan 2022) described HR tech in Indonesia as nascent but attracting funding, indicating demand among SMEs.
outcome_analysis: StafBook is an active Indonesian HRIS for SMEs that claims 100 plus customer companies on its site. No verified funding, exit or shutdown was found, and aggregators only show a small seed of about 500 thousand dollars. It faces funded local incumbents such as Mekari Talenta, so the story is of a small steady business with unknown growth.

name: Stairs Financial
one_liner: Find a home you can actually afford
long_description: Stairs helps young Americans buy their first home. Our home search identifies homes based on their finances, and connects them to government grants, loans and tax breaks.

name: Strac
tags: Generative AI; SaaS; Security; Enterprise; AI
one_liner: Data Discovery, DLP, DSPM for SaaS, Cloud, Gen AI & Endpoints
long_description:
Strac is an agentless Data Discovery (aka DSPM - Data Security Posture Management), Data Classification & DLP (Data Leak Prevention) that automatically discovers, classifies and remediates sensitive data (alert, label, redact, mask, block, delete). 

Strac protects SaaS, Cloud, Gen AI, Browsers, On-Prem and Endpoints like O365, Slack, GDrive, AWS, Salesforce, ChatGPT, Jira, Mac, Zendesk, Azure, On-Prem (On-Prem, MS SQL SAP) and 40+ integrations. 

Strac protects enterprise companies like UiPath, Databricks, thredUP, B Capital, Crypto (dot) com!
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Security and IT teams at SaaS-heavy companies (customers listed include UiPath, thredUP, Databricks) that pay for data loss prevention and data discovery
problem: Sensitive customer data such as personal and payment information leaks into SaaS tools like Slack, Zendesk and Google Drive; Strac finds and redacts it automatically.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription, agentless API-based integrations
product_category: Data loss prevention and data security posture management
market_need_then: Data privacy rules (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, PCI DSS) and growing SaaS sprawl created need; the founder cites his own compromised Social Security number in 2020, and TechCrunch (2022-07) reported dozens of customers and 22 percent monthly revenue growth.
outcome_analysis: Strac raised a 3.5M seed in July 2022 after YC W22 and has stayed independent, expanding from redaction into DSPM and AI data governance with recognizable enterprise customers. Strong founder credentials and regulation tailwinds helped, while crowded DLP competition from Microsoft and well-funded rivals remains the main risk. No later round was confirmed.

name: Stream
one_liner: The AI Claims Workbench automating insurance claims
long_description: At Stream, we’re on a mission to modernize the insurance industry. Our product—the Stream AI Claims Workbench—uses custom AI agents to turn a constant stream of PDFs into automated workflows and high-value signals. This helps claims teams focus on the human work—getting people the medical treatment they need and the benefits they’re owed—while reducing costs for insurance companies.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Workers' compensation insurance carriers, claims administrators and independent medical evaluators that pay for software; State Compensation Insurance Fund (California) is a named customer
problem: Workers' comp adjusters handle about 140 cases each and spend most of the day on phone calls, faxes and unstructured notes; Stream automates document review and claim workflows.
business_model: B2B SaaS to insurance carriers and IMEs
product_category: Insurtech claims automation and medical document review
market_need_then: Launch post cites manual claim handling, about 5 business days to respond to injured workers, and over a third of workers' comp claims in CA and FL being litigated, with attorney involvement raising cost about fivefold.
outcome_analysis: Stream is active and raised a 5.3M seed in October 2024 led by Spark Capital, with a prior smaller raise reported, and won State Fund as a customer. Founders came from Next Insurance and Liberty Mutual claims work, and generative AI made document review feasible. Competition from other AI medical record startups is real and no later round was confirmed.

name: Strong Compute
one_liner: 10x-1000x faster compute for Neural Network training
long_description: Strong Compute is building the future of Cloud Computing, priced by performance not consumption. Our software and hardware optimizations speed up neural network development 10x-1000x, file transfer 1000x, instance start time 10x.  We're starting with AI and are aimed at the $500B cloud market.
all_locations: Merritt Island, FL, USA; Sydney, NSW, Australia
regions: United States of America; Australia; America / Canada; Oceania; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Teams training neural networks (vision startups, research labs, enterprise AI groups) that spend heavily on GPU compute
problem: Neural network training pipelines waste GPU and CPU time on bottlenecks; the company claims 10x-1000x speedups and wants cloud compute priced by performance rather than consumption.
business_model: Cloud compute and training-optimization platform priced by performance (software plus hardware optimizations)
product_category: AI/ML training infrastructure

name: SubscriptionFlow
one_liner: AI based Customizable Subscription & Revenue Management Platform
long_description:
SubscriptionFlow is an AI-based customizable revenue management platform that helps SMBs optimize subscription revenue. It monitors user activity to identify customers at risk of churning and automatically alerts the sales team.

For example, eLearning/SaaS/Membership businesses require to monitor subscription usage to improve customer retention. Ecommerce/Magazine companies need to see the subscription trends to cross-sell and upsell products/services.
all_locations: London, England, United Kingdom; San Francisco, CA, USA
regions: United Kingdom; United States of America; Europe; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Small and mid-sized subscription businesses (eLearning, SaaS, membership, magazines, gyms) that pay for billing and revenue management software
problem: SMBs with subscriptions struggle to bill, track churn risk and cross-sell; SubscriptionFlow offers customizable billing with AI alerts for at-risk customers.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for billing and revenue management
product_category: Subscription billing and revenue management

outcome_analysis: SubscriptionFlow is still active as a small company but shows no confirmed outside round after YC W22. It entered a market with established billing vendors, and self-reported estimates suggest revenue near 1.5M in 2025, down from 2.4M in 2024. It adds AI features, yet no breakout growth is documented.

name: Suggestr
one_liner: Amazon-level personalization for Shopify merchants
long_description: Suggestr is a self-serve, no-code personalization solution for the 20M+ e-commerce brands that sell on platforms like Shopify. Marketplaces like Amazon drive up to 30% of their sales from personalized surfaces (recommendations, bundles, frequently bought together, et cetera). They have large data science teams that build such in-house recommendation engines. However, DTC brands can't afford to do this, and they don't have enough customer data to make the conventional recommendation approaches work. Suggestr uses innovative multi-modal AI technology that sees and understands products (needs 100x less data), allowing it to work with brands of all sizes (SME, mid-market, enterprise). The solution takes less than 30 minutes to integrate and helps merchants increase online store revenues by up to 10% with AI-driven upsells and cross-sells.
regions: Singapore; Southeast Asia; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Sunlight
one_liner: The intelligence and execution layer for agentic B2B card payments.
long_description:
Sunlight moves B2B payment volume onto card without asking a single supplier to onboard. Our AI agents determine where a bill can be paid by card without a surcharge, then execute that payment through the vendor's own billing or AR portal, returning a confirmed status, receipt, and structured remittance data through a single API.

For decades, moving invoice spend onto card meant building a rail or signing suppliers up one at a time. Both are slow, and both leave most of the volume behind. Sunlight takes a different path. Because our agents pay through the portals suppliers already use, the network reaches every supplier without any of them having to join it.

AP platforms and bank card programs issue their own cards, send them to us, and capture the interchange on volume that would otherwise have defaulted to ACH or check. We are the AI infrastructure layer that makes that volume reachable.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Fintechs, banks, card issuers and B2B payables platforms that want to convert ACH and check payments into card payments
problem: Many suppliers accept cards but payments run through manual portals or are assumed to carry surcharges, so card revenue is missed; Sunlight's agents detect acceptance and execute card payments in supplier portals.
business_model: API / usage-based infrastructure sold to B2B payment platforms (agentic portal payments, card-on-file updates)
product_category: B2B payments infrastructure (AI agents for card payments)
market_need_then: Card-on-file updates and B2B card acceptance were described by the company as missed revenue for card issuers and payables platforms; no dated 2021-2022 evidence of demand was found beyond the YC listing.
outcome_analysis: Sunlight is a six-person Summer 2022 company that began as a card-on-file API and now sells AI agents that execute B2B card payments in supplier portals, with fintech customer logos on its site. No funding round, revenue or customer count has been confirmed, and aggregator data shows only a $500K convertible note. It is too early and too opaque to call an outcome, so no success or failure factors are asserted.

name: TAI

name: TYBR Health
one_liner: Natural hydrogel to keep internal organs scar-free after surgery
long_description: TYBR is developing a hydrogel to limit internal scarring after surgery. The naturally derived material is applied to coat tendons at the end of surgery to improve healing outcomes for the millions Americans who undergo tendon or ligament surgery each year.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Orthopedic and hand surgeons and the hospitals or surgery centers that buy surgical biologics for tendon, ligament and muscle repair
problem: Internal scarring and adhesions after tendon or ligament surgery restrict motion and worsen recovery. Existing barriers are hard to shape and wrap around tendons.
business_model: Medical device sold to surgical sites per procedure (flowable ECM based gel, B3 GEL System)
product_category: Surgical biologic, anti-adhesion tissue protection gel

It moved from an NIH funded ECM spray concept to an FDA 510(k) cleared B3 GEL System in June 2025, reported first US clinical use in January 2026 and raised a $30M Series A in July 2026. Success to date rests on deep scientific founders and a regulatory milestone rather than traction, since commercial sales only began around the end of 2025. No acquisition, layoffs or shutdown were found.

name: Tailor
tags: Developer Tools; SaaS; B2B; API; Enterprise
one_liner: Headless ERP for retail operations
long_description:
Tailor is the headless ERP that gives fast-growing retail brands a composable, API-first platform to run operations with speed, flexibility, and control.

🧱 Legacy ERP is too rigid: Systems like NetSuite and SAP take months (or years) to implement and break with every change. Tailor is modular, headless, and easy to adapt.
🧩 Point solutions don’t scale: Tools like inventory or order management software solve one problem, but can’t talk to each other or keep up with growth.
📊 Spreadsheets are everywhere: From demand planning to purchase orders, even $100M+ brands still rely on Excel. Tailor replaces duct-taped workflows with ops modules you can tweak, combine, or scale
⚡️ Complex workflows need custom logic: Whether it's multi-location inventory, DTC + B2B orders, or light manufacturing (like kitting or lot tracking), Tailor supports flexible automations out of the box.
👟 Operators can move faster: Launch backend modules in minutes, not months. Tailor's low-code tools let teams build, automate, and adapt without waiting on engineering or implementation agencies.


Built for composable retail:
- Headless backend with GraphQL APIs
- 50+ integrations (Shopify, QuickBooks, 3PLs, etc.)
- Custom automations via Pipelines, Functions, and Event Triggers
- State machines for approvals and multi-step workflows
- AI features like OCR and vector search built in

Tailor is already powering operations at fast-growing omnichannel brands and modern manufacturers.
We’re proud to be the first Japan-based company to join Y Combinator. 

Learn more at [tailor.tech](https://www.tailor.tech)
regions: Japan; East Asia; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Fast growing retail, ecommerce and omnichannel brands and modern manufacturers that outgrow spreadsheets or rigid ERP suites
problem: Legacy ERPs such as NetSuite and SAP are slow to implement and hard to customize, while point solutions do not talk to each other. Tailor offers a headless, API first ERP backend.
business_model: B2B SaaS platform with implementation and enterprise contracts (pricing not published)
product_category: Headless composable ERP platform
market_need_then: TechCrunch (September 2022) reported that Japanese enterprises faced high maintenance costs and slow development, and the company claimed about 70 percent of Japan's software spending goes to custom builds. Legacy ERPs were described as built for the largest organizations.
outcome_analysis: Tailor is active and grew from 10 employees in 2022 to about 40 on the YC page, with a US launch in 2023 and a Series A in 2025 that the company puts at $37 million total. It benefited from serial founders with retail tech exits and from incumbent ERPs described as rigid. No shutdown, acquisition or layoffs were found. Revenue and customer counts are not public.

name: Take App

Our technical co-founders, Rubén, Vladimir, and Sebastián, bring vast HR industry experience. HoyTrabajas is supported by Rebel Fund, Alan Rutledge, Kube Ventures, Flucas VC, Magic Fund, New Ventures, Y Combinator (w22), and more.
