problem: Accounts payable and procurement staff manually read, match and validate vendor invoices before posting to the ERP.
business_model: B2B SaaS and services for AP automation
product_category: AI agents for accounts payable and procurement
founder_names: Luciana Reznik; Nico Magni; Guido Marucci Blas
market_need_then: In 2023 Cedalio pitched a verifiable data layer for apps as an alternative to Firebase and Supabase, a thin demand signal. The later AP need is regional and invoice driven.
outcome_analysis: Cedalio began as a decentralized Firebase alternative, moved to sustainability traceability and then to AP automation for Latin American enterprises, with named customers such as Banco Galicia per its own site. Funding is thin and unverified, and repeated pivots suggest the earlier markets did not pull, though the AP product may have found traction.

name: Cedana
tags: Deep Learning; Developer Tools; Cloud Computing; Infrastructure; AI
one_liner: Fast, reliable, reproducible AI with GPU live migration
long_description:
Cedana (YC S23) brings hyperscaler and frontier-lab orchestration capabilities for AI workflows. Our core capability is live migration for CPUs and GPUs workloads. This increases cost savings up to 80%, accelerates time to first token 2-10x, and enables stateful reliability of training jobs even through catastrophic GPU failures. We've integrated our solution into K8s, and support Kueue and Slurm for training distributed jobs, and Kserve for serving inference.    

OpenAI, Meta and Microsoft have flavors of these capabilities internally and we’re bringing them to everyone. 

Our vision is to transform cloud compute into a real-time, arbitraged commodity. 

https://www.cedana.ai
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: AI inference providers, neoclouds and research computing teams running GPU workloads on Kubernetes and Slurm
problem: GPU workloads cannot be paused and moved, so cold starts, node failures and idle capacity waste expensive compute.
business_model: Open source CLI plus managed enterprise service
product_category: GPU and CPU live migration infrastructure
market_need_then: Demand for GPU efficiency rose with the 2023 generative AI boom and GPU scarcity. The company claims up to 80 percent cost savings.
outcome_analysis: Cedana is a small, deeply technical YC S23 team with an AWS Marketplace listing and a pitch to inference providers and neoclouds, still hiring in 2026. No verified round beyond YC was found, so traction is unclear, and larger vendors including NVIDIA moved into checkpoint and restore for GPUs.

name: Cembla
one_liner: AI for legal & government
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Legal teams and government agencies
problem: Legal and government work involves large volumes of text that is slow to tag and review.
business_model: API and software, pricing not found
product_category: AI for legal and government
market_need_then: General purpose LLMs were costly for tagging at scale, per the founders' launch post.
outcome_analysis: Cembla is active with a team of two and no public funding, press or customers found. The YC page bios and launch post describe a text tagging product called Taylor, and how it relates to Cembla is unexplained, so the trajectory is unclear.

name: Cercli
one_liner: AI powered HR and Recruitment for people teams
long_description: Cercli is the AI native platform for businesses to hire and manage their workforce.
regions: United Arab Emirates; Middle East and North Africa; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Small and mid-sized employers in the Middle East and North Africa that need HR, payroll and recruiting in one system
problem: MENA companies run HR, payroll and hiring across disconnected tools, with local payroll and compliance rules that global suites handle poorly.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for ATS and HRIS, plus payroll, contractor payments and employer of record services
product_category: HR and recruiting platform with AI agents
market_need_then: MENA SMEs were moving off spreadsheets and global suites. Regional press framed the company as a Rippling for MENA, and a regional HR software market was estimated at 5.8B USD in company press.
outcome_analysis: Cercli is active and raised a 4M seed in September 2024 and a 12M Series A in October 2025. Founders with Careem and Kitopi operating experience and a regional gap in AI era HR software explain the traction, though the Series A was post batch and the company remains early against established regional rivals.

name: Certainly Health
one_liner: Marketplace to book doctors and avoid surprise bills
long_description: Patients enter their insurance and visit reason, and we use machine learning to predict and guarantee their out-of-pocket costs for every health provider.  For health providers, we ensure their patients always pay the bill.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Insured patients booking doctor visits, and providers who want guaranteed payment
problem: Patients get surprise bills because out-of-pocket cost is unknown at booking, and providers struggle to collect patient balances.
business_model: marketplace with provider-paid booking fees and guaranteed patient payments
product_category: healthcare booking marketplace with cost prediction
market_need_then: The No Surprises Act took effect in 2022 and surprise billing was a visible public pain point at the time.
outcome_analysis: Certainly Health raised a 2.3M seed in December 2023 after the batch, with the founders bringing Uber Health experience. The company website now redirects to certainlyglow.com, which suggests a change of business or brand, but no source explains it, so the outcome is unclear and no failure is claimed.

name: Chart
one_liner: Realtime Access to Verified Tax Records
long_description: Chart's Unified Tax Record API provides a direct bridge to tax records from the IRS, state tax agencies, and major tax preparation platforms such as TurboTax and H&R Block.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Fintechs, lenders and banks that need verified tax records for income verification
problem: Lenders and fintechs need verified income data, but obtaining IRS and tax software records is slow and manual.
business_model: usage-based API
product_category: tax records API
market_need_then: Lenders already paid for IRS transcript retrieval through IVES with multi-day turnaround, and real-time income verification was a gap.
outcome_analysis: Chart is active with a product and customer logos, but no funding or exit was found in public sources, so the trajectory is unknown. Team listings show a single founder and a tiny team, and no verified round exists.

name: Chatter
tags: AIOps; Developer Tools; Generative AI; SaaS
one_liner: Dead simple LLM testing and iteration
long_description: Chatter is Postman for LLMs. Our platform helps companies and developers test their LLM models. Iterate on prompts, run them across model families and evaluate them against test cases – all in one place. With collaboration features, engineers can design LLM chains while QA can write test cases.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Engineering and QA teams building products on LLMs
problem: Teams had no structured way to test and iterate on prompts across model families. Chatter offered prompt chains, automatic evaluations, versioning and sharing, described as Postman for LLMs.
business_model: B2B SaaS with a free playground and paid plans
product_category: LLM testing and evaluation tooling
market_need_then: In 2023 companies shipping LLM features lacked tooling for prompt iteration and regression testing, and spending on LLM development was rising.
outcome_analysis: Chatter was a two person Penn team in YC Summer 2023 selling LLM prompt testing. YC lists it as acquired but no buyer, date or price appears anywhere I could find, and funding is only on aggregators. The market filled with funded competitors and platform features, so the exit looks like a small team or product pickup whose terms are not public.

name: CheqUPI
one_liner: India's first UPI wallet for foreign nationals and NRIs
long_description:
Cheq is a modern UPI payments app for NRIs and international citizens visiting India. 
Using Cheq, you can pay digitally at over 55mn+ merchants across India. 
We help tourists avoid ATMs and minimize their foreign exchange costs while in India.
all_locations: Bengaluru, KA, India; San Francisco, CA, USA
regions: India; United States of America; South Asia; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Foreign tourists and NRIs visiting India who want to pay by UPI
problem: Visitors to India relied on ATMs and costly foreign exchange. Cheq let them load a UPI wallet with international cards and pay at merchants.
business_model: Consumer wallet earning forex and payment fees
product_category: Fintech UPI wallet for inbound travellers
market_need_then: RBI allowed foreign nationals and NRIs to use UPI in February 2023 and tourists faced ATMs and forex fees, with inbound travel recovering after the pandemic.
outcome_analysis: Cheq launched in 2021 and joined YC in Summer 2023 after RBI opened UPI to visitors, and raised about $500,000 from Y Combinator. YC lists it as acquired, but no acquisition report was found and the app store listing still shows an operating wallet, so the exit is unverified. NPCI and banks moved into the same inbound traveller wedge in 2023 and 2024, which pressured a standalone wallet.

name: Chima
tags: Developer Tools; Generative AI; SaaS; B2B; AI
one_liner: Building infrastructure tools to help large companies customize their…
long_description: Companies struggle to customize their generative AI models by taking advantage of their existing customer and enterprise data, in real-time. Chima solves for this through a sleek, interoperable layer before the standard generative AI models are applied.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Large enterprises adopting generative AI
problem: Companies struggle to customize generative AI models with their own customer and enterprise data in real time.
business_model: enterprise software sold as AI agents and infrastructure
product_category: enterprise generative AI agents and middleware
competitors_at_founding: Other YC W23 generative AI enterprise startups
market_need_then: Enterprises were rushing to adopt generative AI after ChatGPT in late 2022 and wanted to use their own data.
outcome_analysis: Chima is active and now markets enterprise AI agents with security certifications and case studies with named customers, but no funding round could be verified and its self-reported profit claim is unaudited. The original middleware idea faced rapid substitution from model vendors, and the later shift to agents is undated.

name: Choppy!
tags: Consumer; Climate; Food Tech; Food & Beverage; Consumer Products
one_liner: FAST FLAVORFUL PROTEIN
long_description:
Keto friendly, flexitarian entrees made from plant protein combined with pure beef fat, collagen, and broth. Full of authentic flavor and ready in four minutes, Choppy! is better for you AND the planet. 

The company was founded by Stanford mechanical engineers Saba Fazeli and Brice Klein:

-Saba was the first R&D engineer at Beyond Meat where he developed and scaled all of their textured proteins.
-Brice was the fourth engineer at vertical farming company Plenty where he led the commissioning of their new, multi-million dollar farm.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Chow Central Inc
tags: Consumer; Restaurant Tech; Food; Food & Beverage
one_liner: Asset Light Chipotle for Africa
long_description:
Chow Central is building technology to disrupt the food industry in Nigeria. The goal is to profitably provide food to as many people as possible in record time. 

Chow Central has launched its first product "500chow". A delivery-only quick service restaurant that serves customers in record time. 500chow has 10x lower costs than traditional brick-and-mortar restaurants, and 10x more online orders. 

Our customers love us for our super fast and cheaper deliveries. We are able to do this by launching hyper-locally within a 3km radius.

We are very focused on solving real problems in the food industry one scalable product at a time.
regions: Nigeria; Africa; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Millennial and Gen Z diners in African cities, starting in Lagos
problem: Restaurant chains in Nigeria are hard to scale because of rent, kitchen build-out and fragmented supply.
business_model: owned restaurant brands using an asset light central kitchen and rented commercial kitchens, with delivery-only and dine-in formats
product_category: restaurant chain and cloud kitchen operator
founder_names: Tosin Onafuye; Christopher Obasi; Adeyemi Onafuye
market_need_then: Launch post reports over 80K USD monthly revenue, a company claim.
outcome_analysis: Chow Central is active in Lagos with reported revenue from its batch launch, but public funding and later outcome data were not found. Nigerian food peers faced layoffs and restructuring in 2024, and no company specific news exists for Chow Central.

name: Clad
one_liner: Billing and project management for utility construction
long_description:
Clad is billing and project management software for utility construction.

The world is rebuilding its internet and power networks. The utilities, internet companies, and contractors tasked with this work face immense pressure to deliver.

But their tools haven’t caught up. Contractors struggle to grow, constrained by cashflow. Operators fly blind, lacking real time visibility into issues. 

Clad unifies project operations and finance to automate project tracking, payments, and permitting.

With Clad, contractors grow faster and improve their margins. Operators execute smoothly. And everyone can focus on what’s most important - building.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Utility and telecom construction contractors and asset owners such as fiber operators
problem: Contractors track field work and bill customers manually, causing inaccurate invoices and cash flow gaps.
business_model: B2B SaaS
product_category: construction project management and billing software
market_need_then: Utility contractors rely on manual billing, and fiber construction spending was large.
outcome_analysis: Clad is active with a named customer list claiming over 500M USD of construction powered, a company claim, and a team of about 7 to 12. No verified funding or exit appears in public sources, so its trajectory beyond the batch is unknown.

name: Clearest Health
tags: SaaS; Health Tech; B2B; Healthcare IT; AI
one_liner: AI revenue recovery for underpaid healthcare claims.
long_description: Clearest Health is an AI-enabled revenue recovery platform for independent healthcare practices with underpaid out-of-network claims. Through verified IDR benchmarks, claim analysis, and audit-ready dispute support, Clearest helps providers strengthen No Surprises Act appeals and recover revenue that might otherwise be written off.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Independent healthcare practices with underpaid out-of-network claims
problem: Practices are underpaid on out-of-network claims and lack the tools to pursue No Surprises Act arbitration.
business_model: revenue recovery platform and managed IDR services, likely success based
product_category: healthcare revenue recovery
market_need_then: The No Surprises Act IDR process opened in 2022 and later volume reached 2.6M disputes in 2025 per Georgetown, a later fact.
outcome_analysis: Clearest Health is active with 11 employees on the YC page, but no verified funding or company news was found. Its market of IDR disputes grew sharply and attracted lawsuits against heavy filers, which adds regulatory risk, though no company specific outcome is known.

name: Clearspace
one_liner: Less screen time, more life.
long_description: Giving families their time back with tools to understand and control how their time is spent online.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Individuals and parents who want to cut compulsive phone use; consumers pay via in-app subscription, later a family-focused offering
problem: People lose hours to compulsive phone use and built-in screen time tools are easy to bypass. Clearspace adds friction and blocking so users can control how time is spent online.
business_model: Consumer mobile subscription with free tier and in-app purchases
product_category: Consumer screen time and digital wellbeing app
market_need_then: Widespread public concern about phone addiction after the pandemic. The founder says the app grew from his own struggle, and the first users came from the App Store organically.
outcome_analysis: Clearspace is still active and has not reported an exit or shutdown. It entered YC in Winter 2023 with an App Store consumer app, and sources suggest steady press, and a later move toward family products and an agent based intentionality layer in 2026. Funding is not verified beyond a single aggregator figure, so its trajectory cannot yet be judged against outcomes.

name: ClickPe
one_liner: Finance on a Click
long_description:
Small shop owners earn daily unlike salaried people but when it comes to loan repayment both are asked to pay monthly. For these shop owners it is difficult to calculate how much to save daily so that they will have the required installment amount at the end of the month and also at the time of repayment they have a big hole in their working capital.

Therefore, when you earn daily why not pay daily and get away from the stress of huge one-time installments. 

Every day a small amount of $X is deducted from your digital wallet which is on the auto-debit mandate and you don't need to worry about keeping your balance of $XXXX. You never default and also good credit scores are created.
regions: India; South Asia; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Small shop owners and micro-businesses in India with daily income, and lenders who collect daily
problem: Borrowers earn daily but repay monthly, causing cash gaps and defaults; daily auto-debit repayments smooth this.
business_model: Lending marketplace earning commissions from banks and NBFCs (current model)
product_category: Fintech lending marketplace (originally DailyPe)
market_need_then: Daily-income merchants repay monthly loans, with pain visible in the YC launch post; India had many daily repayment lenders by 2022, indicating real demand.
outcome_analysis: ClickPe began as DailyPe, a daily repayment loan marketplace for shop owners, and joined YC in Winter 2023. It remains active and now markets a wider loans, cards and savings marketplace through regulated lenders; one aggregator claims about $2M revenue by September 2025, which is unverified. No shutdown, layoffs or acquisition were found. Confidence in success factors is limited.

name: Cloudchipr
one_liner: The #1 Actionable FinOps Platform
long_description: Cloudchipr is an actionable FinOps platform that keeps multi-cloud spend under control 24/7 with AI agents.
regions: Germany; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Engineering and finance teams at startups and mid-market companies running AWS, GCP and Azure
problem: Cloud bills are opaque and wasteful, and most tools only report spend. Cloudchipr aims to let teams find waste and act on it with automated workflows.
business_model: B2B SaaS, freemium with paid tiers
product_category: FinOps and cloud cost optimization
market_need_then: Cloud overspend was a widely discussed cost problem in 2022 and 2023 as budgets tightened; the FinOps Foundation practice was growing.
outcome_analysis: Cloudchipr remains active with a team of about 25 per YC and shows named customers and a SOC 2 badge on its site. Raised only small disclosed capital (pre-seed around April 2023), so it looks capital efficient but unproven at venture scale. Funding history beyond the pre-seed is unclear.

name: Clueso
tags: Generative AI; SaaS; B2B; Customer Success; Enterprise
one_liner: Create beautiful videos & docs for any product or process in minutes
long_description: Clueso is the fastest and easiest way for companies to generate high-quality instructional videos and documentation, ideal for customer education/onboarding and employee training. Our AI transforms simple screen-recordings into studio-quality videos and step-by-step documentation in minutes.
regions: India; South Asia
target_customer: Product, customer education, training, marketing and IT teams at software companies, including enterprises such as Atlassian and Zendesk per a founder post
problem: Making and updating instructional videos and help documentation is slow and expensive, so product walkthroughs go stale.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription: free tier, Solo from 40 USD per month, Business from 120 USD per month billed annually, custom enterprise
product_category: AI video and documentation creation
founder_names: Akash Anand; Neel Balar; Prajwal Prakash
market_need_then: Software teams needed product videos and help docs for onboarding and training; the company reports 1M+ videos created in six months and 1000+ organizations, self reported.
outcome_analysis: Clueso, a Winter 2023 YC company from IIT Madras founders who earlier built Desklamp, raised a 1.4M seed in April 2024 and a 10M Series A led by Dharana Capital in October 2026 with all prior investors returning. Reported near 100 percent enterprise retention and 1000+ customer organizations are company claims. Growth is supported by enterprise security certifications, but competition from Scribe, Guidde, Loom and AI video tools is heavy.

name: Coba
one_liner: Dual Currency Accounts For LatAm
long_description:
Coba makes it easy for Mexican knowledge workers employed by US companies to earn in US Dollars and seamlessly spend locally in Pesos.

On average, a knowledge worker will lose $1,000 per year in hidden ForEx and transfer fees. In that process, their money will touch at least 3 different accounts adding time and steps along the way. These workers’ require more than simple money movement, they demand a financial solution that addresses their specific needs: banking, saving, spending - all in two currencies.

Coba allows its users to not only deposit and save their earnings in a US account, but also access critical financial services at home in Mexico - from a local credit card to integrated bill pay. With Coba, remote workers can live across two currencies... efficiently and effortlessly.
all_locations: Monterrey, N.L., Mexico; Austin, TX, USA
regions: Mexico; United States of America; Latin America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Originally Mexican knowledge workers paid in USD by US employers; later US-Mexico businesses, especially freight and logistics
problem: Remote workers in Mexico lose money to hidden FX and transfer fees across several accounts. Coba offered a dual currency account to earn in USD and spend in pesos.
business_model: Fintech account and cards with FX and transfer fees; later cross-border payments infrastructure for businesses
product_category: Cross-border fintech, dual currency accounts
founder_names: Carlos Alberto Medellin Gonzalez; Abraham Kuri Vargas; Eduardo Lopez De Leon
market_need_then: Mexican professionals paid by US firms face FX spreads and multi-hop transfers; the company cites about $1,000 per year lost to hidden fees.
outcome_analysis: Coba raised a $2.2M seed in February 2024 after YC Summer 2023 and remains active. Later profiles describe a move from a consumer account to B2B cross-border payments for freight, suggesting the consumer wedge was narrow while neobanks expanded in Mexico. No later round was found, so it is early and still unproven.

name: Cobblestone
one_liner: Delinquency reduction and automation software for institutional…
long_description: We're building software to help institutional landlords reduce delinquency starting with fraud reduction.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Institutional residential landlords and property managers

name: Cognitio Labs

one_liner: AI back office for food product quality teams
long_description:
CoAsync by Cognitio Labs is the AI back office for product quality compliance teams.

We help mission-critical food manufacturers automate repetitive, document-intensive workflows.

We started with Certificates of Analysis (COAs), one of the many workflows quality teams manage before products can ship. Today, this work is still performed manually across PDFs, emails, spreadsheets, and disconnected ERP systems. 

Other documents we help quality teams respond to 24x7 include supplier audit questionnaires, production schedules, lab reports & changes in product specifications and quality records.

CoAsync automates the workflow by:

Reading supplier documents
Extracting laboratory data
Validating product specifications
Applying compliance requirements
Drafting compliant COAs
Organizing audit-ready documentation

Results from one of our initial deployments with a mid-market food processor:

85% less QA administrative work
4× more COAs processed per shift
1-2 hours saved per document
New product onboarding in under one day

COAs are just the beginning. Our vision is to build the AI back office for product quality and compliance across regulated industries by automating the many document-intensive workflows manufacturers manage every day.

Backed by Y Combinator and leading investors. Founder Diva Avaya Sharma has presented example AI workflows for product quality and compliance through the World Economic Forum Centre for Advanced Manufacturing and Supply Chains' SmartStart initiative and at the International Telecommunication Union's AI for Good Global Summit, organized in partnership with the United Nations.

Know a company shipping food & product urgently? Help them get started with their own document workflows at https://cognitioiq.com
regions: United States of America; America / Canada

name: Coldreach
tags: Generative AI; SaaS; B2B; Sales; AI
one_liner: Find the best leads with custom intent signals
long_description:
Coldreach helps sales teams find ready-to-buy leads, by monitoring public signals *custom* to your product. 

For example, it can find who's hiring their first accountant, so an accounting automation product can hit them with a targeted message at the right time. 

Public data sources (job postings, news articles, 10-k reports, etc.) tell a lot about a company’s priorities and the problems it faces. We train AI sales agents to monitor them and find who needs your help and why. Sales teams know who'd thank them for a cold email/call now, and can sound relevant without hrs of manual research. 

Typically, targeted outreach yields 2-8x higher booking rate compared to random outreach.


**Example intent signals we track**:
- Bookkeeping automation product: Monitor who starts to hire human to manually enter invoices
- Compliance product: Monitor who recently onboarded a new Compliance Analyst
- CRM integrations: Monitor who starts to hire engineers experienced in Salesforce API.

name: DAGWorks Inc.
tags: AIOps; Developer Tools; Generative AI; Open Source; AI
one_liner: Open source tools & services for reliable AI Agents & AI Applications
long_description:
We’re on a mission to enable everyone to build reliable AI agents & AI applications. We're fully open source, and provide a unique integrated development & observability experience for those building anything in the AI space. This is the first step towards laying the foundations for Composable AI Systems; all AI systems need observability and introspection to be first class for them to be reliable.

How? We're standardizing how people write python to express data, ML, LLM, & agent workflows/pipelines/applications with lightweight frameworks. So that no matter the author, it'll be easy to collaborate, connect, and importantly in one line integrate observability and datastore needs. This speeds up time to production and reduces TCO because code remains easy to maintain and your data flywheel stays manageable. So you can increase the top line & bottom line of your business by delivering on AI that is reliable.

We've got two open source projects:
- one focused on AI applications, called Burr (https://github.com/dagworks-inc/burr).
- one focused on AI pipelines/workflows, called Hamilton (https://github.com/dagworks-inc/hamilton) see https://www.tryhamilton.dev

Both Hamilton & Burr come with self-hostable UIs (+ enterprise & SaaS offerings). With a one-line code change, you get versioning, lineage / tracing, cataloging, and observability out of the box with Hamilton. With Burr you get tracing, observability and persistence in a single line addition.

market_need_then: Data and ML teams were struggling with sprawling pandas and feature engineering code, and demand for LLM application tooling rose in 2023. Hamilton had public conference talks in 2022 at PyData NYC and PyData Global.

Rhombus already used the product to track cloud costs per camera and customer, so the deal looks like a customer buying a tool it depended on rather than a venture scale exit. Terms were not disclosed.

name: DataShare
one_liner: Embed charts, dashboards and exports in your app
long_description: DataShare is a data-as-a-service platform that lets you embed charts, dashboards and exports directly into your product. For example, if you run an accounting startup, DataShare would enable you to embed a full profit and loss dashboard, with downloadable statements. DataShare is backed by an enterprise-grade data warehouse, and can be implemented in fewer than 20 lines of code.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: SaaS product teams that want customer-facing charts, dashboards and exports inside their app
problem: Building embedded analytics and export features in-house is slow. DataShare offers a hosted warehouse and embeddable components implementable in under 20 lines of code.
business_model: B2B SaaS, likely usage or seat based (pricing not found)
product_category: Embedded analytics
market_need_then: SaaS companies commonly need customer-facing reporting and export features. Evidence of specific demand for DataShare in 2023 was not found.

name: DataSuite
tags: Developer Tools; Generative AI; Machine Learning; DevOps; AI
one_liner: Dataset Management for AI Trainers
long_description:
DataSuite provides a way to manage and collect multi-terabyte multi-media datasets, and train generative models (diffusion, gan, interactive video) models based on them.  

We make it trivial for non-technical builders to create their own networks by providing an instant way to collect with AI without worrying about data formats, unzipping power, caching, or data locality.
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Non-technical builders and AI trainers who need to collect and manage large multimedia datasets and train generative models
problem: Managing multi-terabyte media datasets and training diffusion, GAN and video models requires handling formats, caching and data locality. DataSuite aimed to make that trivial.
business_model: B2B software platform (pricing not found)

A search suggested Mirman now appears as a former founder at another YC company, which hints the product may have been wound down or changed, but that is not confirmed.

name: Dataglade
tags: Fintech; Generative AI; SaaS; Finance; AI
one_liner: The smart way to research stocks.
long_description: Dataglade is the smart way to research stocks. Our AI generates clear analyses and financial models for any public company, and our fundamental data fulfills almost every research need. We save investors hours every day by eliminating the need to manually dig through financial filings. Customers trust our reports because every number is backed by citations to our proprietary financial data warehouse. We inform $1+ billion of trades every day, and we’re just getting started. Check us out at dataglade.com.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Hedge funds, wealth managers, fintechs and individual investors researching public stocks
problem: Equity research data is expensive and hard to verify. Dataglade offers AI generated analyses and models where each figure links to a source in its financial data warehouse.
business_model: B2B and prosumer subscription for data and AI research tools
product_category: AI stock research and financial data terminal
market_need_then: Investors wanted cheaper alternatives to terminals and LLMs created a chance to summarize filings. Specific evidence of Dataglade demand was not found beyond its own claim of informing over 1 billion dollars of trades daily.
outcome_analysis: Dataglade is active and sells AI research and data tools to investment professionals, with company-stated reach of over 1 billion dollars of trades daily. No funding, exit or independent traction evidence was found, so its trajectory is not verifiable from public sources.

name: Deasy Labs
tags: Data Labeling; Big Data; AI; AI Assistant; Databases
one_liner: Metadata for GenAI workflows
long_description:
Deasy Labs was acquired by Collibra in July 2025 (global leader in enterprise data governance).

Deasy Labs provides metadata orchestration for AI workflows. Deasie's platform provides the best way for AI teams to create and embed high-quality, customized metadata into their AI workflows (e.g., RAG, Agentic frameworks).

Our three founders (from Amazon, McKinsey/QuantumBlack & MIT) previously built an ML data governance tool from 0 to 1 within McKinsey, which we deployed with 11 Fortune 500 companies. We saw in early 2023 the ability to create high-quality metadata (without reliance on domain experts) would be a key factor in achieving the accuracy & speed in GenAI applications required for production.  

Our investors include General Catalyst, Y Combinator, RTP Global and world experts in enterprise data. Website: https://deasylabs.com
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Enterprise AI and data teams building RAG and agent applications over unstructured documents
problem: Generative AI applications perform poorly when fed messy, unclassified enterprise documents. Teams lack a way to create consistent metadata and quality scores for unstructured data.
business_model: Enterprise B2B software platform sold to AI and data governance teams
product_category: Data governance and metadata orchestration for unstructured data and GenAI
founder_names: Reece Griffiths; Mikko Peiponen; Leonard Platzer
market_need_then: In 2023 enterprises rushed to build generative AI applications and found unstructured data quality a bottleneck. TechCrunch in October 2023 described the product as ranking and filtering data to make generative AI more reliable.
outcome_analysis: Deasy Labs rode the 2023 generative AI wave with founders who had built a data governance tool at McKinsey and QuantumBlack, raised a $2.9M seed in October 2023 from General Catalyst and RTP Global, and was acquired by Collibra in July 2025 as the buyer extended governance to unstructured data. Terms were not disclosed, so the quality of the exit is unknown.

name: Decoda Health
tags: SaaS; Digital Health; Healthcare IT; AI
one_liner: The all-in-one EMR built for med spas and elective care
long_description:
Med spas, wellness clinics, and aesthetics practices run on 5-10 disconnected tools — separate systems for scheduling, charting, payments, patient communication, and more. It's expensive, error-prone, and holds teams back.

Decoda is the all-in-one EMR and practice management platform purpose-built for elective care. AI is woven into every workflow — from an AI front desk that answers calls and books patients 24/7, to an ambient scribe that generates clinical notes in real time, to automated patient follow-ups that keep calendars full. Scheduling, payments, memberships, inventory, and analytics all live in one place.

Live in 150+ clinics, processing $100M+ in annual transactions.
regions: Canada; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Med spas and elective care clinics such as wellness, longevity, dermatology and cosmetic surgery practices
problem: Elective clinics run on several disconnected systems. Decoda offers one EMR and practice platform with scheduling, charting, payments, memberships and AI agents for calls and notes.
business_model: B2B vertical SaaS plus payments
product_category: Vertical EMR and practice management for elective care
market_need_then: Med spas were a growing elective segment using fragmented tools. Specific 2023 evidence was not found.
outcome_analysis: Decoda is active and says it serves over 150 live clinics with over 100 million dollars in annual transactions, both company claims. Its site announces a 4.5 million dollar raise led by Y Combinator. It competes with established med spa software vendors, and the exact timeline of its funding is unclear.

name: Decohere
one_liner: Real-time generative AI
long_description: Decohere is building product and infrastructure for real-time generative AI. We enable our customers to iterate towards their creative vision without waiting for long-running GPU jobs.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Content creators and consumers who want fast AI image and video generation (B-roll, music visuals, character art)
problem: Generative image and video tools made users wait on long GPU jobs, which slowed creative iteration.
business_model: Consumer freemium subscription with credits, starting near $9.99 a month per third-party reviews
product_category: Consumer generative AI image and video app
market_need_then: Early 2023 saw explosive interest in generative AI imagery and complaints about slow generation, per the company's pitch of avoiding long GPU waits. No traction numbers found.
outcome_analysis: Decohere is a four person Seattle team from W23 whose founders met at Amazon Robotics. It positioned on real-time generative image and video, and now runs a consumer freemium generator with SEO style use-case pages. No funding round beyond aggregator figures, no exit and no shutdown news were found, so its trajectory is unclear. Low defensibility and heavy competition are the main risks.

name: Defer
one_liner: Zero infrastructure background processing platform.
long_description:
Defer enables Node.js developers to move slow code out of the user's journey.
Its simple and well-documented API enables developers to improve web applications' performance in a few minutes instead of days.

Bryan and Charly noticed that all companies end up building similar abstractions and dashboards over the existing open-source (BullMQ) or commercial solutions (AWS SQS + Lambdas) to support background jobs, CRONs, and workflows.

Defer brings a full-featured and managed platform with a Vercel-like developer experience that comes with an operational dashboard, enabling developers to focus on product work.

After building the self-serve version of Defer in 8 weeks and onboarding 5 paying customers, their recent HN launch brought 250+ users and a warm welcome from the Node.js community with the 2 biggest newsletters featuring Defer and tech influencers spreading the word.

Defer is now available as a Node.js solution but aims to become a cross-language reference.
regions: France; Europe

name: Depot
one_liner: Software delivery built for machine scale.
long_description:
Depot gives engineering teams the fast source control, builds, CI runners, sandboxes, caches, and registries they need to ship reliable software they trust at AI speed. Companies like PostHog, Inference, Wistia, PlanetScale, Poolside, Astral, and Semgrep use Depot to power their entire software delivery stack.

Kyle and Jacob worked together as staff engineers for 4.5 years at Thorn and Era Software, before founding Depot. Depot is their take on what software delivery and a replacement for GitHub could look like in the world of AI.
regions: Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Engineering teams that want faster container builds, CI runners and software delivery infrastructure
problem: Container image builds and CI jobs are slow on default infrastructure. Depot provides remote builders with persistent caches, then expanded to CI runners, a registry, source control and sandboxes.
business_model: Usage and plan based infrastructure SaaS
product_category: Build acceleration and CI infrastructure
market_need_then: The founders started building because of their own platform engineering pain with slow builds, per VentureBeat. Depot launched in beta in May 2022 as a bootstrapped project per its seed announcement as relayed in search results.
outcome_analysis: Depot is active and has raised a 4.1 million dollar seed in August 2024 and a 10 million dollar Series A in March 2026, both led or backed by Felicis. It grew from a bootstrapped build accelerator into a wider delivery platform with named customers. Competition from runner vendors and GitHub itself remains the main risk.

name: Designbase
tags: Developer Tools; Design; Design Tools; Web Development; AI
one_liner: Design and build great interfaces
long_description: Designbase is the interface design tool that gives early teams design and development superpowers. Create stunning interfaces, immediately available as code, regardless of resources.

name: Dialtone
one_liner: AI Agents for Enterprises
long_description: Connect agentic workflows to all your existing software and data. 100+ first party data, action, and event connectors for the tools and services you already use. Easily configurable custom connectors for your enterprise’s proprietary systems, enterprise grade security, and dedicated infrastructure.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada

business_model: B2B SaaS platform with enterprise deployment options (cloud, cloud-prem, on-prem); pricing model not stated
product_category: Enterprise AI agent platform and integration connectors
market_need_then: In mid 2023 enterprises were beginning to pilot LLM agents and needed ways to connect them to internal systems; no company specific demand evidence was found.
outcome_analysis: Dialtone is an active two person YC S23 company with no public funding data and no exit. A directory snippet suggests its focus may have shifted toward go to market and revenue team agents, but that is unverified. Little can be said about success or failure from public sources, and unknown funding should not be read as none.

name: Diffuse Bio
tags: AI-powered Drug Discovery; Deep Learning; Generative AI; Machine Learning; Biotech
one_liner: Generative AI for protein design
long_description: Diffuse is building generative AI for protein design. Our mission is to build AI systems that engineer new and useful proteins with unprecedented control and accuracy. Our team has been behind breakthroughs in AI protein design for the past 7 years, including the first experimental validation of AI-generated proteins and diffusion models for protein structure and sequence.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Biotech and pharma researchers designing protein binders and biologics
problem: Designing new proteins with control and accuracy is slow and expensive; Diffuse builds generative models and a screening platform to speed binder discovery.

product_category: Generative AI for protein design
market_need_then: Biologics and binder discovery were costly and slow, and the 2022 to 2023 generative AI wave created interest in AI protein design; the YC page cites binder design and de novo structure generation as uses.
outcome_analysis: Diffuse Bio is an active, small, research-heavy company that has survived since its W23 batch and kept releasing models and a platform through 2026. Funding is thinly documented, with databases showing about 500K dollars, so its capital efficiency and traction are unclear. Its success depends on whether its models and screening data prove better than larger protein AI labs.

name: Diligent
tags: Fintech; Compliance; Fraud Prevention; Regtech; AI
one_liner: AI agents for fintech risk and compliance operations
long_description:
We help fintech risk and AML compliance teams automate and strengthen routine customer due diligence tasks with LLMs. Our AI assistants slash cost-to-comply, improve risk detection and free up capacity for investigations that require human expertise and decision making. 

Fintechs and banks use us to automate workflows like running thorough due diligence on a legal entity, reviewing customer documents like registry extracts, proofs of address etc and remediating false positive alerts from their AML systems.
regions: United Kingdom; Europe
target_customer: Fintechs and banks with KYC, AML and risk operations teams
problem: Compliance analysts spend large amounts of time on routine due diligence and on false positive sanctions, PEP and adverse media alerts.
business_model: B2B SaaS AI agents for compliance workflows; pricing not stated
product_category: AI agents for KYC and AML compliance operations
market_need_then: AML and KYC teams faced high false positive alert volumes and rising compliance cost; the company later reports customer claims of 50 percent or more handling time reductions, which are self reported.
outcome_analysis: Diligent is active and, per its own announcement, raised a 2.5M dollar seed round in March 2026 led by Speedinvest and Shapers with Y Combinator continuing. It has named fintech customers and compliance trained founders, which supports founder market fit. It is still early, so nothing is known about durability, and the earlier history from the 2023 batch to 2026 is not documented.

name: Dill
one_liner: Dill helps construction suppliers automate accounts receivable,…
long_description: Dill helps construction suppliers automate accounts receivable, online payments, and credit applications.

business_model: B2B SaaS for accounts receivable automation, with payment processing
product_category: accounts receivable automation and payments for construction suppliers

It appears to have moved from foodservice distributor invoicing at YC time to construction supplier credit to cash, serving named customers and buying groups. No verified funding, exit or failure evidence was found, so there is no outcome story beyond continued operation.

name: Dioxus Labs

outcome_analysis: Dioxus grew from a college project into a visible Rust UI framework, funded by sponsors, Futurewei, GitHub Accelerator and a small YC round. The team was brought into Cognition in September 2026 to work on Devin, reported as an acquihire, while Dioxus remains open source. Deal terms are not public and the commercial product never became a scaled revenue business per available sources.

name: DisputeNinja

It reports early merchant traction and has Shopify and Stripe oriented distribution, but the market has funded automation vendors and payment processors offering their own tooling. Too little is known to explain a success or failure.

name: Docsum
one_liner: AI contract repository
long_description: Docsum is a contract intelligence platform designed for legal and finance teams. Using AI, Docsum extracts critical data like renewal dates, obligations, and more into a searchable database. The platform is fully customizable with features like custom field reporting, alerts, and playbook-powered redlining. Getting started is simple—upload contracts or connect Docsum to tools like Google Drive, DocuSign, and more.

product_category: AI contract review and contract intelligence

outcome_analysis: Docsum is active, shipping a Word add-in and AI chat through 2025 and January 2026, with a strategic advisor announced. Funding is only seen in trackers at about 500K to 550K dollars, so growth and runway are unclear. The category is crowded and incumbents have bought into it, so its path depends on legal team adoption.

name: Double – Coding Copilot
tags: Developer Tools; SaaS; Chatbot; Enterprise; AI
one_liner: AI coding copilot engineered for performance
long_description:
Do you run into these problems with Github Copilot?
- Bad completions that break your train of thought when you’re writing comments?
- Doesn’t close brackets, or adds too many closing brackets?
- Functions, variables, and libraries not being auto-imported after accepting a suggestion?
- Multi-cursor mode not working?
- Wish copilot could name your variables?
- Wish copilot could trigger in the middle of a line?
- Want to stop wasting time with GPT3.5 chat and default to GPT4?

Double is an high quality alternative to Copilot inside VS Code, engineered for performance. It’s designed with great craftsmanship by people who care a lot about getting the small details right.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Software developers who use VS Code and pay for AI coding assistance
problem: GitHub Copilot completions were limited in quality, bracket handling and model choice; Double aims to be a higher performance alternative.
business_model: Subscription developer tool (VS Code extension); pricing not captured
product_category: AI coding assistant
market_need_then: Developers were adopting AI completion in 2022 to 2023 and Copilot had millions of users; the YC page claims better completions and model choice as the gap.
outcome_analysis: Double is an active two person coding assistant with no verified funding and no exit found. It faced strong incumbents (Copilot) and fast moving AI IDE competitors, and its defensibility is low because it relies on third party models. Public sources do not show traction, so the outcome is unclear.

name: DrDroid
one_liner: Your best friend in production.
long_description:
DrDroid is building AI Agents for Platform & Infrastructure teams. 
We help engineering teams fix issues faster and reduce escalations during on-call—automating triage, debugging, and remediation.

We’re also the team behind several open-source projects:
🔹 Playbooks – A runbook automation platform
🔹 Kenobi – An event analytics platform for debugging data pipelines

Join us in redefining how teams run operations in the post-GPT world.
regions: India; South Asia

business_model: B2B SaaS AI SRE agent with self-hosted option, plus open source tools; pricing not captured
product_category: AI SRE agent and runbook automation
market_need_then: Alert fatigue and on-call burden were widely discussed engineering pains; a third party source says the company initially worked on patient management tools before the SRE focus, which is unverified.
outcome_analysis: DrDroid raised a seed round led by Accel with Y Combinator in June 2024, announced by Accel, and remains active with an AI SRE product. The founders came from Shadowfax engineering and Accel developer tooling investing, which supports founder market fit. Amount and any later rounds are unknown, so funding coverage is partial.

name: Edge

name: EdgeBit
one_liner: Autofix your software dependencies
long_description:
EdgeBit was acquired by FOSSA in July 2025: https://fossa.com/blog/fossa-acquires-edgebit/

EdgeBit enables engineering teams to ship security updates 10x faster with confidence by automating dependency update analysis. Our platform turns weeks of manual review into minutes, helping teams find and fix security vulnerabilities while maintaining a secure, up-to-date software supply chain without compromising productivity.

target_customer: Engineering and security teams at software companies that need to find and fix vulnerable dependencies quickly
problem: Security scanners flood teams with vulnerability alerts and dependency updates need manual review. EdgeBit automated analysis of dependency updates and prioritised what was actually running in production.

product_category: Software supply chain security and dependency management

It raised only a small round per aggregators and was acquired by FOSSA, announced in September 2025, with YC listing July 2025. Terms were not disclosed. It looks like a strategic tuck-in by a vendor wanting the technology and team rather than a scaled outcome.

name: Electric Air
