outcome_analysis: Finic launched fraud investigation agents from ex Robinhood founders, then moved toward a scoring API built on its own decision model. No funding was found in any source, and benchmark claims on its site come from a single test at one large customer. The company is active with four people, so the outcome is still open.

name: Finn
one_liner: AI Wealth Manager
long_description: Finn is your personal wealth manager that knows your money, plans ahead, and gets things done.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Retail consumers with checking, savings, investment and retirement accounts who want automated wealth management guidance
problem: People lack a single advisor that sees all of their accounts, plans ahead and acts on their behalf; human advisors are costly and budgeting apps only report.
business_model: Consumer subscription or advisory fee as a registered investment adviser (pricing not verified)
product_category: AI wealth manager / personal finance
market_need_then: Unverified from opened sources. The product is pitched at people who want an advisor that sees all accounts; no dated demand evidence was found.
outcome_analysis: Finn is a very small YC W23 team of five still listed as active, with a website showing Y Combinator, Pioneer, UV and Olive Tree Capital as backers but no disclosed rounds. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff reports were found, and no funding figures were found in any reliable source, so the story is unresolved rather than a clear success or failure.

name: Finni Health
one_liner: Empowering Autism Care Providers to Go Independent
long_description: Our platform is simple: we provide everything providers need to go independent, from scheduling and billing to marketing and client support.
regions: Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Independent BCBA-led ABA autism care providers, and families of children with autism who need in-network care
problem: Autism care providers who want to leave large employers need billing, insurance credentialing, scheduling, marketing and client support to run an independent practice.
business_model: Practice enablement platform and insurance network (MSO style); revenue model not stated in sources
product_category: Healthcare practice management / autism care enablement
market_need_then: The YC page reports $30K monthly revenue and operations in five states, and the company site later claims over 1,000 families in more than 25 states (company-reported).
outcome_analysis: Finni Health raised a $3.2M seed led by General Catalyst in June 2023 and is listed as active with about 40 people and a Growth stage. The founders' lived exposure to autism care and a payer-network wedge suggest fit, and no shutdown or layoffs were found. Later rounds are not verified, so success is plausible but not confirmed by independent figures.

name: Finta
one_liner: Magically simplify accounting and taxes
long_description:
Automated bookkeeping, effortless tax filing, real‑time insights.

Set up in 10 mins and get back to building.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: US venture-backed startups needing bookkeeping, tax filing and financial reporting
problem: Early startups juggle bookkeepers, QuickBooks and spreadsheets for accounting, taxes and metrics, which is slow and error prone.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription tiers (Formation, Startup, Growth, Enterprise) with separately priced tax filing
product_category: Accounting software and tax services for startups
market_need_then: The YC launch post says Finta aims to replace bookkeepers, QuickBooks and Google Sheets for startups; no dated demand figures were found.
outcome_analysis: Finta is an active two to a few person YC W23 company selling accounting and tax software to startups, claiming 1,000+ founder customers on its site. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff reports were found. Funding is unverified: aggregators range from two to four million dollars with no primary announcement, so its trajectory cannot be graded as success or failure.

name: Fintool
one_liner: Financial copilot for institutional investors
long_description: Fintool.com is a financial copilot for institutional investors. It’s ChatGPT on top of financial documents. Fintool is engineered to discover financial insights that are beyond the reach of human analysis or search software.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Institutional investors and public equity research teams
problem: Analysts spend hours reading SEC filings, earnings transcripts and footnotes. Fintool applies LLMs to those documents to answer questions and surface insights faster than manual search.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for AI financial research
product_category: AI financial research copilot
market_need_then: Institutional investors pay heavily for research tooling and document analysis. The release of ChatGPT in late 2022 opened a clear opening for LLM based reading of financial filings.
outcome_analysis: Fintool rode the 2023 LLM wave by pointing models at SEC filings and transcripts, backed by a founder with prior experience selling a document search company. It raised a Menlo seed in 2025 and was acquired by Microsoft in April 2026, apparently as a team and product acquisition with undisclosed terms.

name: FleetWorks
one_liner: AI enabled marketplace matching trucks with jobs
long_description:
FleetWorks is rebuilding the $1 trillion freight marketplace with AI.

Every year, companies spend over a trillion dollars moving freight across the U.S. — but the system for matching trucks with jobs is still slow, manual, and fragmented.

FleetWorks is fixing that. We’re turning today’s chaotic freight market into a modern, intelligent marketplace — one where AI agents replace the endless phone calls, texts and emails and match jobs to trucks instantly.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Freight brokerages and carriers who book, track and schedule truck loads
problem: Matching trucks to freight jobs runs on phone calls, texts and emails, which is slow and manual for brokers and carriers.
business_model: Freight marketplace and AI dispatch software for brokers; pricing not stated
product_category: Logistics AI marketplace / freight automation
market_need_then: The company describes a freight market of over a trillion dollars annually still coordinated by calls and emails; Convoy's 2023 shutdown showed digital brokerage was hard.
outcome_analysis: FleetWorks raised a $15M Series A led by First Round Capital in October 2025, bringing reported total funding to $17M, and launched an always-on AI dispatcher. The founders came from Uber Freight and Airbnb, matching the domain, and LLM progress made call automation feasible. No shutdown or layoffs were found; seed details are not sourced.

name: Flex
one_liner: Stripe for HSA/FSA payments
long_description: Flex is a payment platform for businesses to accept HSA/FSA, unlocking the $150B per year sitting in HSA/FSA accounts.
regions: Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Health and wellness brands and retailers that want to accept HSA and FSA payments, and the shoppers who spend those funds
problem: Billions of dollars in HSA and FSA balances go unspent and merchants cannot easily accept those cards or qualify products as eligible.
business_model: Payments and marketplace take rate on HSA/FSA transactions plus consultation-based eligibility; exact fees not stated
product_category: Fintech payments for HSA/FSA
market_need_then: The company cites about $150B per year in HSA and FSA funds, much of it unused, and later claims 2M+ orders and 5x customer growth in the year to September 2025 (company-reported).
outcome_analysis: Flex raised a $3.2M seed in September 2024 and a $15M Series A co-led by First Round Capital and CoreVC in September 2025, with total capital about $18M. Founders with fraud and fintech product experience, a large pool of unspent HSA and FSA money and fast merchant growth drove the raise. Competition from Truemed remains, but no adverse events were found.

name: FlexDesk
tags: Real Estate; B2B; HR Tech; Proptech
one_liner: AI Agents for corporate real estate teams
long_description:
Real estate rent is often the largest non-payroll expense for companies. FlexDesk replaces fragmented, manual back-office work with intelligent agents that execute the workflows required to manage and optimize portfolios.

Internal real estate teams at enterprises like Reddit and Confluent use FlexDesk in the same way that Travel teams use Navan and Procurement teams use Zip.
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Corporate real estate teams at enterprises managing leases, coworking programs and utilization
problem: Companies use scattered tools for coworking bookings, lease records and office utilization, so real estate teams lack one source of truth.
business_model: B2B SaaS and lease administration services; originally a coworking booking engine with consolidated billing
product_category: Corporate real estate software
market_need_then: The 2023 era interview calls the idea Airbnb for workspace; the founder says exposure to asset-heavy models at The Guild shaped the vision. Spend figures were not found.
outcome_analysis: FlexDesk is an active YC W23 company that moved from coworking booking to a portfolio and lease management platform with named customers such as Hopper, ezCater and Confluent. Funding is unverified beyond an aggregator figure near $500K, and no acquisition or layoffs were found, so there is no clear success or failure signal yet.

name: FlexWash
one_liner: The operating system for the car wash industry.
long_description: Car washing is a $15B market in dire need of disruption. Legacy systems are costly, out of date, and inflexible. We are building modern solutions to help car wash operators manage and grow their business.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Car wash operators, including membership and tunnel washes
problem: Legacy car wash software charges large upfront fees, runs on on-premise servers and lags other industries in membership and marketing tools.
business_model: Cloud SaaS monthly subscription with payment processing (Adyen), on hardware under $700
product_category: Vertical SaaS and POS for car washes
market_need_then: Founders cite a roughly $15B market and legacy vendors with large upfront fees; customer-reported results on the site include membership conversion rising from about 18% to 25%+.
outcome_analysis: FlexWash is an active YC W23 car wash software company whose founders ran a family wash, giving domain fit against legacy vendors. Customers such as Rising Tide and Kwik-n-Clean appear on its site and no acquisition or layoffs were found. Funding is reported only by aggregators near $500K, so the commercial scale is unverified.

name: Flint
one_liner: Personalized learning built for schools
long_description:
Flint is an AI-powered personalized learning platform for K-12 schools, helping teachers deliver individualized instruction at scale. Trusted by 500,000+ educators and students, Flint has powered learning activities that increase student engagement, academic performance, and collaboration.

Through AI-driven tutoring, real-time feedback, and interactive learning experiences, Flint enables every student to receive personalized support without adding to teacher workload.

With AI-native student analytics, educators gain full visibility into student progress, strengths, and areas for improvement, while saving time on grading, lesson planning, and differentiation. Students receive a 24/7 AI tutor that adapts to their level without giving away answers, supporting deeper understanding and independent thinking.

For schools and districts, Flint provides robust AI guardrails, including customizable moderation, grade-level controls, and full transparency into student usage, ensuring safe and responsible AI adoption.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: K-12 schools, districts and teachers
problem: Teachers need safe, personalized AI tutoring and content tools with oversight, as students adopt generative AI.
business_model: B2B SaaS to schools and districts (AI learning management system); pricing not stated
product_category: Education AI / K-12 learning platform
market_need_then: Schools were reacting to student use of generative AI in 2023; the company site now claims over 250,000 teachers and a UK Department for Education pioneer selection, but no 2023 demand figures were found.
outcome_analysis: Flint raised a $15M Series A co-led by Basis Set Ventures and Patron in November 2025, built on the 2023 wave of generative AI in schools. It reports use by hundreds of thousands of teachers and students, and a Cognita partnership across 110 schools, though these are company or aggregator claims. No shutdown or layoffs were found; competition from larger edtech players is the risk.

name: Flower
one_liner: Train AI on distributed data
long_description:
Flower Labs is the world-class AI startup behind Flower, the most popular open-source framework and ecosystem in the world for training AI on distributed data and compute resources using federated learning. Trusted by industry leaders such as Mozilla, Banking Circle, Samsung, Temenos and Bosch, Flower empowers organizations to improve their AI models on sensitive data that remains securely distributed across organizational silos or user devices. In a world where most AI relies on centralized public datasets - just a fraction of the data available - we believe unlocking access to (orders of magnitude more) private data will drive the next breakthroughs in artificial intelligence.
Flower Labs is a Y Combinator (YCW23) graduate and backed by top-tier investors and renowned angels, including Felicis, First Spark Ventures, Mozilla Ventures, Hugging Face CEO Clem Delangue, GitHub Co-Founder Scott Chacon, Factorial Capital, Betaworks, and Pioneer Fund. Together, we are redefining how AI is built, deployed, and scaled for privacy, collaboration, and real-world impact.
regions: Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Enterprises and research teams that need to train or fine-tune AI models on sensitive data that cannot be centralized (banks, health, device makers)
problem: Most useful data is private and siloed, so centralized training cannot use it. Federated learning needs tooling that is easy to adopt across heterogeneous devices and organizations.
business_model: Open-source framework with commercial enterprise platform, managed services and support
product_category: Federated learning and decentralized AI infrastructure
founder_names: Daniel J. Beutel; Nic Lane; Taner Topal
market_need_then: Privacy regulation and growing demand for private data in model training created interest in federated learning. The Series A announcement cites dozens of Fortune 500 companies already using the framework by Feb 2024.
outcome_analysis: Flower grew from a Cambridge and Oxford research framework into the most referenced open-source federated learning project, then raised a $20M Series A led by Felicis in February 2024 at a reported valuation of about $100M. Open-source adoption and founder research credibility drove distribution, while the commercial question is how to monetize an open framework.

name: FlowiseAI
tags: Developer Tools; Generative AI; Open Source; AI
one_liner: Open source GenAI development platform
long_description: Flowise uses low-code approach that enable developers to manage the whole lifecycle of building LLMs apps in production. From protoyping, evaluation, to iterations.
regions: Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Developers and teams building LLM apps and AI agents with a low code visual builder
problem: Building LangChain based LLM applications needed repetitive boilerplate code. Flowise gives a drag and drop canvas so developers and non developers can prototype and ship quickly.
business_model: Open source core with freemium cloud tiers (free to about 65 dollars a month) and enterprise self hosting
product_category: Open source low code AI agent and LLM app builder
market_need_then: LangChain grew very quickly in early 2023 and many developers wanted simpler ways to build chatbots and RAG apps, which created demand for visual builders.
outcome_analysis: Flowise grew as an open source visual builder on the 2023 LangChain wave and gained a developer community with very little capital. Workday acquired it in August 2025 to add an agent builder for HR and finance customers, and the standalone product is now being sunset per the site.

name: Floworks
tags: Generative AI; Productivity; Sales; AI; AI Assistant
one_liner: Hire the best AI Sales employees | AI SDR | AI RevOps | AI EA
long_description:
Floworks (https://floworks.ai) is building a suite of AI employees that helps business to run several business functions such as sales, on autopilot.

Our flagship product, Alisha is an AI SDR that performs the full outbound SDR job- fully autonomously without any human involvement. 

Our AI SDR Alisha can perform ICP research, find out prospect lists, research about each prospect across 180 web sources, write highly personalized emails to each, follow and engage, and finally coordinate like a human to book sales calls.

Businesses using Alisha get 3 key benefits:
1.⁠ ⁠They get 12x output from your existing sales team.
2.⁠ ⁠⁠Are able to scale to 8 figure revenues with just a single AE.

Alisha is built on our proprietary function calling model ThorV2 (https://floworks.ai/research) that outperforms both Claude 3 and GPT-4 function calling in accuracy by 13% and 43% respectively. At the same time, ThorV2 uses only a fraction of the cost (<40%) and time/latency (<78%) as the other models.

Our second AI employee, Ashley, is an AI Executive Assistant that keeps you reminded and on top of your on your schedule. Works on your whim- just command Flowy to book a meeting, move a meeting or write a email, and it does without you having to navigate through every apps. You can teach Flowy specific workflows such as ‘inform me immediately if i receive a reply from xyz’, “show my unread emails from last day every morning 7am” and much more

Our third AI employee, Romona is a helpful AI Revenue Operations Manager that keeps track of every CRM data updation on behalf of your team, works on your instruction to update notes, next steps, MEDDIC after every call, does periodic CRM reporting and much more.
regions: India; South Asia; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: B2B sales teams, especially early and growth stage SaaS companies, that want outbound sales automated
problem: Sales teams spend time on prospect research, outreach and CRM upkeep. Floworks started as a Slack assistant that acts across business apps and moved to autonomous AI sales employees.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for AI sales agents
product_category: AI SDR and AI sales assistants
market_need_then: TechCrunch in Aug 2023 reported the beta had paying customers and reportedly close to $250,000 ARR, suggesting early demand for AI that acts inside business apps.
outcome_analysis: Floworks raised a $1.5M seed in 2023 on a Slack assistant with reported near $250K ARR, then repositioned in 2024 to AI sales employees led by the Alisha SDR. A December 2024 report said Series A talks had begun, but no later round is confirmed, and it competes in a crowded AI SDR market. Status remains active.

name: Fluid Markets
one_liner: Invest in public companies KPIs
long_description: Fluid Markets was the first company to attempt to build futures markets on public company KPIs with the legal structure now known as prediction markets.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Institutional and sophisticated investors wanting exposure to public company KPIs such as revenue and earnings without equity risk
problem: Investors with views on a company's fundamentals could only express them through the stock, which carries market risk. Fluid planned futures on individual KPIs.
business_model: Exchange taking fees on KPI futures contracts, pending regulatory approval
product_category: Financial exchange for KPI futures and event contracts
market_need_then: Demand was untested; the beta was a paper trading competition with cash prizes while regulatory approval was pending, so real paying demand is not evidenced.
outcome_analysis: Fluid Markets tried to launch futures on public company KPIs, a model resembling prediction markets, but sources show only a paper trading beta awaiting regulatory approval. The company site says it is no longer operating; the cause is not public. Regulatory delay and funding are plausible but unconfirmed, so failure factors are tentative inferences from the pending approval language.

name: Fortuna Health
one_liner: TurboTax for Medicaid
long_description:
Fortuna is a one-stop solution that helps consumers navigate Medicaid end-to-end from eligibility and enrollment to renewing coverage. 

Our platform creates value as the middleware layer for the $800B Medicaid ecosystem.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Medicaid managed care plans, health systems and providers that pay to help members enroll and renew coverage
problem: Medicaid enrollment and renewal is complex and paperwork heavy, and many eligible people lose coverage. Fortuna provides consumer navigation delivered through plans and providers.
business_model: B2B2C services and software sold to health plans and providers
product_category: Healthcare navigation and Medicaid enrollment
founder_names: Nikita Singareddy; Cydney Kim; Ben Wesner
market_need_then: The federal Medicaid continuous enrollment condition ended on March 31, 2023, and states had 12 months to redetermine eligibility, with KFF reporting over 9 million fewer enrollees by December 2023.
outcome_analysis: Fortuna launched as Medicaid redeterminations began, raised a $4M seed from a16z in November 2023 and an $18M Series A in July 2025, and reports serving more than 185,000 patients in 21 states on its site. Founder healthcare operating experience and distribution through health plans drove traction, with partnerships such as Unite Us in November 2025.

name: Foundation
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate
tags: SaaS; Real Estate; B2B; Proptech; AI Assistant
one_liner: Shopify for Homebuilders
long_description: Foundation is the buyer experience platform for homebuilders. By bringing the new home shopping, purchase, and ownership experience online, Foundation helps homebuilders sell more homes, more profitably, to happier customers.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Production and custom homebuilders that pay for buyer-facing apps and operations software
problem: New home buyers deal with fragmented communication, documents and warranty requests across a long build, and builders lack modern software for that experience.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription to homebuilders
product_category: Proptech buyer experience software
market_need_then: The founders sold into homebuilders at Opendoor and saw the buyer journey remained offline; no independent dated demand evidence was found.
outcome_analysis: Foundation, built by ex-Opendoor homebuilder channel leaders, sells white-label buyer apps and warranty tools to builders. Secondary profiles claim fivefold growth in 2025 and more than 10,000 homes a year sold through the platform, but these are company-reported and no verified funding round or exit was found, so the outcome is early and unproven.

name: Fours
one_liner: Infrastructure for indirect revenue channels
long_description:
Fours is the indirect revenue platform for cloud marketplaces, co-selling, and partnership relationship management (PRM). 300+ customers rely on us to manage the entire deal flow from the first partner signal to recognized revenue.

We make it easy for software companies to list, transact, bill and co-sell through any cloud marketplaces and with any partners through our suite of products.

Fours automates the manual, cross-functional work behind Cloud and Partner GTM from private offers and CRM syncing to entitlement fulfillment and co-sell execution so your sales, ops, and finance teams can focus on closing deals, not chasing workflows.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Software companies selling through AWS, Azure and Google Cloud marketplaces and running partner programs
problem: Listing, transacting, billing and co-selling through cloud marketplaces involves manual cross-functional work. Fours automates private offers, CRM syncing and partner workflows.
business_model: B2B SaaS; AWS Marketplace listing shows pricing tied to partner network size
product_category: Cloud marketplace and partner relationship management software
market_need_then: Cloud marketplace sales were growing; a later Omdia projection quoted by Channel Insider puts hyperscaler marketplace sales at 30 billion dollars in 2024 rising to 163 billion by 2030. No source dated 2022 found.
outcome_analysis: Fours sells marketplace and partner revenue software to software vendors and reports 300 plus customers and a team of 76 on its YC page, suggesting real traction. No funding history, exit or press coverage was found, so it is hard to judge relative to funded rivals Suger, Clazar and Tackle.

name: Fragment
one_liner: Turn manual operations into scalable processes
long_description:
Fragment’s premise is that every company using AI will need humans in the loop, and software for the handoff between AI and humans.

We start by helping operations teams in fintech companies with task management for their manual processes (onboarding, compliance…). Building on top of this, we make it easy to increase automation by adding a layer of human supervision.
regions: Unspecified
target_customer: Operations teams at fintech companies running manual onboarding and compliance processes
problem: Fintech operations teams handle onboarding and compliance with manual tasks and human agents. Fragment provides task management and a human supervision layer so AI can take over more steps safely.
business_model: B2B SaaS for operations task management and AI human handoff
product_category: Human in the loop operations software
market_need_then: Fintechs were scaling KYC and compliance operations with large human teams, and the 2023 rise of LLMs raised demand for tooling that mixes automation with human review.
outcome_analysis: Fragment was a two person team with founders who had run AI and human review operations at KYC providers, giving them strong domain insight. Sierra acquired it in April 2026 mainly for the people and know-how and to expand in France, with undisclosed terms, which looks closer to a soft landing than a scaled outcome.

name: Frigade
tags: SaaS; Customer Success; Customer Service; AI; AI Assistant
one_liner: AI-powered product assistance for modern software teams
long_description:
Frigade AI is an in-app assistant that intelligently guides and onboards your users through your product. Our agent learns your product's interface, gives contextual guidance that adapts to each user, and takes actions directly on your users' behalf.

Learn more at Frigade.com
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Software product teams and developers who need user onboarding and in-app guidance
problem: Onboarding flows and in-app help are hard to build and maintain; Frigade first offered developer-friendly onboarding components, then an AI assistant that guides and acts for users.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for developers and product teams
product_category: Product onboarding and in-app AI assistant
market_need_then: Onboarding is a widely recognized pain for software teams, and a funded market of no-code tools already existed; Frigade bet on developer-first code components. Launch coverage dated October 2023 on Product Hunt.
outcome_analysis: Frigade raised a $3M seed in July 2023 led by Craft Ventures and La Famiglia, launched its onboarding product in October 2023, then moved toward an AI in-app assistant in 2025. No Series A, exit or shutdown was found, so it remains a small, active company in a market with established competitors.

name: Giga
one_liner: AI Support Agent for Enterprises.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Large enterprises that run customer support at scale and want AI support agents, including voice agents
problem: Enterprise support is costly and slow to automate. Giga began with on-premise LLMs for privacy-sensitive firms and moved to AI support agents.
business_model: Enterprise subscription or usage-based AI agents for customer support
product_category: AI customer support agents
market_need_then: In 2023 enterprises with compliance concerns hesitated to send data to OpenAI or Anthropic; the company's own launch claims this as the need, a self-reported rationale.
outcome_analysis: Giga pivoted from on-premise LLMs to enterprise AI support agents and raised a Series A led by Redpoint, reported as 61M in November 2025 after a 50M announcement in August 2025. Self-reported DoorDash results above 90 percent resolution support traction, and valuation estimates of 250M to 350M are aggregator figures.

name: Glade
tags: Generative AI; Consumer; Entertainment; Gaming; AI
one_liner: Build games at the speed of thought
long_description: Glade is helping everyone build games with AI. GladeCore powers hundreds of studios and developers with locally powered AI NPCs that include TTS, STT, emotional tuning, and RAG. GladeKit is Cursor for Games - an AI agent that lives directly in your game engine and builds games for you.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Game studios and indie developers who want AI NPCs (GladeCore) and an in-engine AI coding agent (GladeKit)
problem: Building games and believable NPCs is slow and expensive for small teams. The YC S23 launch pitched a different problem: enterprise financial planning tools such as Anaplan force teams to learn new modelling engines.
business_model: Usage and subscription software for developers (GladeKit priced around $50 per month per a March 2026 blog post); the original S23 product was enterprise financial planning software
product_category: AI tools for game development
market_need_then: The S23 launch cited founder frustration with legacy planning tools and two signed letters of intent from enterprises. The later gaming pivot rides the 2023 to 2026 interest in generative AI for games.
outcome_analysis: Glade is still listed as active with a team of three. It appears to have pivoted from enterprise financial planning to AI tools for game developers and now ships GladeKit with a Unity and Godot agent. Funding is not publicly confirmed beyond aggregator entries, so the trajectory is unclear and no clear success or failure story can be told yet.

name: Glass Health
tags: SaaS; Health Tech; Digital Health; Healthcare; AI
one_liner: AI-Powered Clinical Decision Support & Ambient Scribing
long_description: We empower clinicians with our AI platform for developing differential diagnoses and drafting clinical plans.
regions: Unspecified
target_customer: Individual clinicians (paid monthly subscription) and later health systems via an enterprise EHR integrated offering
problem: Clinicians need help building differential diagnoses and clinical plans, and medical software lagged other sectors.
business_model: B2C style subscription for clinicians plus planned enterprise licensing to health systems
product_category: AI clinical decision support and ambient scribing
market_need_then: Clinicians were adopting ChatGPT informally in early 2023, and Glass reported over 59,000 users and a waitlist of 15 health systems and companies by September 2023.
outcome_analysis: Glass Health pivoted in early 2023 from a physician notebook to an AI diagnosis tool just as ChatGPT drove clinician interest, then raised a 5 million seed in September 2023 after reaching tens of thousands of users. A physician CEO gave founder market fit. It stays active and has added ambient scribing, though crowded competition from Doximity and big model vendors remains the main risk.

name: Gleam
one_liner: Running clinical trials with AI
long_description: Clinical trials need more skilled people than the industry has. Gleam fills that gap.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Clinical research sites (site owners and directors) running trials
problem: Clinical trials need more skilled staff than the industry has; research sites spend staff time on manual multi-visit data entry and quality control.
business_model: B2B software/AI agent for clinical research sites
product_category: Clinical trial operations AI
market_need_then: YC description cites a shortage of skilled clinical trial staff; the company site says research sites spend coordinator time on manual EDC entry. No dated third-party demand data was found.
outcome_analysis: Gleam, YC S23, started as AI to run clinical trials and now sells an agent that moves source data into EDC systems for research sites, with testimonials from two site owners (one claiming a 95% cut in work per visit). No funding, exit or shutdown was found; a third-party estimator (Latka) claims $2.6M 2025 revenue and 24 staff, unverified, against a YC listing of 4. Outcome unresolved, with a clear niche but unknown funding and several AI trial-ops startups raising money since 2024.

name: Glide
tags: Developer Tools; Crypto / Web3; B2B; API; Infrastructure
one_liner: Crypto Deposits, Wallet Funding, and Pay-with-crypto Infra
long_description: Glide lets apps accept crypto deposits from any chain, wallet, or exchange using pre-built wallet funding flows. Users can fund wallets directly — no bridges, no swaps, no repeated KYC.
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Crypto apps and dapps that need deposit and wallet funding flows
problem: Users struggle to fund wallets across chains and exchanges without bridges, swaps and repeated KYC; Glide offers drop-in deposit flows.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with usage, listed at $99 per month plus custom enterprise
product_category: Crypto deposit and payments infrastructure
market_need_then: Wallet funding was a known onboarding pain, and the Wyre onramp shutdown in 2023 pushed apps to switch providers; Glide's founders saw it directly while building Robinhood Wallet.
outcome_analysis: Glide was a four person YC S23 team of former Robinhood Wallet engineers building crypto deposit flows. It reportedly reached more than 50 business customers and about $100M annualized volume before MoonPay acquired it in July 2026 in an all-equity deal with undisclosed terms. The exit looks like a strategic acquisition for a capability rather than a venture-scale outcome, and only a roughly $500K YC-stage round is documented.

name: Gluetrail
tags: Productivity; Sales Enablement; Marketing; Customer Support; AI
one_liner: Create step by step articles with screenshots and videos 10x faster
long_description:
Gluetrail is a chrome extension that allows you to create support/training/marketing assets 10x faster, just from a screen and audio recording. These assets allow you to drive software or process adoption & awareness among prospects, customers or teammates.  

From one single recording, Gluetrail leverages your screen+clicks+audio transcript, and AI, to:
- automatically create step-by-step articles with screenshots and videos
- adapt the content for & publish it on 3rd party platforms in 1 click: internal or external knowledge bases (Notion, Confluence, Intercom, Zendesk...), community platforms and social media (linkedin, youtube, twitter, discourse...)
regions: France; Europe; Remote; Fully Remote

name: GoodCourse
one_liner: The TikTok style corporate training platform
long_description: GoodCourse is the TikTok-style corporate learning platform achieving 10x better completion rates, training employees on topics like compliance and inclusion.
regions: United Kingdom; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Gooseworks
one_liner: Self-Improving Marketing Harness
long_description:
Goose is an AI marketing brain that understands your company's marketing context deeply and makes it accessible to agents. 

We index your existing materials — videos, product shots, testimonials, ad performance data — into a context layer that AI agents can then use to make creatives, webpages, write emails, social content and more.

The engine compounds: the agent learns from campaign performance, competitors, trends, and human feedback, so your creative gets better every month.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: E-commerce brands and go to market teams that want AI agents for growth and creative work

name: GovEagle

long_description: GovEagle is an AI-native platform built to help public sector teams find, win, and manage work.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada

problem: Government contractors spend weeks building compliant proposals from past responses and RFP documents.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription
product_category: AI proposal and capture software for government contracting
market_need_then: Federal contractors write large volumes of proposals under tight deadlines; the YC page frames RFP reading and first drafts as the pain. No dated 2023 spend figures were found.
outcome_analysis: GovEagle is still operating as of 2026 with a small 2025 raise of 2.5 million dollars and a FedRAMP Moderate authorization announced in August 2026. The founders' federal sales exposure and the arrival of capable LLMs gave a clear wedge, but the funding found is modest and the field of GovCon AI rivals grew after 2023, so the outcome is still open.

name: GreenTally

one_liner: Affordable carbon tracking solution for all businesses
long_description:
GreenTally is a carbon accounting platform built for all businesses that transforms environmental reporting from a complex, expensive ordeal into a streamlined, affordable process. Using LLM, we help companies measure their carbon footprint in hours instead of months.

GreenTally automates emissions calculations and reporting, enabling businesses to meet regulatory requirements and track reduction targets without the overhead of consultants or dedicated sustainability teams. By making enterprise-grade carbon accounting accessible and practical, GreenTally empowers growing businesses to take control of their sustainability journey.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Guac

long_description: Guac accurately forecasts grocery demand to help supermarkets order and produce the right amount of inventory — reducing food waste and increasing availability.

name: Hadrius

Hadrius allows regulated financial firms of all sizes to consolidate and automate their compliance processes using AI in one platform. Today, we're securing compliance for $3T+ AUM across our clients.

name: Hammr

long_description: Generic payroll providers weren't built for construction - Hammr is. Our modern tools simplify construction payroll, HR and operations. We help construction companies boost profits, not paperwork.

name: HappyRobot

By combining real-time truth, specialized AI workers, and an orchestrating intelligence, HappyRobot manages complex, mission-critical work with true autonomy. Acting as a central brain, the OS compounds intelligence over time, optimizes decisions at every level, and continuously improves as it operates. Starting with supply chain and industrial-scale operations, HappyRobot enables enterprises to run with greater resilience and speed, while humans focus on strategy, creativity, and values.

name: HarnessRouter

Build agent-powered products without rebuilding the runtime infrastructure. HarnessRouter is the world's first unified interface for agent harnesses, connecting your app to Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, DeepSeek Harness, and other supported harnesses through one API.

HarnessRouter Cloud runs tasks in isolated, serverless sandboxes and handles sessions, streaming, files, artifacts, recovery, and execution tracing. Teams can compare harness and model configurations on their own tasks to choose the right balance of quality, latency, and cost.

Use the managed Cloud or self-host the Apache 2.0 Community Edition on infrastructure you control. Both implement the Unified Harness Protocol (UHP).
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Haven

name: Health Harbor

long_description:
We use generative AI to call insurance on behalf of healthcare clinics. We save clinics up to 40 hours of calls every week over existing outsourced human solutions. 

Compared to the existing solutions for benefits verifications: 
- We're faster -- by default, we have a turnaround of 24 hours compared to typically a 3 day turnaround for competitors
- We can reach more payors -- as long as they have a phone line, we can support calling them for benefits. There's quite a few payors in both medical and dental (e.g. Seledent) that have yet to offer a digital retrieval of benefits
- We're reliable and consistent -- there is no person-to-person variation or question skipping when it comes to working with software
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Private healthcare clinics, billing teams and providers that call insurers for benefits, prior authorization and claim status
problem: Clinics spend many staff hours each week on phone calls to insurers, usually outsourced to human call centers with multi day turnaround.
business_model: B2B SaaS and per call usage pricing for AI payor calls
product_category: AI voice agent for healthcare insurance calls
market_need_then: The YC launch post says private practices spend hours weekly on insurer calls and cites over 230,000 US private practices spending more than eight hours a week; this is a company claim.
outcome_analysis: Health Harbor is an active four person YC S23 company that began as AI calling insurers for clinics and now lists customers and claims of thousands of automated calls daily. Funding is not verified beyond aggregator claims of about 500 thousand dollars, and no shutdown, acquisition or layoff was found, so the outcome so far is early and unproven.

name: Healthtech 1
tags: Health Tech; Workflow Automation; Digital Health; Healthcare; Healthcare IT
one_liner: Navigating patients to the right place, first time.
long_description:
Healthtech-1 builds clinical AI that navigates patients to the right place, first time. Today we automate eligibility checks, triage and appointment booking for 1,600+ NHS GP practices.

Tomorrow, every healthcare appointment - GP, pharmacy, dentist, physio - is instantly bookable on bookable.health.

Why now?
The NHS has come a long way, but access to it hasn't. Patient satisfaction is at a 25-year low. Automating access to care - eligibility, triage, booking - is how we reverse the trend.
regions: United Kingdom; Europe
target_customer: NHS GP practices in England, paying per automated registration or via subscription
problem: GP practice staff spend hours on patient registration, eligibility checks, triage and booking, while patient access to care is poor.
business_model: B2B SaaS to GP practices with free tier and a per registration fee, plus booking products

outcome_analysis: Healthtech-1 grew from a registration automation into a 40 person company claiming coverage of 1,600+ NHS GP practices, with a mid 2024 seed round led by Moonfire. Wide practice adoption of a narrow admin wedge, and a UK buying channel through G-Cloud, point to real product market fit, while later rounds remain unverified.

name: Hegel AI
one_liner: Open source tools for developing generative AI applications
long_description:
We build tools for developing applications with generative AI models. Whether you are using LLMs, vector databases, and text-to-image models like Stable Diffusion, our tools help you find the right model, prompt, configuration and consistently monitor their behaviors in production.

---

**PromptTools**: the first open-source, developer-focused SDK for experimenting with and evaluating prompts, models, and vector databases. You can try the repo here: https://github.com/hegelai/prompttools. If you're building with LLMs and struggling with evaluation, reach out and we can help.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Developers and teams building applications on large language models, with enterprise support as the paid layer
problem: Developers building with LLMs, vector databases and image models lack simple tools to compare models and prompts and to monitor behavior in production.
business_model: Open source SDK with paid enterprise support and a planned hosted UI and observability product
product_category: LLM evaluation and observability developer tools
market_need_then: The YC launch post cites over a thousand downloads per week of PromptTools after launch and use cases such as monitoring GPT-4 regressions, suggesting demand from developers in 2023.
outcome_analysis: Hegel AI is an active two person YC S23 company with an open source product that drew over a thousand weekly downloads at launch and a family office investment in January 2024. The company site returned 404 in this run, and funding totals are unverified, so its long term outcome is unclear.

name: Helicone
tags: AIOps; Developer Tools; Analytics; Open Source
one_liner: LLM Observability for Developers
long_description:
Helicone.ai is creating an advanced observability platform tailored for developers working with Large Language Models (LLMs). Our goal is to simplify and enhance the operational side of deploying these models, making it easier for developers to monitor, manage, and optimize their AI applications at scale. Helicone provides a unified view of performance, cost, and user interaction metrics for various LLM providers, like OpenAI, Anthropic, and LangChain, empowering developers to make their LLM deployments more efficient, reliable, and cost-effective.

### Key Features

1. **Centralized Observability**: Our platform captures and visualizes detailed logs and metrics across all LLM deployments. With tools for prompt management, performance tracing, and debugging, Helicone provides real-time insights into the inner workings of your LLMs.

2. **LLM Performance Optimization**: Helicone supports prompt experimentation, success rate tracking, and fine-tuning, allowing you to continuously improve response quality and efficiency. This level of insight makes it easier to deliver high-performing, cost-effective AI applications.

3. **Flexible Data Management**: We understand that data privacy is critical. Helicone supports deployment options for dedicated instances, hybrid cloud integrations, or self-hosted environments, allowing clients to maintain control over their data and ensuring compliance with privacy standards.

### Built for Developers and Data Scientists

Helicone is designed to meet the needs of engineers and data scientists who require transparency and control over their LLMs. From chatbots to document processing systems, Helicone equips you with the insights needed to track costs, understand user interactions, and optimize outputs—all from one intuitive platform.

By combining observability with LLM-specific insights, Helicone is redefining AI monitoring, empowering developers to deploy and scale their AI models with confidence.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Developers and engineering teams shipping LLM powered applications
problem: Teams calling OpenAI and other LLM APIs lacked visibility into cost, latency, errors and user behavior. Helicone sits as a proxy and logs requests with one line integration.
business_model: Open source core with usage based SaaS tiers and self hosting
product_category: LLM observability and AI gateway
founder_names: Justin Torre; Barak Oshri; Scott Nguyen; Cole Gottdank
market_need_then: After ChatGPT and the OpenAI API boom in early 2023, developers needed to track spend and debug prompts in production, and no standard tooling existed yet.
outcome_analysis: Helicone caught the 2023 LLM tooling wave with an open source proxy and reached about 16,000 organizations in three years. Competition from LangSmith, Langfuse and others was heavy and the team joined Mintlify in March 2026, with the product moving to maintenance mode, which suggests a soft exit rather than a breakout.

name: Hindsight

long_description:
Hindsight's AI helps teams understand why they win or lose deals - and use that insight to win more.

Our platform is used by teams like Ironclad, LaunchDarkly, and Klaviyo to build workflows on top of their GTM data.

1. Build battlecards, objection handling guides, and case studies that never go out of date
2. Create AI roleplays based on real conversations your sales team is having

regions: United States of America; America / Canada

name: Hippo Scribe

name: HockeyStack
one_liner: The operating system for inbound B2B revenue
long_description:
HockeyStack improves sales outcomes for B2B companies by helping them record and understand every interaction their customers have with their marketing, sales reps, CSMs, and products. 

We map every customer touchpoint from ad impression to closed won and to upsell using our own tracking script and native integrations to the B2B GTM tech stack.

- Deploy marketing budget: "Launch this ad campaign to this audience to generate $XM in pipeline"
- Target the right accounts with the right messaging: "These accounts have the highest likelihood to convert, put them on this email sequence"
- Convert more of the pipeline: “Pied Piper hasn't visited the site for 8 days; give Jim a phone call”

name: Hona

In addition to status updates, Hona allows clients to upload documents, securely message their legal team, and share feedback—all in one place. Hona integrates seamlessly with the law firm's existing case management systems, making it easy to implement without disrupting day-to-day operations.

Hona's long-term vision is to transform client communication across the legal industry by making clarity and transparency the standard.

name: Honeydew
one_liner: The home for shared data logic
long_description:
The way people use data is constantly changing. Data teams must support every new context without breaking the shared truth. Honeydew’s semantic layer does it automatically. We validate each change and update every data flow.

Using Honeydew, data teams can support 10x more data users - without more engineers or compromising integrity.

Funding visibility is poor, so scale is unknown, and no shutdown or sale was found.

name: HyLight
tags: Hydrogen Energy; B2B; Climate; Energy; Aerospace
one_liner: Unmanned airships for inspecting our critical assets
long_description:
HyLight builds and operates the HyLighters. Our autonomous airships for long range monitoring. We focus on critical infrastructure inspections:
- detecting methane leaks on pipelines.
- defects & vegetation risks on power lines.
- defects & vegetation risks on railways.

Our innovation, the HyLighter, is a crossover between drone and airship technology. Like a drone, it is easily controllable and transportable. And, like an airship, it is extremely energy-efficient, enabling it to fly for up to 10 hours at slow speed (22mph) for optimal data collection which represents a range of 220miles. 

Today, energy infrastructure operators struggle with conducting inspections that are simultaneously: massive and precise. HyLight offers a solution to precisely detect issues on the infrastructure at an industrial scale, and all of this without emitting GHGs.

We are 3 co-founders experienced in hardware and energy companies with Masters in Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science and Business from the best Engineering and Business School in France.

We have manufactured 20 HyLighter and are deploying across Europe.
regions: France; Europe
target_customer: Energy and infrastructure operators (power line, pipeline and railway owners) that pay for inspection data
problem: Helicopter and drone inspections of long linear infrastructure are polluting, costly or short range. HyLight flies hydrogen-powered autonomous airships with sensors for long, precise inspection runs.
business_model: Inspection as a service with own hardware, data platform and reports
product_category: Autonomous airship drones for infrastructure inspection
founder_names: Martin Bocken; Josef Rokusek; Thomas Laporte
market_need_then: Operators must inspect long networks regularly and methane leak and vegetation rules push for frequent checks. The 2024 round announcements describe the decarbonisation of aerial inspection as the pitch; no dated spend figure was found.
outcome_analysis: HyLight raised about 3.7 million euros in April 2024 and 13 million euros in October 2026, and by October 2026 reported four airships in operation with Enedis planning 15,570 km of inspections. The hardware moat and utility pilots helped it raise. The risk noted by Tech Funding News is whether utilities sign contracts large enough to fund a 15 aircraft fleet. No shutdown or sale was found.

name: Hyperbound
tags: AI-Enhanced Learning; B2B; Sales; Sales Enablement; Conversational AI
one_liner: Revenue Activation Platform
long_description:

name: MagnaPlay
one_liner: AI-powered game translation.
long_description:
MagnaPlay is game translation simplified into SAAS. Every game needs to be translated - a process which currently consists of finding freelancers, verifying their quality, negotiating prices, building contracts and waiting months for them to deliver. 

With MagnaPlay, game developers cut out the middleman and get results 5x faster, at half the price and with more reliable quality. Our combination of AI, expert translators and SAAS fully integrates translation into the gamedev workflow, ensuring games are translated and reach the worldwide audiences that love them so much.
regions: Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Indie, mid-market and publisher game studios that need to translate their games into many languages
problem: Game translation means finding freelancers, vetting quality, negotiating prices and contracts, and waiting months for delivery.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription combining machine translation, human translator review and QA
product_category: Game localization software
founder_names: Pedro Esteves; Paulo Rodrigues; Eugenio Sanchez Rabiella
market_need_then: The company's own launch copy describes slow, costly freelancer-based translation as the pain. No dated independent demand data was found.
outcome_analysis: MagnaPlay joined YC in Winter 2023 with an AI plus human game translation SaaS and appears to have raised only a small pre-seed. No later funding, customer or product news was found, and the original domain now redirects to a for-sale page, which suggests the company may have stalled even though YC lists it as Active. The cause, if any, is not public.

name: Maintouch
one_liner: Make more $$$ with SEO and AEO
long_description: We help you turn SEO and AEO into your best growth channel. I grew up working at my family's 9-figure SEO agency and learned how to automate everything. That's what we do for people now.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: B2B software and startup companies that want organic search and AI search traffic without an agency
problem: SEO and now answer engine optimization are labor heavy and agencies are slow and expensive. Maintouch automates the work with AI plus human experts.
business_model: Subscription: analytics and visibility from 149 dollars a month and an agent platform from 1,999 dollars a month
product_category: SEO and AEO automation platform and service
market_need_then: Agencies dominated SEO spend. The AEO category emerged later as AI assistants started citing brands, which the company now sells against.
outcome_analysis: Maintouch grew out of the founder's experience in his family SEO agency and joined YC in Summer 2023. It now sells SEO and AEO automation, lists six customers with large traffic gains, has about 9 to 15 staff and holds SOC 2 Type II. No verified funding round, exit or shutdown was found. The record is largely company reported, so the outcome is unproven.

name: Mandel AI
tags: Logistics; Manufacturing; Supply Chain; Procurement; AI
one_liner: AI Coordination Layer for Supply Chain
long_description:
Mandel runs the operational work across direct-materials sourcing and ordering - from RFQ through invoice - for manufacturers and distributors. It coordinates suppliers, checks orders and invoices against agreed terms, resolves discrepancies, recovers supplier credits, and keeps the ERP current.

Working across email, supplier portals, EDI, and ERP systems, Mandel investigates issues and carries out the next steps within your team’s approval rules.
regions: Bulgaria; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Manufacturers and distributors with direct materials procurement and supplier email workflows
problem: Supplier coordination from RFQ to invoice still runs on email, portals and ERP updates by hand. Mandel reads supplier messages, checks them against POs and contracts, and acts within approval rules.
business_model: B2B enterprise software for procurement operations
product_category: AI agents for supply chain and procurement coordination
market_need_then: Supplier communication ran on email at manufacturers, an observation from a Fortune 500 executive conversation about a year before the March 2026 announcement. Its YC page claims 50 million dollars of material spend processed; the 2026 announcement says over 1 billion.
outcome_analysis: Mandel started in YC Summer 2023, moved from supply chain planning tools to AI coordination of supplier communication around 2025, and announced a 3.9 million dollar seed round on 2026-03-25 with Y Combinator, Category Ventures, Ritual Capital and e2vc. It lists customers in aerospace, pharma and medical devices and SOC 2 Type II compliance. There is no sign of an exit or failure, and the long path from batch to seed shows slow early traction.

name: Mantys
one_liner: AI agents for healthcare and insurance operations in GCC
long_description: Mantys builds AI agents that automate healthcare and insurance operations. We work with some of the largest healthcare groups in the Middle East, including Aster, NMC, Zulekha, Medcare, Thumbay and Fakeeh. Our agents automate patient access workflows such as insurance eligibility, registration and prior authorization by working across hospital information systems, payer portals and unstructured documents. Today, Mantys is deployed across 100+ healthcare facilities and processes workflows for more than 40,000 patients every day.
regions: United Arab Emirates; Middle East and North Africa; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Hospital groups and healthcare providers in the GCC (current); SaaS finance teams (at YC entry)
problem: Originally SaaS companies struggled to calculate and forecast ARR from CRM and billing data without spreadsheets. Now hospitals spend staff time on insurance eligibility, registration and prior authorization.
business_model: B2B software and AI agents for healthcare operations (current)
product_category: AI agents for healthcare revenue cycle and insurance operations; earlier SaaS ARR analytics
market_need_then: Finance teams reconciled ARR across spreadsheets, as described on the original YC launch. Current need is manual insurance workflows in GCC hospitals, which the company says it serves across 100 plus facilities and 40,000 patients per day (self reported).
outcome_analysis: Mantys entered YC Winter 2023 with an ARR analytics tool for SaaS companies, a crowded category, and later pivoted to AI agents for hospital insurance workflows in the Gulf. By its own account it now serves more than 100 facilities. No verified funding beyond aggregator figures, no exit and no shutdown were found, so the pivot's success is claimed by the company rather than independently shown.

name: Margin

long_description: Margin is empowering beer, wine & liquor stores with amazing technology. We bring enterprise-level sophistication to liquor retailers, giving them one integrated operating system for every part of their business. We increase profits for liquor stores who have been underserved by technology.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada

business_model: SaaS POS subscription plus payment processing revenue
product_category: Vertical POS and operating system for liquor retail

outcome_analysis: Margin, from Transformity Inc., is a liquor store POS by founders from liquor retail families who worked at Amazon and AWS. It joined YC in Summer 2023 and has a Stripe case study claiming 5x payment volume growth in ten months. No verified funding, exit or shutdown was found. Direct competitors raised larger rounds in 2025 to 2026, so the outcome is still open.

name: Matano
one_liner: Cloud Native SIEM (alternative to Splunk/Elastic)
long_description:
Matano is a modern SIEM, built for cloud-first security teams. 

It replaces traditional SIEM databases like Splunk or Elastic with a cybersecurity platform built on top of a cost-effective Security Data Lake.
all_locations: Seattle, WA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Cloud first security teams running on AWS that find Splunk and Elastic too costly
problem: Traditional SIEMs are expensive to scale. Matano offers an open source security data lake in the customer's AWS account with detections as code.
business_model: Open source core (Apache 2.0) with a commercial managed Cloud SIEM
product_category: Open source cloud native SIEM and security data lake
market_need_then: SIEM cost at scale and data lake architecture were live themes in 2022 to 2023; the Launch HN post in January 2023 pitched an open source lower cost alternative to Splunk and Elastic.
outcome_analysis: Matano is a two person open source SIEM company that launched in 2022, joined YC Winter 2023 and posted a Launch HN in January 2023. Aggregators report about 500 thousand dollars raised mostly from the YC deal, and it also offers a managed Cloud SIEM. No exit or shutdown was found. With an Apache 2.0 license and strong incumbents, the commercial outcome is unproven.

name: Maven Bio
tags: Generative AI; Biotech; Healthcare; Enterprise; Healthcare IT
one_liner: Live intelligence for biopharma teams.
long_description:
Maven Bio is a live intelligence platform for biopharma teams. It continuously monitors clinical, regulatory, company, and deal developments, identifies what matters to each team's priorities, and delivers signals and updates to keep key documents current. Its monitoring agent can apply edits automatically, with sources attached and the option to roll back changes.

Maven runs thousands of monitors across company and individual product websites, trade press, health technology assessment bodies, and patient advocacy groups worldwide. Teams use that intelligence to maintain competitive views, asset screens, and recurring briefs, in Maven or through connected AI assistants and custom workflows.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Biopharma and biotech teams, life sciences consultants and investment firms that track clinical, regulatory and deal news
problem: Biopharma teams spend analyst time manually tracking trials, regulatory moves and competitor news and keeping key documents current.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with API and webhooks
product_category: AI market intelligence for biopharma
market_need_then: Pharma teams relied on analyst reports and manual monitoring; generative AI in 2023 made automated synthesis feasible. Specific spend evidence was not found.
outcome_analysis: Maven Bio joined YC in Summer 2023 and stayed small, raising a 3.1 million dollar seed only in April 2025, about 20 months after the batch. It rode the generative AI tailwind in a niche with established intelligence vendors. It remains active with a team near ten and no reported exit.

name: Maxi

long_description: Maxi is an iMessage-based, AI-native agent for your personal finances. It connects to all your accounts (secure read-only access) and Gmail and proactively texts you to help cancel subscriptions, identify split expenses, and send Venmo requests (on your behalf). It also tracks your net worth, reminds you about bills, and keeps you in line with your budgets.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada

business_model: Consumer subscription (not confirmed by a source)

outcome_analysis: Maxi was a two person team in Winter 2023 that later positioned itself as an AI agent on iMessage. No funding, traction, exit or shutdown is publicly documented, so no outcome story can be supported beyond it still being listed as active on the YC directory.

name: Mercoa
one_liner: AI Agent for Billpay platforms to pay invoices with virtual cards
long_description: Mercoa helps AP and Spend management platforms drive more virtual card volume from their BillPay customers. Our agent identifies card-eligible invoices and securely pays them through supplier portals or payment links.

name: Metal
one_liner: The AI context platform for private capital. Everything your firm…
long_description:
Firm proprietary data is only as sharp as the context around it. Metal is the context platform for private capital.

It structures everything a firm has touched, every deal, company, and figure, along with every decision the deal team has made, into one context graph. So the AI tools your deal teams already rely on, like Claude, ChatGPT, and Copilot, can reason with the firm's own knowledge. Every deal feeds back into the graph, so the firm's edge compounds: each decision sharpens the one that follows.

Metal is purpose-built for private equity and private credit. We turn what a firm knows into how it wins.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Private equity and private credit firms (deal teams and CTOs)
problem: Private capital firms keep deals, documents, figures and decision rationale scattered across CRMs, file stores, data rooms and email, so AI tools cannot reason over the firm's own knowledge.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to private capital firms, with integrations via API and MCP
product_category: AI context graph and diligence platform for private equity
founder_names: Taylor Lowe; James O'Dwyer; Sergio Prada
market_need_then: Early 2023 saw a surge of interest in LLMs. The founders reported that private equity had fragmented data across CRMs, repositories and local storage, per a 2025 funding article. Berkshire Partners was an early customer.
outcome_analysis: Metal started in W23 as LLM developer infrastructure, then narrowed to private equity after early work with Berkshire Partners. It reportedly raised a small round in 2023 and a $5M seed led by Base10 Partners in 2025, and now names firms such as Berkshire, Clearlake and Valesco as customers. It remains active with 17 people. The pivot into a vertical with high-value buyers and the LLM tailwind drive the story; funding stays modest and the rounds are only partly confirmed.

name: Metal

long_description:
Backed by a16z and YC, Metal is building an AI-native operating system for founders raising venture rounds. Metal brings proprietary intelligence on the venture ecosystem, enabling founders to identify the "most likely" investors, research various firms, and identify who they know that can introduce them to specific investors.

More than 100 YC founders have signed as paying customers.
regions: Pakistan; South Asia
target_customer: Startup founders raising venture rounds, and later investor relations users

business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for founders
product_category: AI fundraising operating system

outcome_analysis: Metal started in Winter 2023 with a founder who had previously built and raised for Airlift, giving direct fundraising experience. Its first publicly reported round is a 4.5 million dollar seed from a16z speedrun and YC in 2026, with company claimed strong quarterly growth that is unverified. It is still active.

name: Metalware
one_liner: Firmware cybersecurity
long_description:
Metalware develops advanced firmware security solutions for critical infrastructure, protecting industries like aerospace, defense, automotive, telecom, and healthcare from cyber threats.

Our product is an automated, intelligent binary fuzzer that enables organizations to efficiently discover and remediate security weaknesses in hardware products before deployment.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Makers and operators of embedded devices in aerospace, defense, automotive, telecom, medical and ICS, plus government buyers
problem: Firmware bugs in embedded devices are hard to find without source code, hardware or test harnesses.
business_model: Enterprise software licenses and government contracts (pricing unpublished)
product_category: Firmware security and automated binary fuzzing
market_need_then: Rising attention to firmware and supply chain security for critical infrastructure; specific dated demand evidence not found.
outcome_analysis: Metalware raised a reported 3 million dollar seed shortly after its Summer 2023 batch and built an automated binary fuzzer sold into defense and critical infrastructure, reaching the 2025 RSAC Innovation Sandbox top ten per LinkedIn. The team stays at about four. No exit or later round is confirmed.

name: Middleware
one_liner: AI-based full stack observability platform
long_description:
Middleware is a full-stack cloud observability platform. We allow the dev and ops teams to debug the issue faster by bringing all the metrics, logs, traces, and events to a single unified timeline and train data to AI so it can give better insight into infrastructure and application.  

- Single command installation to collect all the metrics, logs, traces, and events.
- AI-based anomaly and error detection 
- GPT 4-based error resolution
- Support Infrastructure monitoring, Logs, APM, Kubernetes Monitoring, Synthetic Monitoring,  RUM, Custom dashboard, and Alerts. 
- Full-stack observability, observe any stack at any scale.

We are at Middleware and wanted to make cloud observability faster, cheaper, and better.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Development and operations teams that pay for cloud observability
problem: Teams pay high prices for observability tools and juggle metrics, logs and traces in separate places when debugging.
business_model: Usage based SaaS subscription
product_category: Full stack cloud observability platform
market_need_then: Founder cited high observability costs at his previous company; the pitch is cheaper and faster than incumbents, but dated spend evidence was not found.
outcome_analysis: Middleware went through YC in Winter 2023 with a repeat founder who had already built Acquire.io, and raised a 6.5 million dollar seed in August 2023 led by 8VC. It planned a Series A by mid 2024 but none is found. It reached about 40 people per YC and is still active in a crowded market.

name: Midrender

long_description: Midrender is a visual editor for creating motion graphics, powered by AI. Point the agent at your codebase, it reads your code, understands the feature, and creates an animated walkthrough you can ship. A full timeline and design editor lets you fine-tune every detail.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Product and marketing teams who need launch videos and motion graphics

business_model: SaaS subscription (a directory lists a 20 dollar monthly plan, unverified)
product_category: AI motion graphics editor
market_need_then: Demand for programmatic and templated video was shown by the open source Revideo project, but dated evidence for Midrender itself was not found.
outcome_analysis: Midrender is a one person company from Summer 2023 whose founder also built the open source Revideo library. It now sells an AI motion graphics editor. No funding, exit or traction figures are public, so no outcome story is supportable beyond it being active.

name: Milio
one_liner: B2B-2C real-time account to account payments
long_description:
Milio is a fully interoperable and immediate payment system for Colombia through a single API connected to millions of accounts. Milio allows companies to perform payable and receivable in real time without ACH rails.

We provide our solution through two Plug and Play integrations:

PID payment button:
End-to-end, white label, native, non-redirection payment technology for your customers to pay you account-to-account more efficiently than PSE, without heavy and inefficient ACH cycles and fixed rates.

Technology: API, SDK, Checkout UI.

Immediate disbursement:
Single API connection to all banks, allowing any company or person to disburse 24/7, in real-time, with immediate crediting of funds to third parties at any bank or digital wallet.

Technology: API, Dashboard UI.
regions: Colombia; Latin America; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Colombian companies, fintechs, wallets and banks that need to collect and disburse money in real time
problem: Colombian account to account payments ran through PSE and ACH cycles with delays and fixed fees. Companies could not collect or disburse instantly across all banks.
business_model: B2B payments API with per transaction fees
product_category: Real-time account to account payments infrastructure
founder_names: Juan Luis Perez E; Daniel Gomez; Toni Riera
market_need_then: The YC description says PSE and ACH rails were slow and charged fixed rates, and companies wanted 24/7 immediate disbursement.
outcome_analysis: Milio is still active with about 16 people per YC. No acquisition, shutdown or layoffs were found. Funding figures conflict across aggregators, so its progress cannot be judged. The Bre-B central bank rail launched in 2025 is a risk to the original wedge and the company's site now describes cross border and bank core connections.

name: Minded

long_description: Generate AI agents with plain English, edit visually, customize with code in your own IDE. Currently automating millions of tasks across support, sales, finance and more for companies like eToro, Payoneer and JustEat.
