problem: Syncing data from third-party APIs into a product database needs auth, pagination, backfill and change listening boilerplate.
business_model: Usage or subscription ETL for developers
product_category: API data sync (ETL) for SaaS integrations
market_need_then: Founder says repeated integration boilerplate was the pain, per the YC launch post; no dated spend figures.
outcome_analysis: Portalform launched the Fiber API sync service in the W23 batch with a solo founder, but its current website presents a mix of personal tools and no longer leads with Fiber. No funding or exit is publicly confirmed, so the cause of the shift away from the original product is not public, and the outcome is unclear.

name: Proglix
one_liner: B2B Marketplace for Steel Raw Materials
long_description: Proglix is a marketplace for small and medium manufacturers to buy metal and steel raw materials in Indonesia. With our platform, customers can easily order domestic and import raw materials with cheaper price, no minimum order quantities, 2x faster in SLA and real time inventory stock.
regions: Indonesia; Southeast Asia; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Small and medium manufacturers in Indonesia buying steel and metal raw materials
problem: SMEs in Indonesia face high prices, minimum order quantities, slow delivery and no inventory visibility when buying steel; Proglix aggregates domestic and imported supply with credit financing.
business_model: B2B marketplace and aggregator (margin on goods) with 30-day credit financing
product_category: B2B steel and raw materials marketplace
founder_names: Wynn Wijaya; Wendy Wijaya; Prawira Indrawan
market_need_then: Fragmented Indonesian steel supply with minimum order quantities and slow delivery; 500 Global backed it and the company reported 200+ manufacturing plants connected on its site.
outcome_analysis: Proglix, founded in 2022 by founders with Indonesian steel distribution experience, raised a $1.35M seed in February 2023 led by 500 Global after YC Winter 2023 and was the only Indonesian company in that batch. It is still operating with a Singapore holding company and a reported team of 25, with no later round or exit found, so its outcome so far is growth without a verified follow-on.

name: Proof of Human
one_liner: continuous human verification without CAPTCHAs or user friction
long_description:
Proof of Human is an API that invisibly detects bots and verifies human identity.

Founded by Princeton cognitive scientists, Proof of Human leverages world-class research with industry-beating benchmarks so platforms can verify their human users friction-free.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Online platforms and market research panels that need to filter bots and AI agents from real users (survey panels, financial sign-ups, ticketing)
problem: CAPTCHAs add friction and increasingly fail against AI agents, so platforms cannot cheaply tell humans from bots.
business_model: usage-based API sold to platforms
product_category: bot detection and human verification API
market_need_then: Search results show bot and AI agent traffic and survey fraud as a live pain by 2025; no source dated near the 2023 batch was found, so need at founding is inferred only from the YC page pitch.
outcome_analysis: Proof of Human is active with a five person team as of the YC page and no reported acquisition, shutdown or layoffs. It started as Roundtable and now sells an invisible bot verification API; its public traction claims are 10M plus monthly sessions and named customers like Stanford Psychology. Funding is not publicly confirmed, so its trajectory cannot be judged beyond staying alive and shipping.

name: PropRise
tags: Machine Learning; SaaS; Real Estate; B2B; Analytics
one_liner: The AI platform for CRE investment teams
long_description: PropRise is the AI platform for institutional CRE investment teams. We automate the tedious, Excel-heavy workflows that slow down dealmaking: from sourcing to underwriting to due diligence. Our two live products serve 50+ customers including Public Storage: Beacon automates site selection for developers, and Primer extracts financial data from deal packages into structured, model-ready formats, cutting hours of analyst work to minutes. We're expanding across asset classes to become the operating system for CRE dealmaking.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Institutional commercial real estate investment teams, developers and brokers, with a focus on self-storage
problem: CRE teams spend analyst hours extracting deal package data into Excel models and screening sites by hand.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription
product_category: AI underwriting and site selection software for commercial real estate
market_need_then: The YC page says CRE workflows are Excel heavy and slow dealmaking; no dated 2023 source for spend or complaints was found.
outcome_analysis: PropRise is active and has grown from a three person team on the YC page to claiming 50 plus customers including Public Storage and Bain Capital on its site. Primer reportedly launched in 2024-01 for self-storage deals and Beacon covers site selection. No acquisition, shutdown or layoffs were found; funding is thinly documented so its financing progress is unknown.

name: Propexo
tags: Developer Tools; SaaS; B2B; Proptech; API
one_liner: Plaid for Commercial Real Estate
long_description: Propexo lets engineers build, test, and launch CRE software integrations in days, not months. We modernize the developer experience for our customers, providing clear documentation and robust infrastructure to support the needs of property owners, property managers, & proptechs.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Proptech software builders, property owners and managers needing integrations with property management systems
problem: Each property management system has its own integration, so engineers spend months building point connections.
business_model: B2B SaaS and usage-based unified API
product_category: unified API and data platform for property management systems
founder_names: Remen Okoruwa; Nick Johnson; Ben Keller
market_need_then: Seed coverage states that integrations took engineers months and that founders pitched a universal translator between systems; no quantified spend figure was found.
outcome_analysis: Propexo pivoted out of the rent payment app RentDrop in fall 2022, was in YC Winter 2023 and closed a 3.3M seed in October 2023 led by Prudence. It remains active and now sells a data platform for multifamily plus the unified API, with 127 plus integrations claimed on its site. A later 5M Series A and a 9M total appear only on CB Insights, so growth after seed is unverified.

name: Prosper
one_liner: AI Phone Agents for Healthcare Operations
long_description:
Prosper builds AI phone agents for healthcare providers. Our agents automate manual, time-intensive workflows like patient scheduling, balance reminders, claims status checks, benefit verification, and prior authorizations. We integrate with 80+ EHRs, go live in 3 weeks, and offer a no-code interface for customization.

Today, Prosper handles thousands of daily calls for dozens of providers, reducing costs by 50% and tripling productivity. We’re building the AI-first operating system for healthcare to eliminate the $200B lost to administrative overhead every year.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Outpatient healthcare practices and provider groups, plus revenue cycle teams making payer calls
problem: Practices lose time and money to phone based admin: scheduling, benefits checks, prior authorizations and claims follow-up.
business_model: B2B SaaS for AI voice agents, priced by usage or contract
product_category: healthcare voice AI agents
market_need_then: Both founders cite call center experience; the site claims 200B dollars of admin overhead yearly (company claim). No dated 2023 source for need was found.
outcome_analysis: Prosper reached 60 people by the directory data and raised a 5M seed in September 2025 and a 30M a16z led Series A in June 2026. Coverage reports revenue growing 4x since Q2 2025 and EHR integrations with 80 plus systems. Voice AI tailwinds and the founders' call center operating experience fit the success story; the claims are company reported.

name: Punchcard
one_liner: Agentive assurance system for auditors, risk consultants, and clients.
long_description:
Punchcard is a system designed for assurance engagements like financial statement audits and SOX control programs. Purpose-built for selecting, requesting, and testing audit evidence. Punchcard leverages assertion-driven AI agents that perform testing procedures from natural language instructions—just like an audit associate.

By combining critical workflows such as audit planning, client document requests, evidence testing, and workpaper documentation into one seamless platform, Agentive streamlines audit processes, reduces inefficiencies, and frees teams to focus on high-impact areas.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Audit and risk advisory firms running financial statement audits and SOX programs
problem: Auditors manually select, request and test evidence and document workpapers, which is slow and repetitive.
business_model: B2B SaaS for audit firms
product_category: AI agents for audit and assurance workflows
market_need_then: No dated 2023 source on audit labor cost or demand was found; the YC page frames audit evidence testing as manual.
outcome_analysis: Punchcard (formerly Agentive) is active in Provo and the site claims customers such as RSM, Richey May and JLK Rosenberger and SOC 2 certification. No acquisition, shutdown or layoffs were found. Funding is not verifiable from primary sources, so whether it has raised beyond YC is unknown.

name: Pure
one_liner: Marketplace for Rare Coins & Precious Metals
long_description: Pure is the first transparent marketplace for the $11B Rare Coins Sector & $55B Precious Metals sector. We make it easy to buy & sell authenticated rare coins and precious metals such as Gold, Silver, Platinum, Palladium & Rhodium.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Retail buyers and sellers of bullion and certified rare coins, plus dealers
problem: Retailers charge 10 to 30 percent over spot on precious metals while cash-for-gold buyers pay about 30 percent under spot; no transparent price discovery exists.
business_model: marketplace take rate on an order book
product_category: precious metals and rare coin marketplace
market_need_then: The YC launch post cites predatory premiums and 30 percent below spot buyback; the company claims an 11B rare coin and 55B precious metals market.
outcome_analysis: Pure is active, grew from the YC launch to an order book marketplace with sellers, vaulting and a Trustpilot presence, and its team size is the largest of those in this batch of records. No acquisition, shutdown or lawsuit was found. A reported November 2025 round of about 15.6M is on aggregators only, so financing success is plausible but unverified.

name: Pylon
tags: B2B; Customer Success; Customer Support; AI
one_liner: The Agentic Support Platform purpose-built for B2B.
long_description:
Pylon is the only agentic support platform, purpose-built for B2B companies. For leaders scaling AI-native support teams, Pylon lets humans and agents collaborate on customer work – investigating, resolving, and acting on every signal across every channel that matters.

Unlike platforms built before the AI era, Pylon enriches every interaction with deep account-level context, automates the low impact customer work, and surfaces answers before your team even has to ask. The result: faster responses, happier customers, and a system that continuously improves itself.

Hundreds of fast-growing YC companies of all sizes like Retool, Hightouch, and Deel use Pylon to manage their customers.

Learn more at usepylon.com
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: B2B companies that support customers through Slack, Teams and email
problem: B2B support lives in shared Slack channels, which generic helpdesks handle poorly, so teams stitch together ticketing, customer success and knowledge tools.
business_model: B2B SaaS per seat plus usage credits for agents
product_category: B2B customer support platform with AI agents
founder_names: Marty Kausas; Advith Chelikani; Robert Eng
market_need_then: Series B post says Pylon began as a Slack to Zendesk integration in November 2022, indicating B2B teams already ran support in Slack; 2024 coverage describes buying separate tools for ticketing and success.
outcome_analysis: Pylon started as a Slack to Zendesk integration in November 2022, raised a 3.2M seed from General Catalyst, a 17M Series A from a16z in August 2024 and a 31M Series B in August 2025 for about 51M total. Customer counts rose from 750 plus at the Series B to a claimed 1,800 plus on the site. Repositioning as an agentic support platform in 2026 fits the AI tailwind and strong investor follow-ons.

name: Quill Bills
tags: Healthcare; Health Insurance; Healthcare IT; Billing; AI
one_liner: AI-Powered Medical Billing
long_description:
Quill Bills is a medical billing company that works with healthcare providers to significantly lower billing costs and recover denied claims.
Our platform performs much of a biller's job autonomously, and we sell this platform to private practice doctors and medical MSOs.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Independent medical practices, private practice doctors and MSOs
problem: Doctors pay billing agencies 2 to 10 percent of revenue and insurers deny up to 30 percent of claim revenue without follow-up.
business_model: software plus AI billing, likely priced as a share of revenue or subscription (not stated)
product_category: AI revenue cycle management and practice management
market_need_then: YC launch post cites agency fees of 2 to 10 percent and denials up to 30 percent of revenue; the launch date is only 'about 1 year ago' per the page.
outcome_analysis: Quill Bills is a three person YC company that is active, with a 2026 review calling it a convincing AI native billing tool. The site names only TapMD as a customer and funding is not found. No acquisition or shutdown was reported, so the story is early, small and unproven.

name: RUUF
tags: Solar Power; Climate; Renewable Energy; ClimateTech
one_liner: Managed marketplace for solar in Latam
long_description: We offer no-money-down installations that generate free money for homeowners from day one. We are digitalizing the whole process of going solar. Instead of using traditional forms and leaving it up to customers to fill them, we use technology to take all that burden off our customers plate. We only ask for an address and offer free instant quotes.
regions: Chile; Latin America
target_customer: Chilean homeowners (and later small businesses) who want rooftop solar without paying upfront
problem: Residential solar in Chile had a long payback and a slow, form-heavy buying process, so few households adopted it despite net billing laws.
business_model: managed marketplace and installer for residential solar, sold with financing (no money down), later backed by debt and investment funds
product_category: residential solar installation and financing
founder_names: Domingo Garcia-Huidobro; Tomas Campos; Pedro Saratscheff
market_need_then: Chile's net billing law (2014) and distributed energy law 21.118 (2018) created incentives, but a CEPAL-hosted analysis described a roughly 9 year payback as unattractive to consumers, which a no-money-down offer targets. Electricity tariff increases later raised demand (Positive Ventures, 4x sales growth 2023 to 2024).
outcome_analysis: Ruuf was founded in 2022, entered YC in Winter 2023 and raised a pre-seed round around November 2022 after a first YC rejection for lacking a technical cofounder. Later press describes about 4x sales growth from 2023 to 2024 as electricity tariffs rose, 1,900 or more customers by the company site, and a 2026 move into dedicated debt and investment vehicles. No layoffs, shutdown or acquisition were found, so the company looks like a steady operator whose next test is financing scale in a small residential market.

name: Radical
one_liner: Building persistent, high-performance infrastructure in the sky
long_description: Radical’s StratoSats are autonomous platforms that provide satellite-like services on demand. They fly within Earth’s atmosphere to provide persistent, high performance infrastructure across applications in earth observation, connectivity, and more. Unlike satellites, StratoSats navigate freely without the need for rocket launches or orbits - reducing costs, increasing flexibility, and ensuring customers get the targeted coverage they need.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Government, defense, telecom and environmental monitoring customers that need persistent aerial coverage
problem: Satellites are costly to launch and cannot loiter over a target, while conventional aircraft cannot stay up for months, leaving a gap for persistent coverage and connectivity.
business_model: hardware platform providing satellite-like services from solar stratospheric aircraft (platform sales or service contracts; model not stated by sources)
product_category: high-altitude solar-powered uncrewed aircraft (StratoSats)
market_need_then: Demand for persistent surveillance, wildfire detection, maritime awareness and direct-to-device connectivity was rising, and Airbus was spinning out a dedicated HAPS venture in 2022.
outcome_analysis: Radical was founded in 2022 by two ex Amazon Prime Air engineers, joined YC in Winter 2023 and raised a 4.5 million seed round in April 2024 to build a full-scale aircraft. It flew a full-size Evenstar prototype in October 2025 and planned stratospheric tests for 2026. It remains a small, capital-light hardware company whose outcome depends on proving months-long flight against Airbus and Skydweller.

name: Rainmaker
one_liner: DeFi for Everyone
long_description: Rainmaker is an account abstraction-based crypto wallet that makes DeFi investing simple and fast. Set up a wallet with just an email, instantly deposit funds from your bank or credit card, and invest in DeFi without gas fees.
regions: Unspecified

name: Rally Tax
one_liner: AI-native tax platform to save $1T+ for Americans
long_description:
For millions of Americans, taxes are far more than a simple W-2. Managing investments, property, or a side business creates a world of complexity that makes DIY software risky, while traditional CPA help is often slow, expensive, and reactive. This broken system causes anxiety and leaves billions in potential savings on the table every year.

Rally is the modern solution for tax peace of mind. We are an AI-powered tax platform that provides proactive, year-round strategic guidance, not just seasonal filing. Our unique approach combines a smart platform that automates 80% of the manual work with a team of in-house experts to provide strategic advice. We deliver the expertise of a private advisor with the convenience and access of a modern tech company.

Our vision is to use the trust we earn in taxes to become the definitive financial co-pilot for our customers. We will expand from tax strategy into a full suite of services that helps millions of people proactively manage and optimize their entire financial future.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: High income US individuals with complex taxes such as RSUs, investments, property or side businesses
problem: DIY tax software is risky for complex situations while CPAs are slow, expensive and reactive, so savings are missed.
business_model: Subscription for year-round AI plus expert tax strategy
product_category: AI tax planning and advisory
market_need_then: Complex tax situations are a recognized pain, but no dated evidence for this company was found.
outcome_analysis: The YC directory lists Rally Tax as Acquired and as Winter 2023, but the YC page says it was founded in 2025 and gives no acquirer, date or terms, and no outside report of a sale was found. The record is internally inconsistent, so why it ended up as it did, and who bought it, is not public in the sources checked.

name: Rankai
one_liner: RankAI grows your website on autopilot
long_description:
Websites used to be static billboards, passive and waiting to be found.  

RankAI helps startups and agencies grow websites on autopilot. It learns from your site, market, competitors, and performance data to identify which pages should exist, creates them in your brand, publishes them directly to your live website, and continuously improves them based on real traffic and conversion — so your website gets discovered, trusted, and converted on by both human and Agents.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Startups and agencies that want organic search and AI search traffic without a marketing agency
problem: Growing a website through SEO needs constant research, page creation and optimization that small teams cannot afford or sustain.
business_model: B2B SaaS and managed service, with an agency partner program
product_category: AI agent for SEO, AEO and website growth
market_need_then: Search teams were adopting generative AI for content in 2023 and later shifted attention to AI answer engines, creating demand for automated SEO and GEO.
outcome_analysis: Rankai joined YC in Summer 2023 as a three to four person team building AI SEO automation and still lists as active. Its site shows named customers and case studies, and a self-reported tracker estimates modest revenue, but no verified funding or exit was found. The story is unresolved: it is a small operator in a crowded AI SEO market whose scale and funding are not publicly documented.

name: Read Bean
one_liner: Learn language with real-world content, at your level
long_description: Read Bean helps intermediate-advanced language learners and heritage speakers improve their literacy using real-world content. The app measures your initial reading level and automatically transforms texts into bite-sized lessons at your level. It adapts to your progress, reinforcing vocabulary and tailoring content to ensure continuous improvement.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Intermediate to advanced Chinese learners and heritage speakers who want to improve reading literacy
problem: Learners past beginner level lack reading material at their own vocabulary level, so literacy stalls.
business_model: consumer subscription app (premium monthly plan listed on the App Store)
product_category: language learning app, graded reading
market_need_then: Heritage speakers and intermediate learners lacked adaptive reading material, and LLMs made level-matched text cheap to produce from 2023.
outcome_analysis: Read Bean joined YC in Summer 2023 and launched on iOS in North America in January 2025 as a Chinese graded reading app, later adding roleplay speaking features. No funding, exit or shutdown was found, and a third-party tracker estimates modest installs and revenue with a declining install trend, which is unverified. The company appears to be a small active consumer app competing with established graded readers.

name: Readily
one_liner: AI Compliance Platform for Healthcare Organizations
long_description: Readily uses AI to free 20 million healthcare professionals from manual compliance work so they can focus on patient care. We've helped $B healthcare organizations cut regulatory analysis, policy drafting, and audit work by up to 90%, reducing consulting spend and compliance risk.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Health plans, state agencies, IPAs and MSOs, especially Medi-Cal managed care plans
problem: Healthcare organizations spend heavy consulting and staff time tracking regulatory changes, mapping them to policies and preparing audits.
business_model: enterprise SaaS for compliance and regulatory change management
product_category: AI compliance platform for healthcare
market_need_then: Medicaid managed care plans face frequent state and federal guidance letters and audits; the CHCF reports one plan cut compliance spend from 2 million to 120 thousand a year, which is a vendor-era claim.
outcome_analysis: Readily joined YC in Summer 2023 and focused on California Medicaid managed care plans, reporting 15 plans including L.A. Care and 25 million covered lives across 46 states by 2026. It raised an 11 million Series A in October 2026 led by Define Ventures to expand into operational oversight. Traction with regulated buyers and a clear compliance pain explain the raise, with no layoffs or exit reported.

name: RecipeUI
one_liner: The open source Postman alternative.
long_description: The first version of RecipeUI was a viral project at Robinhood that reached 100% adoption from all engineering and QA teams. When an API broke, anyone from Frontend to QA to PMs could debug without relying on backend engineers
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Developers and non-engineers such as QA, product and support staff who test APIs
problem: API tools such as Postman are developer oriented and heavy, so non-engineers cannot easily test APIs without help.
business_model: open source developer tool (monetization not stated by sources)
product_category: API testing client
market_need_then: Postman was widely criticized by 2023 for becoming heavier and account-gated, which opened room for lightweight open source clients, though this was not documented in a source dated 2023 that I opened.
outcome_analysis: RecipeUI launched an open source Postman alternative with YC in Summer 2023 and a Product Hunt launch in September 2023. YC lists it as active with two people, but AlternativeTo reports the GitHub repository was archived in February 2024 while SourceForge shows a 2025 update, so the current state is unclear. No verified funding, exit or post-mortem was found, which makes the real outcome uncertain and likely a stalled or dormant project.

name: Reflex
tags: Developer Tools; Open Source; Web Development; Infrastructure; AI
one_liner: Build the software you wish existed.
long_description:
For decades, businesses have adapted to software that wasn’t built for them. Teams pay for features they don’t need, go without the ones they do, and fill the gaps with spreadsheets, emails, and manual work. AI flips the equation. Now, software can be built around your business.

Reflex brings AI and engineering expertise to your business without requiring you to become a software company. We work alongside your team to identify where better software can make the biggest difference, build on or replace your existing systems, and help you put it to work.

Our platform gives every app a shared foundation, making your software easier to connect, maintain, and improve. As your business evolves, your software can evolve with it.

That foundation is Reflex, our open-source framework for building full-stack web apps entirely in Python. With 1M+ apps built, approximately 29,000 GitHub stars, and usage by 30% of the Fortune 500, Reflex gives developers a shared foundation for building and extending applications, with source code they can inspect, customize, and run themselves.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Python developers and enterprises building internal apps and full-stack web apps without a JavaScript frontend
problem: Building web apps requires separate frontend and backend skills; Python developers wanted full-stack apps in pure Python without the limits of dashboard tools.
business_model: open source framework with paid cloud hosting, AI app builder and forward-deployed engineering for enterprises
product_category: Python web framework and AI app builder
market_need_then: The launch post (December 2022) said existing Python frameworks such as Streamlit and Dash did not allow customizable full web apps, and the project grew quickly in open source before becoming a company.
outcome_analysis: Reflex began as the Pynecone open source framework in December 2022, joined YC in Winter 2023 and raised a 5 million seed led by Lux Capital in August 2023. It renamed in June 2023, grew a large GitHub following, and reported a Series A led by Standard Capital in late 2026 as it shifted toward AI app building for enterprises. Open source distribution drove adoption, and the main open question is monetizing the enterprise offering.

name: Relace
one_liner: Models and infra for coding agents
long_description: Relace makes it easy to deploy production-ready coding agents. Our models are co-optimized with infrastructure to achieve SoTA performance: 10k+ token/s code merging and retrieval across million-line repositories in seconds.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: AI coding agent and app-builder companies such as Lovable, Magic Patterns and Codebuff, plus developers buying open model inference
problem: Coding agents need fast, reliable ways to merge generated edits into code and retrieve the right files, and generic frontier models are slow and costly for those steps.
business_model: usage-based API for specialized models (apply, embeddings, reranking) and open model inference
product_category: models and infrastructure for coding agents
market_need_then: AI coding tools exploded in 2024, and agent builders needed faster code edit application, retrieval and reranking.
outcome_analysis: Relace is listed under YC Winter 2023 but its product launched around 2024 and it raised a 23 million Series A led by a16z in October 2025 with customers such as Lovable and Figma according to press. Its site later pitched open model inference with 30 trillion tokens served in 30 days (self-reported). Strong timing in the AI coding boom and fast execution explain the raise, while commoditization of apply models explains the pivot toward inference.

name: Remy
tags: Generative AI; Health Insurance; Operations; AI
one_liner: Making it simpler for medical clinics to work with insurance
long_description: Remy automates insurance-related tasks for practices, starting with phone calls to verify patient benefits and check on claims.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada

name: Repacket
one_liner: Employee security done for you.
long_description:
90% of security breaches are caused by a simple employee mistake. 

Your employee clicks a bad link, and gives up their password.
They download ransomware from an email and run it.
They leak your intellectual property and sensitive customer data to ChatGPT.

Repacket allows your employees to enjoy the internet without risk - instantly blocking threats like phishing and sensitive data leaks. This gives your employees the ability to make that mistake without impacting your company.

Repacket is built for smaller companies, who may not have dedicated IT or security people to run the show. We install in 60 seconds and give your employee instant protection where they need it most.

Founded by cybersecurity leaders from SpaceX, AWS, and Google - we're building the easy button for cybersecurity.
regions: Canada; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Small and mid-sized companies without dedicated IT or security staff
problem: Employee mistakes such as clicking phishing links or pasting sensitive data into ChatGPT cause most breaches, and small companies lack security teams to prevent them.
business_model: B2B SaaS, per-employee security proxy subscription (pricing not found)
product_category: Secure web gateway, data loss prevention, phishing protection
market_need_then: Late 2022 and early 2023 saw ChatGPT adoption raise fear of employees leaking data, and the YC page cites phishing and data leaks as the core pain. No spend or regulation data was found.
outcome_analysis: Repacket is still active as of the sources found, with a small team and a seed round in 2023 from investors including 645 Ventures and BoxGroup. No acquisition, layoff or shutdown news appeared. The positioning has moved from small-company security toward an AI-era secure web gateway with data loss prevention. The exact funding amount is unverified, so success or stall cannot be judged yet.

name: Repaint
tags: SaaS; Chatbot; E-commerce; Web Development; AI
one_liner: Redesign your website by chatting with AI
long_description:
Repaint is an AI platform for building business websites and web apps.

It is especially good at redesigning existing websites. You can paste in a link to a current site, and Repaint imports its pages, text, and images. From there, you can have it redesign the site in a new style or keep the original design. You can also start a new site from a description.

Beyond the website, Repaint can build online stores, appointment booking, memberships, online courses, and client portals. Payments, customer accounts, and email are built in, so there's no need to connect other services. Every change is made by chatting with the AI.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Small businesses and individuals who want a website, payments and simple operations built by chatting with AI
problem: Building or redesigning a business website is slow and manual. The founders found that nobody finished a site in their first drag-and-drop builder.
business_model: SaaS subscription tiers ($25, $100, $200 per month) plus card processing fee of 2.9% + 30 cents
product_category: AI website and web app builder
market_need_then: Demand for AI site creation grew after ChatGPT in 2023, but the founders reported their first non-AI builder saw few completed sites. No spend data found.
outcome_analysis: Repaint pivoted within its YC batch from a manual drag-and-drop builder to an AI chat builder after seeing users fail to finish sites, and has since widened into payments, email and custom software with paid plans. It remains active with a tiny team. Funding data is thin and conflicting, so traction and outcome remain unclear.

name: Resend
one_liner: Email for developers
long_description:
Resend is the new email API for developers. It's designed for you to build, test, and send transactional emails at scale.

If you're using Sendgrid, AWS SES, or Postmark, come talk to us.
regions: Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Software developers and product teams sending transactional and later marketing email
problem: Sending email that reliably reaches the inbox is hard, and legacy providers like SendGrid had poor developer experience. Building email templates that work across clients is also painful.
business_model: Usage-based email API with free tier and paid volume plans
product_category: Developer email API
founder_names: Zeno Rocha; Bu Kinoshita; Jonni Lundy
market_need_then: Developers complained about legacy email provider experience; React Email had 5.1k GitHub stars at launch and 10,000 developers signed up within about six months of the January 2023 launch, per the company's seed post.
outcome_analysis: Resend grew from an open-source email template project into a developer email API that raised a $3M seed in July 2023 and an $18M Series A led by a16z in December 2024, with over 200,000 developers signed up by then. Founders came from WorkOS with developer experience credentials, and the open-source React Email brought distribution. It remains independent; later acquisitions of small companies in 2025 were reported by secondary sources.

name: Retape
one_liner: AI Operating System for Debt Settlement
long_description: We're building an AI Operating System for DSCs. This includes a set of AI agents that can work together to complete a workflow end to end.
regions: India; South Asia; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Debt settlement companies and call centers
problem: Debt settlement firms run labor-heavy sales, servicing and creditor negotiation workflows that can be automated with AI agents.
business_model: B2B SaaS CRM with AI agent workforce (pricing not found)
product_category: Vertical AI CRM and AI call agents for debt settlement
founder_names: Sahil Singla; Ankit Goyal; Shubham Rana
market_need_then: Debt settlement is a call-center heavy industry; the YC page frames AI automation of its workflow as the opportunity. No demand data found.
outcome_analysis: Retape remains active with a three-person founding team from India and now sells a debt relief CRM called Resolve under the legal entity Merse, Inc. No funding beyond the YC deal was found and no shutdown or acquisition reports appeared, so the story is early and unresolved. The move from a general AI operating system to a CRM with AI workers suggests a product narrowing, but no source dates it.

name: Revamp
one_liner: AI-Powered Customer Segmentation for eCommerce
long_description: Revamp helps eCommerce brands and agencies understand customer behavior by creating smarter segments for targeted email and paid acquisition campaigns.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: eCommerce brands and agencies running email and paid campaigns on Klaviyo and Shopify
problem: Marketers cannot easily see behavioral differences between customer groups, so segments for email and ads are crude.
business_model: B2B SaaS, usage-based (a profile lists 1,000 free generations then $0.02 per profile, unverified)
product_category: AI customer segmentation, later AI agents for lifecycle marketing
market_need_then: The founder reported a spreadsheet prototype raised email revenue about 5 percent (unverified founder claim); eCommerce marketers rely heavily on email segmentation.
outcome_analysis: Revamp launched in YC S23 as an AI segmentation layer on Klaviyo and Shopify data and has since repositioned toward AI agents for retention marketing, with a team reported at about nine people by a third-party profile. No shutdown, acquisition or verified funding was found. The segmentation wedge sat on Klaviyo's own features, which likely pushed the move to agents.

name: Reworkd
tags: Generative AI; B2B; Open Source; AI
one_liner: The simplest way to extract web data at scale
long_description:
At Reworkd, we're working on multimodal LLM agents that serve as the simplest way to extract web data at scale. Customers come to us with lists of 100s to 1000s of websites along with a data schema. Our agents traverse these websites, understand their structure, and generate code to extract data from them.

We've been working on LLM agents since their inception and have received over 30k stars on GitHub and 1M+ users across previous agent products. If you're interested in our pilot program, shoot us an email!
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Companies that need structured data from hundreds or thousands of websites
problem: Web scrapers break and need custom code per site; Reworkd's agents generate and maintain extraction code at scale. Originally the product let users run autonomous LLM agents in a browser.
business_model: Managed web data extraction service, sold through a pilot program (pricing not found)
product_category: AI agents, then web data extraction
market_need_then: AgentGPT drew over 30,000 GitHub stars and over a million users per the YC page, and the company said web scraping was a popular use of it.
outcome_analysis: Reworkd rode the 2023 autonomous agent boom with AgentGPT, raised a $1.25M pre-seed in July 2023 and a $2.75M seed in July 2024 after pivoting to web scraping agents. Its own site later announced the product would sunset on February 6, 2025, and the AgentGPT repository was reported archived in 2026, so the extraction pivot did not hold. The reasons are not public. Status in the YC directory remains Active.

name: Rimward
tags: Machine Learning; Computer Vision; B2B; Security; Enterprise
one_liner: Solar farm security software for existing cameras
long_description: Rimward helps solar asset managers detect intrusions using the cameras already installed across their sites. It flags camera failures and coverage gaps, and gathers video evidence from multiple cameras to help their team or monitoring provider filter out false alarms and decide when to act.
regions: France; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Solar asset managers and their security monitoring providers
problem: Solar sites suffer theft and intrusions, and security cameras generate false alarms and silent failures; managers want detection without replacing hardware.
business_model: Per-site subscription, no per-alert charge
product_category: Computer vision intrusion detection for remote outdoor sites
market_need_then: Solar farms attract theft per industry articles, but undated; no dated 2023 evidence of spend was found.
outcome_analysis: Rimward is a one-person Paris startup selling camera-agnostic intrusion detection to solar operators, led by a computer vision researcher with field wildfire detection experience. No shutdown, acquisition or verified funding was found. Traction is unknown, so outcome is unresolved.

name: Rivet
one_liner: The orchestrator for agentic workloads.
long_description:
A fast, high-density and scalable orchestrator for every workload an agent needs.
Open-source and self-hostable.

Open source and self-hostable alternative to Durable Objects
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Game developers at founding; now developers building agent and realtime backends
problem: Hosting multiplayer game servers needs matchmaking, scaling and DDoS protection that small studios struggle to build; later, agent workloads need durable stateful runtimes.
business_model: Open-source (Apache 2.0) with managed cloud usage pricing (pricing not found)
product_category: Game server orchestration, now actor-based orchestrator for agents
market_need_then: The YC launch framed it as Heroku for multiplayer games, but no demand or spend data was opened.
outcome_analysis: Rivet began as a managed game server platform in YC W23 and repositioned to an open-source actor orchestrator for agents, now backed by YC and a16z Speedrun with a team of seven. The game backend market saw shutdowns of Multiplay and Hathora in 2026, which may support the pivot, though the founders have not said why they moved. Funding beyond the YC deal is not public, so traction is unclear.

name: Roame
tags: SaaS; Travel; Airlines; Consumer Finance; AI
one_liner: Flight search engine using credit card points and miles
long_description:
Roame is flight search engine design for credit card points and miles. We help travelers redeem their points for dream vacations in seconds rather than days.

At Roame, we are on a mission to revolutionize travel and consumer finance. We stand at the intersection of travel tech and fintech.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Consumer travelers and points and miles enthusiasts who redeem credit card points or airline miles for flights, paying through a membership
problem: Award flight availability is spread across many airline loyalty programs, so searching for a points redemption can take hours. Roame says it can take up to 30 hours per trip and offers one search across programs.
business_model: Consumer freemium subscription (free live award search with an account, paid membership for alerts and advanced tools)
product_category: Award travel search engine (points and miles)
market_need_then: The YC launch post says redemption data is fragmented and searching across programs can take up to 30 hours per trip, and compares Roame with Google Flights and the Chase and Amex portals, which it says give worse value per point. Point.me raising a seed round in 2022 shows investor interest in the category.
outcome_analysis: Roame is an active, small team consumer travel tool that launched in the points and miles community and positioned itself as a faster, region-first alternative to point.me and similar tools. Sources through 2025 show product expansion into hotels, alerts and a paid plan, with no reported exit, shutdown or layoffs. Funding is not publicly confirmed beyond aggregator listings of a YC-sized check, so scale of the business is unknown.

name: Rollstack
one_liner: Automate data-driven slide decks and documents with AI
long_description:
At Rollstack, we are revolutionizing the way businesses share and communicate data and insights. Organizations worldwide rely on slide decks and documents to make informed decisions, whether for leadership, clients, or partners. Yet, preparing these materials often consumes countless hours. Rollstack fully automates that.

We help some of the world's leading organizations—from mid-sized to public companies like SoFi, Zillow and Whirlpool—in automating their slide decks and documents. Headquartered in New York, we offer a remote-friendly workplace and are backed by Insight Partners and Y Combinator, the most successful startup incubator in the world that produced the likes of Airbnb, Twitch, Instacart, Dropbox, Reddit, Doordash, Stripe, Coinbase, etc.

Our team operates with speed and focus to deliver outsized impacts for our customers. We approach every challenge with first principles, never assuming things have to be done a certain way. We are a diverse team that believes intelligence and kindness go hand in hand, welcoming individuals from all backgrounds. Our persistence and rapid execution define us as a category leader and a future generational company.
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Data, finance, RevOps, customer success and business operations teams at mid sized and public companies that report to leadership and clients in slide decks
problem: Teams spend countless hours copying numbers from BI tools and warehouses into slide decks and documents.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription
product_category: Automated reporting and AI slide generation connected to BI tools
founder_names: Nabil Jallouli; Saad Bahir; Younes Jallouli
market_need_then: Rollstack's own pitch cites organizations relying on slide decks for leadership, client and partner reporting while preparation consumes many hours. Early customers named on its site include SoFi, Zillow and Whirlpool (YC listing) and later SoFi, Tripadvisor and CarGurus.
outcome_analysis: Rollstack raised a small seed after YC W23 and an 11 million dollar Series A led by Insight Partners in October 2024, with named enterprise customers and a product that has moved from BI to slides toward an AI slides platform with an MCP server. No acquisition, shutdown or layoffs were found. Its progress rests on a repeatable B2B reporting use case and integration depth, though revenue is not disclosed.

name: Rubber Ducky Labs
one_liner: AI Powered Product Discovery
long_description: We built Rubber Ducky Labs to help e-commerce teams effortlessly improve product discovery through better metadata. Our tool enables non-technical users to leverage multi-modal AI on product catalogs—just upload a CSV and start tagging metadata in minutes.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote

name: Rubbrband
one_liner: A new kind of creative company.
long_description: Rubbrband is a creative company making commercials for some of the world's top brands.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Startups and brands that buy commercials and launch films (clients named on the site include Novig, Paraform, Commure, Mutiny and NodeNooks)
problem: Traditional ad studios charge hundreds of thousands of dollars and take months, while generic AI ads feel disposable. Rubbrband sells narrative driven AI assisted commercials in weeks.
business_model: Creative services and agency projects priced per campaign, plus earlier self serve AI video tools
product_category: AI creative studio and video production
founder_names: Jeremy Lee; Abhinav Gopal; Darren Hsu
market_need_then: In late 2022 and early 2023 generative video was emerging, and the YC launch post says making long form movies with AI tools was hard. Brands were paying agencies large sums for ads, which the founders' later pitch contrasts with weeks not months delivery.
outcome_analysis: Rubbrband began in 2022 as a tool and model effort for AI generated films, then moved toward producing commercials for startups such as Novig and Paraform while the underlying video models became widely available. It is active in 2026 with a ten person team and named clients, but there is no verified funding data or revenue, so how well the pivot worked is unknown.

name: Ruby Card
one_liner: Neobank for e-commerce businesses
long_description:
Ruby is a neobank that offers e-commerce businesses a flexible spend management solution and direct integrations with commerce platforms. 

By combining banking and commerce data, Ruby provides businesses with a real-time, unified view of their financial health and money movement, empowering them to make better financial decisions and scale their operations.
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: E-commerce businesses selling on Shopify, Amazon and Stripe that need banking, corporate cards and spend management
problem: E-commerce operators juggle traditional banks that do not see commerce data. Ruby combines banking and commerce data for a real time view of financial health and money movement.
business_model: Neobank with card interchange and software fees (corporate cards, reimbursements, chargeback automation)
product_category: Neobank and spend management for e-commerce
founder_names: Shariar Kabir; Miguel Acero; Jordan Yaqoob
market_need_then: The YC launch post says Ruby had processed millions in transactions since joining YC and integrates with Shopify, Stripe and Amazon, which it names as the platforms its customers use. Highbeam's 2022 seed round shows investor interest in banking for e-commerce.
outcome_analysis: Ruby Card aimed to be the neobank for e-commerce sellers during a crowded period in which Highbeam and Shopify Balance targeted the same wedge. In April 2026 Numeral announced it had acquired the team behind Ruby, and the founders joined Numeral's engineering team. The deal price is undisclosed and the post does not say whether the product continues, so this reads as a team acquisition rather than a clear product exit.

name: SID
one_liner: AI research center for retrieval
long_description: SID is an AI research center based in San Francisco. We train models that can retrieve and reason over any data source.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Developers and companies building AI apps and agents that need retrieval over their own data (initially SID connected AI apps to customer data; now sells retrieval models)
problem: AI systems need the right context from scattered data sources. SID first offered connectors to data such as email, Notion and Google Drive, then moved to training its own retrieval and agentic search models.
business_model: Usage-based API and model access (SID-1 via waitlist)
product_category: AI retrieval and agentic search models
market_need_then: In mid 2023 companies were rushing to connect LLM apps to private data, shown by seed rounds for LlamaIndex (May 2023) and Dust (June 2023). SID's own pitch says context needs retrieval.
outcome_analysis: SID started as a data connector layer for AI apps in mid 2023, then repositioned as an AI research lab training retrieval models, releasing SID-1 via waitlist with claims of better recall and speed than frontier models. The site lists Canaan, Rebel and General Catalyst as backers, but amounts and dates are not confirmed by a press release, so the funding trajectory is unknown. No exit, shutdown or layoffs were found.

name: Saatvy
tags: Consumer Health Services; Health & Wellness; AI
one_liner: Root cause help for chronic conditions
long_description:
Saatvy is a transparent, personalized and natural wellness platform to manage chronic conditions such as gut/sleep disorder, diabetes, arthritis, and postpartum thyroiditis. We do this by personalizing the health plans which are created by experienced and authentic Ayurveda practitioners.

Several people in the USA have trusted us with their natural wellness journeys. The biggest benefit our customers find in the first consultation is understanding the root causes of their health issues, where traditional medicine often falls short. Our Ayurvedic practitioners have decades of experience, with some serving on Ayurveda boards in the USA.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote

name: SafetyKit
one_liner: AI agents for risk, compliance, and safety
long_description:
SafetyKit's AI agents do the dirty work for big tech and finance companies so humans don't have to.

Today companies rely on armies of low-paid outsourced humans to protect their platforms from fraud, harassment, and crime. It’s super important work, but the jobs are difficult and sometimes traumatizing, and it’s impossible to keep up. Our mission is to end this manual toil.

We learned this domain first-hand at Stripe and Airbnb, where first we built software for human reviewers, and then built models to replace them.

We’re a group of engineers from Stripe, Meta, Netflix, MIT, and Princeton that love language models and unironically love B2B SaaS. We know the economy is going to be rearranged over the next 4 years and we want to be in the driver’s seat.

We build vertical AI that works and have some of the world’s largest companies as paying customers. Patreon, Eventbrite, Upwork, Character.ai, Substack, Faire, along with a $10B+ marketplace, a $100B+ payments company, and more rely on SafetyKit in production.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Large tech platforms, marketplaces and payments companies that run trust and safety, risk and compliance review
problem: Platforms rely on large outsourced human review teams for fraud, harassment and policy enforcement, which is costly, traumatic work that cannot keep up with volume.
business_model: B2B SaaS and API for AI review agents and decision models, with expert labeled data offered more recently
product_category: AI agents for trust and safety, risk and compliance
market_need_then: Large platforms relied on outsourced reviewers and the founders saw the pain at Stripe and Airbnb. Layoffs in in-house trust and safety teams in 2023 pushed work toward vendors, per press coverage found.
outcome_analysis: SafetyKit raised a 27 million dollar Series A in 2025 per the YC page and trackers, backed by Ribbit, First Round and YC, and lists marquee customers such as Patreon, Eventbrite, Upwork and Substack. Founders came from Stripe risk review, matching the buyer's pain. No acquisition or shutdown was found. Its site now emphasizes expert labeled data, suggesting positioning has widened since the batch.

name: Sage AI
tags: Developer Tools; SaaS; B2B; AI Assistant
one_liner: Your self-generating, self-maintaining code knowledge base.
long_description:
Sage is a self-generating, self-maintaining knowledge base for your code with in-built chat, accelerating expertise, and comprehension of any codebase.

Documentation is perpetually stale, codebases become increasingly old, large, and complex, and knowledge remains siloed within individuals and teams. As a result, engineers take 8-12 months to become fully operational, enterprise code becomes slow and unmaintainable, and core knowledge is continually lost upon engineer turnover.

Sage is changing this reality. We take your code and automatically generate a symbol-level knowledge base that self-updates to remain forever fresh. We integrate with source control to pull your code and generate a symbolic graph representation of functions, classes, interfaces, types, etc., automatically determining the relevant context for each symbol, and using LLMs to annotate and propagate documentation via traversals of the symbol graph. 

Sage revolutionizes the way teams and individuals interact with and understand their code, ensuring that knowledge is always accessible, up-to-date, and interactive.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Engineering teams with large or aging codebases that need up to date documentation and onboarding
problem: Documentation goes stale, codebases grow complex and knowledge sits with individuals. Sage generates and maintains a symbol level knowledge base from source code with built in chat.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for teams (web app and GitHub app)
product_category: AI code documentation and knowledge base

name: Salient

business_model: Enterprise B2B software sold to lenders, with AI agents priced by contract
product_category: AI voice and workflow automation for loan servicing and collections
market_need_then: Auto lenders run large servicing and collections operations under heavy regulation, and early 2023 saw a jump in capable language models. Sources opened give no market spend figures.

name: Sameday
tags: Generative AI; B2B; Sales Enablement; Automation; AI
one_liner: The leading AI workforce for the trades.
long_description: Sameday is the AI workforce for the trades — outperforming humans at high-stakes, revenue-critical work, such as sales, dispatch, and more.

target_customer: Owner-operated and mid-size home service and trades businesses (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, pest control, cleaning) that lose revenue on missed calls
problem: Home service businesses miss inbound calls and leads and lose booked jobs. Sameday's agents answer, book and follow up so revenue-critical calls are not dropped.
business_model: B2B SaaS and usage-based AI agent service sold to trades businesses, with human CSR backup (company positioning)

name: Santé
one_liner: All-in-one POS for liquor stores
regions: United States of America; America / Canada

problem: Independent liquor stores run on generic or dated POS tools that handle receiving, purchase orders, theft, shipping compliance and online sales poorly. Santé offers one liquor specific system.

product_category: Vertical POS and retail operating system for liquor stores

name: Sanvivo
tags: Marketplace; SaaS; Consumer Health Services; Delivery
one_liner: Shopify for pharmacies in Europe
long_description:
Sanvivo builds a multisided platform to enable customers to order medications, get pharmaceutical advice, and book health services at local pharmacies in Europe. Just like Shopify for pharmacies.

Sanvivo gives pharmacies software to take, fill and schedule delivery for online orders. We also bring instant demand through integrations with 3rd party consumer delivery companies.

Almost all pharmacies in Europe are, by law, local 1-person businesses. And they are not ready for online orders. Regulatory changes require pharmacies to take and fill e-prescriptions (roll-out Jan-23), but many have no way to do this online today. 

Sanvivo uses technology to give local pharmacies digital superpowers, enabling them to combine fast supply and high-quality consultation with state of the are e-commerce solutions.
regions: Germany; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Independent pharmacies in Germany, with consumers as the second side of the platform
problem: German pharmacies are mostly single owner businesses without online ordering, while e-prescription rules required them to take and fill prescriptions digitally from January 2023. Sanvivo gave them software and delivery through partner apps.
business_model: Multisided platform with commission on orders routed through third party delivery partners, plus pharmacy software
product_category: Pharmacy ecommerce and delivery software
founder_names: Julius Rachor; Nikolai Alemi Hariri; Dominic Haul; Sven Wildermann
market_need_then: German e-prescription rollout started in January 2023 and many single owner pharmacies had no online order capability (YC description). Third party pharmacy delivery players Kurando (shut 2022) and Aponia (insolvent 2023) already struggled, per Pharmazeutische Zeitung.
outcome_analysis: Sanvivo launched around the 2023 German e-prescription rollout, linking pharmacies to delivery apps. On 16 August 2024 it told partner pharmacies that its Lieferando and Wolt delivery service would end on 31 August, citing the DigiG law and market changes, and its Vivoly app left the app stores. The company stays Active and sells software to pharmacies, with its site now claiming over 1,000 partner pharmacies. Whether the software pivot has worked is not independently verified.

name: Scanbase
tags: Machine Learning; Computer Vision; Health Tech; Telemedicine; AI
one_liner: The API for Diagnostic Test Analysis (COVID-19, FLU, RSV, STD,…
long_description: Scanbase makes it easy for medical companies to convert photos of rapid diagnostic tests into results. We do this by providing a simple API that any medical company can access.

business_model: Usage-based API, with later services for integration and support per the company site
product_category: Computer vision API for diagnostic tests
market_need_then: COVID rapid tests surged in 2020 to 2022 and academic work in 2022 studied AI apps for reading lateral flow results, showing demand for objective readings. Demand for COVID tests then declined.
outcome_analysis: Scanbase launched in the Winter 2023 batch with an API for reading photos of rapid tests, near the end of the COVID testing surge. Its own site now emphasizes consulting, integration and support alongside the API, which may signal a shift, but no source states one. A directory reports no further funding or trade news after August 2023. The record is too thin to assign clear success or failure factors.

name: Scout

name: Second

long_description: AI-native enterprise codebase maintenance, including automated migrations and codebase intelligence for engineering teams who need to get stuff done.

product_category: AI codebase migration and maintenance agents

It raised a small $1.9M pre-seed, pivoted once to migrations in a crowded space, and the failure factor is a tentative reading of that pivot, not a stated reason.

name: Sendblue
one_liner: iMessage for Sales
long_description: Sendblue provides businesses with virtual iMessage lines to text prospects and nurture leads. Our users on average see a 70% increase in response rate. The company is founded by Rob Haber, former ML Engineer at Scale AI, and Alex Luis, former PM at PwC's telecom practice.

product_category: iMessage API and sales messaging platform

Team size on the YC page is 50. The main risk is dependence on Apple, shown by its block of Beeper Mini in 2023. Funding is unverified, so growth is attributed to a clear need and self reported traction.

name: SensorSurf
one_liner: Resolve PR check failures instantly with AI

regions: United States of America; America / Canada

name: Serial

long_description:
Serial is software to help manufacturers root cause problems in minutes not days and avoid millions in liabilities. Our solution integrates with data sources from any production line, enabling engineering & operations teams to ask questions about their manufacturing data and instantly get answers. Serial will become the single source of truth for manufacturing data.

Our founding team has 10+ years of manufacturing and product design experience from Apple, Tesla, and more. We have suffered this problem firsthand and are building the tool to fix it.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Serra

name: Shadeform
one_liner: The GPU Cloud Marketplace
long_description: Teams struggling with GPU availability use our platform to unlock capacity immediately for their growing AI workloads. product_category: GPU cloud marketplace / multi-cloud aggregator
market_need_then: 2023 GPU shortage framed in YC launch post ('solving for the GPU shortage'); a RunPod article also describes the shortage but no 2023-dated independent source was gathered.
outcome_analysis: Shadeform launched in Summer 2023 during the GPU shortage with a multi-cloud marketplace and grew to 22 people and 30+ provider clouds, with customers including inference providers and a later Flex VMs product launch (year not confirmed). name: Shasta Health

name: Shekel Mobility
one_liner: B2B marketplace for Auto Dealers in Africa
long_description:
Our platform helps car dealers find, finance and sell more cars in the $30B African used Car market.

We are building the largest auto dealership ecosystem ; powering $10Bn transactions annually
all_locations: Lagos, LA, Nigeria; San Francisco, CA, USA
regions: Nigeria; United States of America; Africa; America / Canada
target_customer: Used car dealers in Nigeria and Africa, plus agent dealers and global vehicle suppliers
problem: African car dealers struggle to source, finance and sell vehicles with informal operations and costly credit. Shekel offers a marketplace, dealer credit and management tools.

product_category: Auto dealer marketplace and fintech

name: Sherloq
tags: Generative AI; SaaS; B2B; Analytics; AI
one_liner: One place for all your queries, directly on your SQL editor
long_description:
Companies use Sherloq as their single source of truth for their SQL on top of their existing data stack.

Today, data-driven organizations face the challenge of giving 2 of their data analysts the same task and getting 2 totally different results from their analysis. Although SQL is the #1 coding language for data analysis, it is still managed independently on each user's internal documentation tools (notepads, Slack channels, or docx files).
Creating one source of truth is an ongoing difficult process, that’s done manually and takes time to implement. 

Using our plugin on top of our user's existing query editors, companies can now manage their SQL code in one place.
We ourselves are data users and we've built Sherloq to fit the exact needs of data teams, becoming a true alternative to the way SQL is being managed today.
all_locations: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
regions: Israel; Middle East and North Africa
target_customer: Data analysts and data teams at companies that write a lot of SQL in existing query editors
problem: SQL is kept in personal notepads, Slack and docs, so two analysts can get different answers to the same question and no team has one source of truth for its queries.
business_model: Freemium B2B SaaS plugin, payment required after a saved-query limit
product_category: SQL repository and collaboration plugin for query editors, later with AI features
market_need_then: The company says SQL is the number one analysis language yet is managed in scattered personal tools. Its site claims customers such as Taboola and AppsFlyer (company claim, unverified).
outcome_analysis: Sherloq is still active in 2026 as a small team with an SQL repository plugin that has added AI chat on top of saved queries. No shutdown, acquisition or layoff news was found. Funding is not publicly confirmed, so the trajectory after the Winter 2023 batch cannot be judged beyond product launches and a claimed customer list.

name: ShortLoop
one_liner: Phone AI that Captures Every Dealership Revenue Opportunity
long_description:
Dealerships leave significant revenue every year because they are unable to effectively answer calls or run campaigns due to staffing issues. 

ShortLoop fixes this with human-like AI phone agents that answer calls instantly, book appointments and test drives, and also help run outbound campaigns. It ensures that our customers never miss a revenue opportunity, inbound or outbound. 

Our AI is integrated with CDK, Reynolds, Tekion, Xtime, Auto/Mate, DealerFX, VinSolutions, myKaarma and other popular dealership tools. It handles thousands of calls each week for U.S. dealerships across service, sales, and outbound campaigns.

Our mission is to help dealerships transition their phone operations to the AI world and capture the revenue they leave on the table today.
regions: India; South Asia; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: US car dealerships, mainly service and sales departments
problem: Dealerships miss calls and campaigns because of staffing issues, losing appointments and revenue.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription, listed from $890 a month with modular pricing per a search summary
product_category: Voice AI phone agents for automotive dealerships
founder_names: Vishnu Vinjam; Sumit Mulchandani; Deepak Thakur
market_need_then: At founding the pitch was API visibility from live traffic; the dealership product targets missed calls from staffing shortages, with company-claimed results of 95 percent of appointments captured.
outcome_analysis: ShortLoop began as an API tooling startup in the Winter 2023 batch, raised a reported seed of about 2.7 million dollars in July 2023, and later moved to voice AI for dealerships, where it lists about 22 dealership groups and integrations with the main dealership systems. It is still active, but the pivot timing and reason are not public and the market is crowded with voice agent vendors.

name: Shortbread
one_liner: Read romance comics.
long_description: Shortbread app is Netflix for romance comics built by a team of women writers, artists and engineers. We work with bestselling authors on Kindle and #BookTok to turn their romance fictions into comics. Our content specialize in viral romance fiction tropes such as mafia and dark romance. The comics are free to read with options to buy a subscription.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Adult readers of romance fiction who read on mobile, mostly via a free app with optional subscription

business_model: Freemium mobile content app with subscription and paid episodes
product_category: Consumer romance comics and visual series app using AI assisted production

outcome_analysis: Shortbread moved from a comics creation tool to a consumer romance content app and is still active with a very small team. The YC page credits the founder with about 500K dollars in revenue and 2 million episodes sold, which is a company claim. Funding is only visible on aggregators with conflicting figures, so its capital position and long term outcome are not established.

name: Sidenote

market_need_then: A profile notes EDA seats cost tens of thousands of dollars and design cycles span years, and that Silimate focuses on verification, debug and PPA closure rather than generating designs. YC called it the first EDA company it backed.
outcome_analysis: Silimate has stayed small since its Summer 2023 batch but is still active, claims enterprise and chip unicorn licensees, and has gotten trade press coverage. Founders with Apple, Synopsys and NVIDIA experience fit the niche. Only a roughly 2 million dollar seed is visible, and no later round is confirmed, so the upside remains unproven against Synopsys and Cadence.

name: Simbie AI

problem: Patients drop off after visits, with the company claiming about 30 percent of return visits never happen, and practices lack staff to follow up on results, refills and scheduling.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for EHR integrated AI agents
product_category: Healthcare voice and text AI agents for patient follow up and front desk work
market_need_then: The company claims missed return visits cost practices about 10 percent of revenue; these are unverified company figures.
outcome_analysis: Simbie AI is active with a five person team and clinician founders. It claims 400X growth since January 2025, zero churn and fully inbound customers, but those are company claims and no funding round is confirmed. The story so far is an early stage vertical AI company in a crowded healthcare voice market.

name: Singularity
