The founders have prior Rose Rocket freight software experience, and no shutdown or acquisition was found.

name: Cekura
one_liner: Voice AI and Chat AI agents: Testing and Observability
long_description:
Cekura helps Conversational AI companies with automated QA. From pre-production simulation and evaluations to production call monitoring, to assisting customers in setting up the CI/CD pipeline, we help in QA across the agent lifecycle.

We are working with 75+ customers across healthcare, BFSI, logistics, recruitment, and retail. Some of the largest CCAS players and enterprises use Cekura to ship AI voice and chat agents reliably
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Companies building voice and chat AI agents in healthcare, banking, logistics, recruitment and retail, plus conversational AI platforms
problem: Voice and chat agents fail unpredictably in production and teams lack automated testing, simulation and monitoring.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for testing and observability of conversational agents
product_category: AI agent QA and observability
founder_names: Tarush Agarwal; Shashij Gupta; Sidhant Kabra
market_need_then: Companies were rapidly deploying voice and chat agents in 2024 and needed pre-production testing and production monitoring; the company reports 75+ customers.
outcome_analysis: Cekura was founded by three IIT Bombay graduates with quant and NLP research backgrounds and joined YC in Fall 2024. It announced a $2.4M seed round in mid 2025 led by YC and reports 75+ customers across several industries. It renamed from Vocera. The market is crowded with direct testing competitors, but no shutdown or acquisition was found.

name: Celest
tags: Developer Tools; SaaS; B2B; Cloud Computing; Infrastructure
one_liner: The Vercel of Flutter
long_description:
Celest is a backend-as-a-service for Flutter and Dart developers. It empowers Flutter developers with the tools and capabilities they need to become full-stack developers. We are introducing "Cloud Widgets", a set of primitives which enable you to declaratively define every piece of your backend and infrastructure in Dart.

As the role of the front-end developer evolves towards full-stack proficiency, we recognize that existing tools have fallen short for those specializing in Flutter. Using the programming language and patterns Flutter developers already know from building their frontend, Celest enables developers to build and connect their apps to their backend with no additional tooling.

We enable Flutter developers to concentrate on building features and delivering value to their customers rather than learning additional domains and fragmenting themselves across disparate toolchains.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada

name: Centauri AI
one_liner: Helps teams work effectively with AI coding agents.
long_description:
We build coSlash, a management layer for AI coding agents. Our platform enables teams to orchestrate parallel Claude Code and Codex sessions, track project progress, team knowledge, and seamlessly transfer context between developers.

https://coslash.io/
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Financial services firms with document heavy work (private equity, private credit, asset managers); later software teams using AI coding agents
problem: Investment firms extract and analyze structured finance data from documents by hand; later, teams need to manage parallel AI coding agents.
business_model: Enterprise SaaS with SaaS, single tenant and in-VPC deployment options
product_category: AI document data platform for finance; AI agent management layer
market_need_then: Banks and investment firms process large volumes of financial documents manually, and language models made structured extraction newly feasible in 2023 and 2024.
outcome_analysis: Centauri AI started as a structured finance data platform and now also sells coSlash for orchestrating AI coding agents, while the site still lists enterprise finance products and SOC 2 Type II assessment. No funding could be verified, no shutdown or acquisition was found, and the team is five people, so the traction story is unclear.

name: Central
tags: Fintech; B2B; HR Tech; Payroll; AI
one_liner: Payroll, benefits, state compliance & other bullsh*t for startups
long_description:
Central kills back-office work for startups. While HR/payroll platforms give you software to figure it out, Central actually does all the work using AI agents and human experts: payroll, benefits, compliance, accounting, taxes, and more. That's 10+ hours back every month. 

Thousands of founders trust Central. Learn more and start for free at centralhq.com
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Early stage startups, especially YC companies, that need payroll, benefits and compliance without an in house operations hire
problem: Founders lose 10 or more hours a month on payroll, benefits, state compliance, accounting and taxes. Central does the work with AI agents and human experts instead of handing over software to configure.
business_model: Subscription service for payroll, HR, benefits and compliance with AI agents plus human experts, with a free start offer
product_category: AI back office for startups (payroll, HR, benefits, compliance)
founder_names: Josh Wymer; Pranav Kashyap; Nilay Modi
market_need_then: Startups routinely struggle with multi state payroll and compliance in their first hires. Central's YC launch pitched freeing founders from back office work, and its own pages claimed 200 plus YC customers before the seed round.
outcome_analysis: Central sold a done for you back office to YC startups, starting in 2024 and growing to nearly 500 customers and more than 175 million dollars of processed payroll by its sale. It raised an 8.6 million dollar seed in August 2025 led by First Round, then was acquired by Mercury on 2026-04-02 to anchor Mercury Payroll. Strong distribution into the YC network and founders with Mixpanel and Stripe experience helped, while the generic name and crowded payroll market limited standalone independence.

name: Centralize
one_liner: The relationship intelligence platform for enterprise revenue
long_description: Centralize is the relationship intelligence platform for enterprise revenue. We show reps who they know inside every deal, who they're missing, and the fastest path to the decision-makers who close it. We're building the graph of who trusts who in B2B.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Enterprise and high ACV B2B sales, customer success and revenue teams
problem: Reps do not know who they know inside a deal, who they are missing, or the fastest path to the decision makers, so enterprise deals stall.
business_model: B2B SaaS with a free tier for individual reps added in 2026
product_category: Relationship intelligence and deal workspace
market_need_then: Enterprise sales deals involve large buying committees and reps lack visibility into relationships, which the YC launch posts framed as AI powered org charts for enterprise sales.
outcome_analysis: Centralize raised a reported $4M seed in October 2025 led by Salesforce Ventures and announced an NEA led Series A in July 2026, with $19M total raised per the company. Founders with Slack and Facebook backgrounds, strategic Salesforce backing and enterprise logos point to a working enterprise sales motion. Salesforce ownership of the CRM layer is the key risk. No revenue was disclosed.

name: Cerulion
one_liner: Open source operating system for robots
long_description: Cerulion is an open source operating system for robots built by 2 MIT robotics PhDs. Engineers at Amazon Robotics and Boston Dynamics AI Institute are using us to develop faster and ship more reliable robots than with ROS. With up to 1000x improvements in communications performance over state of the art, Cerulion is enabling the next generation of embodied AI.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Robotics engineers and robotics companies building robots with ROS or similar middleware
problem: Robot middleware such as ROS has slow communication performance and painful debugging, slowing development and reliability.
business_model: Open source robot middleware, with paid tooling implied (Studio, Hindsight early access); pricing not stated
product_category: Robotics middleware and runtime
market_need_then: ROS 2 users reported discovery overhead and network setup pain with DDS, prompting Open Robotics to evaluate alternatives, as shown by the 2024 rmw_zenoh work.
outcome_analysis: Cerulion is a two person open source robotics middleware company from YC S24 that has shifted toward a runtime for AI agents controlling robots. It claims large communication speedups and users at Amazon Robotics and Boston Dynamics AI Institute, unverified. No funding could be verified, and the middleware space is shaped by ROS 2 and Zenoh, so traction is unclear.

name: Charm
tags: Crypto / Web3; Payments; Consumer; Messaging; Social Media
one_liner: Charm is the universal payments app — send money to anyone.
long_description: Charm makes sending money as easy as sending email. Most people juggle multiple payment apps and scattered balances. Charm lets you pay anyone — no matter what app they use — and earns you 5% interest on your balance, automatically.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Consumers who send money to friends across payment apps
problem: People juggle several payment apps and scattered balances and cannot easily pay someone who uses a different app.
business_model: Consumer wallet app, likely earning on float or interchange (not stated)
product_category: Consumer payments wallet
market_need_then: Consumers in 2024 used fragmented P2P apps, and the YC pitch targets that fragmentation. Evidence is the product pitch only, no usage numbers found.
outcome_analysis: Charm is a Fall 2024 YC consumer payments app from two former Uniswap team members who earlier launched BeerMe. It is listed as active with a one person team. No funding, shutdown or acquisition was found, and the competition from Venmo, Cash App and Zelle is severe.

name: Cheers
one_liner: Helping AI choose the best local business
long_description: Cheers is the done-for-you local visibility partner for established home-service companies and PE-backed portfolios. Our team manages your Google Business Profiles, website, reviews, directory listings, local pages and AI search visibility, so you get found on Google and Maps and recommended by AI. Y Combinator S24, based in San Francisco.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Established multi-location home service companies (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, solar, smart home) and PE backed portfolios
problem: Home service companies struggle to get found and recommended on Google, Maps and AI search, and to collect reviews from frontline employees.
business_model: Done-for-you local visibility service (managed fee); launched as an NFC review capture product for in-person employees
product_category: Local SEO and generative engine optimization for service businesses
market_need_then: Home service firms rely on Google reviews and local search for leads, and by 2025 AI search recommendations created a new visibility problem.
outcome_analysis: Cheers launched in S24 as a review capture app for frontline workers and moved to AI search visibility for home service companies, claiming 70,000 reviews collected for Vivint in five months, which is self-reported. Funding is unverified, the team is small and the category is crowded, so the traction story is unclear. No shutdown or acquisition was found.

name: Circleback
one_liner: AI-powered meeting notes and automations
long_description:
Circleback helps teams get the most out of every conversation with best-in-class AI-powered meeting notes, action items, automations, and search.

For example, Circleback can automatically identify feature requests that come up in product demo calls and create Linear tasks for each of them, or update your CRM with customer details after a sales call.

Before Circleback, Ali led the first integration of LLMs into the Stripe support product and Kevin worked on predictive analytics at Tableau as a senior software engineer.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Teams and professionals who hold many customer and internal meetings and pay per seat for notes and follow-up automation
problem: Meeting insights and action items are lost or must be copied by hand into tools like Linear and a CRM.
business_model: B2B SaaS per seat subscription
product_category: AI meeting notetaker and workflow automation
market_need_then: Meeting notetaking already had paying users of Otter and Fireflies, and LLMs made summaries and action item extraction much better in 2023, creating demand for automation after calls.
outcome_analysis: Circleback is active after YC W24 and raised a small $2.5M seed in November 2024 while reportedly cash flow positive with thousands of paying customers per TechCrunch. It competes in a crowded notetaker market against Otter, Fireflies and Read AI, so the outcome depends on whether its automation focus stays differentiated from platform native features.

name: ClaimSorted
one_liner: Making it easy for insurance companies to process claims
long_description: ClaimSorted helps insurance companies remove the hassle of managing claims by enabling them to outsource their claim operations to us. This service is known as a Third Party Administrator (TPA). Unlike traditional TPAs, we blend AI and best-in-class experts to deliver a 5-star customer experience, minimise mistakes and speed up claim assessment.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Insurers, MGAs and carriers that outsource claims handling to a third party administrator
problem: Traditional TPAs are slow, error prone and damage customer trust, and insurers lack tech-enabled claims outsourcing.
business_model: Service fees as a tech-enabled third party administrator for insurance claims
product_category: AI-enabled insurance claims TPA
market_need_then: The founders ran an insurer and found third party claims agencies unreliable, with tech.eu citing nearly 20% of TPA payouts as incorrect.
outcome_analysis: ClaimSorted is active, raising a $3M pre-seed in October 2024 and a $13.3M seed in October 2025 led by Atomico, with founders who previously ran an insurer. The team wedge is operational: pairing AI with human claims specialists as a TPA, with claimed partnerships including Lloyd's delegated authority.

name: Clarion
tags: Health Tech; Digital Health; Healthcare; AI
one_liner: The AI communication layer for healthcare
long_description:
Clarion is building the most advanced AI communication layer for healthcare. Our AI agents handle the overwhelming volume of calls and messages that clinics face daily—from scheduling to billing to prescription refills—freeing staff to focus on patient care. We're an in-person company based in New York.

Today, clinics miss 30-40% of inbound calls due to staffing shortages. We're solving this by automating complex workflows end-to-end, already serving tens of thousands of patients monthly across virtual care companies, health systems, and a $5B health insurance company.

We've raised $5.4M from Accel, Y Combinator, Sequoia (scout), and healthcare founders from Ophelia, Medallion, and Counsel Health. 

Our founders bring both clinical and technical expertise—our CEO Ryan is a Stanford/Harvard-trained physician who was on the founding teams of Two Chairs and Ophelia, while our CTO Jeffrey built voice AI at Amazon Alexa and led AI/ML teams at Salesforce.

Join us as we transform healthcare communication—creating a future where patients get faster resolutions and providers reclaim time for what matters most.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Clinics, health systems and virtual care companies that pay to automate inbound and outbound patient calls and messages
problem: Clinics miss 30 to 40 percent of inbound calls because of staffing shortages and front office work is manual.
business_model: B2B SaaS and usage-based AI agents for healthcare front office
product_category: Healthcare voice and messaging AI agents
market_need_then: YC page states clinics miss 30 to 40 percent of calls due to staffing shortages, and LLM voice quality had just reached usable levels.
outcome_analysis: Clarion is active and raised about $5.4M with Accel after YC W24, with a physician CEO and a voice AI CTO. Reported customers include insurers and virtual care firms. The category is crowded with well funded voice AI rivals, so scaling depends on EHR integration depth.

name: Clarum
one_liner: AI agents for private market diligence, monitoring, and reporting
long_description:
Clarum automates diligence, monitoring, and reporting for private market investors. Our AI agents learn how each firm works and automate their process end to end. Everything is individualized (checklists, templates, scoring models) and adapts as your process changes.

Clarum also acts as a self-updating knowledge base across every document your firm has ever seen, connecting dots no analyst could.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Private equity, venture capital, family office and fund-of-funds teams
problem: Diligence, monitoring and reporting for private market investors is slow manual work across Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
business_model: B2B SaaS for private market investors
product_category: AI agents for private market diligence
market_need_then: Private equity diligence is document heavy and LLMs made automation feasible in 2023, but no sourced demand figures were found.
outcome_analysis: Clarum is active with a team of two, started as an AI diligence assistant for private market investors and now describes itself as an intelligence layer for private capital. Little verifiable funding or traction is public, so the story is unclear beyond early stage survival.

name: Clearly AI
one_liner: Automate security and privacy reviews
long_description:
Clearly AI automates security and privacy reviews with AI. We performed hundreds of reviews at Amazon and Moveworks and now we're building the product we wish we had. Our users complete reviews in minutes instead of days.

Emily and Joe are technical co-founders and senior engineers. We met in 2019 while working on an Alexa security review.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Product security, privacy and GRC teams at enterprises that review many products
problem: Security and privacy reviews are manual and slow, so only a fraction of products get reviewed.
business_model: Enterprise B2B SaaS subscription
product_category: AI security and privacy review and threat modeling
market_need_then: Founders say they ran hundreds of reviews at Amazon and Moveworks; reviews were a manual bottleneck as AI features multiplied.
outcome_analysis: Clearly AI is active, raised an $8.4M seed in February 2026 led by Basis Set and was an RSAC 2026 Innovation Sandbox finalist. Founders with Amazon security review experience and named enterprise customers such as Ericsson and Rivian support early traction, though company claims are unaudited.

name: Cleva
tags: Fintech; Crypto / Web3; Remote Work; Emerging Markets; Neobank
one_liner: Global neobank for emerging markets
long_description:
Cleva breaks down financial borders across the globe by enabling remote workers, individuals, and businesses to hold stablecoin-backed dollars. Specifically, we enable our customers:

1. Receive USD, GBP, EUR payments: Individuals and businesses can receive USD, GBP, and EUR payments into their virtual account.
2. Receive and send stablecoins: They can also receive USDT or USDC, and make global payments via USDT and USDC.
3. Hold funds in USD: They can choose to hold their funds in USD instead of converting to local currency. In high inflation countries, this is extremely desirable as it helps our customers hedge against inflation until they're ready to spend in local currency.
4. Stablecoin-backed cards: We issue cards that are stablecoin-backed and accepted by 150M+ merchants across the globe. Users can fund in stablecoins or fiat, spend anywhere VISA is accepted, and earn cashback in the form of Cleva Points.
5. Savings: We recently launched Cleva Pots, allowing users to save towards their goals and earn yield on their savings.

It's still very early days at Cleva. We've been hyper-focused on our home country Nigeria but we're now expanding to more countries across the globe.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Nigerians and the Nigerian diaspora who receive or send USD and other foreign currency payments
problem: People in emerging markets struggle to receive foreign payments, hold stable currency and pay internationally due to inflation and limited banking access.
business_model: Fintech fees on payments, FX and cards plus savings yield
product_category: Cross-border USD accounts and stablecoin-backed neobank
competitors_at_founding: Geegpay; Payday; Chipper Cash; Lemfi; Afriex
market_need_then: TechCrunch Jan 2024 reports about $1M monthly payments within four months of an August 2023 launch and thousands of Nigerians opening US-based accounts; naira depreciation drove demand for USD.
outcome_analysis: Cleva is active after raising a $1.5M pre-seed in January 2024 led by 1984 Ventures and reports over 500,000 Nigerian customers by August 2025 per its blog. Nigerian founders with Stripe and AWS experience, naira depreciation and a 2025 money transfer licence support growth. Crowded competition remains.

name: CloudCruise
one_liner: The developer platform for fast and reliable browser agents
long_description: Build healthcare browser automations faster. Run self-healing payer portal and EHR workflows on a fully managed infrastructure.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Healthcare AI automation companies and engineering teams that need reliable payer portal and EHR browser automations
problem: Custom browser scripts against payer portals and EHRs break often and need constant maintenance.
business_model: Developer platform usage-based pricing for managed browser automation
product_category: Healthcare browser automation developer platform
market_need_then: Healthcare administrative workflows such as eligibility checks and prior authorization depend on portals without APIs; no dated demand evidence from 2024 was found.
outcome_analysis: CloudCruise is active and announced a $5M seed in March 2026 about two years after YC W24. It sells a self-healing builder and maintenance agent for healthcare browser automations to AI automation companies. Traction is described only in company terms, so success is not yet established.

name: Cloudglue
tags: Developer Tools; Machine Learning; Video; AI
one_liner: The video context layer for AI.
long_description:
Cloudglue is the video context layer for AI. We make it easy for your AI to understand video.
- Tinycloud - your AI agent for video, now open for beta: https://tinycloud.cloudglue.dev
- Developer API Platform: https://cloudglue.dev
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Developers building AI applications that need to understand video
problem: Turning video into structured, searchable context for AI requires heavy infrastructure work.
business_model: Usage-based developer API
product_category: Video understanding API and agent
market_need_then: LLM and multimodal models made video analysis feasible in 2024; no sourced demand metrics for Cloudglue were found.
outcome_analysis: Cloudglue is active, a small team of four with a video API and the Tinycloud agent in beta. No verified funding or traction is public, and a funded competitor, Twelve Labs, existed with a $5M seed from 2022, so the outcome is unclear.

name: CoCrafter
one_liner: B2B construction marketplace to match contractors and subcontractors.
long_description: CoCrafter is a construction marketplace to match contractors and subcontractors. Already used by over 3000 companies in the strong German SMB sector, CoCrafter helps contractors to find and manage local as well as foreign subcontractors.
regions: Germany; Europe
target_customer: German SMB construction contractors and general contractors that hire subcontractors, plus the subcontractors themselves who get a free profile
problem: Contractors struggle to find, vet and manage subcontractors and to keep compliance certificates and external staff lists in order.
business_model: B2B SaaS and marketplace for subcontractor management, paid by the contractor side
product_category: Construction subcontractor marketplace and compliance software
founder_names: Johannes Lutz; Philipp Rollwage; Annabell V.
market_need_then: Fragmented German SMB construction sector with heavy subcontracting and legal compliance duties for contractors; the company claims over 3000 companies use the product, a figure from its YC page that I could not verify independently.
outcome_analysis: CoCrafter is an active nine person Munich company that started as a contractor to subcontractor marketplace and now presents itself as subcontractor management software with named German customers such as Lindner Group. Public funding is thin and aggregator figures conflict, so the story is early stage with traction claims but no verified rounds or exit.

name: CodeAnt AI
one_liner: Autonomous offensive and defensive cybersecurity platform
long_description:
CodeAnt AI attacks your systems the way a real adversary would, then it walks back into your code and helps you build the defenses exactly where the attack got through.

Continuous attack. Continuous defense. One self-learning platform.

Trigger a free pentest No engagement fee. Pay only if we find high or critical issues; low and medium issues are free.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Engineering and security teams at software companies that want automated AI code review, code security scanning and pentesting
problem: AI makes code easier to write but reviewing it and finding security holes is slow; teams need automated review and continuous security testing.
business_model: B2B SaaS per developer seat for code review, plus usage-based pentests billed only when high or critical issues are found
product_category: AI code review and application security platform
market_need_then: Growing volume of AI generated code in 2024 increased review burden; Product Hunt launch Oct 2024 and a 2025 press cycle describe the review bottleneck. Company claims 2,000+ organizations use review, self reported.
outcome_analysis: CodeAnt AI is an active 25 person San Francisco company that raised a 2M seed in May 2025 and has expanded from AI code review into security and pentesting. It benefits from the AI coding wave, but faces heavy competition from better funded review tools, so its trajectory is unproven.

name: CodeViz
one_liner: One living model of your software architecture
long_description:
CodeViz creates interactive codebase maps to help engineers quickly understand and navigate code. 
 
Adopted by engineers at Amazon, Microsoft, and Roblox, CodeViz was founded by two ex-Tesla engineers to tackle the 75% of development time lost to reading code. Download today at https://codeviz.ai
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Software engineers and engineering teams that need to understand and document large codebases
problem: Engineers lose a large share of time reading and navigating unfamiliar code; architecture knowledge is not shared or kept current.
business_model: Freemium developer tool with paid tier for architecture diagrams and team features
product_category: Developer tools, code visualization and architecture diagrams
market_need_then: The company cites that most developer time goes to reading code (75 percent per the YC description, self reported). Launch HN in Aug 2024 and a Product Hunt launch on 2024-09-10 show developer interest.
outcome_analysis: CodeViz is a two person YC S24 developer tool that began as a VS Code extension and now sells team architecture diagrams. It has launch traction and claims large user numbers, but no verified funding round or revenue figure is public, so its outcome is unresolved.

name: Codes Health
one_liner: AI-native medical record retrieval
long_description: Codes Health is building an AI-native platform to retrieve medical records nationwide. We reverse-engineer the back offices of healthcare providers to handle the process end to end: submitting requests, navigating provider requirements, and tracking each request through delivery.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Plaintiff personal injury, mass tort and medical malpractice law firms that need medical records for cases
problem: Law firms wait weeks or months to get medical records from providers with varied back office rules; chasing requests is slow and manual.
business_model: Per request or service fee for end to end medical record retrieval, with software integrations into legal case management
product_category: AI enabled medical record retrieval for legal teams
founder_names: Alvaro Rivera; Cody Durr; Austin Mills
market_need_then: Personal injury firms spend heavily on medical record requests and face long turnaround; the Filevine release says hundreds of firms use the product, which is a partner statement and not independently verified.
outcome_analysis: Codes Health is an active New York company with about 45 staff that sells medical record retrieval to plaintiff law firms, and in July 2026 it gained distribution through a Filevine partnership. Funding amounts are not verified, so the stage and scale of its financing remain unclear, though named investors include Y Combinator, Haystack and Amplify Partners.

name: CollectWise
one_liner: Automating consumer debt collection with AI
long_description: CollectWise automates consumer debt collection with AI. Our platform allows collection agencies, debt buyers, collection law firms, and original creditors to maximize liquidation rates while reducing collection costs by 80%.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Collection agencies, debt buyers, collection law firms and original creditors
problem: Consumer debt collection relies on costly human callers with low recovery; AI agents can contact debtors at scale within compliance rules.
business_model: B2B SaaS and usage based AI agents for debt collection teams
product_category: AI voice and text agents for debt collection
market_need_then: Large consumer debt market with high operating costs; a TransUnion report cited in coverage says AI and ML use among collection firms rose from 49 percent in 2023 to 73 percent in 2024. The founder claims over 2 million USD of debt serviced by Nov 2024 (self reported).
outcome_analysis: CollectWise is an active 22 person New York company founded by a single CEO that sells AI collections agents and claims 100+ collection teams as customers. Only aggregator funding data exists, so the financing path and real traction are unverified, and the AI collections category got crowded after its batch.

name: Comfy Deploy
one_liner: ComfyUI for everyone on your team
long_description:
ComfyUI is the most popular open-source framework to build media generation workflows. However, it's a single-player experience that needs to run on a local GPU. Everyone has different environments and sharing workflows to someone else can take days to get setup.

Comfy Deploy fixes this by creating a collaborative workspace, where a teams environemnt, models and workflows can be shared as easily with a link.

**Team ComfyUI workspace**

• Replacing cobbled-together solutions with a unified, team-focused environment. When it works for you, you can be sure it works for your team.

• Eliminate "works on my machine" issues with version control.

• Share storage for models and outputs.

• Leverage the power of ComfyUI without the complexities of self-hosting

**Powerful GPU Infrastructure**
• Access managed GPUs that grow with your teams needs

• Tailor the platform to your requirements by easily installing custom nodes and models


**Custom configuration**

• Download the models you want, stored privately in your personal volume

• Install the custom nodes your workflow needs

• Train models on your own datasets.


**API Deployments: From workflow to production in seconds**

• Transform any workflow into a fully functional API immediately without extra engineering

• Comprehensive observability on every run

• Built-in API authentication

• TS/JS/Python/Ruby SDKs for seamless integration
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Product and creative engineering teams that build image and video generation workflows in ComfyUI and need to share and deploy them
problem: ComfyUI is a single user tool tied to a local GPU; teams cannot easily share environments, models and workflows or turn a workflow into a production API.
business_model: Usage based managed GPU hosting and API deployment with team workspace subscriptions
product_category: Managed ComfyUI cloud and workflow deployment platform
market_need_then: ComfyUI was the most popular open source workflow tool for media generation in 2024; the company had about 2.5K MRR when accepted to YC per its own blog.
outcome_analysis: Comfy Deploy grew from a ComfyUI deployment open source project to about 29K MRR by Sept 2025, per its own blog, but depended on a platform it did not control and expected ComfyOrg to launch a competing cloud. The founders re-open sourced the platform, kept customers supported and said they would explore new problems.

name: CommodityAI
tags: B2B; Workflow Automation; Enterprise Software; AI
one_liner: The AI operating system for commodity operations
long_description:
CommodityAI builds intelligent automation agents for some of the most operationally complex businesses in the world: physical commodity traders.

In trading operations, critical data is often buried in spreadsheets, emails, PDFs, and legacy systems — making workflows slow, error-prone, and overly manual. CommodityAI acts as a digital operator, continuously reading, interpreting, and updating information across the trade lifecycle to keep records accurate and systems in sync.

Our agents extract and validate key details from trade confirmations, contracts, vessel updates, and more — turning scattered, unstructured data into clean, structured records that flow directly into CTRMs, ERPs, and other core platforms. No manual entry required.

By automating what others still do by hand, we help trading teams move faster, reduce risk, and focus on the decisions that matter most.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Physical commodity trading and operations teams (sugar, grains and similar) at trading houses
problem: Trade confirmations, contracts, vessel updates and invoices sit in emails and PDFs and are keyed manually into CTRM and ERP systems, which is slow and error prone.
business_model: Enterprise B2B software with AI agents sold per deployment, integrated with CTRMs and ERPs
product_category: AI operations agents for physical commodity trading
founder_names: Philip Koenig; Daniel Cervoni; Kyle Franz

name: Conductor
one_liner: Run a team of coding agents on your Mac
long_description: Run parallel agents in isolated workspaces. See at a glance what they’re working on, then review and merge their changes.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Software engineers and engineering teams that use AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex
problem: Running several coding agents at once on one codebase causes conflicts and makes review hard; developers need isolated workspaces and one place to review and merge agent work.
business_model: Freemium developer tool for Mac, with Pro subscription and a team cloud product
product_category: Developer tools, coding agent orchestration
market_need_then: Developers began running multiple Claude Code sessions in mid 2025; the Conductor Show HN in July 2025 reached 228 points per a search summary. The company later cited 10x user growth since January 2026 and listed large tech company users, both self reported.
outcome_analysis: Conductor started as the YC S24 company Melty, pivoted in 2025 into a parallel coding agent Mac app that spread quickly among developers, raised a 22M Series A in March 2026 and was acquired by Meta in November 2026. The exit came amid heavy platform risk, since model labs shipped similar apps, so it reads as a talent and product acquisition with undisclosed terms.

name: Conductor Quantum
tags: Hard Tech; Machine Learning; Quantum Computing; Semiconductors; AI
one_liner: AI that operates quantum computers for scientific discovery
long_description:
Conductor Quantum is building quantum superintelligence: AI that operates quantum computers to make scientific discoveries beyond human reach.

Quantum computers let us understand the world at its most fundamental level, the path to new drugs, new materials, and discoveries no human can reach alone. 

A quantum computer is the perfect simulator of nature: it encodes the logic of reality into a programmable machine, atom by atom, electron by electron. Give AI that simulator and you open the door to discovery.

The bottleneck is operating the hardware. Today, engineers spend days or weeks by hand to bring a chip to operating conditions for just two qubits. A qubit is the information-carrying unit of a quantum computer, the equivalent of a bit in a classical one, and a useful machine needs billions. 

Removing the human from that loop is only half the problem. Every command an AI sends to a quantum computer must be optimised for the specific hardware it runs on.

We build the AI that operates quantum computers and tunes every machine it runs on. That is the path to quantum superintelligence.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Quantum hardware builders and research labs that need qubit calibration and control, plus developers who want to program quantum computers
problem: Engineers spend days or weeks tuning a quantum chip by hand to bring even two qubits to operating conditions, which blocks scaling.
business_model: B2B software for quantum hardware control (Control) and a natural language programming interface (Coda); pricing not public
product_category: AI software for quantum computer calibration and control
market_need_then: Quantum hardware makers faced manual, slow calibration as qubit counts grew, a bottleneck the company's own materials describe; no independent spend data was found.
outcome_analysis: Conductor Quantum is active with a small team and a clear research led wedge in AI control of quantum hardware. Its public traction is not documented beyond products named Coda and Control, and funding amounts are only seen in aggregators, so the outcome so far is early and unproven rather than a success or failure.

name: Conduit
one_liner: AI Agents for Hospitality
long_description:
Conduit is the leading AI agent platform for hospitality operations.

Operators can create, test, and run AI agents on Conduit's harness purpose built for hospitality. On-brand agents handles the full guest journey, converting inquiries into bookings and driving upsell revenue, then runs internal operations and surfaces insights for leadership. All connected to the systems operators already use. 

Trusted by over 1000+ global hospitality brands across 120+ countries.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Hotels, short term rental operators and property managers that handle guest messages and calls
problem: Hospitality operators spend staff time answering repetitive guest inquiries across chat and phone and miss bookings after hours.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for AI chat and voice agents integrated with property management systems
product_category: Conversational AI agents for hospitality
market_need_then: Short term rental and hotel operators faced high message volume and staffing costs; no dated third party spend data was found.
outcome_analysis: Conduit is active and raised a reported $3.1M seed in April 2025 after rebranding from HostAI, and it claims over 1000 hospitality brands as customers. Those traction numbers are self reported, and the market has several dedicated AI guest messaging rivals, so the outcome is still open.

name: Consul

long_description: Consul is building the future of payouts for the online economy. We make it easy for marketplaces, agencies, and startups to make payouts using stablecoins.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Marketplaces, agencies and startups that pay contractors, creators and vendors across borders
problem: Cross border payouts are slow and expensive. Consul lets businesses pay in USDC stablecoins and recipients claim by email without needing a crypto wallet.
business_model: Payments platform with fees on stablecoin payouts via API, plus consumer account and card features
product_category: Stablecoin payouts infrastructure

outcome_analysis: Consul built a stablecoin payouts API from a two founder team in the Winter 2024 batch and registered as a money services business. YC marks it Acquired, but the live site presents it as an independent company under the legal name Swift Finance, Inc., and no acquirer, date or price turned up in searches. The outcome is therefore unconfirmed, and no funding beyond the YC deal is public.

name: Consus

long_description: Consus is an API that routes all AI requests to secure and compliant infrastructure. product_category: Compliant AI gateway for controlled data
market_need_then: Defense contractors were restricted from using commercial AI on ITAR and CUI data; the founder's launch material argues few contractors sit in all three GovClouds. No independent spend data was found.
outcome_analysis: Consus is active, lists several defense startup customers and announced a FedRAMP High equivalent assessment in October 2026. Funding is not public and a solo founder team is thin, so the evidence supports a promising niche rather than a proven outcome.

name: Conveo
tags: SaaS; Feedback; Market Research; Enterprise Software; Conversational AI

long_description: Conveo's AI-moderator interviews real people that compound into a queryable understanding layer: research-grade, available to every team.

name: Copper Health

name: Cora

long_description:
Cora is a mobile app that provides personalized fitness coaching using health and wearable data. Cora is built for people who want structure and guidance in their training, but don’t benefit from generic programs or static plans. By connecting to Apple Watch and other health data sources, Cora understands a user’s current fitness level and adapts coaching, insights, and training plans over time.

With Cora, users get:
- Coaching and insights based on real health and wearable data
- Adaptive training plans that evolve with fitness level
- Nutrition tracking with smart macro targets based on your goals
- Clear guidance on training, recovery, and progress over time
- A simple way to understand where they are and what to do next
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Consumers who train with Apple Watch and other wearables and want adaptive coaching

business_model: Consumer app, free download with premium subscription
product_category: AI fitness coaching mobile app
founder_names: Aditya Ganapathi; Ryan Ali; Josh Passell
market_need_then: Wearable owners had abundant data and generic plans; no dated demand figures were found.
outcome_analysis: Cora is active with a three person team and a live App Store product, but no funding amounts, user numbers or press were found. Large wearable and fitness brands launched AI coaches in the same period, so the outcome is unproven.

name: Corgi
one_liner: Corgi is building an AI financial infrastructure company
long_description: Corgi is using AI to make financial products faster, better, and lower fee. Our goal is to save every business and person a lot of time, and to be there to provide protection if something bad happens to them.

outcome_analysis: Corgi reported $108M in January 2026 at a $630M valuation and a $160M Series B at $1.3B in May 2026, then reportedly another round at a higher valuation, and its site claims over $450M raised. The pace of raising and a 250 person team show very fast execution, though outlets disagree on later valuations and the long term insurance risk is untested.

name: Coval
tags: Developer Tools; SaaS; B2B; Monitoring; AI
one_liner: Simulation & Evaluation that scales voice and chat AI agents
long_description:
Coval is a simulation & evaluation platform for autonomous AI agents, helping engineers launch dependable assistants across chat, voice, and other modalities. 
We simulate thousands of scenarios engineers don't have to manually test their agents. Our CI/CD evaluations automatically simulate and detect regressions.

The record supports founder-market fit and a timing tailwind; it also faces a crowded field of voice-agent testing vendors, so durable defensibility is not shown.

name: CreativeMode
one_liner: Lovable for Minecraft mods
long_description:
In the past 9 months, more Minecraft mods were made with CreativeMode than in the game's previous 17 years combined. CreativeMode is making every player a creator.

Games like Minecraft, Fortnite, and Roblox started a revolution by allowing players to shape the games they love. CreativeMode is taking it to the next level by giving every player the power of a game studio at their fingertips. Players on CreativeMode create new experiences, play them with friends, and share their creations with the community. It’s a new way to play and create where imagination is the only limit.

CreativeMode’s founding team met as early engineers at Crusoe (soon to IPO) and studied CS+AI at Stanford, MIT, and CMU. The team is backed by top investors including YC and General Catalyst.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada

business_model: Freemium consumer platform with a paid Pro tier, multiplayer hosting and an affiliate program
product_category: AI mod creation platform for games

outcome_analysis: CreativeMode is active with self reported growth to hundreds of thousands of mods and players, regular releases and an independent community. Funding amounts and independent press are absent, so traction is unverified and platform dependence on Minecraft remains a risk.

name: Crouton
one_liner: The living map of your organization
long_description:
Crouton is the living map of your organization.

It’s for founders and operators at growing companies who need to understand how people, teams, roles, and ownership actually fit together.

Today they piece this together from org charts, Notion docs, spreadsheets, Slack, and memory and then redo it every time something changes.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Founders and operators at growing companies
problem: People, teams, roles and ownership are tracked across org charts, Notion, spreadsheets and Slack and must be reworked after every change.
business_model: B2B SaaS (pricing not found)
product_category: Organization mapping / org design software
market_need_then: Company describes fragmented tracking of org structure; no dated demand evidence retrieved.

problem: Secondary ticket marketplaces focus on seller asking prices and charge heavy fees, which frustrates buyers of scarce rave and club tickets.

product_category: secondary ticket marketplace

Founders are fans of the EDM scene, which gives founder market fit, but the sources do not yet show durable traction or a response from big incumbents, so the outcome is still open.

name: Crustdata
one_liner: Real-time B2B data via simple APIs
long_description:
Crustdata provides live company and people data via APIs and full dataset delivery. We make hard to get data easy to use at scale.

Customers use us to build their AI agent platforms and applications over our trusted data. We power builders of:
-AI SDRs
-AI sales platofmrs
-AI recruiting platforms
-AI investment/due diligence platforms
-Internal sales or marketing platforms


We serve use cases like: automatic pipeline building, pipeline prioritization, champion watching, company and people triggers for sales and marketing automation, investment deal sourcing

We have developed technology that allows us to pipe in live data from over a dozen different data sources and deliver this data instantly to our customers. 

Our goal is index all the important data on the web and deliver it to customers in an easy-to-use way.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: AI agent builders, sales, recruiting and investment platforms that need live B2B people and company data
problem: Sales and recruiting AI products need fresh people and company data, but static datasets go stale and scraping is hard to maintain.
business_model: usage-based API and dataset delivery
product_category: real-time B2B data API
founder_names: Abhilash Chowdhary; Manmohit Grewal; Chris Pisarski
market_need_then: AI SDR, recruiting and diligence products were multiplying in 2024 and needed live people and company data; specific dated demand evidence was not opened.
outcome_analysis: Crustdata joined YC in Fall 2024 as a real-time B2B data API for AI agents and announced a 6 million dollar seed in October 2025. By its own account revenue grew from 770 thousand to over 4 million dollars in seven months with a one person sales team and profitability. The growth claims are company reported and legal risk around scraped data remains.

name: Curo

Raised $6M+ from YC, Blue Bear, Not Boring, Eniac and others.

name: DGI Apparel

name: Dataleap

name: David AI

name: Dayflow

name: Decipher AI

Decipher AI generates your E2E tests, maintains them as you ship, and catches issues before customers do. Plus, get alerted when users hit live bugs.

name: Decisional AI

Decisional builds custom AI Agents for commercial contractors.

name: Deep24

problem: People struggle to turn scattered personal data into concrete plans for behavior change. Deep24 syncs with a user's data sources and an AI coach builds plans to improve their life.

name: DeepSim, Inc.

long_description: DeepSim is building an AI physics simulator. We are currently developing the only thermal simulator to meet AI chip design needs and are validating our tool with Intel. problem: Physics simulation for chips needs hours of meshing and setup and can run for hours or weeks on costly compute. DeepSim automates setup and uses AI and GPUs to simulate much faster.
business_model: Enterprise engineering software licensing (not confirmed by a source)
product_category: AI physics simulation for chip design (EDA adjacent)

Its edge is PhD level domain depth in thermal simulation for chips, which fits a market with real need, while Cadence and other vendors compete. name: Deepnight

long_description: DeepNight is building the next generation of night vision with AI.

business_model: Software and imaging platform sold to government and hardware partners via contracts
product_category: AI night vision software
market_need_then: Large military night vision programs (ENVG-B, hundreds of millions of dollars) and expensive hardware created demand; the Army awarded an early $100,000 contract in February 2024.
