The founders timed it to AI accelerators on SoCs becoming fast enough for real time imaging. The company announced a US Army OTA award in October 2026, so it is still growing.

name: Dench.com
tags: Workflow Automation; Open Source; CRM; AI; AI Assistant
one_liner: Workspace for your AI Agents, Build any Workflow.
long_description:
Dench: AI CRM + Full-Service Deployment

Most CRMs sell you software and hand you a 200-page setup guide. Dench is different. We're the only CRM that ships with an embedded team: we migrate your data, build your object schema, configure your integrations, train your people, and deploy AI agents that keep your pipeline clean without a Salesforce developer, a RevOps contractor, or a six-month implementation project.

From day one, our team works inside your stack. We pull your existing data out of HubSpot, Salesforce, or whatever spreadsheet graveyard you're currently using, and rebuild it properly in Dench. Custom objects, custom fields, automation rules, integration config across Gmail, Slack, Notion, GitHub, LinkedIn, and 50+ other tools. Everything set up the way your business actually works, not the way a generic CRM template assumes it does.

Then we train your team. Not a one-hour Zoom and a PDF. Real sessions that build CRM discipline: how to log activity consistently, how to keep data clean, how to use AI agents to do the repetitive work so your reps spend time selling instead of updating fields. Quarterly business reviews keep the system evolving as your pipeline grows.

The AI layer is what makes it permanent. Dench agents enrich leads automatically, move deals through stages based on real signals, draft outreach, log interactions, and flag hygiene issues before they compound. Your CRM stays accurate without someone babysitting it.

No implementation consultant invoice. No dedicated Salesforce admin headcount. No duct-taped automation stack. One engagement, everything included, starting at $1,500/month.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Sales and revenue teams at small and mid sized companies (CRM and go to market); an earlier launch post targeted law firms for AI voice intake
problem: CRMs need long setup and constant maintenance. Dench sells an AI CRM with agents that enrich leads, run outreach and keep the pipeline clean, with deployment help included.
business_model: SaaS subscription with full service deployment (YC page cites a starting price of $1,500 per month); open source core
product_category: AI CRM and agent workspace
market_need_then: Complaints about heavy CRM implementation and rising interest in AI agents; no hard spend data found.
outcome_analysis: Dench is an active Summer 2024 company of about six people that has changed product direction, from law firm voice intake to a general AI CRM, and later to an open source project. Public traction signals are GitHub stars and a Product Hunt launch, but no funding or revenue figures are public, so the outcome is unknown.

name: Dexter
one_liner: Spend Intelligence for Complex Enterprises
long_description: Dexter helps procurement teams understand exactly where money is being spent and where it can be saved. Dexter's AI agents mine supplier invoices and contracts for insights, surfacing consolidation opportunities, contract leakage, and off-contract spend.
regions: Germany; Europe
target_customer: Procurement and finance teams at complex mid sized and large enterprises, mainly in Europe
problem: Companies cannot see line item spend across invoices and contracts, so they miss savings from vendor consolidation, contract leakage and off contract buying. Dexter's AI agents read invoices and contracts and surface those savings.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription (pricing not stated)
product_category: Spend intelligence and procurement analytics
founder_names: Bella Wu; Vincent Garrigues; Caterina Kiehntopf
market_need_then: Procurement teams lacked line item visibility; competitor pages show an existing spend analytics market, but no direct spend or complaint data for Dexter was found.
outcome_analysis: Dexter is a three person Berlin team from Fall 2024 and is active with named enterprise customers on its site. The founders previously ran product, engineering and operations at Dance, which supplies procurement domain context. Funding and growth are not publicly confirmed, and the spend analytics field already has established vendors.

name: Diana
tags: Productivity; SMB; Operations; AI; AI Assistant
one_liner: Give Your Employee An Employee
long_description: The first business-ready OpenClaw platform. A secure AI assistant embedded directly into Slack.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Small and mid sized businesses needing HR back office help; later positioned at teams wanting a governed AI assistant in Slack
problem: SMBs lack HR staff for onboarding, payroll and compliance. The company started with AI plus human HR specialists as a service (DianaHR), then launched a Slack AI assistant with a Governor that checks actions.
business_model: HR as a service subscription (AI plus human specialist); later AI assistant platform
product_category: AI HR services and AI workplace assistant
market_need_then: SMBs commonly outsource HR to PEOs or run without it; no dated 2024 demand evidence for this specific product was found.
outcome_analysis: Diana raised a $3.7 million seed in September 2025 led by SNR Ventures with General Catalyst, and the founder comes from Gusto HR engineering, which fits the HR service wedge. In 2026 the company widened to an AI assistant product. It is active, with no exit; results beyond funding are unknown.

name: Diffusion Studio
one_liner: Turn your agent into a professional video editor
long_description: Diffusion Studio lets your agents make videos. Every edit is written to a real codebase that coding agents can read, write, and render.
regions: Germany; Europe; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Video creators, developers automating video editing, and teams producing video with AI agents
problem: Repetitive video editing is slow and cloud editors require uploads. Diffusion Studio runs editing in the browser using WebCodecs and WebGPU, and later lets coding agents read, write and render edits as code.
business_model: Freemium editor with credits for AI model actions; open source library
product_category: Browser based AI video editor and open source video library
market_need_then: Growing demand for automated video editing and AI video tools; the company reports 100K+ creators using the product (own site, unverified).
outcome_analysis: Diffusion Studio is an active Fall 2024 company with a small team, an open source library and a browser editor that has moved toward agent driven editing. It reports 100K+ creators, but no verified funding or revenue is public, so the outcome cannot be judged yet.

name: DigitalCarbon
tags: Computer Vision; Real Estate; B2B; E-commerce; AI
one_liner: Transform Images And Videos Into Immersive 3D With AI
long_description:
Digitalcarbon transforms ordinary images and videos into interactive, photorealistic 3D environments. Our technology can take photos from any device and render 3D scenes at more than 100 frames per second on everyday devices. 

The founders were the first and second hires at a previous YC company AssemblyAI, and have more than 8 years of experience building AI models. 

Creating immersive 3D experiences typically requires complex equipment and suffers from slow rendering speeds. This has limited the adoption of 3D technology across various industries. Digitalcarbon fixes that, eliminating the need for specialized equipment and dramatically accelerating the rendering process.

Our technology enables applications across various industries:
* Real estate: Creating virtual property tours that feel remarkably lifelike
* E-commerce: Providing interactive 3D product visualizations to boost consumer experience
* Tourism: Helping tourist businesses attract more travelers with immersive virtual previews
* Drone mapping and inspection: Enhancing aerial surveys and structural assessments with detailed 3D models

Think Unreal Engine meets Matterport with no hardware, but faster, editable, and more accessible for businesses of all sizes.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Real estate agents, e-commerce brands, tourism and drone inspection teams wanting 3D scenes from photos and video
problem: Producing photorealistic 3D scenes normally needs special equipment and slow processing. DigitalCarbon turns ordinary photos and videos into interactive 3D that renders at high frame rates on everyday devices.
business_model: App and developer API (pricing not stated)
product_category: Gaussian splatting and radiance field 3D capture
market_need_then: Interest in virtual tours and 3D product views existed, but no dated demand evidence for the Summer 2024 period was found; the launch post sought beta testers.
outcome_analysis: DigitalCarbon is a Summer 2024 company founded by early AssemblyAI employees, still listed as active with early access signups. Radiance Fields coverage from 2024 treats it as a research lab. No verified funding, revenue or exit exists in public sources, so success or failure is undetermined.

name: Dime
one_liner: Dime automates administrative busywork at healthcare clinics
long_description:
At Dime, we automate repetitive administrative work in healthcare clinics, including insurance coordination, referrals, referring-provider communication, scheduling, and patient communication. 

We integrate directly with RIS and EHR systems, creating true end-to-end automation rather than adding another software layer. Our HIPAA-compliant AI agents eliminate paperwork bottlenecks, reduce errors, and restore hours of clinical time - enabling care teams to focus on patients.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Outpatient clinics, mostly imaging and radiology practices, that handle referrals, insurance authorizations and patient calls
problem: Clinic staff spend hours on referral intake, prior authorization, provider communication, scheduling and patient calls, which delays visits and causes errors.
business_model: B2B SaaS and AI agent services sold to clinics, integrated with RIS and EHR systems
product_category: Healthcare administrative AI agents
market_need_then: Prior authorization and referral processing are widely reported administrative burdens for clinics, and generative AI voice agents became practical in 2023 and 2024.
outcome_analysis: Dime is a three person YC W24 company still listed as active that sells AI agents for clinic paperwork, mainly to imaging practices. No verified funding, exit or press was found, so its trajectory is unknown. It competes with better funded intake and authorization vendors, and its YC page also asks for manufacturing introductions, which hints at a possible second market that is not confirmed.

name: Dimely
one_liner: AI-Powered Spreadsheet for Billing Automation
long_description:
Dimely helps accounting teams scale their order management & contract review workflows. Today fast-growing tech unicorns like Checkr and Airbyte get more coverage with less manual work by using Dimely’s AI agents to intelligently extract relevant details from core files like Order Forms, MSAs & POs, flag discrepancies, and then sync this information to core finance systems like NetSuite and Stripe.

Dimely leverages what finance and accounting teams love most, spreadsheets, for all its workflows so teams never feel out of place. Teams just replace their existing, siloed Excel spreadsheet with one that's connected and powered by AI. Teams love Dimely for its ease of use and intuitive user experience that saves them hundreds if not thousands of hours a month.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Finance and accounting teams at fast growing B2B software companies
problem: Order forms, MSAs and POs hold billing terms that teams re-key by hand into NetSuite or Stripe, causing billing errors and slow revenue recognition.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for AI contract extraction and billing validation in a spreadsheet interface
product_category: Revenue and billing automation
market_need_then: Finance teams at usage and contract heavy software companies reported manual order form entry and billing errors, and LLMs made document extraction newly practical in 2023 and 2024.
outcome_analysis: Dimely is a three person YC S24 company whose founders ran billing operations and data at OneSignal, which gives real domain insight. It names Checkr and Airbyte as customers on its YC page. No press or confirmed round beyond YC was found, so its progress is unverified and it faces funded revenue automation rivals.

name: Diode Computers, Inc.
one_liner: Automate circuit board design using AI
long_description: Diode automates circuit board design. We work with hardware companies to get them the PCBs they need, fast.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Hardware companies in robotics, aerospace and medical devices that need custom circuit boards
problem: Designing, fabricating and sourcing parts for a printed circuit board takes months and many iterations, slowing hardware startups.
business_model: Design services starting at $10,000 per design plus fabrication and assembly revenue, with a self serve AI design tool
product_category: AI PCB design and manufacturing
market_need_then: Hardware startups reported months long PCB cycles, and robotics and defense hardware demand grew in 2024 alongside AI code generation.
outcome_analysis: Diode is a YC S24 company that went from a ten person team to an a16z led Series A of reported $11.4M in July 2025 by combining AI design with its own fabrication and assembly service. The investor cited technical founders with hardware and software range. It still competes with Quilter, Flux and JITX, and no exit has occurred.

name: Distro
tags: SaaS; B2B; Manufacturing; Supply Chain; AI
one_liner: The AI co-pilot for sales reps at industrial wholesale distributors.
long_description: Distro is the all-in-one AI-powered sales platform for counter staff and inside sales at industrial wholesale distributors (HVAC/R, plumbing, electrical, and more).
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Industrial wholesale distributors (HVAC/R, plumbing, electrical) and manufacturers' reps
problem: Counter and inside sales reps spend time turning complex customer requests, RFQs and spec sheets into accurate quotes and orders.
business_model: B2B SaaS for AI quoting, sales agent, CPQ and AP automation, integrated with distributor ERPs
product_category: Vertical AI sales and quoting for industrial distribution
market_need_then: Industrial distribution is large, run on legacy ERPs and manual quoting; no spend data from 2022 to 2024 was found beyond trade press interviews.
outcome_analysis: Distro is an active YC S24 company building AI quoting and sales tools for industrial distributors, with a team of 11 and integrations across major ERPs. Funding is only seen on aggregators with conflicting dates, so traction cannot be judged from public data. Incumbent ERP vendors and several startups have since entered the same space.

name: Dodo
tags: Health Tech; Dental; Call Center; AI; Conversational AI
one_liner: AI agents that handle communications for clinics
long_description:
Dodo turns client communication into booked appointments, completed workflows, and predictive analytics, powering millions of client interactions annually for thousands of clinics.

Our multi-agent system autonomously runs scheduling, refills, intake, and follow-ups across calls and texts — integrating directly with clinic systems to cut communication overhead ~70% and act like a trained CSR 24/7.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Specialty clinics, starting with veterinary practices and extending to dental and other clinics
problem: Clinics miss calls and lose appointments because front desk staff cannot handle scheduling, refills, intake and follow ups around the clock.
business_model: Subscription with fixed fee pricing for small clinics and usage based pricing for larger ones, per the company's launch pitch as reported
product_category: Clinic communications AI agents
founder_names: Dominik Moehrle; Julius Hillebrand; Tim Reinhart
market_need_then: Clinics were short of front desk staff and missed calls, and voice AI became usable in 2023 and 2024.
outcome_analysis: Dodo is a YC S24 team with Stanford trained founders selling AI communications agents to clinics, and its own site claims over 1,000 clinics, which is unverified. No credible funding round beyond the YC deal was found, and aggregator figures conflict. Its trajectory depends on holding vertical integrations against Weave and many AI receptionist rivals.

name: Domu Technology Inc.
tags: AIOps; Call Center; AI; AI Assistant
one_liner: AI Agents for collections
long_description: Domu automates debt-collection calls, texts, and emails for financial services and healthcare. We work with some of the largest financial institutions in the world and win by doing what nobody else is willing to do.  We are hiring :)
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Banks, lenders, insurers, BNPL providers and collection agencies and outsourcers
problem: Collections and loan servicing rely on large call centers that are costly and must meet strict compliance rules.
business_model: Enterprise usage based AI voice, text and email agents for collections and servicing
product_category: AI agents for debt collections
market_need_then: Collections is labor heavy and call centers face turnover, while generative voice AI matured in 2023 and 2024.
outcome_analysis: Domu is a YC S24 company with a reported team of 50 that sells AI collections agents to large financial institutions. Its CEO's co-founder claims forty plus bank deals, and a June 2026 Alorica release reports early results. No verified funding round beyond YC was found, so capital raised is unknown despite apparent growth.

name: Doublezero
one_liner: Platform to build, use, and monetize fully autonomous agents
long_description:
Doublezero is a platform that provides developers with everything they need to build, operate, and monetize autonomous agents. Developers can focus on creating tools while Doublezero handles reasoning frameworks, state management, analytics, monetization, and a runner UI.

Users can interact with agents through a powerful UI that allows play, pause, rewind, and human intervention, and discover or share agents and tools through an integrated marketplace.
regions: Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Developers building and monetizing autonomous AI agents
problem: Building agents requires reasoning frameworks, state management, analytics and monetization that developers must assemble themselves.
business_model: Developer platform with a marketplace and monetization layer (pricing not found)
product_category: Agent development and runtime platform
market_need_then: Strong developer interest in agents in 2024; no direct evidence of paying demand found.
outcome_analysis: Doublezero is a two-person team that entered S24 as Superfilter, an inbox assistant, and now presents an agent platform; they also run Ceejay. No funding, revenue or user numbers are public, so only the repeated pivoting and crowded agent-platform market can be noted.

name: Downlink
one_liner: Make your LLMs 3x faster.
long_description:
Downlink is a platform that continuously improves your AI.

Boost rate limits, slash latency, and raise accuracy.All through one simple API.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: AI engineers and developers building LLM applications
problem: LLM apps hit rate limits, latency and accuracy problems that are hard to tune across models.
business_model: Usage based API that selects and fine tunes models for a use case
product_category: LLM optimization API
market_need_then: Teams building on LLMs in early 2024 faced rate limits and latency, but model prices and speeds were falling quickly.
outcome_analysis: Downlink was a one person YC W24 company offering a single API to speed up and improve LLM apps. No funding, press, exit or shutdown was found, so its outcome is unknown. The wedge sat in a crowded and fast commoditizing layer that providers and routers were absorbing, which suggests a hard path, though that is not confirmed by any source.

name: Draft The Record
one_liner: AI For Litigation
long_description:
We are on a mission to provide faster and affordable access to the justice system - starting with depositions and trials.

1000s of depositions and trials run through DraftTheRecord every week including Senate and House meetings, Confidential federal hearings, criminal proceedings like murder trials, and civil lawsuits involving family disputes, personal injury and much more.

During legal proceedings,
• DraftTheRecord provides real time assistance to attorneys, previously requiring a legal team. The platform then helps analyze depositions and other evidence cutting down trial prep time from weeks to days. 
• Court reporters use DraftTheRecord to capture audio and generate live transcript drafts for attorneys and judges. 
• Transcribers use our legal-specific AI transcription model to cut transcription time by 3x.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Attorneys, court reporters and transcribers handling depositions and trials
problem: Court reporting and deposition transcription are slow and costly, which limits access to justice and burdens litigation teams.
business_model: Software subscription for attorneys, court reporters and transcribers, including a desktop product for court reporters
product_category: Legal AI for depositions and court reporting
market_need_then: Court reporter shortages and high transcript costs created demand, and speech models improved by 2024.
outcome_analysis: Draft The Record is a five person YC S24 company serving attorneys, court reporters and transcribers. Its founders came from Google's Pixel AI teams, but no verified funding, press or exit was found. Its YC page also mixes in an unrelated ADHD product called Focus Buddy, which may signal a split in focus that sources do not explain.

name: Draftaid
tags: Construction; Design; Manufacturing; Architecture; AI Assistant
one_liner: Go from 3D models to CAD drawings using AI
long_description:
DraftAid is the world's first generative AI for CAD manufacturing drawings, akin to GitHub Copilot but for CAD. It drastically shortens drawing creation time, turning hours into seconds.

Every product that is manufactured - from construction to aerospace, automotive, durable goods, and electronics—relies on drawings. Currently, engineers and designers painstakingly make these essential drawings manually. Draftaid streamlines this process saving teams millions in time and quality. 

The idea was born out of Abdullah's experience as a mechanical design team member, where he created thousands of drawings and longed for a more efficient process. Partnering with Tahsin, a neighbour with a PhD in AI, and Mohammed, a seasoned engineering VP with experience in construction software, they turned the dream into reality.

Since their launch in August, DraftAid has engaged customers through targeted outreach and word-of-mouth, securing paid pilots with subsequent contracts valued at $150,000.

Be a part of ushering in the new era of CAD designs!
regions: Canada; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Engineering and manufacturing teams in construction, automotive, aerospace and fabrication that produce 2D drawings from 3D CAD models
problem: Engineers manually create manufacturing drawings for each part, which is slow and error prone.
business_model: B2B software subscription and pilots, integrating with Inventor and SolidWorks
product_category: CAD drawing automation
founder_names: Mohammed Al-arnawoot; Abdullah Elqabbany; Tahsin Rahman
market_need_then: Engineers described drawing creation as repetitive work, and the founders reported paid pilots with contracts valued at $150,000 by early 2024.
outcome_analysis: Draftaid is a Toronto YC W24 company whose founders combine drafting, engineering management and a PhD in AI. It reported paid pilots worth $150,000 and later claimed about 180,000 drawings generated in 2025, a company figure. Autodesk's own AI drawings feature in October 2024 is the clearest incumbent threat, and no verified funding beyond YC was found.

name: Dragoneye
tags: Developer Tools; Computer Vision; AI; ML
one_liner: Custom video detection models in less than 5 minutes
long_description:
Dragoneye helps devs build their custom video detection models in less than 5 minutes. These models can then be used to power apps and features that use images and videos. No more arduous process of annotating any training data or doing any machine learning work themselves.

Try out our demo today at https://playground.dragoneye.ai/ !
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Developers and product teams that need to extract structured data from video without training models
problem: Building a custom video detection model normally needs labeled data and ML work. Dragoneye lets a developer describe what to detect and get a model without annotating or training.
business_model: Usage-based API and SDK with a subscription tier (a directory lists a starting price of $49 per month, unverified)
product_category: Zero-shot computer vision API for video
market_need_then: Developers wanted vision features without labeling pipelines. Evidence of demand is thin: the site names no customers and the YC page gives no traction numbers.
outcome_analysis: Dragoneye is still active with a two person team as of the YC page. The product moved from custom video detection models toward zero-shot video to data extraction with an SDK and an MCP server for coding agents. No outside round could be verified, so its trajectory cannot be judged beyond staying small and shipping.

name: DreamRP
one_liner: Tech and platforms for human creators and the entertainment industry
long_description:
AI entertainment feels like slop because companies bet on technology instead of people.

Companies chase tech because it usually lets them win. But what fans love has never been about the tech.

A fan doesn’t fill their apartment with posters because of the lens a movie was shot on. They do it because of the mind behind the camera.

AI is a power-up. In the wrong hands, more and more of what you see becomes sludge. In the right ones, the good stuff wins.

DreamRP builds for creatives, from indie artists to global stars, because they’ve always been the real reason fans love what they love.

If you get it, message me why.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Creators and artists who want to turn characters into interactive AI experiences for fans; fans as consumers
problem: AI entertainment is described as sludge because companies bet on technology over creators. DreamRP builds tools and a platform so human creators can earn from AI roleplay.
business_model: Consumer roleplay platform with a free plan and creator monetization (details not confirmed)
product_category: AI character chat and roleplay platform for creators
market_need_then: Large audiences used character chat apps in 2024 and creators of characters wanted pay. Specific evidence for DreamRP traction was not found.
outcome_analysis: DreamRP is active with a two person team. Its positioning is human creators over generic AI content, launched on Product Hunt in September 2024 as a Character.ai meets Patreon style product. No traction, funding or exit evidence could be confirmed, so the outcome is unknown.

name: Drillbit
one_liner: Automating Office Work for Residential Contractors.
long_description: Residential contractors are drowning in office work. Drillbit automates all of it. We use AI receptionists and an LLM based quoting tool on top of our own CRM to entirely manage jobs from lead, to quote, to scheduling, to staffing, and even collecting payment.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Residential contractors and home service businesses, including franchise networks
problem: Residential contractors are buried in office work: answering leads, quoting, scheduling, staffing and collecting payment.
business_model: B2B SaaS per location (site states from $500 per month) with usage billing
product_category: AI agent and CRM for home services back office
market_need_then: Home service firms lose leads to missed calls and carry heavy admin work, and LLMs and voice AI made automation feasible in 2024.
outcome_analysis: Drillbit grew to about 12 people in Austin and sells its AI agent Mason with a ResiBrands case study on its site. It reports strong growth and a hiring push, but funding figures conflict across sources and no exit exists. Founder experience with robotics and home renovation supports founder market fit, while many AI receptionist rivals and platform add ons are the main risk.

name: Driver
one_liner: Context for Codebases
long_description: Driver is the context layer that translates your codebase into shared, structured understanding. By computing context ahead of time, Driver delivers symbol‑complete documentation, architecture maps, and history guides so teams and agents can reason across an entire codebase without guesswork.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Engineering, support and product teams at software companies, and AI coding agents needing codebase context
problem: Teams struggle to understand large business critical codebases, which slows documentation, support investigation and onboarding.
business_model: Enterprise software sold through contact sales
product_category: AI codebase understanding and documentation
market_need_then: Large legacy codebases and fast LLM progress created demand for automated documentation; launch customer UICO said Driver helped it understand systems and port software.
outcome_analysis: Driver launched out of stealth in October 2024 with an $8M seed led by GV and by 2026 names Optiver, Geneva Trading, ShipBob and Lucanet as customers. Serial founders with two earlier exits and enterprise traction explain the seed, while a pivot toward agent context shows it adapting to coding agents. No later round or exit was found.

name: Dropback
one_liner: The front office software suite for college sports
long_description:
Dropback is building front office software for the future of college sports. We help major athletic departments manage their teams' "salary caps" and roster limits to construct their most competitive rosters.

Just two years ago, it became legal for athletes to earn an income beyond their scholarships. Since then, despite college athletes earning $2B+, rapid regulation change has put college sports in disarray. Dropback brings order to this chaos through custom compensation frameworks, roster management, what-if playgrounds, and more--ultimately helping elite programs optimize spend & maximize talent.
regions: Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: College athletic departments and football and basketball programs
problem: After athletes could earn income, programs must manage compensation budgets and roster limits with no tooling.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to athletic departments
product_category: Front office software for college sports
market_need_then: Athletes could earn NIL income from 2021 and rapid rule changes left programs managing compensation caps without tools.
outcome_analysis: Dropback rode the NIL rule change and now reports 30+ teams across the ACC, Big Ten, Big East and SEC, with data partners PFF, Hudl and Sports Info Solutions. It looks like a company with product market fit in a niche. Funding is only reported by a newsletter and no later round is verified.

name: DryMerge
one_liner: AI that updates your CRM for you
long_description:
We create AI agents that constantly monitor emails, calendar, calls, or wherever else companies have relationship data and organize it into CRM records as meticulously as a great rep would.

We build these agents on top of the DryMerge platform, a tool to build AI agents that integrate with business apps and work in the background.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Sales teams, asset managers and operations teams using CRMs
problem: CRM records go stale because reps do not enter data; DryMerge agents read email, calendar and calls and update the CRM.
business_model: B2B SaaS tiers with enterprise custom models
product_category: AI CRM updating and background agent platform
market_need_then: Sales teams spend time on manual CRM entry and LLMs made extraction practical in 2023 and 2024.
outcome_analysis: DryMerge raised a $2.2M seed in September 2024 after the Winter 2024 batch and refocused on CRM automation with customers such as Altai Capital and ContextLogic. Several rivals in AI CRM capture compete, and no later round or exit is known, so it is a small active company with modest verified traction.

name: Duckie
tags: Generative AI; Customer Support; Operations; AI
one_liner: Build AI Support Agents in Minutes
long_description:
Duckie lets customer support teams build their own AI agents in minutes! 

With Duckie, support teams can translate their tasks and processes into predictable and reliable AI workflows that saves them time and money. Folks use Duckie to handle a wide range of use cases, from answers customers technical questions to processing refunds, and everything in between.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: B2B customer support and technical support teams
problem: Support teams spend time on repetitive tickets and issue investigation across many tools.
business_model: B2B SaaS agent platform sold by demo
product_category: AI agents for customer and technical support
market_need_then: Support volume and cost pressures plus LLM capability drove demand for AI support in 2024.
outcome_analysis: Duckie shows sixteen customer logos and testimonials such as an Automox team reporting a drop from three support staff to one while handling 30 percent more tickets, which is self reported. Funding is unclear, with one source saying it is bootstrapped, and competition is heavy, so it is an active small company with some customer evidence and no verified exit.

name: Durate
one_liner: Self-running physician scheduling
long_description: Durate helps physician groups, clinics, and hospitals eliminate coverage gaps and create personalized schedules. Our platform auto-syncs with existing systems and uses smart automation to build optimized physician schedules in seconds.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Physician groups, clinics and hospitals
problem: Physician scheduling with coverage gaps and personal preferences is done by hand or with legacy tools.
business_model: B2B SaaS scheduling and analytics
product_category: Physician scheduling software
market_need_then: Hospitals face coverage gaps and clinician burnout and rely on dated schedulers; the company started inside a psychiatry residency scheduling problem.
outcome_analysis: Durate began as Docflow inside a psychiatry residency and now lists customers such as Brown Emergency Medicine across seven hospitals, Baylor College of Medicine and Cambridge Health Alliance. No funding or exit evidence was found. Entrenched incumbents are the main risk, while hospital customer logos suggest early enterprise traction.

name: Dynamite
one_liner: Personalize your website for every visitor in <300ms
long_description:
Dynamite personalizes your website for every visitor in under 300ms, so they see what is most likely to convert. It installs on ANY website with one line of JavaScript and typically increases conversion rates by ~20%.

Dynamite uses browsing behavior, campaign context and connected customer data to select the right combination of approved content. You control the designs and what can change, through the dashboard or your AI agents via MCP.

Dynamite is used across e-commerce and B2B, personalizing across messaging, customer stories, CTAs, product listings, imagery, and more. No two buyers have the same exact reasons for buying, they should see different content.

Dynamite grew out of our work building ion.design, helping companies design and improve their websites autonomously with agents.

name: Educato

Educato builds exam prep platforms worldwide using AI.

Educato uses AI to generate high-quality prep content for these exams. LLMs allow us to target the profitable fat middle in the distribution of exams, historically overlooked by education companies.

name: Elayne
tags: Fintech; B2B; Legal; Consumer Finance; AI
one_liner: Estate settlement, from verified discovery to distribution
long_description:
Elayne is building the modern estate settlement platform. 

Estate settlement is a $250B+ annual market, with $80T+ in assets expected to transfer over the next 25 years. But after a death, families and executors have to spend 400+ hours manually identifying, organize, and distribute everything that was left behind like: financial accounts, debts, property, insurance, legal documents, incorporating juristidi ation requirements and family context. 

Elayne is the first platform to surface verified assets and debts for precisely this moment, then turing our discovery into a clear inheritance map. We work directly with families and executors, and with the partners who support them: funeral homes, hospice and aftercare providers, attorneys, and financial institutions.

The company was founded by Adria, a former large-cap investor who experienced the problem firsthand, and Rebecca, a repeat fintech and mental health founder who left her master’s program in psychology at Harvard to launch Elayne. Together, they bring financial rigor, technical execution, and lived empathy to a massive but deeply human category.

Backed by Y Combinator and Accel, we are now an 8-person team based in NYC.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Bereaved families and executors; employers (HR) and partners such as funeral homes and attorneys
problem: Settling an estate takes 400+ hours (company claim) of manual work finding and distributing assets and debts.
business_model: B2B2C estate settlement platform sold to employers and partners plus families
product_category: AI estate settlement
founder_names: Adria Ferrier; Jake Grafenstein (Graf); Rebecca Lee
market_need_then: Company cites a $250B+ estate settlement market and $80T asset transfer; Ferrier says she lived the problem after losing her mother.
outcome_analysis: Elayne is an active S24 company with an 8-person team. Its founder lived the problem and the brand voice fits a grief-adjacent market. No verified funding round was found, and a market of entrants (Alix with a $20M Series A in 2025) is crowding in. Too early to call an outcome.

name: Elevate
one_liner: Automated AI data integrations for roll-ups
long_description:
Elevate is bringing AI to private equity-backed roll-ups. 

For example, one of our customers is Guardian Restoration Partners, which is backed by Alpine Investors, the leading roll-up focused private equity firm. In three months, we integrated 10 acquisitions and enabled them to pilot AI agents built on top of our data warehouse. 

We know this problem personally. Before Elevate, Scott was a Vice President at a $15B private equity firm where he was leading a roll-up. Steve and Jeff are both software engineers with backgrounds across finance, big tech, and start-ups. The founding team has been friends for over a decade from their Duke undergraduate days.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Private equity backed roll-ups, holding companies and serial acquirers that need to unify data across acquisitions
problem: After each acquisition a roll-up inherits a different set of systems and messy data, which slows integration and reporting. Elevate migrates, cleans and warehouses that data and builds AI workflows on top.
business_model: B2B services plus software, deployed with forward deployed engineers; pricing not found
product_category: AI data integration and warehousing for PE roll-ups
founder_names: Scott Cara; Steve Mazzari; Jeff (surname not stated on YC page)
market_need_then: PE buy-and-build strategies create acquisition integration problems; commentary from consultancies describes data silos as the core pain, and the founder lived it as a PE vice president.
outcome_analysis: Elevate is an active YC Summer 2024 company with about ten people selling data integration to PE roll-ups. The CEO worked in a PE roll-up, which gives founder market fit, and the site shows named case studies and SOC 2 Type 2. No round size or exit was found, so outcome is unclear.

name: Ellipsis
one_liner: Managed Agent platform
long_description:
Ellipsis is a Managed Agent Platform for Developers. Spawn, manage, and govern cloud agents for Software Factories, custom Code Review, and Background Tasks. You choose the model, harness, prompts, and tools. We'll handle the infrastructure.

Documentation: https://www.ellipsis.dev/docs

problem: Pull request review is slow and bugs slip through. Ellipsis launched as an automatic AI reviewer that also turns review comments into tested code, then expanded into a managed platform for running coding agents.
business_model: B2B SaaS per developer, later usage based managed agent platform
product_category: AI code review and managed coding agent platform

outcome_analysis: Ellipsis is an active two person YC Winter 2024 company that raised a 2M USD seed in 2024 per its own blog. It claims installs on 67,000+ repositories across 400+ companies and has broadened from code review to a managed agent platform. Competition from Copilot and other reviewers is heavy, and no later round or exit was found.

name: Ember
one_liner: AI RCM. Increase net revenue by 16%.
long_description:
Ember is rebuilding the back office of healthcare finance.

Behind every provider sits a mountain of administrative complexity, and that drag lands where it matters most: cost, capacity, and care. Ember clears it with intelligent automation, so provider groups can spend their time on patients, not paperwork.

We're reimagining how revenue moves through healthcare, and how lean teams scale without trading away quality. Our platform drops into existing provider workflows, takes the manual work off their plate, and gives leaders real-time visibility into financial and operational performance.

We're growing fast, and we're hiring sharp, resourceful people who want to build. Right now, that starts with you.

outcome_analysis: Ember is active and growing as of 2026-11, with a $4.3M seed in November 2025, customer claims of 2,700 plus providers and EHR marketplace listings such as NextGen. It rides the AI revenue cycle wave and has a CTO from MIT with medical AI research, but competes with several funded 2024 entrants and incumbents like Waystar. Customer and denial reduction figures are company reported.

name: Emergent

Emergent builds autonomous coding agents that replace traditional software development by generating, testing, and deploying production applications directly from plain-language intent. Our systems run in production at global scale and are used to build millions of real applications. 

Since our public launch, Emergent has reached $50M ARR in 7 months making us one of the fastest-growing startups in the world. 5M+ users across 190+ countries have built 6M+ applications on Emergent. We've raised $100M from Khosla Ventures, SoftBank, Google, Lightspeed India, Prosus Ventures, Together Fund, and Y Combinator.

The twin founders had startup, Google and Amazon backgrounds. Growth rode the vibe coding wave. Risks include copycat tools, model labs and quality concerns; revenue figures are company statements.

name: Endstack
tags: Developer Tools; Generative AI; AI; AI Assistant
one_liner: The complete, collaborative workspace for humans and agents
long_description:
Endstack is a full desktop, collaborative workspace built for humans and agents running in the cloud available on web, desktop, and mobile.

Each workspace powered by endOS, giving you a familiar channel-based experience augmented by a real desktop environment. The desktop is backed by Linux and ships with a built-in Chrome browser. Files, notes, browser tabs, native apps, terminal, and all your agents in a single beautiful, unified interface. 

At the center of it all you get a powerful agent running 24/7 that you can also reach via Slack, email, or SMS.

business_model: Subscription for individual and team plans (prices not captured)
product_category: Cloud desktop OS and AI agent workspace
market_need_then: Agentic computer use appeared in late 2024 (Anthropic computer use), raising interest in giving agents a full desktop.
outcome_analysis: Endstack is a two person Fall 2024 company that appears to have repositioned from the Lune brand to a cloud desktop and agent workspace. No priced rounds, customers or outcome events are public, so the story is unresolved. It sits in a crowded category where model labs ship adjacent agent products.

No public funding, named customers or outcome events were found, so its trajectory is unknown. It competes in a crowded referral automation field with several funded rivals.

name: Eris Biotech
one_liner: Our drugs engage the immune system to fight tumors
long_description: We are developing cancer therapeutics using small molecules that inhibit immune suppression. Our drugs engage the immune system to aggressively fight tumors. Our therapeutic portfolio addresses a range of solid tumors, starting with mesothelioma.

name: Evolvere BioSciences
tags: AI-powered Drug Discovery; Biotech; Therapeutics; AI; Biotechnology
one_liner: Making Next-Generation Antibiotics that Outpace Bacterial Evolution
long_description:
🦠🤖 We use our computational models to make next-generation antibiotics that outcompete bacterial evolution and precisely target pathogenic bacteria, without harming good microbes or human cells. 

☠️ Current antibiotics stop working because bacteria evolve resistance to them. This makes drug-resistant bacteria a looming global health crisis - already killing more people than malaria and AIDS and it is getting exponentially worse 📈. 

🧬 Our approach leverages co-evolutionary protein-protein interaction datasets combined with AI to forecast bacterial mutations and create ‘future-proof’ antibiotics, addressing antibiotic resistance before it develops. This changes the game for how frequently society will need to make new antibiotics and how long our new antibiotics will be able to treat patients 👩‍⚕️.

We are a team of biochemists and evolutionary biologists who met at the University of Oxford.
regions: United Kingdom; Europe
target_customer: Pharmaceutical and biotech partners and public antimicrobial resistance funders who would license or co-develop new antibiotic candidates
problem: Bacteria evolve resistance to antibiotics faster than new drugs are developed, so each new antibiotic loses effectiveness. Evolvere aims to design antibiotics using co-evolutionary protein interaction data and AI so that resistance is anticipated.
business_model: Therapeutics R&D; likely licensing or partnership of drug candidates (not stated by sources)
product_category: AI-driven antibiotic discovery
founder_names: Adam Winnifrith; Piotr Jedryszek; Weronika Slesak
market_need_then: Antimicrobial resistance was widely described as a growing global health crisis, with government grant programs (Innovate UK, AMR programmes) funding early work. Commercial market for new antibiotics is weak, which is a known problem.
outcome_analysis: Evolvere is an Oxford spinout that won a university biohackathon, joined the BioEscalator, took an Innovate UK grant and entered YC in Summer 2024. No priced equity round, exit or shutdown was found, so the outcome is still open. The scientific team has strong domain fit, but antibiotics are a hard commercial market and the company has not shown validated drug candidates in public sources.

name: FINNY AI
tags: Fintech; Machine Learning; Finance; Sales Enablement; Automation
one_liner: The organic growth engine for financial advisors
long_description:
FINNY is the AI-native organic growth engine for financial advisors, focused on helping them grow their practices
 
Our goal is to empower financial advisors to reach the right potential clients at the right time, with the right message.  We are building a world where anyone who wants financial advice can connect with the right advisor, while helping advisors ensure organic growth, the most existential problem advisors face. 
                                                                                                                                                      
The organic growth process has historically been highly inefficient and full of noise. Advisors often waste 60+ hours of business development to convert 1 new client.  

At FINNY, we are certain we can do better with AI. With our tool, advisors can:
- Identify prospects within their target niche, aggregating thousands of data points per lead
- Prioritize prospects based on their predicted likelihood of converting using F-Score, a score unique to each advisor and prospect pair
- Automate the outreach and meeting scheduling with their high priority prospects

In essence, FINNY does all the rote work for the advisors, letting them focus on what actually matters: the client relationship.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Independent and enterprise-affiliated financial advisors and wealth management firms who pay for prospecting and marketing software
problem: Advisors spend large amounts of time on business development to win each new client and organic growth is their central problem. FINNY finds and scores prospects and automates outreach.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for advisors and firms
product_category: AI prospecting and marketing platform for financial advisors
founder_names: Eden Ovadia; Theodore Janson; Victoria Toli
market_need_then: Financial advisors cite organic growth as their hardest problem, with YC page claiming 60+ hours of business development per new client; advisor technology budgets were growing around AI meeting tools in 2024.
outcome_analysis: FINNY went from March 2024 founding and a YC Summer 2024 batch to a roughly 4.3M seed in December 2024 and a 17M Series A led by Venrock in December 2025. It focused on a narrow vertical, advisor prospecting, with a clear painful job. Risks are copying by advisor marketing vendors and the dependence on prospect data quality, but funding momentum was strong.

name: Fazeshift
one_liner: AI agent for Accounts Receivable
long_description:
Fazeshift is an AI agent for automating Accounts Receivable. What used to take teams of people and hours of manual work can now be fully automated with Fazeshift. 

Caitlin and Timmy met while getting their MBA at Harvard. After graduating, they started a B2B marketing software startup, which is where they first experienced the pain of this process.

The problem stems from fragmented data across software platforms like QuickBooks, Stripe, NetSuite, DocuSign, HubSpot, and Salesforce. Fazeshift’s infrastructure connects the data across these software platforms and uses LLMs to automate the previously manual workflow.

business_model: B2B SaaS AI agents sold to finance teams
product_category: AI accounts receivable automation

outcome_analysis: Fazeshift graduated YC in Summer 2024, raised a 4M USD seed led by Gradient in January 2025, and reports SOC 2 and named customers on its site. The LLM timing tailwind and founders who lived the AR problem helped. Later rounds reported in 2026 are unverified here, and a crowded AR market is the main risk.

name: Feldy

long_description:
Feldy is field-first AI for home service businesses helping teams capture jobsites, create take-offs & estimates, and documentation.

With Feldy, teams capture the physical world using photos, videos, AI jobsite walkthroughs, and 3D scans using your mobile phone. It turns field information into takeoffs & estimates, visual designs, and project documentation. Feldy works across home services such as roofing, exteriors, remodeling, painting, cleaning, landscaping, handymen, and other home services.

We’re building a new way for more than 2 million U.S. home service businesses operating in an $800B+ market to capture, understand, and complete work in the field.

Feldy is available on iOS, Android, and the web.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote

product_category: Field capture and AI estimating for home services

outcome_analysis: Feldy is an active Denver based startup from YC Winter 2024 that sells field capture and AI estimating to home service contractors. No priced funding round, exit or shutdown was found, so the outcome is unknown. name: Fileforge
one_liner: API For PDF Document Workflows
long_description:
Fileforge is an API for PDF document workflows. 

With Fileforge, you can generate, manipulate, host, share, sign and track your documents - all in on place. Our open-source library helps developers build complex documents that integrate with our API and external services to build document-centric workflows.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote

name: Finosu
one_liner: AI Native Consumer Loan Servicer
long_description:
Hi - Mark and Gab here!

We met while working at Alt, a marketplace for collectibles, where we built a $200 million specialty finance business line. At Alt, we faced the complex challenges that come with servicing consumer loans. We spent countless hours and resources developing internal tools to manage loan payments, communicate with borrowers, and keep track of loan performance—all while ensuring a positive experience for our customers.

However, after dealing with the headaches of manual data entry, fragmented systems, delayed payments, lack of personalized borrower engagement, and the stress of maintaining accurate records, we knew there had to be a better way to service consumer loans.

So, we started Finosu to build the servicer we wish we had—an AI-powered consumer loan servicer designed to streamline and enhance every aspect of the loan servicing process. 

Our mission is to transform loan servicing into a seamless, efficient, and customer-centric experience.

The operational cost of servicing loans reaches into the tens of billions a year and that is money out of the pocket of lenders, borrowers, investors, and ultimately the consumers as a cost of doing business – we are changing that.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Consumer lenders (personal installment loans, lines of credit, BNPL, credit cards, rent-to-own) that need loan servicing and collections
problem: Servicing consumer loans involves manual data entry, fragmented systems, delayed payments and compliance burden. Finosu is an AI-native servicer handling borrower engagement across channels, payments and compliance controls.
business_model: Servicing fees from lenders, as third-party servicer or first-party platform (pricing not found)
product_category: AI consumer loan servicing and collections
market_need_then: Servicing cost is claimed to be tens of billions a year in the company's own pitch; consumer specialty finance had grown (the founders ran a 200M line at Alt), but no independent dated demand data was found.
outcome_analysis: Finosu is a seven person New York company from YC Summer 2024 offering AI-native loan servicing for consumer lenders, built by two founders who ran a 200M specialty finance line at Alt. No priced funding round, customer announcement, exit or shutdown was found, so the outcome is unknown. Strong domain fit is offset by a crowded AI collections field and sparse public traction data.

name: Firebender
one_liner: Most powerful coding agent for Android engineers
long_description:
Firebender is the most powerful coding agent for Android engineering. 

One-click install from the IntelliJ plugin marketplace to your IDE. It has context over your codebase and lets you use the best models for asking questions, debugging code, and writing full features.

Unlike other AI assistants, Firebender has access to the emulator, compose previews, and LSP tools like finding usages, renaming variables/functions. It continuously stays up to date with the latest Android SDKs, libraries, and best practices, providing more accurate and relevant assistance for Android development.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Android engineers and mobile teams using IntelliJ or Android Studio
problem: General coding assistants know little about Android specifics such as Compose and the emulator. Firebender is an IDE plugin agent with access to the emulator, compose previews and language server tools.
business_model: Developer tool subscription (pricing not found; launch described the plugin as free and privacy-first)
product_category: AI coding agent for Android engineering
market_need_then: Founders reported developers found GPT-4 and Claude clueless about the Android UI framework, per the launch post; AI coding tools were in rapid demand in 2024.
outcome_analysis: Firebender pivoted from an AI Android fork to an Android coding agent plugin and joined YC in Winter 2024. It reports thousands of users and heavy token usage in a job post but no priced round, exit or shutdown was found. Google's own assistant and general coding agents make the niche contested, so outcome is open.

name: FirstWork
tags: SaaS; Human Resources; Workflow Automation; Compliance; AI
one_liner: Applied AI for workforce operations
long_description:
Firstwork is a next-generation HR platform designed specifically for companies with dynamic workforce needs. Our mission is to streamline and automate key HR processes to help businesses operate more efficiently and effectively.

What We Do (for now):

(1) Smart Onboarding 📋: Our platform simplifies the onboarding process by automating the collection and verification of credentials, such as right-to-work documents, insurance forms and driver’s licenses. This reduces administrative burden and accelerates the time-to-productivity for new hires.

(2) AI-Assisted Activation 🤖: Leveraging AI, we enhance communication and messaging for new hires, ensuring they receive timely and relevant information. This helps in better engagement and faster integration into their roles.

(3) Perpetual Compliance ✅: Our system uses AI and OCR technology to continuously monitor and ensure compliance with various regulatory requirements. This includes tracking expirations of critical documents, updating records, and generating compliance reports, thus reducing the risk of penalties and legal issues.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Staffing, logistics, delivery, care, retail and light industrial employers with high volume frontline hiring
problem: Onboarding frontline workers involves manual credential collection, compliance checks and expiring documents across HR, payroll and screening systems. Firstwork automates this with document verification and AI agents.
business_model: B2B SaaS and forward deployed AI agents for enterprise customers
product_category: Applied AI for frontline workforce operations and compliance
market_need_then: The company cites over 2 billion frontline workers globally and claims onboarding time cuts up to 75 percent (company claims, unverified); right to work and I-9 verification are standard compliance needs for staffing firms.
outcome_analysis: Firstwork raised a 5M seed in February 2025 led by Gradient and a 15M Series A in October 2026 led by Earlybird, with Deel ventures and customers. Founders came from Deel, Rippling, Remitly and Deliveroo, giving domain access to staffing buyers. It serves enterprise frontline employers, and growth looks strong, with risk from large HR platforms.

name: Fluently
one_liner: Speaking coach for non-native English professionals
long_description:
Imagine a human-like English tutor, but 20x cheaper and available 24/7 - that's Fluently!

Fluently made for people who already know the basics of English but want to feel truly confident in real conversations: whether that’s in an interview, a business meeting, or chatting with friends.

Most English learning apps are built for beginners and don’t help you improve speaking skills.

With Fluently, you get:
- Unlimited real-world speaking practice
- Personalized learning plan
- Free English level assessment and progress tracking
- Real progress in English speaking skills

We’re non-native founders who know the stress of speaking English in important moments. With deep AI expertise, we built Fluently to solve it.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Non-native English speaking professionals who want to speak with confidence in meetings and interviews
problem: Most English learning apps target beginners and do not improve real conversation skills. Fluently provides an AI speaking coach with practice, feedback after calls and a personalized plan.
business_model: Consumer subscription mobile and web app
product_category: AI English speaking coach
market_need_then: Large global demand for English speaking practice and a funded category of AI speaking apps; company claims 25,000 plus professional users and over 1M Google Play downloads on its site.
outcome_analysis: Fluently raised a 2M seed in June 2024 right after YC Winter 2024 and reports over a million downloads and a 4.8 rating on its own site. It is active in 2026. The market is crowded with well funded AI speaking apps and free voice assistants, so its edge is focus on non-native professionals, and long term outcome is still open.

name: Flyflow
one_liner: The easiest way to find high-quality sales leads
long_description:
"I don’t know how I would have found these leads myself."  - YC Founder

Flyflow enables companies to find prospective customers using AI workflows instead of drowning in tables. Try out our product at app.flyflow.ai.

How are we different?

(1) Higher quality leads: get to a list that’s so relevant, you’ll want to spend time getting introduced to people there, instead of sending another 1,000 cold emails

(2) Incredibly easy to set up: get up and running with a list of prospects in hand  in under 10 minutes

name: Forerunner

long_description: Forerunner is an AI-native factory building precision bent-tubes for aerospace, defense, energy, and industrials.

target_customer: Aerospace, defense, energy and industrial manufacturers that need small batches of precision bent tubing quickly

business_model: Manufacturing services, per-part sales of bent tube assemblies
product_category: AI-native contract manufacturing (bent tubes)

name: Forge
one_liner: AI native freight forwarder and customs broker
long_description:
Forge manages international logistics for business around the world. We’re an AI native freight forwarder, customs broker, and tariff expert.

We’re growing rapidly and support small mom and pop business to the Fortune 1000s, including companies like Allegiant Airlines, Malbon Golf, and R.E.M. beauty.

Forge has raised capital from world class investors including Google, Y-Combinator, and Gradient Ventures.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada

problem: Companies overpay duties and struggle with customs paperwork and freight logistics. Forge started with hardware procurement and moved to duty drawback and then full AI-native freight forwarding and customs brokerage.
business_model: Freight forwarding and customs brokerage service fees, plus a share of duty drawback and tariff refunds
product_category: AI-native freight forwarder and customs broker
market_need_then: Tariff and duty costs were a rising pain for importers. The company's own launch post described duty drawback, where companies recover duties on goods later exported or scrapped. Dated demand figures were not found.
outcome_analysis: Forge raised a small seed in mid 2024 on a hardware procurement idea, then moved into duty drawback and later full freight forwarding and customs brokerage for brands such as Allegiant Airlines and r.e.m. beauty. It remains active with a seven person team and no later round was found. Tariff turbulence created demand, but well funded incumbents like Flexport entered the same wedge.

name: Freestyle
one_liner: The most powerful sandboxes for AI Agents
long_description:
Freestyle builds the most powerful VMs for AI Agents. 

- **Instant Startup**: Freestyle VMs provision in milliseconds, with p99s under 400ms.
- **Persistence**: Freestyle VMs can run forever, they can be hibernated with their exact memory in place and come back to life weeks later instantly, in that exact state.
- **Powerful**: Freestyle VMs go up to 64GB of RAM for public tiers and much further for enterprise. Freestyle does high quality hardware virtualization supporting nested virtualization, FUSE, eBPF, full Linux networking and more. If it can run in an EC2, it can run in a Freestyle VM.
- **Cheaply Snapshottable and Branchable**: Freestyle VMs are instantly and cheaply snapshottable (sub 1ms interruption, sub 50ms to snapshot ready). These snapshots can be used to create new VMs in the exact state of the original VM (memory and disk). This enables powerful workflows like branching, cloning, and rapid recovery from failures.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Developers and companies building AI coding agents and app builders that need isolated Linux machines
problem: AI agents need full, fast, persistent virtual machines that can be cloned and hibernated. Freestyle began as a TypeScript fullstack framework and cloud, and now sells Linux VMs for agents.
business_model: Usage-based cloud VMs with public tiers and enterprise plans
product_category: Cloud infrastructure for AI agents (VMs and sandboxes)
market_need_then: The company's original 2024 pitch was TypeScript for everything on one framework and cloud. The agent VM need grew after AI coding agents spread, and the company launched on Hacker News as a cloud for coding agents in April 2026.
outcome_analysis: Freestyle moved from a TypeScript cloud framework to selling fast, persistent Linux VMs for AI coding agents and lists customers such as Onlook, Wordware and Bloom. It remains active with five people. Funding is not confirmed from a primary source. Its progress rides the agent infrastructure wave, but it competes with funded providers like E2B, Modal and Daytona.

name: Freestyle
one_liner: The AI Assistant for Gmail
long_description:
Email sucks. It takes forever to go through, and hiring an assistant is costly and invasive. Freestyle is building the assistant that learns how to predict the action that you will take on your emails, and does it for you.

Today's email products try to help you go through your emails a little faster, but if you have to get through 1000 emails, those products doesn't do much for you. 

The reality is, most of the emails you get don't require you to personally look at them. Freestyle completely eliminates the need to check those emails, and handles them all at once for you, immediately. 

Freestyle is here to file away spam, sift through newsletters for important tidbits, text you important notifications, and reply to mundane emails, so that no matter how many thousands of emails are in your inbox, you'll just be left with the few emails that actually require your personal touch.

Getting this right is difficult, so everyone else settles with trying to help you go through your email twice as fast. If you want to go 100x as fast, you shouldn't spend even a second on useless emails. 

Freestyle gets this right, bringing the elite experience of having a professional assistant to the entire world.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Individual professionals with overloaded Gmail inboxes
problem: Most email does not need a person's attention. Existing tools only help read faster, while Freestyle aims to predict and execute the user's actions on email automatically.
business_model: Consumer and prosumer subscription for an AI email assistant (pricing not verified)
product_category: AI email assistant for Gmail
market_need_then: Email overload is a long-standing complaint, and the YC description argues that most email needs no personal attention. No dated spend data was collected.
outcome_analysis: Friday, now Freestyle, entered YC in Fall 2024 to build an assistant that handles Gmail automatically and raised about 500K in December 2024. A Chrome extension was updated in October 2026 so the product appears live. No later round, exit or layoffs were found, and the crowded AI email market with Gmail and Superhuman is the main risk. Outcome is open.

name: Fresco
one_liner: AI copilot for construction estimators
long_description:
Fresco is an AI-powered takeoff and estimating for Division 8 construction (doors, frames, and hardware).

Estimating Division 8 has always been brutally manual: flipping through hundreds of pages of specs, cross-referencing hardware sets, and building out schedules by hand. A single missed door or misread hardware group can kill a bid's margin.

Fresco automates the entire takeoff process with 99% accuracy, cutting the time estimators spend on takeoffs by 70%. We've processed 3,000+ takeoffs for general contractors and Division 8 subs, and we're becoming the system of record for how this trade gets estimated.

Division 8 is our beachhead: it's complex enough that AI creates massive value, and siloed enough that the incumbents haven't solved it. We're starting here and expanding across the spec trades.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: general contractors and Division 8 (doors, frames, hardware) subcontractors who estimate bids
problem: Division 8 takeoffs mean manually reading hundreds of pages of specs and hardware sets, and a missed door or hardware group can ruin a bid's margin.
business_model: B2B SaaS for estimators (pricing not found)
product_category: AI construction takeoff and estimating (originally an AI documentation scribe for superintendents)
market_need_then: Launch post says superintendents spend up to 3 hours a day on documentation, and the YC page says Division 8 estimating is manual; both are company claims, not independently measured.
outcome_analysis: Fresco is a two-person YC Fall 2024 company that started as an AI documentation scribe for superintendents and now sells AI takeoff for Division 8 estimating, claiming 3,000+ takeoffs, 99% accuracy and 70% time savings. No funding was found and it is too early to judge; competitors such as Bild AI raised seed money in 2025, so the main questions are whether the niche is large enough and whether early traction converts into capital.

name: FurtherAI
one_liner: AI Workforce for the Insurance Industry
long_description:
FurtherAI is a domain-specific AI for the insurance industry. Our AI Assistant automates complex workflows like submission intake, policy comparisons, and underwriting audits - making teams faster, smarter, and more efficient.

Leading insurers, reinsurers, MGAs, and brokers rely on FurtherAI to drive better decisions at scale. Backed by top investors including Y Combinator, Nexus, South Park Commons, and Converge, FurtherAI supports customers writing over $15B in premiums across all 50 states.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada

business_model: B2B SaaS and AI workflow automation sold to insurance firms, delivered with forward-deployed engineering
product_category: Vertical AI agents for insurance operations
market_need_then: The founders report a five day wait for their own D&O quote, and they describe manual document review across the insurance industry. Funded rivals such as Sixfold existed by mid 2024, which shows investor demand for the category.
outcome_analysis: FurtherAI rode the LLM wave into insurance workflow automation. It raised a $5M seed and then a $25M Series A led by a16z in October 2025, and its site cites large carrier and broker customers. The founders had little insurance background at the start and built domain knowledge by interviewing practitioners. It is still active with no exit, and no negative news was found.

name: Fuse
one_liner: AI-powered workflow automation for US healthcare providers.
long_description:
AI-powered automation for US healthcare provider workflows like patient intake, eligibility and benefits checks and billing using data-driven approaches. 

If you know senior execs in medical groups or partners in healthcare PE please do connect us. We won’t waste their time: +1 628 468 3232.

product_category: Healthcare revenue cycle automation

It won a startup pitch competition in early 2025 and holds SOC 2 Type II, but no funding, customer counts or exit were found, so the outcome is still open.

name: FutureClinic
one_liner: Personal doctors through chat
long_description:
FutureClinic is the world's largest agent-native medical clinic: over 300 doctors (generalists and specialists, covering over 63 specialty types) you can reach directly from Claude, ChatGPT or whichever AI agent you already use. 

Hundreds of millions of people use AI models to better understand their own health. But when it comes time to take that information and turn it into medical care, they're left going back to the broken healthcare system, waiting months for a rushed appointment, and feeling frustrated that their doctor doesn't have the time to digest the research they've done with their AI. 

Now, you can ask your AI to bring in a real doctor into that same conversation. A physician reads your whole case and answers you personally, typically within a few hours, and sends a live recorded video called a Human Signature with their response so you know you're getting real care from an expert every time.

They can diagnose, prescribe to the pharmacy you choose, order lab tests and even imaging when needed. A visit is $40, with no insurance, appointment or subscription needed, in 33 states and Washington, D.C. You can also start at futureclinic.com. 

For doctors, FutureClinic is the way to become a personal doctor to patients directly. Build your own AI-native clinic for free in under 3 minutes, get found by the AI agents patients already turn to for help, and set your own prices and hours. Malpractice coverage is included. It’s care on your terms, where you're in control, with no private equity owner or hospital system standing between you and your patients.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: US patients paying out of pocket for chat-based primary and specialist care, reached through AI assistants; doctors who want a digital clinic
problem: Patients wait months for rushed appointments and cannot bring AI-assisted health research into care. FutureClinic offers a personal doctor reachable by chat, with AI doing intake and the doctor signing off.
business_model: Pay per visit or monthly subscription (YC page states a $40 visit, no insurance), plus a platform for doctors to run their own clinics
product_category: AI-assisted digital medical clinic and EHR
founder_names: Usama Syed; Nabil Belahouane; Hassan Mirza
market_need_then: The company says long waits and rushed appointments push people to AI for health questions. Evidence is the company's own claims; no independent demand data was found.
outcome_analysis: FutureClinic is an early stage Fall 2024 YC company that now positions itself as an agent-native clinic reachable from AI assistants, with over 300 doctors per its YC page. Funding is unclear, with a claimed 5M raise and a 500K figure both unverified. It is active with no exit or negative news found, so no outcome can yet be assessed.

name: Gait

product_category: B2B marketplace for specialized vehicles and equipment

outcome_analysis: Garage built a marketplace for used fire trucks and other municipal equipment, led by a founder who was a firefighter and knew the buyers. It raised a $4.5M seed, a $13.5M Series A in August 2025 and a reported $41M Series B at a $225M valuation in November 2026, and serves over 1,000 communities per its own claim. Its early success rests on founder market fit and a fragmented incumbent process.

name: Gauge
one_liner: Gauge helps you get recommended and implemented by AI.
long_description:
Agents are leading the next wave of growth for companies like Supabase, Openrouter, Resend, PostHog, Braintrust, and more.

Unlike chat experiences, Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor are now implementing products autonomously. They are doing so without ever talking to a sales rep or taking a demo.

Gauge runs real chats and coding sessions to help your product get recommended and implemented by AI.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Software and consumer companies that want to be recommended by AI assistants and coding agents (customer logos include Supabase, PostHog, Airtable, Clerk)
problem: Buyers and developers increasingly ask AI assistants and coding agents which tools to use. Companies cannot see how they appear in those answers or why agents pick rivals.

product_category: AI search visibility (AEO/GEO) and agent-led growth platform

outcome_analysis: Gauge joined YC in Summer 2024 as a small team selling AI visibility tooling and has expanded toward testing how coding agents pick tools. Its site lists well known developer companies as customers.
