Developers use us to create Voice-first digital experiences (eg. Voice eCommerce, Voice Banking, Voice AI Tutors etc).

We gather our own data, develop our own labelling tools, train our own models, and design our own voice infra. This fully integrated approach enables us to offer the best models and the best developer experience for regional languages.

---

People who would previously never use certain digital services (like online ordering), actually use the service when they are given an intuitive Voice based interface.
We believe that Voice Interfaces will onboard 100s of millions of new users onto digital services; and double the addressable market for technology companies. 
Uplift AI will provide the best models to create these Voice Interfaces for 60% of the world's population that only speaks their regional language and represents 42 trillion dollars in GDP.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Developers and enterprises in Pakistan building voice agents (e-commerce, couriers, healthcare, real estate, financial services, telecom), plus creators and education publishers needing Urdu voices
problem: Mainstream voice AI handles regional languages poorly; Uplift AI collects its own data and trains voice models for Urdu and other Pakistani languages, offered via API, studio and calling agents.
business_model: Usage and subscription API and studio plans (free, 5, 50, 300 USD per month tiers) plus enterprise including on-prem
product_category: Voice AI models for regional languages
market_need_then: Pakistan has a large Urdu-speaking population poorly served by voice AI; the company cites Khan Academy using its voices for 2,500 Urdu videos and a Syngenta Pakistan endorsement (company and press reports).
outcome_analysis: Uplift AI, a Summer 2025 company, raised a 3.5M USD seed in January 2026 reported by Dawn, Business Recorder and TechJuice. Founders with Apple, Amazon and AWS voice and AI backgrounds, own data collection, and early customers such as Khan Academy support the story. No negative events found. Risk is large voice providers adding Urdu.

name: ValueMate
one_liner: Valuemate automates real estate appraisals with AI
long_description:
ValueMate’s LiDAR-plus-AI app captures a property in a three-minute walkthrough and delivers a regulator-ready report on our dashboard, slashing cycle times by 80% for the valuation firms already on board.

In the next few months, every bank, AMC, and independent appraiser must switch to the new format or watch loans pile up. ValueMate handles the transition end-to-end, with zero tape measures, zero data entry, and zero closing delay.

We’re transforming the multi-billion dollar appraisal industry with technology that captures millions of 3D data points per walkthrough.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Residential appraisers, appraisal firms and AMCs or lenders who need UAD 3.6 compliant reports
problem: Appraisers spend hours measuring, entering data and assembling reports, and the move to the UAD 3.6 report format adds workload; ValueMate captures a property by LiDAR walkthrough and drafts the report.
business_model: Per-appraiser SaaS subscription (about 208 USD per month on annual plan per the site) plus an in-house appraisal firm, VM Appraisals, selling completed appraisals
product_category: AI appraisal software and managed appraisal services
founder_names: Anir Prativadi; Pietro Demicheli; Vivek Isukapalli
market_need_then: Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac required UAD 3.6 for new appraisals, with a mandate reported for November 2026 and broad production from September 2025, forcing a switch of appraisal software and workflows.
outcome_analysis: ValueMate is an active Spring 2025 company that began as a LiDAR walkthrough appraisal app and now sells appraiser software for UAD 3.6 plus an in-house appraisal firm. The regulatory format change is a tailwind, but no verified funding or independent customer evidence was found, and established vendors are competing.

name: Vantel
one_liner: AI Platform for Commercial Insurance Brokerages
long_description: AI OS for commercial insurance brokerages.
regions: Sweden; Europe
target_customer: Commercial insurance brokerages, mid-market and corporate placements across Europe and globally
problem: Brokers manually read long policies, wordings and quotes to compare coverage and spot gaps; Vantel reads documents in any language, generates RFQs and compares quotes with cited clauses.
business_model: B2B SaaS for insurance brokers
product_category: AI for commercial insurance brokerage
market_need_then: Founders cite a claims-desk problem where exclusions hid in fine print; brokers spend 10 or more hours a week on manual comparison (company claim); LLMs made long document reading feasible by 2022.
outcome_analysis: Vantel, a Winter 2025 Stockholm company, raised a 2M USD seed in March 2025 and now lists European broker customers such as Funk Gruppe and RENOMIA. Founders with insurance claims and ML backgrounds rode the LLM document reading shift. No negative events found. Main risk is similar AI tools and incumbents.

name: Vassar Robotics
one_liner: Gearless robot joints for better embodied AI.
long_description: Vassar Robotics is building gearless robot joints and arms using high-torque transverse-flux motors. Eliminating gearboxes makes robots more precise, reliable, affordable, and easier to simulate. We’re starting with AI research labs and robot developers, helping them collect better training data and transfer learned skills from simulation to the real world.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: AI research labs and robot developers
problem: Geared robot joints add backlash and wear and hurt sim-to-real transfer; gearless transverse-flux joints aim to fix this.
business_model: Hardware sales of robot arms and joints
product_category: Robotics hardware (gearless actuators)
market_need_then: Embodied-AI labs need precise, affordable arms and actuators for data collection and sim-to-real transfer (company positioning); the company reports 200+ robots delivered (self-reported).
outcome_analysis: Vassar Robotics is a Spring 2025 YC hardware company building gearless transverse-flux robot joints and arms, listed Active and early. Directory profiles describe both semi-humanoid open-source developer arms and gearless joints for AI labs, so positioning may have shifted, and aggregators place it in San Francisco, Los Angeles or Boston inconsistently. Funding is reported only as roughly $500K (likely the YC deal) by aggregators, so there is no verified outcome beyond being early, and no success or failure factors are asserted.

name: Velvet
tags: Generative AI; Data Engineering; AI; Conversational AI
one_liner: Expressive conversational AI
long_description: Expressive conversational AI
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: AI labs and consumer companies that train or deploy audiovisual conversation models and need datasets and models
problem: Most AI models lack spatial reasoning and have uncanny latency in conversation; Velvet builds interactive conversational models and datasets so they behave more like people.
business_model: Datasets and models for AI labs plus a paid contributor data program (per company site); details not stated
product_category: Conversational AI data and models (audiovisual)
market_need_then: AI labs were racing to build natural real-time conversational models and needed audiovisual conversation data, per directory descriptions (Data for world models); no demand metrics found.
outcome_analysis: Velvet is an active Fall 2025 company with a team of four and no public funding found. The YC profile and some directories describe an AI video editor while the current site describes conversation datasets and models, suggesting a reposition that is not clearly dated. No outcome events found, so the story is too early to read.

name: Verbiflow
tags: SaaS; Analytics; Sales; Sales Enablement; AI
one_liner: Outbound Sequencing Infrastructure for Startups
long_description: We help startups reach prospective customers through email, LinkedIn, and cold calls, while keeping your team aligned on every conversation and response.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Startups and small go-to-market teams doing outbound sales via email, LinkedIn and cold calls
problem: Sales teams struggle with disorganization, fragmented data and turnover while running multichannel outbound; Verbiflow offered sequencing infrastructure and a shared inbox, and its current site pitches Mochi, an AI coworker in Slack for GTM engineering and operations.
business_model: B2B SaaS with hands-on forward-deployed engineering support (per company site); pricing not seen
product_category: Outbound sales sequencing and AI GTM operations
market_need_then: Outbound teams commonly stitch together enrichment, sequencing and inbox tools; the founders cite disorganization and fragmented data. No quantified demand evidence found.
outcome_analysis: Verbiflow is an active Winter 2025 company with two founders and no verified funding. Its public positioning moved from outbound sequencing infrastructure for startups to Mochi, an AI coworker for GTM work in Slack, though the date of that change is not sourced. No outcome events were found, and it competes in a crowded category.

name: Veria Labs
one_liner: Continuous AI pentesting that finds and fixes vulnerabilities
long_description:
Veria Labs is developing AI agents that hack better than the best human hackers. Founded by members of the #1 US competitive hacking team, we've already found critical bugs in AI tools, operating systems, fintech and billion dollar crypto exchanges. 

Now we're scaling that expertise through AI-native security tooling that operates faster than human researchers while finding deeper, more complex vulnerabilities that traditional tools miss.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Software and crypto companies and open-source projects needing continuous security testing (logos shown include Ramp, PostHog, Infisical, Pydantic, Ripple, Phantom)
problem: Human pentests are periodic and costly; Veria Labs runs AI agents that map the attack surface, prove real exploits and draft fix pull requests continuously.
business_model: B2B subscription for continuous AI pentesting (demo-led sales)
product_category: AI pentesting and application security
founder_names: Stephen Xu; Cayden Liao; Jayden Sarveshkumar
market_need_then: AI generated vulnerability reports were rising fast (HackerOne data cited by a secondary source) and teams shipping AI-written code needed continuous testing; customers shown include several startups and crypto firms.
outcome_analysis: Veria Labs, a Fall 2025 company with three founders from a top competitive hacking team, reported a 3.2M USD seed in early 2026 and shows named startup customers. Strong founder skill and the AI security tailwind support it, but XBOW and others are better funded. No negative events found.

name: Veritus
one_liner: AI agents for the consumer lending industry
long_description:
Veritus is a omni-channel platform for deploying AI agents for loan servicing and collections, including inbound and outbound voice agents. Our agents negotiate repayment plans, follow up across channels, and drive recoveries with zero human involvement.

By combining cutting edge voice AI with deep regulatory compliance and vertical specialization we're able to drastically reduce the cost-to-collect while increasing recovery rates.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Consumer lenders, fintechs, loan servicers, card issuers and third-party collection agencies
problem: Loan servicing and collections rely on expensive human call centers under heavy regulation. Veritus sells AI voice and messaging agents that negotiate repayment plans while following conduct rules.
business_model: B2B platform licensing to lenders and servicers, with a stated plan to also hold collection licenses and buy charged-off consumer debt (hybrid software and direct collections)
product_category: Voice and messaging AI agents for lending servicing and collections
founder_names: Joshua March; David Schlesinger; Joseph Stein
market_need_then: Collections and servicing are labor heavy and regulated; the company's site cites results such as a 71% containment rate and payments on 1 in 5 collections calls for one agency customer (company claim, unverified).
outcome_analysis: Veritus is an active company that raised a $10.1M seed in February 2026, about seven months after its YC Summer 2025 batch, led by Crosslink and Threshold. Serial founder credentials and the voice AI timing tailwind support the raise; compliance risk in collections and a crowded voice agent field are the open risks. No exit or distress was found.

name: Verne Robotics
one_liner: AI models that teach robots new skills in hours
long_description: Verne builds general‑purpose physical AI. We deploy robots to expand the productive capacity of the physical world.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Manufacturers and labs with repetitive manual tasks (first customer named: biotech ABClonal, vial packing)
problem: Industrial robot arms need weeks of reprogramming and large upfront capital. Verne teaches arms new tasks from about 30 minutes of teleoperation data and rents them by the hour.
business_model: Robotics as a service, pay by the hour, plus a finetuning platform for its foundation model
product_category: Physical AI models and robot arms (Nemo3 bimanual arm)
competitors_at_founding: Physical Intelligence; Genesis AI; Dyna Robotics
market_need_then: Investor essay by the company argues industrial robot deployment is held back by capex and integration complexity; no hard demand data found.
outcome_analysis: Verne Robotics is an active YC Summer 2025 company with a strong research-oriented founding team and a rental model aimed at lowering robot adoption cost. No verified funding, customers beyond one named biotech deployment, or exit was found, so its trajectory is still unwritten and heavily exposed to well-funded physical AI labs.

name: Vesence
one_liner: The Agent-Native Computer
long_description:
Vesence is a computer built for agents doing 99% of the work. 

Device-agnostic and model-agnostic, it brings your inbox, files, browser, and tools into one workspace. Run Claude Code and Codex, direct agents in parallel, and stay in control from any device.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Law firms (first logos are Nordic firms), plus banks, investment firms, consultancies and life sciences companies doing document-heavy work
problem: Transactional lawyers and similar professionals spend hours checking and redlining documents in Word and email. Vesence puts quality-assurance agents inside Microsoft Word and Outlook, later widening to an agent-native computer.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to firms
product_category: Legal AI review agents and agent workspace
market_need_then: Legal teams were adopting AI drafting tools in 2025; Vesence's pitch is checking existing work rather than generating content.
outcome_analysis: Vesence raised a $9M seed in October 2025, months after its YC Spring 2025 batch, led by Emergence with Creandum, YC and 20VC. The raise reflects strong investor interest in legal AI delivered inside Office, backed by well-connected Swedish founders. It has since broadened toward Excel, PowerPoint and an agent workspace. No distress or exit found.

name: Vetnio
one_liner: AI Copilot that automates admin work for veterinary professionals
long_description: Veterinarians spend 40% of their time on admin work, >20% on note taking alone. We're here to change that so they can focus on what really matters - providing the best care possible for animals.
regions: Sweden; Europe
target_customer: Veterinary clinics and chains (agreement with IVC Evidensia referenced on the company site)
problem: Vets spend about 40% of their time on admin and over 20% on note taking. Vetnio records visits and generates clinical notes, emails, diagnostics help and invoices.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for veterinary practices
product_category: AI scribe and copilot for veterinary care
market_need_then: Admin burden in vet practice is a widely cited pain point; multiple scribe launches in 2024 and 2025 show demand.
outcome_analysis: Vetnio raised a 1M euro pre-seed in December 2024 led by Peak and YZR just before YC Winter 2025, and reports a deal with IVC Evidensia. It is active but small and faces many scribes, including ones bundled by practice software vendors. Later rounds were not found.

name: VibeFlow
one_liner: AI content manager that grows your company's online presence
long_description: VibeFlow is the AI content manager, that hands-off creates and manages viral social content for startup founders and growth teams, saving them hours and delivering qualified leads.  Existing AI tools spit out generic, off-brand content you can't really use. VibeFlow learns your brand, voice, and goals, then autonomously creates on-brand, tailored posts (with visuals) ready to publish.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Startup founders and growth teams for the original content product; non-developers building full-stack web apps for the product shown in later launches
problem: Generic AI content tools produce off-brand posts. VibeFlow was pitched as an AI content manager that learns brand voice and publishes social content. Its launch material later describes a prompt-to-app builder with a visual backend editor.
business_model: SaaS subscription (pricing not found)
product_category: AI social content manager, later AI full-stack app builder
market_need_then: Founders and small teams struggle to keep a consistent social presence; evidence is the YC description only.
outcome_analysis: VibeFlow is an active three-person YC Summer 2025 company. Its YC listing describes a social content manager while launch coverage describes a vibe coding app builder, so the product focus is unclear. No verified funding, traction or exit was found, and the competing space is crowded and well funded.

name: Vocality Health
one_liner: Voice AI for medical language translation
long_description:
Our app allows doctors to speak any language, eliminating the need for human medical translators in hospitals and clinics. Despite spending billions on in-person and remote translators—mostly through outdated call centers—hospitals still fail to provide adequate care for non-English-speaking patients.

We're building the most accurate and compliant medical language translation system across voice and video modalities.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Hospitals, health systems and clinics serving non-English-speaking patients
problem: Hospitals spend heavily on in-person and remote interpreters, often through call centers, and still under-serve patients with limited English. Vocality offers AI medical interpretation across voice and video.
business_model: B2B SaaS to health systems (pricing not found)
product_category: Voice AI medical language translation
market_need_then: Company description cites billions spent on interpreters and poor care for non-English-speaking patients; no independent demand data found.
outcome_analysis: Vocality Health is an active two person YC Winter 2025 company building AI medical interpretation. Founders have a prior consumer app with millions of downloads, but no verified funding, customers or press were found, so the outcome cannot yet be classified beyond early stage.

name: VoiceOS
one_liner: Say it and it's done. Voice is the new OS
long_description:
VoiceOS turns voice into a seamless, universal interface to 10x productivity — a true voice operating system for the next era of computing.

It works across any app, letting users speak naturally to dictate, edit, and write text instantly. Whether writing an email, revising a document, or grasping complex information, VoiceOS transforms voice into the most powerful productivity tool, bridging the gap between thought and expression.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Knowledge workers and professionals who dictate and edit text across apps on Mac and Windows
problem: Typing is slow for writing and editing. VoiceOS provides system-wide voice dictation, editing and actions across any app, pitched as Siri for productivity.
business_model: Consumer and prosumer software subscription (pricing not found)
product_category: Voice dictation and voice control software
market_need_then: Voice input was gaining attention with Wispr Flow's 2024 launch and later growth; no independent demand data on VoiceOS itself.
outcome_analysis: VoiceOS is an active two person YC Spring 2025 company in a category where Wispr Flow raised far larger rounds. No verified funding, traction or exit was found, so the company is early stage and exposed to a better funded direct competitor.

name: Vulcan Technologies
one_liner: Secure frontier AI for government & adjacent knowledge work
long_description:
Vulcan builds agents for government and government-adjacent work. We currently sell two agents: Justinian and Trajan.

Justinian is an AI agent coworker for people who work in and adjacent to American government. To power Justinian, we created the world’s largest legal and policy database and knowledge graph, accessible to our customers via our platform, email, and Slack.

Trajan is a public-facing AI concierge built to help governments modernize service delivery. Hosted on a government website, Trajan helps businesses and citizens automatically complete permits, licenses, applications, and answer regulatory and legal questions.

In addition to government customers, Vulcan's agents serve regulatory, legal, policy, and government relations teams at major U.S. enterprises.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: State and federal agencies, legislative counsels and corporate regulatory/legal/policy teams
problem: Governments and companies struggle to review, cut and comply with large bodies of regulation; Vulcan uses AI agents over a legal and policy knowledge graph.
business_model: B2G and enterprise SaaS (government contracts, agent subscriptions)
product_category: GovTech / RegTech AI agents
founder_names: Tanner Jones; Chris Minge; Aleksander Mekhanik
market_need_then: Virginia's Executive Order 19 called for cutting the state regulatory code by 25 percent and Vulcan's platform supported it (City Biz); a follow-up executive order embedded Vulcan's agentic review in state processes (company launch post, not independently verified).
outcome_analysis: Vulcan is a 2025 company that moved quickly: it won a Virginia government contract formalised by executive order, acquired competitor RegsBot, and raised a US$10.9M seed in October 2025 led by General Catalyst and Cubit Capital. Founder policy background and a government anchor customer explain the early traction; it is too early to judge the outcome.

name: Vybe
one_liner: Secure internal apps. Built by AI in seconds. Powered by your data.
long_description:
We're 2 repeat YC founders. We founded Plato (W16, sold to Coda) and Wolfia (S22). Quang lead Product/GTM for Coda Solutions and Fabien is ex-SWE at Meta and lead Engineering at Wealthfront before.

We’re building Vybe: "Lovable for internal apps". We come with pre-built building blocks: Integrations (Gmail, Gcal, Github, Jira, etc.), SSO and AI tools (Websearch, Summarization etc.) so anyone in a company can build and launch internal AI-powered apps.

Vibe coding is dramatically lowering the barrier for non-technical users to create full web apps. Lovable, Replit, Bolt, Google, Canva, Figma all launched their vibe-coding platforms. People love them. They're great for prototyping, but it's difficult to roll out inside a company for internal use cases for those reasons: 

1. Data: If you want to connect your existing data (e.g. Salesforce, Gmail, Jira), you'd need to rebuild the API auth, pagination, etc. 

2. SSO: If you build 20 apps, you'll have 20 different logins

3. Security: AI-built apps have massive risk of exposing data, especially if built by non developers

So companies are stuck in the old world: clunky spreadsheets, rigid SaaS solutions or complex no-code tools.

Time to build!
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Companies whose employees build internal apps; later positioned as AI agents for business teams
problem: Vibe coding tools are hard to roll out internally because of data connections, SSO sprawl and security risk. Vybe offers prebuilt integrations, SSO and AI tools so anyone can build internal apps.
business_model: B2B SaaS (pricing not found)
product_category: AI internal app builder, evolving into an AI agent platform
market_need_then: Companies used spreadsheets, rigid SaaS and no-code tools for internal needs while vibe coding spread in 2025; company argues security and data access block internal rollout.
outcome_analysis: Vybe raised a 10M seed on 2025-12-10 led by First Round, with YC, Orange Collective, Pelion and Pioneer Fund, backed by repeat YC founders with a prior Coda exit. The vibe coding wave and founder track record drove the raise. The product has broadened toward agents, and Retool and general builders are strong competitors. Still active as of mid 2026.

name: Wafer
one_liner: AI that makes AI fast
long_description:
Wafer builds AI agents that work as autonomous performance engineers, optimizing GPU kernels for AI inference. 

Our product is serverless and dedicated inference for the world’s fastest open source LLMs, achieved by Wafer's autonomous performance engineers.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: AI application companies and inference buyers that run open source LLMs and pay per token or for dedicated endpoints
problem: Serving open source models fast and cheaply on GPUs needs scarce kernel and performance engineering talent. Wafer uses AI agents as autonomous performance engineers that tune the whole serving stack to a customer's real traffic.
business_model: usage-based inference API (serverless per token) plus reserved and dedicated endpoints with SLAs
product_category: AI inference cloud and GPU kernel optimization
market_need_then: Demand for cheaper inference on open models was rising in 2025 and GPU supply and kernel talent were constrained, pushing buyers to look for non Nvidia hardware and tuned stacks.
outcome_analysis: Wafer entered YC in Summer 2025 as a GPU kernel optimization company and by September 2026 announced a $40M Series A co-led by Marathon and Chemistry, with AMD Ventures participating. Press says it turned down acquisition offers. Growth came from the inference cost squeeze, non Nvidia hardware interest and a shift from kernel automation toward a full inference cloud.

name: Waffle
one_liner: AI Video Editor
long_description: AI video editor with hundreds of templates for reels, shorts, and tiktoks. Make short-form content for marketing or personal use.
regions: United Kingdom; Europe
target_customer: Marketers and individual creators who produce short form video for TikTok, Reels and Shorts
problem: Producing a steady stream of short form video for marketing is slow and expensive. Waffle offered an AI editor with hundreds of templates, and its site now describes a tool to run a TikTok campaign with an AI creator network.
business_model: software subscription (pricing not stated in sources opened)
product_category: AI short form video creation and posting
market_need_then: Short form video demand from marketers was large in early 2025 and CapCut dominated creator editing, while AI generated video tools were multiplying.
outcome_analysis: Waffle joined YC in Spring 2025 as a two person London team building a template driven AI video editor. No funding, acquisition or shutdown news was found, so the outcome is unknown and the company is listed as active. Its homepage now describes an AI creator network for TikTok marketing, which suggests a move up the stack from editing toward campaign automation.

name: Wardstone
tags: Hard Tech; Satellites; Rocketry; Aerospace; Defense
one_liner: The Modular Interceptor Platform
long_description: Wardstone builds a low-cost, modular interceptor platform for air and missile defense. Our platform enables the warfighter to right sizes their interceptors against the threat. This allows us to defeat air-breathing and ballistic missile threats at a fraction of the cost of exquisite interceptors, adding affordable magazine depth to existing air defense systems.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: US and allied defense customers (Department of War, missile defense programs) buying air and missile interceptors
problem: Exquisite interceptors cost far more than the threats they defeat and magazines are shallow. Wardstone builds a low cost modular interceptor platform; its launch post describes space based kinetic interceptors, starting with a product called Hailstorm.
business_model: defense hardware contracts and development awards
product_category: missile defense interceptors and space based interceptors
market_need_then: Interceptor cost exchange ratios and shortages were a prominent defense concern in 2025, with the DIU pushing cheaper counter UAS interceptors.
outcome_analysis: Wardstone entered YC in Fall 2025 with two brothers from Amazon Prime Air, Cruise, Lockheed and Astranis backgrounds, aiming to field cheap interceptors. Aggregators report a roughly $5M seed and a planned prototype flight in spring 2026, but the outcome of that flight and later funding are not confirmed. The record is early with no exit or failure signal.

name: Wavedash
one_liner: Play the latest games in your browser with no downloads
long_description: Wavedash uses cutting edge browser technology to let gamers play the latest releases with no downloads or installation.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Players who want instant play, and game studios paying for web porting and distribution on the platform
problem: Playing modern games requires large downloads, launchers and hardware. Wavedash runs games locally in the browser through WebAssembly and WebGPU so a link starts play in seconds.
business_model: game storefront with developer revenue share plus porting services for studios
product_category: browser based PC game platform
founder_names: Kyler Blue; Raymond (George) Kennedy; Matthew Portner
market_need_then: Browser capabilities (WebAssembly, WebGPU) had matured by 2025 and install friction hurts game discovery, but demand for high end games in tabs was unproven.
outcome_analysis: Wavedash joined YC in Spring 2025 and raised a $4.3M seed led by Floodgate with a public beta on 2025-12-15 and a launch title from indie developer Walaber. Founders have prior consumer and music startup exits. Whether developers port to a new storefront remains the open risk, and the company is still active with no exit.

name: Wayline
one_liner: AI voice for property managers
long_description: Wayline is an AI front desk assistant purpose-built for real estate to answer calls and messages 24/7. It’s like an always-on property manager that can convert leads and resolve issues better than any human, day or night. Our AI can be setup in as little as 24 hours and works seamlessly with existing phone/management software. Uniquely, our AI knowledge base is domain-specific to learn and handle the most complex real estate workflows. For property operators, Wayline instantly replaces robo-menus and call centers, while centralizing and scaling back-office teams.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Property managers and real estate operators who need calls and messages answered from tenants and prospects
problem: Property teams miss calls and spend staff time on leasing inquiries, maintenance triage and support. Wayline provides an AI front desk with human property managers as backup.
business_model: B2B SaaS plus human backed call handling (pricing not public; book a demo)
product_category: AI voice and text front desk for real estate
market_need_then: Property operators had constant inbound call volume and staffing cost, and AI voice became good enough in 2025 for leasing and maintenance triage; incumbents were shipping voice launches at the same time.
outcome_analysis: Wayline joined YC in Summer 2025 with a founder pair that has property management and prior YC and exit experience. It sells an AI plus human front desk to property managers with named operator customers on its site. No exit or shutdown was found and funding detail is limited to aggregator reports, so the outcome is still open.

name: Waypoint Transit
one_liner: We automate urban planning so cities can build cheaper and faster.
long_description:
Waypoint Transit is an AI city planner that generates civil infrastructure studies. Cities spend $50B/year on planning. With Waypoint, cities can generate reports in months rather than years, and at 30% of the cost.

Varun and Ryan met at Stanford, where they graduated with degrees in CS and EE respectively. Before founding Waypoint, Varun worked on AI at Microsoft and Ryan worked on chip design at Apple.

US cities are facing three major crises: congestion, budget deficits, and climate change. At the same time, city governments are understaffed and frequently need to contract work out to expensive consultants. Leveraging recent advancements in AI, we empower cities to reduce their costs, build infrastructure, and respond to problems quickly.

In the United States, state and local governments spend $50B/year on planning. Through automation, we can redefine the existing transportation and urban planning consulting markets.

For more information, visit waypointtransit.com or contact us at contact@waypointtransit.com.
regions: Unspecified
target_customer: Municipalities, counties, transit agencies and regional planning bodies that buy planning studies from consultants
problem: Civil infrastructure and transportation studies take years and cost heavily through consulting firms. Waypoint uses AI to connect planning data and generate studies and analyses faster.
business_model: project based studies and software for city planners (pricing not public)
product_category: AI city planning and civil infrastructure studies
market_need_then: Local governments rely on slow consultant led studies and have tight budgets; the company says it delivers studies at about 30 percent of consulting cost, which is a company claim.
outcome_analysis: Waypoint Transit came out of YC Winter 2025 from two Stanford engineers whose transit signage side project became an AI planning tool. Its site lists projects for Santa Fe MPO, Teton County, Marin County, Berkshire County, Walnut Creek and Duluth. No exit or shutdown was found, and funding is unverified, so the company is early and the outcome is open.

name: Weave
one_liner: AI to understand and then route engineering work
long_description:
Weave builds AI to understand engineering work from prompt to production. We show how much faster AI is making your team, how that impacts quality, and what it's costing. 

Weave then takes that data to route all of your tasks to the most cost efficient model without compromising speed or quality.

Weave is used by over 500+ orgs from startups to public companies like Robinhood, Posthog and Telnyx.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Engineering organizations that want to measure engineering output and AI coding spend, from startups to large companies
problem: Leaders cannot tell how much AI coding tools change team speed, quality and cost. Weave builds models that measure engineering work and routes tasks to cost efficient models.
business_model: B2B SaaS for engineering intelligence plus a model router
product_category: engineering analytics and AI coding ROI
market_need_then: AI coding tool spend was growing fast in early 2025 and executives wanted proof of return, while classic DORA metrics did not capture AI effect.
outcome_analysis: Weave joined YC in Winter 2025 and positioned itself as the measurement layer for AI coding output. It raised a $4.2M seed in 2025 and a $13.5M round reported in July 2026, and its site claims 500 plus customer organizations including Robinhood and PostHog. Growth followed the AI coding spend wave, while analytics incumbents add competing dashboards.

name: Wedge
one_liner: AI Employees for Healthcare
long_description: The Operating System for Health AI: we deploy, govern, and scale AI agents across healthcare organizations.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Large hospitals, health plans and multi physician groups that want AI agents for back office work
problem: Hospitals are hesitant to adopt AI and lack engineers to build and govern agents. Wedge forward deploys engineers to build, monitor and maintain custom agents for tasks such as claims, coding and records retrieval.
business_model: services led B2B contracts with a shared agent platform
product_category: healthcare AI agents and governance
market_need_then: Health systems faced administrative burden and staffing pressure in 2025 and were piloting agents cautiously, with governance a stated concern.
outcome_analysis: Wedge joined YC in Summer 2025 with a two person team selling forward deployed health AI agents. Its site claims pilots at 60 plus locations and 1.8M plus patients served, which are company claims. No exit, shutdown or verified funding was found, so the outcome is open and the company is early.

name: Willow
one_liner: The voice interface replacing your keyboard
long_description:
Willow is an AI dictation app that lets you type with your voice. Built to 4x the productivity of anyone spending too much time on email, docs, and AI prompting workflows.

We’re Mac-only for now. You can try it free at WillowVoice.com
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Knowledge workers and teams who write a lot of email, messaging and AI prompts; individual subscribers and company teams
problem: Typing is slow for people who spend hours on email, docs and AI prompting, and built-in OS dictation is inaccurate and unformatted.
business_model: Freemium consumer and prosumer subscription with a weekly free word allowance, plus team plans
product_category: AI voice dictation app
market_need_then: Rising use of AI prompting and email-heavy work created demand for fast voice input, and speech models had become accurate enough for formatted dictation by 2024 and 2025.
outcome_analysis: Willow is an active Spring 2025 company that raised a reported 4.2 million seed from BoxGroup and others around mid 2025 and reportedly grew headcount through early 2026. It rides the shift toward voice input for AI prompting, but it competes with well funded rivals using the same models, so its outcome is still open. No acquisition, layoffs or shutdown were found.

name: Woz
one_liner: Claude Code plugin that reduces token consumption and cost by 50%
long_description:
WOZCODE is the highest performing, lowest cost AI coding agent. Available via Claude Code Plugin. 

The WOZCODE plugin outperforms Claude Code alone on all key metrics:

Cost: 25-55% cheaper
Speed: 5-10x faster on database tasks, 30-40% faster on most others
Performance: beats Claude code on Terminal Bench 2.0 (68% vs 58%)

Install with one command. Access directly via Claude Code

Your tools, your workflows, but Better, Faster, Cheaper.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Developers and teams using Claude Code who want lower token cost and faster runs
problem: Claude Code usage consumes many tokens through tool calls and context growth. WOZCODE replaces tool calls with custom tools to cut cost and time.
business_model: Plugin for an AI coding agent, subscription or usage pricing, details not found
product_category: AI coding agent efficiency plugin
market_need_then: AI coding agent bills were a visible pain; many guides and tools on cutting Claude Code token use appeared, showing demand.
outcome_analysis: Woz joined YC in Winter 2025 with two MIT trained founders, raised 6 million dollars in seed funding in October 2025 and then agreed to be bought by Kapital for 30 million dollars in cash and stock in October 2026. One report says the deal is mainly for the team and that the plugin is the smaller asset. The result is a soft exit for a small team in a thin layer on top of a platform.

name: YouLearn
one_liner: AI tutor for each student.
long_description: YouLearn is an AI tutor for college students. It turns your learning materials into concise notes, an AI tutor you can talk to, and personalized tests.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: College students who pay a subscription for study help
problem: Students juggle generic chatbots, flashcard apps and notes tools that give quick answers without lasting understanding.
business_model: Freemium consumer subscription for students
product_category: AI tutor and study tools
founder_names: David Yu; Achyut Krishna Byanjankar; Soami Kapadia
market_need_then: Students already used ChatGPT, Quizlet and Notion together, and the founders cite that fragmented workflow; generative AI made automatic notes and tests feasible.
outcome_analysis: YouLearn is an active Spring 2025 company. Per its YC launch post it reached about 150,000 monthly users and grew revenue from 1K to 70K monthly in eight months, helped by the CEO's education content audience. Funding is not verified, and the market is crowded with general assistants, so the long run outcome is open.

name: YouShift
tags: Health Tech; Healthcare; HR Tech; Operations; AI
one_liner: The OS for hospital workforce management
long_description: YouShift uses AI to automate hospital shift scheduling, replacing legacy software and eliminating the need for full-time schedulers. And scheduling is just the beginning — we're building the future of healthcare workforce management.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Hospitals and physician groups that schedule doctors and clinical staff
problem: Hospital shift scheduling runs on legacy software and full-time schedulers, causing swap, compliance and fairness headaches.
business_model: B2B SaaS for hospital workforce scheduling, expanding toward payroll, credentialing and analytics
product_category: Healthcare workforce management software
founder_names: Lucía Vives Martorell; Jota Chamorro; Adolfo Roquero Gimenez
market_need_then: Hospitals depend on full-time schedulers and legacy tools, and healthcare staffing strain made automation attractive; the YC page claims 1,000+ doctors on the product.
outcome_analysis: YouShift is an active Winter 2025 company selling AI scheduling to hospitals. The Harvard Crimson reported an Xfund grant in 2023 and aggregators report a roughly 500K pre-seed or seed around the batch. No outcome event was found, and incumbents plus other AI scheduling entrants make the path uncertain.

name: Zalos
tags: Fintech; Finance; Enterprise; Billing; AI Assistant
one_liner: Hire Zalos AI workers to run your finance department
long_description:
Zalos is the Finance Automation Workbench for enterprise finance teams.

Zero Integrations | Transparent Decisioning | Outcome-based Pricing

Learn more at www.zalos.ai/contact-us

Zalos AI Workers automate processes with improved accuracy, controls & auditability, using a Finance-specific agent harness & skill library.

Backed by Y Combinator, 14 Peaks, Cohen Circle and strategic angels such as CFO Fedex, Board Member TA Associates, COO Deel and more.

Hire Zalos AI workers such as:
• Zalos AI Staff Accountant
• Zalos AI Billing Analyst
• Zalos AI AP Analyst
• Zalos AI Treasury Manager

And more. Discuss your enterprise finance transformation at www.zalos.ai/contact-us
regions: United Kingdom; Europe
target_customer: Midmarket and enterprise finance teams (payroll, billing, AP, reconciliation) that run legacy ERPs and portals
problem: Finance teams do repetitive work in systems without usable APIs, such as reconciling invoices and payslips and filling portal forms, which is slow and error prone.
business_model: Outcome-based pricing for AI computer agents sold to enterprise finance teams
product_category: AI computer agents for finance operations
market_need_then: Enterprise finance work still depends on portals and legacy systems without APIs, and computer-use agents made automating them without integrations feasible around 2025.
outcome_analysis: Zalos is an active Fall 2025 company that announced a 3.6 million seed led by 14 Peaks in March 2026, carried by many outlets and a press release, with angels from FedEx and Tide finance leadership. It targets enterprise finance work in systems without APIs. No outcome event exists yet; execution against AI-native ERPs and RPA vendors will decide it.

name: Zarna
one_liner: AI Associates for Middle-Market Private Equity
long_description:
Zarna is private equity's first AI associate class. 

Built for BD teams at middle-market firms, our agents manage your CRM, source new opportunities, and prep you for every meeting. Runs natively in Outlook and Teams.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Middle-market private equity and investment banking firms, specifically business development teams
problem: Deal teams spend time on CRM data entry, sourcing, teaser screening and meeting prep, and generic copilots do not know a firm's history or decision making.
business_model: Usage-based or pilot-based B2B subscription for AI associate agents (pricing per aggregator profiles, unverified)
product_category: AI agents for private capital markets
founder_names: Rishabh Dhariwal; Vivan Agrawal; Hrishi Joshi; Rakesh Mehta
market_need_then: PE business development relies on manual CRM upkeep and sourcing; the founders saw this directly as forward-deployed engineers at a PE firm.
outcome_analysis: Zarna is an active Fall 2025 company founded by four Berkeley alumni who worked as forward-deployed engineers at a PE firm, and it markets AI associates to middle-market deal teams with named quotes from one fund and an unnamed 20B firm. No funding announcement was found. It faces funded rivals and incumbent CRM vendors adding AI, so the outcome is open.

name: Zavo
one_liner: Data research lab for frontier AI.
long_description:
Zavo is a research lab focused on data across complex domains. We develop specialized datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and evaluations in partnership with frontier AI labs to advance AI capabilities in high-value, real-world settings.

partnerships@zavo.ai
regions: United Kingdom; Europe; Remote; Partly Remote
target_customer: Frontier AI labs that buy custom training data, RL environments and evaluations
problem: Frontier labs need specialized datasets, verifiable RL environments and evals across complex domains that general data vendors do not supply.
business_model: Custom data and environment contracts with AI labs plus off-the-shelf datasets
product_category: AI training data and RL environments
market_need_then: Labs were reportedly spending heavily on RL environments by September 2025 (press reports of billion dollar spending discussions), creating demand for specialist vendors.
outcome_analysis: Zavo is an active Fall 2025 company in London and San Francisco selling data and RL environments to frontier AI labs. No funding, customers or outcome were found in primary or credible sources, and no news after the batch exists. The market is crowded with larger data vendors, so little can be said beyond its early stage.

name: Zeon Systems
tags: Robotic Process Automation; Robotics; Automation; AI
one_liner: AI-powered robotics for scientific lab automation.
long_description:
We’re building AI-powered systems that automate manual work in scientific labs using robotics.

Scientists simply type their experiment in plain English. Zeon translates it into code and runs it on robotic arms (no coding required).

By controlling robots with natural language, we’re enabling automation for every lab, every scientist, and every experiment.

Zeon is lab-aware. It detects equipment, adapts to protocols, and moves autonomously between instruments to execute full workflows.

We’re already deployed at labs across the US to accelerate discovery. Zeon reclaims time for what matters most: the science.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Academic and biotech research labs that run manual bench experiments
problem: Scientists lose time on manual lab work and robot programming; lab automation normally needs coding expertise and expensive custom setups.
business_model: Hardware and software system sold or piloted with labs, using off-the-shelf robot arms
product_category: AI lab automation robotics
market_need_then: Lab work is manual and lab robots struggle to replace simple tasks like pipetting; AI models made natural language to robot code more plausible by 2025.
outcome_analysis: Zeon Systems is an active Spring 2025 company building AI driven lab robotics, with reported pilots at university labs and community events in 2026. No funding was verified. Hardware heavy work and well funded lab automation rivals leave its trajectory uncertain, and no outcome event has occurred.

name: Zephyr Fusion
tags: Fusion Energy; Hard Tech; Satellites; Aerospace
one_liner: Powering tomorrow's industrial revolution in space
long_description:
Zephyr Fusion is building the first in-orbit fusion power source: a megawatt-class reactor enabling large-scale industry in space, at a fraction of the cost of equivalent solar.

Founded by former physicists from Lawrence Livermore and Oak Ridge National Laboratories, Zephyr leverages decades of fusion research to deliver a compact magnetic confinement system designed to take advantage of the space environment.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Space industry operators needing megawatt-scale orbital power for manufacturing, data centers, defense and propulsion
problem: Space operations are power-starved, and solar is costly at megawatt scale; the company proposes in-orbit fusion power using the vacuum of space for plasma confinement.
business_model: Develop a megawatt-class in-orbit fusion power source and sell power to space customers (pre-revenue)
product_category: Space fusion power
market_need_then: Launch costs had fallen roughly tenfold over a decade per the company's pitch, and growing interest in orbital data centers and manufacturing created demand for large amounts of power in space.
outcome_analysis: Zephyr Fusion is an active Fall 2025 deep tech company led by two plasma physicists with national lab and Wisconsin backgrounds, pursuing in-orbit dipole fusion. Funding is small and mostly aggregator reported, with an investor post from Tekedia Capital in May 2026. The technical risk is extreme and no hardware has flown, so any outcome is a long dated bet.

name: ZeroEntropy
one_liner: Artificial Specialized Intelligence
long_description:
We are on a mission to build the world’s most accurate, fastest, and cheapest task-specific models for every production AI system.

Most AI products, whether copilots, agents, or search systems, depend on frontier LLMs to handle every step of their pipeline. 

Yet, the vast majority of these steps are narrow, repeatable workloads: reranking, embedding, classification, routing, query rewriting, context compression, where frontier intelligence is overkill. 

Running them on general-purpose models is slow and expensive, capping what production AI can achieve. 

That is why we're building ZeroEntropy: to train small, task-specific models that replace frontier LLMs on these workloads, and empower developers to ship AI products that are more accurate, faster, and cheaper.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: AI developers and companies running production retrieval and agent pipelines
problem: Production AI systems use expensive frontier LLMs for narrow steps like reranking and embedding, which is slow and costly, and retrieval accuracy is weak.
business_model: Usage-based API for rerankers and embeddings plus custom models and enterprise deployments
product_category: AI retrieval models and search infrastructure
market_need_then: RAG and agent builders needed better retrieval quality and lower latency than general LLMs gave. The company reported customers such as Assembled, Profound, Sendbird and Mem0.
outcome_analysis: ZeroEntropy raised a 4.2M seed in July 2025 after YC Winter 2025, shipped open competitive rerankers and embeddings with named customers, and was acquired by Notion in July 2026 with the team forming a model research group. It reads as a technical team led acquisition where quality models beat incumbents on benchmarks. Price is undisclosed.

name: a0.dev
tags: Developer Tools; Generative AI; Design; AI
one_liner: We make mobile apps using AI.
long_description: a0.dev is a platform that helps mobile developers build high quality apps in days instead of weeks by generating custom react native projects. We've launched top ranking apps that have been used by hundreds of thousands, and now we're creating the tools we wish we had to build faster.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Mobile app developers and indie makers who want to ship React Native apps quickly
problem: Setting up navigation, state and every screen of a mobile app from scratch takes weeks. a0.dev generates custom React Native projects from chat so apps ship in days.
business_model: Subscription with usage limits (daily message limits noted by reviewers), plus built-in payments tooling for makers
product_category: AI mobile app builder (developer tools)
market_need_then: Strong developer appetite for AI coding and app generation in early 2025, and a claimed hundreds of thousands of users by the company's own figures (unverified).
outcome_analysis: a0.dev is an Active early-stage company from Winter 2025 with no exit or shutdown found. It claims a large user base from viral app-building tools and added iOS builds, store submission and payments in 2025, but funding and revenue are not public, so no outcome judgment on success is supported yet.

name: args
one_liner: A better GItHub
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Software developers and engineering teams unhappy with GitHub
problem: Developers want a faster, higher quality code hosting and review platform than GitHub, with stacked diffs and integrated CI.
business_model: Hosted git platform, likely subscription; pricing not found
product_category: Code hosting and developer collaboration platform
market_need_then: Developer complaints about GitHub reliability and AI-heavy direction; the company's Show HN pitch is anti-AI and quality focused, drawing 285 points and 264 comments in June 2026 per a community listing.
outcome_analysis: Args, a Summer 2025 YC company, is Active with no exit found. A search tying its YC tagline to the open source gitdot project suggests it launched publicly in 2026 with a strong Hacker News reception but without issues, pull requests or CI at first, so it is too early to judge success or failure.

name: assistant-ui
tags: Developer Tools; Generative AI; Chat; Web Development; AI Assistant
one_liner: Open Source React.js Library for AI Chat
long_description: assistant-ui helps frontend developers add AI chat to their apps. Our product is used by several dozen companies, like LangChain, Stack AI, Browser Use, and Athena Intelligence. We're building an open source Typescript/React library and a backend as a service, with first class integrations into popular agent frameworks like LangGraph and Vercel AI SDK.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Frontend and AI application developers who need a chat interface for their agents
problem: Building a production quality AI chat UI (streaming, tool calls, attachments) is slow; assistant-ui offers open source React primitives plus a hosted backend for thread storage.
business_model: Open source MIT library with a paid hosted backend (Assistant Cloud) priced by usage and enterprise tiers
product_category: Open source developer library and backend as a service for AI chat
market_need_then: Rapid growth of LLM apps in 2024 created demand for chat UI components; the first version was built for the founder's own app after friends asked about it.
outcome_analysis: assistant-ui grew quickly as an open source chat UI library on the 2024 to 2025 LLM app wave, with named customers in the agent ecosystem and rising GitHub and download numbers. Funding is not publicly confirmed beyond YC, and well funded rivals such as CopilotKit and Vercel mean outcome remains open.

name: awen
one_liner: awen translates intent into exceptional visuals through conversation
long_description:
AI creative tools became powerful quickly. But they also got complicated. Most of them require creatives to do the engineering.

Prompts.
Parameters.
Node graphs.

Creative work doesn’t start there. It starts with thinking, exploring directions, and iterating on ideas. With Awen, we’re trying a different approach: 

A creative partner that turns intent into exceptional visuals through conversation.
regions: France; Europe; Remote; Fully Remote
target_customer: Creative teams in design, advertising, e-commerce and video production, including enterprise brands and media groups
problem: AI image and video tools require prompts, parameters and node graphs, which makes creatives do engineering. awen turns intent into visuals through conversation.
business_model: B2B SaaS with team workspaces and enterprise security
product_category: Conversational generative AI creative tool
market_need_then: Creative teams were adopting generative AI but found prompt and node based tools complex, per the company's own pitch.
outcome_analysis: awen is Active from Winter 2025 and shows enterprise customer logos (M6, Kering, Havas) on its site. No funding, shutdown or acquisition is confirmed by company or press sources, so success or failure cannot yet be judged.

name: b12 Labs
one_liner: Making hard molecules for Pharma and Biotech
long_description:
b12 makes high-value molecules that are otherwise hard to make. We help pharma companies plan and make new drugs, accelerating early-stage drug discovery from years to months.

Andres built the first AI agent that can autonomously think and make molecules in a robotic lab, published in Nature Machine Intelligence (1000+ citations), and won the best paper award at the NeurIPS AI for Science conference.
Zlatko is a 3x National Chemistry Olympiad champion, competed at IChO level, and medicinal chemist who has worked at Roche and leading lab robotics companies. 

Combined, we have an extensive network of hundreds of chemists, automation scientists, and AI 4 Science researchers.

We run paid pilots with big pharma companies, demonstrating that our platform planned a set of experiments that achieved full conversion in a single attempt, eliminating the iteration cycle.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Pharma and biotech companies that need hard to make molecules for early drug discovery
problem: Planning and making difficult molecules takes years of iteration. b12 uses AI agents with robotic partner labs to plan and run chemistry end to end.
business_model: Paid pilots and services with pharma customers, running the b12 Foundry lab system
product_category: AI for science, autonomous chemistry
market_need_then: Pharma is paying for pilots; the company claims paid pilots with large pharma where a planned experiment set achieved full conversion on the first attempt (company claim, unverified).
outcome_analysis: b12 Labs is an Active Summer 2025 company with strong founder credentials in AI chemistry and early paid pharma pilots by its own account. It has launched the b12 Foundry and exhibits at lab automation events, but funding and revenue are not confirmed publicly, so outcome is still open.

name: burnt
one_liner: Agentic Operating System for Food Supply Chain
long_description:
Food Supply Chain companies have been using legacy ERPs for decades. Everyone knows these are necessary evils that essentially run the business but take up a lot of operational capacity. They are not about to just rip and replace their existing system that runs their whole business with a system that takes years to implement. Imagine if they could implement AI that runs the ERP for them, in weeks?

Burnt’s building an agentic OS for the Food Supply Chain with AI Agents for each department. 

Our AI Agent, Ozai, has started by replacing the whole order management job function at food distribution companies, so that sales and customer service teams can focus on what matters - the customer. Ozai monitors all incoming messages (emails, phone calls, voicemails, whatsapp, fax etc.), figures out if it's an order, learns each customer's habits, shorthand, and favorite products, picks up on any prep notes, and enters it straight into the existing ERP. It'll even go back to the customers on your behalf when it's not sure about something, clarify things and carry on working. 

The more it sees, the smarter it gets.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Food distributors (seafood, specialty and packaged food) that run orders through legacy ERPs
problem: Order entry from email, phone, WhatsApp and fax is manual and consumes sales and customer service capacity. Ozai reads incoming messages and enters orders into the existing ERP.
business_model: B2B SaaS agents sold to distributors, expanding by department
product_category: Agentic AI for food supply chain operations
founder_names: Joseph Jacob; Rhea Karimpanal; Chandru Shanmugasundaram
market_need_then: Legacy ERPs are entrenched and order desks are manual; the company reports over 10M USD of monthly orders processed and six figure revenue after a January 2025 launch (company claims).
outcome_analysis: Burnt raised a 3.8M USD seed in September 2025 within months of YC Summer 2025, led by Penny Jar Capital, on founder domain insight in food distribution and a January 2025 launch with claimed traction. Competition from Choco and Pepper is intense, but no negative event is found and the company is Active.

name: careCycle
one_liner: Voice AI teams for medicare agencies.
long_description:
careCycle is an AI workforce for medicare agencies and FMOs - helping leading agencies achieve 5x higher conversions, 37% better retention, and saving thousands of agent hours.

We're transforming how Medicare agencies handle member relationships with teams of voice AI agents. We're solving the industry's biggest challenge: 50% annual member churn caused by poor post-enrollment engagement.

Our multi-agent AI teams work together to handle the entire customer journey - from initial contact through enrollment and ongoing care. When a lead comes in after hours, one AI agent answers and schedules a callback, another calls at the perfect time, a third captures qualifying information, and a fourth handles the warm transfer to a licensed agent. This approach helped a leading FMO write over $2M in renewals during AEP 2024 while reducing agent talk time by 20% per sale.

We've pioneered a purpose-built solution for Medicare's unique compliance requirements. Unlike generic AI platforms, our system features built-in HIPAA/CMS compliance, real-time data structuring, and seamless CRM integration. This enables agencies of all sizes to deliver enterprise-grade member care without massive infrastructure investments.

Early metrics show the power of our approach:

- 5x increase in after-hours conversion rates
- 37% improvement in 90-day retention
- 3,000+ agent hours saved in a single AEP
- $2M+ in additional renewals during AEP 2024

The Medicare Advantage market represents a massive opportunity, with over $360B in annual premiums and growing 10% year over year. By solving the member retention challenge, we're positioning ourselves to capture significant value by transforming the member care experience for beneficiaries.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Medicare agencies, independent agents and field marketing organizations (FMOs), later also beneficiaries
problem: Medicare agencies lose members to roughly 50% annual churn and miss after-hours leads. Teams of voice AI agents handle intake, callbacks, qualification, warm transfer and post-enrollment engagement.
business_model: B2B SaaS for voice AI workforce, with HIPAA and CMS compliance built in
product_category: Vertical voice AI for Medicare distribution
market_need_then: Medicare Advantage is a large market with high churn and seasonal enrollment peaks; the company reports an FMO writing over 2M USD in renewals and saving 3,000 agent hours in the 2024 enrollment period (company claim).
outcome_analysis: careCycle focused a voice AI product on Medicare distribution, reported renewals and retention gains in its first enrollment season, raised a reported 2M USD seed after YC Winter 2025 and in October 2026 expanded to a free consumer tool. Traction claims are company reported and larger horizontal rivals exist, but it is Active.

name: chrt
tags: Autonomous Shipping; Logistics; Healthcare; Manufacturing; Industrial
one_liner: chrt is a logistics platform for time-critical shipping
long_description:
chrt is a logistics platform for time-critical shipping. We enable businesses to deliver their most critical items same-day.

Time-Critical Logistics is a $30B market growing at a 20% CAGR driven by growth in American healthcare and manufacturing.

Businesses that place time-critical orders are enterprises who have urgent items they need to deliver ASAP. These orders are critical in nature and often require white glove service -- think therapeutic treatments for healthcare providers or specialized equipment for manufacturers. 

chrt builds the software for forwarders and professional couriers who pick up and deliver these orders. Couriers use chrt to coordinate and track their shipments, including a driver app and fleet management tools. Forwarders use chrt to dispatch couriers, book flights, and track time-critical orders from start to finish. Shippers use chrt to place these orders with their providers and to monitor everything. 

In addition, we also sell physical tracking devices that can be used to track valuable cargo or assets.

This gives us full control of the shipment and allows us to provide shippers with end-to-end tracking. It also allows us to intervene early if we notice something is going wrong.

We’re software engineers that became friends years ago at McKinsey. Kyle is an expert in Time-Critical Logistics, having led strategy at a leader in the space. Aaron is an expert at designing and implementing AI systems to handle complex coordination. We were shipping code together on nights and weekends for years before chrt; now we’re also shipping freight.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Freight forwarders, professional couriers and shippers of time-critical items in healthcare and manufacturing
problem: Same-day, white glove shipments are coordinated by phone and spreadsheets. chrt provides dispatch, courier apps, booking and end-to-end tracking, including physical tracker devices.
business_model: B2B SaaS TMS for forwarders and couriers plus hardware tracker sales
product_category: Time-critical logistics software
market_need_then: Founders cite a 30B USD time-critical logistics market growing about 20% per year, driven by healthcare and manufacturing (company claim).
outcome_analysis: chrt is an Active Spring 2025 company led by founders with prior time-critical logistics and consulting experience, selling software and trackers to a niche market. Funding is unconfirmed beyond aggregator entries and no negative events are found, so its outcome is still open.

name: cocreate
one_liner: video production software
long_description:
Cocreate was built alongside our friends and colleagues — editors and their assistants, DITs, post supervisors, and UPMs — to design something that will keep individual professionals competitive in a landscape rapidly overrun by needless automation.

We've spent the past few years collecting as many grumbling stories of production and post production inefficiency; lost footage, wasted time. Shots un-slated, timecodes un-jammed, script supervisor notes incoherent; days wasted on menial tasks.

What if there was a tool to take care of all that?
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Assistant editors, DITs, post supervisors and post houses in film, TV and commercial production
problem: Footage ingest and prep work (offload, checksums, proxies, slating, syncing, organizing) wastes days of skilled editorial time before cutting can start.
business_model: B2B software licensed to post-production teams (pricing not public; demo and download offered)
product_category: Post-production workflow and media management software
market_need_then: Founders say they collected stories of lost footage, un-slated shots and wasted days in production and post; YC and the company frame the demand as editorial inefficiency amid AI automation.
outcome_analysis: Active as of 2026-11 with no reported exit, shutdown or layoffs. A trade feature appeared in February 2026. Outcome is too early to judge; the wedge is a niche but painful workflow for assistant editors, and the main risks are a small market and copying by established dailies tools.

name: cubic
one_liner: AI-powered code review platform
long_description:
Code review is a major bottleneck for software teams, and the rise of AI-generated code is making the problem worse. Reviewing large volumes of code slows devs down, and increases the chances of bugs slipping through.

That's why we're building cubic: an intelligent code review platform that helps devs merge PRs 28% faster.

How? 
- When you open a PR, cubic automatically reviews it. It learns from your codebase's patterns, points out bugs, suggesting fixes, and frees you from low-level review tasks.
- You then jump into the cubic platform, which is designed to optimize how humans review code. For example, file changes are organized in a logical order instead of alphabetical, and cubic generates diagrams of architecture changes.
regions: United Kingdom; Europe
target_customer: Software engineering teams (developer seats), including open source projects
problem: AI-generated code floods pull requests and human review becomes the bottleneck; bugs slip through.
business_model: Per-developer SaaS tiers (free, $30, $79, $160 per developer yearly plus enterprise) with usage overages
product_category: AI code review
market_need_then: Rising AI-generated code volume in 2025 made review the bottleneck, which is the problem YC and the company cite.
outcome_analysis: Active as of 2026-11. Named customers such as Cal.com and n8n and the cubic 2.0 launch in January 2026 show product traction, but the field is crowded with CodeRabbit, Greptile, Graphite and platform vendors. Outcome is open; no exit or distress found.

name: dari.dev
one_liner: The Routing Layer for AI Agents
long_description:
We let developers run more agents while keeping your token bill low. We train custom models to determine how we can maintain performance while reducing your token bill. 

Integrate into your own apps, or use our router with Claude Code, Codex, or any agent of your choice.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Developers and teams running coding or business AI agents that want lower token bills
problem: Running many agents is expensive in tokens, and deploying agents to production needs sandboxes, sessions and logs.
business_model: Usage-based router and agent deployment; no markup initially, BYOK supported
product_category: LLM routing and agent deployment infrastructure
market_need_then: Token costs for agent workloads were a visible pain in 2025; the company pitches cost reduction while keeping performance.
outcome_analysis: Active as of 2026-11 and too early to judge. The company moved from a browser agent to a routing and deployment layer, in a space with many gateways, so differentiation and distribution are the open questions.

name: hillclimb
one_liner: Training Data for Recursive Self-Improvement
long_description: We work with frontier AI labs to help train their agents to become AI research scientists
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Frontier AI labs buying training data and RL environments
problem: Labs need expert-quality training data and environments (starting with competition math) to improve reasoning and AI research agents.
business_model: Sells datasets and RL environments to AI labs; expert contractor network
product_category: AI training data and RL environments
competitors_at_founding: Mercor, Surge, Handshake, Turing; Scale AI
market_need_then: In 2025 labs shifted spending to RL environments and expert data; TechCrunch reported in September 2025 that Silicon Valley was betting heavily on environments.
outcome_analysis: Active as of 2026-11 and too early to call. The team shows a lab partnership with Nous Research and a math expert network, but vendors with far more capital sell the same product and labs are in-housing, so durability depends on keeping scarce expert supply.

name: idler
one_liner: Hill-climb any benchmark, for any model, in any domain.
long_description: idler is a frontier data research lab. We build the evals and environments that the world's leading frontier labs use to measure and train their models.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Frontier AI labs buying evals and RL environments; also businesses licensing codebases or operating data
problem: Labs need realistic environments and evals built from real production work to measure and train models.
business_model: Sells RL environments and datasets to labs; sources data from licensing businesses' codebases and de-identified operating data
product_category: AI evals and RL environments
founder_names: Ivan Chub; Nalu Concepcion; Tony Goss
market_need_then: Demand from labs for RL environments surged in 2025; idler says it built thousands of coding evals for an unnamed lab in its first year.
outcome_analysis: Active as of 2026-11. Reported $9M Paradigm-led seed and a public benchmark, plus a founding team with game-hacking and crypto lab backgrounds, suggest strong early momentum; the risks are lab in-housing and large data vendors.

name: item
one_liner: The AI-Native CRM that works for you
long_description:
item connects to all your customer tools, gathers and enriches context automatically, and becomes your company’s source of truth — one place where your team and your AI agents share the full picture to act autonomously.

At the center is the Assistant — your sidekick for daily work. It can send follow-ups, research leads, or add deals with a simple prompt. No complex UI, drop-downs or fields, simply ask.

For repeatable work, you build Agents that you can train like new hires, simply by writing documents that describe your processes. item Agents run business processes across sales, support, and account management autonomously.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Small and mid-size sales, support and account management teams replacing HubSpot or Salesforce
problem: Legacy CRMs need manual data entry and rigid fields; teams want agents that act on shared customer context.
business_model: B2B SaaS CRM with agents (pricing not public, sales-led)
product_category: AI-native CRM
market_need_then: Teams in 2025 wanted agentic CRM; startups like Attio raised large rounds on the thesis.
outcome_analysis: Active as of 2026-11 with named early customers on its site. It competes in a crowded AI CRM space where Attio and others raised large rounds, so distribution and differentiation will decide the outcome. Too early to judge.

name: mlop
tags: AIOps; Developer Tools; Machine Learning; SaaS

long_description: A fully open-source, performant and actionable ML model training platform
regions: United Kingdom; Europe
target_customer: ML engineers and teams training models, especially those on Weights & Biases
problem: Experiment tracking tools are closed, costly or slow; teams want an open-source, performant alternative.
business_model: Open-source core with hosted cloud and enterprise features; free tier, pricing not found
product_category: ML experiment tracking

outcome_analysis: Active as of 2026-11 with a solo founder listed and an open-source following. The market shifted in its favor when Neptune closed, but MLflow and ClearML are established and W&B compatibility cuts both ways. Too early to judge.

name: nao Labs
one_liner: Open Source Analytics Agent
long_description:
nao is an open source framework to build and deploy analytics agent.
Create the context of your analytics agent with nao-core cli: data, metadata, modeling, rules, etc. Deploy a UI for anyone to chat with your agent and run analytics on your data.
regions: France; Europe
target_customer: Data teams building analytics agents for company-wide data access; some SQL and dbt practitioners
problem: Analytics agents are unreliable without curated context; data teams need to build, test and deploy them safely.
business_model: Open-source (Apache 2.0) core plus paid nao Cloud
product_category: Open-source analytics agent framework
market_need_then: Demand for natural-language analytics rose in 2025; the company's launch positioned it as an AI editor for data work, later shifting to analytics agents.
outcome_analysis: Active as of 2026-11 with open-source traction and customers listed on its site, but competing with funded text-to-SQL and BI agent vendors. Positioning moved from data IDE to analytics agents. Too early to judge.

name: neoncoral
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Consumers (product not publicly described)
problem: Not stated. The company describes itself only as AI consumer social and is in stealth.
business_model: Unknown, consumer social with AI, no public monetization
product_category: Consumer social with AI (stealth)
market_need_then: Unproven. AI social products such as Butterflies and SocialAI had launched in 2024 but no source shows durable demand.
