Its outcome will turn on whether agent output meets real analog specs and whether it can outpace better funded analog AI startups and the big EDA vendors.

name: Aucert
tags: Developer Tools; SaaS; B2B; Automation; AI
one_liner: Expert AI agents that explore, understand, and verify mobile apps.
long_description:
AI made building apps fast. Verifying did not keep up: every mobile team, from a first release to a billion downloads, still waits on QA, design, accessibility, compliance and security checks for everything it builds.

Aucert is a team of expert AI agents that does that work in hours, with no scripts. Each agent explores the app on its own, learns how it should work, and finds the issues in its area. Aucert plugs into agentic coding workflows, so developers and coding agents fix issues in the same loop, on every build.

Live: Accessibility · Google Play policy
Beta: Validation (functional QA) · Design
Coming soon: Apple App Store policy · Security · Create your own
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Mobile-first engineering teams shipping high consequence apps and using coding agents
problem: AI made building apps fast but QA, design, accessibility, compliance and store policy checks still slow every release.
business_model: B2B SaaS of AI expert agents per build or team (pricing not public)
product_category: AI mobile app testing and certification
market_need_then: AI coding sped up app creation, raising demand for automated verification; rivals raised funds in 2025 and 2026.
outcome_analysis: Aucert is a two person Fall 2026 company launched in the batch, with senior mobile engineers from Meta, PhonePe and PayPal as founders. There is no exit or failure. Its outcome depends on whether agent verdicts are trusted enough to gate releases and on beating better known testing vendors.

name: Audora
one_liner: Audiobooks where every character has their own voice.
long_description:
Audora turns your book or story into an audiobook where every character has their own voice.

The best adaptation of a book is the one in your head. You can see the characters in front of you and hear them talking to each other. We want an audiobook to do those characters justice: a voice that fits each of them, so a conversation actually sounds like a conversation.

Paste a story link or upload a file. Audora works out who’s speaking and gives each character a distinct voice alongside the narrator. You can start listening while the rest of the book is still being made.

Our roots are in fanfiction. We’re building for readers who already know these characters by heart, with a focus on voices that capture their personalities and stay consistent throughout the story.

Try Audora: https://audora.art
Watch the demo: https://youtu.be/R6Pt2O0fD4c
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Readers of fanfiction and web fiction who want audio, plus authors ordering commercial audiobooks
problem: Most stories, especially fanfiction, have no audiobook and single voice narration does not make conversations sound like conversations.
business_model: Consumer subscription or per book plans for personal use, with paid commercial audiobook orders for authors
product_category: AI multi voice audiobook generation
competitors_at_founding: ElevenLabs Character Casting; Spoken; LyricWinter; Audible Character Guide
market_need_then: Fanfiction readers want audio; a June 2026 survey cited in coverage found AI narration trust falling from 70 to 61 percent willingness to try, a headwind.
outcome_analysis: Audora is a solo founder Fall 2026 company that just entered YC, so there is no outcome. The fandom roots give distribution insight, but well funded players already ship character casting, so durability depends on fandom community pull and voice quality.

name: Audun
one_liner: AI-native debt collection company
long_description: Audun automates debt collection.
regions: Norway; Europe
target_customer: Creditors and businesses with overdue invoices, starting in Norway
problem: Debt collection is slow, manual and often hostile; creditors want higher recovery and debtors want calmer settlement plans.
business_model: Collections services priced on recovery, using AI agents with human handover (pricing not public)
product_category: AI debt collection
founder_names: Jacob Hambro; Magnus Vonen; Henrik Brun Fevang; Peter Flo
market_need_then: Large incumbent collectors rely on manual processes and 2026 saw many AI collection launches and raises.
outcome_analysis: Audun is a four founder Summer 2026 Oslo company with consulting, engineering and Midjourney backgrounds. There is no exit or failure. Success depends on proving recovery rates versus Norwegian incumbents and well funded European AI collection startups.

name: Aurorin CAD
one_liner: Claude code for Mechanical Engineers
long_description:
There are 2 problems:

The first, CAD software is slow and the second, designing with it is a tedious process with many steps. Aurorin solves both of these problems by being a CAD software built from the ground up on a modern tech stack with AI at its heart.

Building the CAD kernel lets us fully leverage AI while modernizing execution speed. Almost all existing CAD software (Solidworks, NX, Creo, Catia, Fusion 360, Onshape etc) use the same couple of underlying CAD kernels built in the 80's. It's common for these programs to take 4 hours to open a file.

Aurorin uses a custom parametric and B-Rep driven CAD Kernel built to take full advantage of modern CPUs and GPUs and be AI native.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Mechanical engineers and engineering teams using SolidWorks, NX, Creo, Fusion 360 or Onshape
problem: Legacy CAD runs on 1980s kernels, is slow to open files, and designing is a tedious multi step process.
business_model: Free desktop download for individuals with paid team licensing by contact
product_category: AI-native mechanical CAD software with custom kernel
competitors_at_founding: Zoo (KittyCAD); AdamCAD; SolidWorks, Onshape and Fusion 360
market_need_then: Engineers complain about slow CAD (company claim of 4 hour file opens) and AI native tools drew attention in 2026.
outcome_analysis: Aurorin CAD is a solo founder Winter 2026 company building its own CAD kernel, with a free public launch in January 2026 and no exit or failure. The technical bet is large for one person, so the outcome hinges on kernel performance and file compatibility with existing CAD tools.

name: AutoSitu
one_liner: The AI operating system for the built world
long_description:
At AutoSitu, we’re building the AI operating system for the built world—coordinated AI agents that work across development, design, review, and construction.

Our agents analyze complex plans, requirements, and project documentation in minutes—surfacing critical issues, doing the heavy lifting, and escalating the decisions that require human expertise.

From site feasibility and entitlement risk to QA/QC, code compliance, constructability, quantity takeoff, and scope analysis, AutoSitu helps cities, architects, engineers, developers, and construction teams identify problems earlier and move projects forward with greater speed and confidence.

We serve as a strategic AI partner to forward-thinking public agencies and AEC organizations across the country and are backed by Y Combinator (W26).
regions: Unspecified
target_customer: City permitting departments and AEC firms (developers, architects, engineers, contractors) that pay for plan review software
problem: Development plans are reviewed slowly by cities, with many comment rounds and resubmittals that delay approvals by months.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to public agencies and AEC firms (pricing not public)
product_category: AI development plan review and AEC agents

It sells AI plan review into a crowded permitting market where CivCheck and Archistar already had city deployments, so its path depends on winning agencies and AEC firms with a broader pipeline from feasibility to construction. Company claims of 50 to 70 percent fewer city comments are unverified.

name: Autoresearch, Inc.
tags: Developer Tools; Machine Learning; Reinforcement Learning; Infrastructure; AI
one_liner: Autoresearch as a service: we solve your hardest measurable problems
long_description:
Autoresearch helps teams train agents for tasks where general models are not good enough. Give us a task, your current agent or model, and an evaluation. Autoresearch runs an autoresearch campaign across data, SFT and other post-training methods, continual learning, prompts, tools, harnesses, and systems, then returns the best verified improvement. It runs hosted or in your cloud.

We provide the research system around models: persistent memory, full experiment lineage, compute orchestration, and statistical verification. We’re starting with agent and model training, continual learning, and optimization.

Reach out to us for early access at founders@autoresearch.inc.
regions: United States of America; America / Canada
target_customer: Teams that need better performing AI agents or models and can supply a task and an evaluation
problem: Improving an agent or model through many experiments is slow. The company runs automated research campaigns across data, post-training, prompts, tools and systems and returns the best verified gain.
business_model: Research as a service, hosted or in the customer's cloud (pricing not published)
product_category: Automated ML research and optimization service
